## probes/phase4_ipc_network/28_ipv6_scmrights.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 28: IPv6 raw sockets + SCM_RIGHTS deep probe
-- From probe 27:
--   - AF_INET6 RAW works (ip6_input_hbh UAF surface)
--   - SCM_RIGHTS fd passing works
--   - No threading (fork/rfork/thr_new all blocked)
--   - dup/dup2 blocked, fstat blocked
--
-- Part 1: IPv6 raw socket options (setsockopt surface)
-- Part 2: IPv6 ancillary data (sendmsg with IPv6 options)
-- Part 3: SCM_RIGHTS stress — pass many fds, close racing
-- Part 4: SCM_RIGHTS with invalid/closed fds

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: IPV6 + SCM_RIGHTS ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_sendto = 133,
    sc_recvfrom = 29,
})

local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: IPv6 raw socket setsockopt surface
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: IPv6 raw socket options ---")

-- Create IPv6 raw socket (proto=0 or specific)
local s6_ok, s6_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(28, 3, 0) -- AF_INET6, SOCK_RAW, proto 0
end)
local raw6_fd = -1
if s6_ok then
    raw6_fd = s6_ret:tonumber()
    log("  raw6 socket: fd=" .. raw6_fd)
end

if raw6_fd >= 0 then
    local optval = memory.alloc(256)
    local optlen = memory.alloc(8)

    -- IPPROTO_IPV6 = 41
    local IPV6 = 41

    -- Test key IPv6 socket options
    local ipv6_opts = {
        {1, "IPV6_UNICAST_HOPS"},
        {2, "IPV6_MULTICAST_IF"}, -- was IPV6_MULTICAST_IF on older
        {8, "IPV6_V6ONLY"},
        {18, "IPV6_RECVTCLASS"},
        {25, "IPV6_RECVPKTINFO"},
        {26, "IPV6_RECVHOPLIMIT"},
        {27, "IPV6_RECVRTHDR"},      -- receive routing header
        {28, "IPV6_RECVHOPOPTS"},    -- receive hop-by-hop opts ← THE TARGET
        {29, "IPV6_RECVDSTOPTS"},    -- receive destination opts
        {36, "IPV6_RTHDR"},          -- set routing header
        {39, "IPV6_HOPOPTS"},        -- set hop-by-hop options ← KEY
        {40, "IPV6_DSTOPTS"},        -- set destination options
        {41, "IPV6_RTHDRDSTOPTS"},   -- dest opts before routing hdr
        {50, "IPV6_PKTINFO"},
        {51, "IPV6_HOPLIMIT"},
        {52, "IPV6_NEXTHOP"},
        {54, "IPV6_TCLASS"},
        {61, "IPV6_ORIGDSTADDR"},
    }

    for _, opt in ipairs(ipv6_opts) do
        -- Try getsockopt first
        memory.write_qword(optlen, 256)
        for i = 0, 31, 8 do memory.write_qword(optval + i, 0) end

        local g_ok, g_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_getsockopt(raw6_fd, IPV6, opt[1], optval, optlen)
        end)

        local info = ""
        if g_ok then
            local len = memory.read_qword(optlen):tonumber()
            local val = memory.read_dword(optval):tonumber()
            info = string.format("get:rv=%d len=%d val=%d", g_ret:tonumber(), len, val)
        else
            info = "get:ERR"
        end

        -- Try setsockopt (enable it)
        memory.write_dword(optval, 1) -- enable
        local s_ok, s_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw6_fd, IPV6, opt[1], optval, 4)
        end)
        info = info .. " set:" .. (s_ok and "rv=" .. s_ret:tonumber() or "ERR")

        log(string.format("  %-22s %s", opt[2], info))
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- PART 2: IPv6 HBH options via sendmsg ancillary data
    -- This is the ip6_input_hbh attack surface
    -- ============================================================
    log("")
    log("--- PART 2: IPv6 HBH ancillary data ---")

    -- First enable IPV6_HOPOPTS
    memory.write_dword(optval, 1)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw6_fd, IPV6, 39, optval, 4) end)

    -- Build a hop-by-hop options header
    -- Format: next_header(1) + hdr_ext_len(1) + options...
    -- Option TLV: type(1) + length(1) + data(length)
    -- PadN option: type=1, length=N-2, data=zeros
    local hbh = memory.alloc(64)
    -- 8-byte HBH header with PadN
    memory.write_byte(hbh, 59)   -- next header = no next
    memory.write_byte(hbh + 1, 0) -- hdr_ext_len = 0 (8 bytes total)
    memory.write_byte(hbh + 2, 1) -- PadN option type
    memory.write_byte(hbh + 3, 4) -- PadN length = 4 (6 bytes total with TL)
    memory.write_dword(hbh + 4, 0) -- padding

    -- Build cmsg with IPV6_HOPOPTS
    local cmsg = memory.alloc(64)
    -- CMSG header: cmsg_len(4) + cmsg_level(4) + cmsg_type(4) then data at +16
    local CMSG_DATA_OFF = 16
    local hbh_len = 8
    memory.write_dword(cmsg, CMSG_DATA_OFF + hbh_len) -- cmsg_len = 24
    memory.write_dword(cmsg + 4, IPV6)     -- cmsg_level = IPPROTO_IPV6
    memory.write_dword(cmsg + 8, 39)       -- cmsg_type = IPV6_HOPOPTS
    -- Copy HBH data
    for i = 0, hbh_len - 1 do
        memory.write_byte(cmsg + CMSG_DATA_OFF + i, memory.read_byte(hbh + i):tonumber())
    end

    -- Build target address (::1 = localhost IPv6)
    local dst = memory.alloc(32) -- sockaddr_in6
    memory.write_byte(dst, 28)   -- sin6_len
    memory.write_byte(dst + 1, 28) -- sin6_family = AF_INET6
    -- sin6_port at +2 = 0
    -- sin6_flowinfo at +4 = 0
    -- sin6_addr at +8 = ::1
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(dst + 8 + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(dst + 23, 1) -- ::1

    -- Build iovec
    local payload = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(payload, 0x4141414142424242)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, payload)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 8)

    -- Build msghdr
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh, dst)         -- msg_name
    memory.write_dword(mh + 8, 28)      -- msg_namelen
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)    -- msg_iov
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)      -- msg_iovlen
    memory.write_qword(mh + 32, cmsg)   -- msg_control
    memory.write_qword(mh + 40, 32)     -- msg_controllen (CMSG_SPACE(8))

    local sm_ok, sm_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(raw6_fd, mh, 0)
    end)
    log("  sendmsg with HBH: " .. (sm_ok and "rv=" .. sm_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- Try with malformed HBH (oversized length)
    memory.write_byte(hbh + 1, 255) -- hdr_ext_len = 255 (2048 bytes claimed)
    for i = 0, hbh_len - 1 do
        memory.write_byte(cmsg + CMSG_DATA_OFF + i, memory.read_byte(hbh + i):tonumber())
    end
    local sm2_ok, sm2_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(raw6_fd, mh, 0)
    end)
    log("  sendmsg malformed HBH: " .. (sm2_ok and "rv=" .. sm2_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- Try with large HBH option value
    memory.write_byte(hbh + 1, 1) -- hdr_ext_len=1 (16 bytes)
    memory.write_byte(hbh + 2, 0xC2) -- option type with "change" flag
    memory.write_byte(hbh + 3, 10)   -- option data length = 10
    memory.write_dword(cmsg, CMSG_DATA_OFF + 16) -- cmsg_len = 32
    memory.write_qword(mh + 40, 40) -- controllen
    for i = 0, 15 do
        memory.write_byte(cmsg + CMSG_DATA_OFF + i, memory.read_byte(hbh + i):tonumber())
    end
    local sm3_ok, sm3_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(raw6_fd, mh, 0)
    end)
    log("  sendmsg change-flag HBH: " .. (sm3_ok and "rv=" .. sm3_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(raw6_fd) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: SCM_RIGHTS stress — pass many fds
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: SCM_RIGHTS stress ---")

local sp = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local ssa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local ssb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()
log(string.format("  control pair: %d,%d", ssa, ssb))

-- Create a bunch of sockets to pass
local pass_fds = {}
for i = 1, 10 do
    local tmp = memory.alloc(8)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, tmp) end)
    local fa = memory.read_dword(tmp):tonumber()
    local fb = memory.read_dword(tmp + 4):tonumber()
    pass_fds[#pass_fds+1] = fa
    pass_fds[#pass_fds+1] = fb
end
log("  created " .. #pass_fds .. " fds to pass")

-- Pass multiple fds at once (up to 20 fds in one SCM_RIGHTS msg)
local n_pass = math.min(#pass_fds, 16)
local cmsg_multi = memory.alloc(256)
local cmsg_data_off = 16
local cmsg_total = cmsg_data_off + n_pass * 4
memory.write_dword(cmsg_multi, cmsg_total) -- cmsg_len
memory.write_dword(cmsg_multi + 4, 0xFFFF) -- SOL_SOCKET
memory.write_dword(cmsg_multi + 8, 1)       -- SCM_RIGHTS
for i = 0, n_pass - 1 do
    memory.write_dword(cmsg_multi + cmsg_data_off + i * 4, pass_fds[i + 1])
end

-- Align CMSG_SPACE
local cmsg_space = cmsg_total
if cmsg_space % 8 ~= 0 then cmsg_space = cmsg_space + (8 - cmsg_space % 8) end

local payload = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(payload, 0xBEEF)
local iov = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(iov, payload)
memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 4)

local mh_send = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh_send + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(mh_send + 16, iov)
memory.write_qword(mh_send + 24, 1)
memory.write_qword(mh_send + 32, cmsg_multi)
memory.write_qword(mh_send + 40, cmsg_space)

local ms_ok, ms_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(ssa, mh_send, 0) end)
log("  sendmsg " .. n_pass .. " fds: " ..
    (ms_ok and "rv=" .. ms_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- Receive them
local recv_cmsg = memory.alloc(256)
local recv_buf = memory.alloc(16)
local recv_iov = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(recv_iov, recv_buf)
memory.write_qword(recv_iov + 8, 16)

local mh_recv = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh_recv + i, 0) end
for i = 0, 255, 8 do memory.write_qword(recv_cmsg + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(mh_recv + 16, recv_iov)
memory.write_qword(mh_recv + 24, 1)
memory.write_qword(mh_recv + 32, recv_cmsg)
memory.write_qword(mh_recv + 40, 256)

local mr_ok, mr_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_recvmsg(ssb, mh_recv, 0) end)
if mr_ok then
    local rcv_len = memory.read_dword(recv_cmsg):tonumber()
    local rcv_n = (rcv_len - cmsg_data_off) / 4
    local fds_str = {}
    for i = 0, rcv_n - 1 do
        fds_str[#fds_str+1] = tostring(memory.read_dword(recv_cmsg + cmsg_data_off + i * 4):tonumber())
    end
    log(string.format("  recvmsg: %d fds received: %s", rcv_n, table.concat(fds_str, ",")))
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: SCM_RIGHTS with already-closed fds
-- If kernel doesn't validate: refcount underflow
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: SCM_RIGHTS closed fd ---")

-- Close some of the fds we're about to pass
local closed_fd = pass_fds[1]
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(closed_fd) end)

-- Try to pass the closed fd
memory.write_dword(cmsg_multi, cmsg_data_off + 4) -- 1 fd
memory.write_dword(cmsg_multi + cmsg_data_off, closed_fd)
memory.write_qword(mh_send + 40, 24)

local mc_ok, mc_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(ssa, mh_send, 0) end)
log("  sendmsg closed fd " .. closed_fd .. ": " ..
    (mc_ok and "rv=" .. mc_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- Try to pass fd -1 (invalid)
memory.write_dword(cmsg_multi + cmsg_data_off, 0xFFFFFFFF) -- -1
local mi_ok, mi_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(ssa, mh_send, 0) end)
log("  sendmsg fd=-1: " .. (mi_ok and "rv=" .. mi_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- Try to pass fd 9999 (likely invalid)
memory.write_dword(cmsg_multi + cmsg_data_off, 9999)
local m9_ok, m9_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(ssa, mh_send, 0) end)
log("  sendmsg fd=9999: " .. (m9_ok and "rv=" .. m9_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- Cleanup
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ssa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ssb) end)
for _, fd in ipairs(pass_fds) do
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
end

log("")
log("=== IPV6+SCM DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase4_ipc_network/29_rthdr_mmap.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 29: IPv6 routing header + mmap attack surface
-- From probe 28:
--   IPV6_RTHDR setsockopt works
--   IPV6_RECVRTHDR is already enabled (val=1)
--   sendmsg with routing header ancillary should work
--   HBH blocked, but RTHDR may not be
-- Also: mmap/munmap races, MAP_FIXED overlaps

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: RTHDR + MMAP ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 29,
    sc_sendto = 133,
    sc_recvfrom = 29,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_listen = 106,
    sc_accept = 30,
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_munmap = 73,
    sc_mprotect = 74,
    sc_minherit = 250,
    sc_madvise = 75,
    sc_msync = 226,
    sc_mlock = 203,
    sc_pipe2 = 542,
    sc_writev = 121,
    sc_readv = 120,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
})

local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()
local PROT_READ = 1
local PROT_WRITE = 2
local MAP_PRIVATE = 2
local MAP_ANON = 0x1000
local MAP_FIXED = 0x0010

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: IPv6 routing header via sendmsg
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: IPv6 routing header ---")

local raw6_ok, raw6_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(28, 3, 0) -- AF_INET6 RAW
end)
local r6 = raw6_ok and raw6_ret:tonumber() or -1
log("  raw6: fd=" .. r6)

if r6 >= 0 then
    local optval = memory.alloc(16)
    -- Enable RTHDR receiving
    memory.write_dword(optval, 1)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(r6, 41, 27, optval, 4) end) -- IPV6_RECVRTHDR

    -- Build routing header type 0 (deprecated but still parsed)
    -- struct ip6_rthdr { next_hdr(1), len(1), type(1), segleft(1) }
    -- Type 0 routing header: 8 bytes header + 16 bytes per segment
    local rthdr = memory.alloc(64)
    memory.write_byte(rthdr, 59)   -- next header = no next
    memory.write_byte(rthdr + 1, 2) -- len = 2 (24 bytes total = 8 + 16*1)
    memory.write_byte(rthdr + 2, 0) -- type = 0 (deprecated)
    memory.write_byte(rthdr + 3, 1) -- segments left = 1
    memory.write_dword(rthdr + 4, 0) -- reserved
    -- Segment: ::1
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(rthdr + 8 + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(rthdr + 23, 1) -- ::1

    -- Build cmsg with IPV6_RTHDR
    local cmsg = memory.alloc(64)
    local CMSG_DATA_OFF = 16
    local rthdr_len = 24
    memory.write_dword(cmsg, CMSG_DATA_OFF + rthdr_len) -- cmsg_len
    memory.write_dword(cmsg + 4, 41)   -- IPPROTO_IPV6
    memory.write_dword(cmsg + 8, 36)   -- IPV6_RTHDR
    for i = 0, rthdr_len - 1 do
        memory.write_byte(cmsg + CMSG_DATA_OFF + i, memory.read_byte(rthdr + i):tonumber())
    end

    -- Destination: ::1
    local dst = memory.alloc(32)
    memory.write_byte(dst, 28)      -- sin6_len
    memory.write_byte(dst + 1, 28)  -- AF_INET6
    for i = 2, 27 do memory.write_byte(dst + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(dst + 23, 1)  -- ::1

    local payload = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(payload, 0x4343434344444444)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, payload)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 8)

    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh, dst)
    memory.write_dword(mh + 8, 28)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 32, cmsg)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 40, 48) -- CMSG_SPACE(24)

    local sm_ok, sm_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(r6, mh, 0) end)
    log("  sendmsg RTHDR type0: " .. (sm_ok and "rv=" .. sm_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- Try type 2 (mobile IPv6)
    memory.write_byte(rthdr + 2, 2) -- type 2
    for i = 0, rthdr_len - 1 do
        memory.write_byte(cmsg + CMSG_DATA_OFF + i, memory.read_byte(rthdr + i):tonumber())
    end
    local sm2_ok, sm2_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(r6, mh, 0) end)
    log("  sendmsg RTHDR type2: " .. (sm2_ok and "rv=" .. sm2_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- Try dstopts
    local dsthdr = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_byte(dsthdr, 59)  -- next = none
    memory.write_byte(dsthdr + 1, 0) -- len=0 (8 bytes)
    memory.write_byte(dsthdr + 2, 1) -- PadN
    memory.write_byte(dsthdr + 3, 4) -- pad 4
    memory.write_dword(dsthdr + 4, 0)

    memory.write_dword(cmsg, CMSG_DATA_OFF + 8) -- cmsg_len
    memory.write_dword(cmsg + 8, 40) -- IPV6_DSTOPTS
    for i = 0, 7 do
        memory.write_byte(cmsg + CMSG_DATA_OFF + i, memory.read_byte(dsthdr + i):tonumber())
    end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 40, 32) -- CMSG_SPACE(8)

    local sd_ok, sd_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(r6, mh, 0) end)
    log("  sendmsg DSTOPTS: " .. (sd_ok and "rv=" .. sd_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- Try connect + sendto
    local target = memory.alloc(32)
    memory.write_byte(target, 28)
    memory.write_byte(target + 1, 28)
    for i = 2, 27 do memory.write_byte(target + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(target + 23, 1)

    local cn_ok, cn_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_connect(r6, target, 28) end)
    log("  connect(::1): " .. (cn_ok and "rv=" .. cn_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    local st_ok, st_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendto(r6, payload, 8, 0, target, 28)
    end)
    log("  sendto(::1): " .. (st_ok and "rv=" .. st_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- Bind to :: port 0
    local baddr = memory.alloc(32)
    memory.write_byte(baddr, 28)
    memory.write_byte(baddr + 1, 28)
    for i = 2, 27 do memory.write_byte(baddr + i, 0) end

    local bn_ok, bn_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(r6, baddr, 28) end)
    log("  bind(::): " .. (bn_ok and "rv=" .. bn_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(r6) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: mmap attack surface
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: mmap surface ---")

-- Test MAP_FIXED overlapping allocations
local page1_ok, page1 = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0x40000000, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
        MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON + MAP_FIXED, -1, 0)
end)
log("  MAP_FIXED 0x40000000: " ..
    (page1_ok and string.format("0x%x", page1:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

if page1_ok and page1:tonumber() > 0 then
    -- Write pattern
    memory.write_dword(page1, 0xDEAD1111)

    -- MAP_FIXED same address again — replaces the mapping
    local page2_ok, page2 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_mmap(0x40000000, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
            MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON + MAP_FIXED, -1, 0)
    end)
    log("  remap same addr: " ..
        (page2_ok and string.format("0x%x", page2:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

    if page2_ok then
        local val = memory.read_dword(page2):tonumber()
        log(string.format("  after remap: 0x%08x (0=fresh, DEAD1111=stale)", val))
    end

    -- MAP_FIXED overlapping (half-page overlap)
    local page3_ok, page3 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_mmap(0x40000800, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
            MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON + MAP_FIXED, -1, 0)
    end)
    log("  MAP_FIXED 0x40000800: " ..
        (page3_ok and string.format("0x%x", page3:tonumber()) or "ERR"))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(page1, 4096) end)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(page3, 4096) end)
end

-- munmap then read (UAF test)
local uaf_ok, uaf_ptr = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 8192, PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
        MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
end)
if uaf_ok then
    local uaf_addr = uaf_ptr:tonumber()
    log(string.format("  UAF test page: 0x%x", uaf_addr))
    memory.write_dword(uaf_ptr, 0xBEEF2222)

    -- Unmap
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(uaf_ptr, 8192) end)

    -- Try to read after unmap
    local uaf_rd_ok, uaf_val = pcall(function()
        return memory.read_dword(uaf_ptr):tonumber()
    end)
    log("  read after munmap: " ..
        (uaf_rd_ok and string.format("0x%08x", uaf_val) or "SIGSEGV"))
end

-- madvise
local madv_ok, madv_ptr = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
        MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
end)
if madv_ok then
    memory.write_dword(madv_ptr, 0xAAAA3333)

    -- MADV_FREE (5) — mark as freeable
    local mf_ok, mf_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_madvise(madv_ptr, 4096, 5)
    end)
    log("  madvise(FREE): " .. (mf_ok and "rv=" .. mf_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- Check if data still there
    local mf_val = memory.read_dword(madv_ptr):tonumber()
    log(string.format("  after MADV_FREE: 0x%08x", mf_val))

    -- MADV_DONTNEED (4) — hint to release pages
    local md_ok, md_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_madvise(madv_ptr, 4096, 4)
    end)
    log("  madvise(DONTNEED): " .. (md_ok and "rv=" .. md_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    local md_val = memory.read_dword(madv_ptr):tonumber()
    log(string.format("  after DONTNEED: 0x%08x (0=page reclaimed)", md_val))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(madv_ptr, 4096) end)
end

-- minherit
local mi_ok, mi_ptr = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 4096, PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE,
        MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
end)
if mi_ok then
    -- INHERIT_SHARE=0, INHERIT_COPY=1, INHERIT_NONE=2, INHERIT_ZERO=3
    for inherit = 0, 3 do
        local ih_ok, ih_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_minherit(mi_ptr, 4096, inherit)
        end)
        log("  minherit(" .. inherit .. "): " ..
            (ih_ok and "rv=" .. ih_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
    end
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(mi_ptr, 4096) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: writev/readv with many iovecs
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: writev/readv ---")

local sp = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local wa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local wb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Build 16 iovecs
local N_IOV = 16
local iovecs = memory.alloc(N_IOV * 16)
local total_write = 0
for i = 0, N_IOV - 1 do
    local buf = memory.alloc(64)
    for j = 0, 63, 4 do memory.write_dword(buf + j, 0x50000000 + i * 64 + j) end
    memory.write_qword(iovecs + i * 16, buf)
    memory.write_qword(iovecs + i * 16 + 8, 64)
    total_write = total_write + 64
end

local wv_ok, wv_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_writev(wa, iovecs, N_IOV)
end)
log(string.format("  writev %d iovecs: %s",
    N_IOV, wv_ok and "rv=" .. wv_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- readv on the other end
local rd_iovecs = memory.alloc(N_IOV * 16)
for i = 0, N_IOV - 1 do
    local buf = memory.alloc(64)
    memory.write_qword(rd_iovecs + i * 16, buf)
    memory.write_qword(rd_iovecs + i * 16 + 8, 64)
end

local rv_ok, rv_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_readv(wb, rd_iovecs, N_IOV)
end)
log(string.format("  readv %d iovecs: %s",
    N_IOV, rv_ok and "rv=" .. rv_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- writev with IOV_MAX+ iovecs (should fail with EINVAL)
local huge_iov = memory.alloc(2048 * 16)
local hbuf = memory.alloc(8)
for i = 0, 2047 do
    memory.write_qword(huge_iov + i * 16, hbuf)
    memory.write_qword(huge_iov + i * 16 + 8, 1)
end
local hv_ok, hv_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_writev(wa, huge_iov, 2048)
end)
log(string.format("  writev 2048 iovecs: %s",
    hv_ok and "rv=" .. hv_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- writev with 0-length iov
local zero_iov = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(zero_iov, hbuf)
memory.write_qword(zero_iov + 8, 0) -- len=0
local zv_ok, zv_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_writev(wa, zero_iov, 1)
end)
log("  writev 0-len: " .. (zv_ok and "rv=" .. zv_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(wa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(wb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: fcntl deep probe
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: fcntl ---")

local fsp = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, fsp) end)
local ffd = memory.read_dword(fsp):tonumber()

-- F_GETFL=3, F_SETFL=4, F_GETFD=1, F_SETFD=2
-- F_DUPFD=0, F_GETLK=11, F_SETLK=12
-- F_SETOWN=6, F_GETOWN=5
-- F_OGETLK=7, F_OSETLK=8
-- F_READAHEAD=15, F_RDAHEAD=16
-- F_ADD_SEALS=19, F_GET_SEALS=20

local fcntl_cmds = {
    {0, 0, "F_DUPFD"},
    {1, 0, "F_GETFD"},
    {2, 1, "F_SETFD(CLOEXEC)"},
    {3, 0, "F_GETFL"},
    {4, 0x0004, "F_SETFL(O_NONBLOCK)"},
    {5, 0, "F_GETOWN"},
    {6, pid, "F_SETOWN(self)"},
    {11, 0, "F_GETLK"},
    {15, 0, "F_READAHEAD"},
    {16, 1, "F_RDAHEAD"},
    {20, 0, "F_GET_SEALS"},
}

for _, cmd in ipairs(fcntl_cmds) do
    local fc_ok, fc_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_fcntl(ffd, cmd[1], cmd[2])
    end)
    log(string.format("  %-20s %s", cmd[3],
        fc_ok and "rv=" .. fc_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ffd) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(memory.read_dword(fsp + 4):tonumber()) end)

log("")
log("=== RTHDR+MMAP DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
-- Focus on: madvise, minherit, writev, fcntl, pipe2,

log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({

    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_munmap = 73,
    sc_madvise = 75,
    sc_minherit = 250,
    sc_mlock = 203,
    sc_msync = 226,
    sc_writev = 121,
    sc_readv = 120,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
    sc_pipe2 = 542,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_shutdown = 134,
    sc_listen = 106,
    sc_accept = 30,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_select = 93,
    sc_poll = 209,
})

local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: madvise variants
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: madvise ---")

local page = memory.alloc(4096 * 4)
-- Align to page boundary
local page_addr = page:tonumber()
local aligned = page_addr
if aligned % 4096 ~= 0 then
    aligned = aligned + (4096 - aligned % 4096)
end
-- Use mmap instead for guaranteed page alignment
local mp_ok, mp = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 4096, 3, 0x1002, -1, 0) -- RW PRIV ANON
end)
if mp_ok then
    memory.write_dword(mp, 0xBBBB1111)

    local advices = {
        {0, "MADV_NORMAL"},
        {1, "MADV_RANDOM"},
        {2, "MADV_SEQUENTIAL"},
        {3, "MADV_WILLNEED"},
        {4, "MADV_DONTNEED"},
        {5, "MADV_FREE"},
        {6, "MADV_NOSYNC"},
        {7, "MADV_AUTOSYNC"},
        {8, "MADV_NOCORE"},
        {9, "MADV_CORE"},
        {12, "MADV_PROTECT"},
    }

    for _, adv in ipairs(advices) do
        -- Reset pattern
        memory.write_dword(mp, 0xBBBB1111)
        local a_ok, a_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_madvise(mp, 4096, adv[1])
        end)
        local val_after = memory.read_dword(mp):tonumber()
        local info = a_ok and "rv=" .. a_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"
        if val_after ~= 0xBBBB1111 then
            info = info .. string.format(" DATA_CHANGED:0x%08x", val_after)
        end
        log(string.format("  %-20s %s", adv[2], info))
    end

    -- mlock / munlock
    local ml_ok, ml_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_mlock(mp, 4096) end)
    log("  mlock: " .. (ml_ok and "rv=" .. ml_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- msync
    local ms_ok, ms_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_msync(mp, 4096, 2) -- MS_SYNC
    end)
    log("  msync(SYNC): " .. (ms_ok and "rv=" .. ms_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- minherit
    for inherit = 0, 3 do
        local ih_ok, ih_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_minherit(mp, 4096, inherit)
        end)
        log("  minherit(" .. inherit .. "): " ..
            (ih_ok and "rv=" .. ih_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
    end

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_munmap(mp, 4096) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: writev/readv
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: writev/readv ---")

local sp = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local wa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local wb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- writev with 16 iovecs
local N_IOV = 16
local iovecs = memory.alloc(N_IOV * 16)
for i = 0, N_IOV - 1 do
    local buf = memory.alloc(64)
    for j = 0, 63, 4 do memory.write_dword(buf + j, 0x50000000 + i * 64 + j) end
    memory.write_qword(iovecs + i * 16, buf)
    memory.write_qword(iovecs + i * 16 + 8, 64)
end

local wv_ok, wv_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_writev(wa, iovecs, N_IOV) end)
log("  writev 16x64: " .. (wv_ok and "rv=" .. wv_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- readv
local rd_iovecs = memory.alloc(N_IOV * 16)
for i = 0, N_IOV - 1 do
    local buf = memory.alloc(64)
    memory.write_qword(rd_iovecs + i * 16, buf)
    memory.write_qword(rd_iovecs + i * 16 + 8, 64)
end

local rv_ok, rv_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_readv(wb, rd_iovecs, N_IOV) end)
log("  readv 16x64: " .. (rv_ok and "rv=" .. rv_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- writev with 1024 iovecs (near IOV_MAX=1024 on FreeBSD)
local BIG_N = 1024
local big_iov = memory.alloc(BIG_N * 16)
local tiny = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_byte(tiny, 0x41)
for i = 0, BIG_N - 1 do
    memory.write_qword(big_iov + i * 16, tiny)
    memory.write_qword(big_iov + i * 16 + 8, 1)
end

local bv_ok, bv_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_writev(wa, big_iov, BIG_N) end)
log("  writev 1024x1: " .. (bv_ok and "rv=" .. bv_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- writev with 1025 (over IOV_MAX)
local ov_ok, ov_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_writev(wa, big_iov, 1025) end)
log("  writev 1025x1: " .. (ov_ok and "rv=" .. ov_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(wa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(wb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: fcntl deep
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: fcntl ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local ffd = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local ffb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

local fcntl_cmds = {
    {0, 0, "F_DUPFD"},
    {1, 0, "F_GETFD"},
    {2, 1, "F_SETFD(CLOEXEC)"},
    {3, 0, "F_GETFL"},
    {4, 4, "F_SETFL(NONBLOCK)"},
    {3, 0, "F_GETFL(verify)"},
    {5, 0, "F_GETOWN"},
    {6, pid, "F_SETOWN(self)"},
    {5, 0, "F_GETOWN(verify)"},
    {15, 0, "F_READAHEAD"},
    {16, 1, "F_RDAHEAD(1)"},
    {17, 0, "F_DUP2FD"}, -- FreeBSD extension
    {18, 0, "F_DUP2FD_CLOEXEC"},
    {20, 0, "F_GET_SEALS"},
}

for _, cmd in ipairs(fcntl_cmds) do
    local fc_ok, fc_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_fcntl(ffd, cmd[1], cmd[2])
    end)
    log(string.format("  %-22s %s", cmd[3],
        fc_ok and "rv=" .. fc_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: pipe2
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: pipe2 ---")

local pipe_fds = memory.alloc(8)
-- O_NONBLOCK=4, O_CLOEXEC=0x100000
local p2_ok, p2_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_pipe2(pipe_fds, 0) end)
if p2_ok then
    local pr = memory.read_dword(pipe_fds):tonumber()
    local pw = memory.read_dword(pipe_fds + 4):tonumber()
    log(string.format("  pipe2(0): rv=%d read=%d write=%d", p2_ret:tonumber(), pr, pw))
    if pr > 0 and pw > 0 then
        -- Test the pipe
        local wr_buf = memory.alloc(8)
        memory.write_qword(wr_buf, 0xCAFEBABE)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_write(pw, wr_buf, 8) end)
        local rd_buf = memory.alloc(8)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_read(pr, rd_buf, 8) end)
        local rd_val = memory.read_dword(rd_buf):tonumber()
        log(string.format("  pipe data: 0x%08x", rd_val))
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(pr) end)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(pw) end)
    else
        log("  pipe2 returned bad fds (same as probe 19)")
    end
else
    log("  pipe2: ERR")
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 5: SCM_RIGHTS double-receive (refcount inflation)
-- Send fd once, receive it twice (if possible)
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 5: SCM_RIGHTS double-recv ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Create a target fd
local tgt = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, tgt) end)
local tgt_fd = memory.read_dword(tgt):tonumber()

-- Send it
local cmsg = memory.alloc(32)
memory.write_dword(cmsg, 20)     -- cmsg_len
memory.write_dword(cmsg + 4, 0xFFFF) -- SOL_SOCKET
memory.write_dword(cmsg + 8, 1)      -- SCM_RIGHTS
memory.write_dword(cmsg + 16, tgt_fd)

local payload = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(payload, 0xAAAA)
local iov = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(iov, payload)
memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 4)

local mh = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
memory.write_qword(mh + 32, cmsg)
memory.write_qword(mh + 40, 24)

pcall(function() syscall.sc_sendmsg(sa, mh, 0) end)

-- First receive
local rcmsg1 = memory.alloc(64)
local rbuf1 = memory.alloc(16)
local riov1 = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(riov1, rbuf1)
memory.write_qword(riov1 + 8, 16)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(rcmsg1 + i, 0) end

local rmh1 = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(rmh1 + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(rmh1 + 16, riov1)
memory.write_qword(rmh1 + 24, 1)
memory.write_qword(rmh1 + 32, rcmsg1)
memory.write_qword(rmh1 + 40, 64)

local r1_ok, r1_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_recvmsg(sb, rmh1, 0) end)
local recv_fd1 = memory.read_dword(rcmsg1 + 16):tonumber()
log(string.format("  recv1: %s fd=%d",
    r1_ok and "rv=" .. r1_ret:tonumber() or "ERR", recv_fd1))

-- Second receive (should be empty — only sent once)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(rcmsg1 + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(rmh1 + 32, rcmsg1)
memory.write_qword(rmh1 + 40, 64)

-- Set socket nonblocking for this
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sb, 4, 4) end) -- F_SETFL O_NONBLOCK

local r2_ok, r2_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_recvmsg(sb, rmh1, 0) end)
log("  recv2 (should fail): " .. (r2_ok and "rv=" .. r2_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- Close original, then use received fd (test if still valid)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tgt_fd) end)
local test_buf = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(test_buf, 0xDEDE)
local tw_ok, tw_ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(recv_fd1, test_buf, 4) end)
log("  write to received fd after closing original: " ..
    (tw_ok and "rv=" .. tw_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

-- Cleanup
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(recv_fd1) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ffd) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ffb) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(memory.read_dword(tgt + 4):tonumber()) end)

log("")
log("=== MMAP+FCNTL DEEP DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
    local cm = memory.alloc(32)

    memory.write_qword(mh + 32, cm)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 40, 24)

    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -1

    if ok then

    end
    return -1

        {0xFFFF, 0x1001, "SO_SNDBUF"},
        {0xFFFF, 0x1002, "SO_RCVBUF"},
        {0xFFFF, 0x0080, "SO_LINGER"},
        {0xFFFF, 0x1005, "SO_SNDLOWAT"},
        {0xFFFF, 0x1004, "SO_RCVLOWAT"},
    }

    for _, opt in ipairs(sol_opts) do
        memory.write_qword(optlen, 16)
        for i = 0, 15, 8 do memory.write_qword(optval + i, 0) end
        local g_ok, g_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_getsockopt(tcp_fd, opt[1], opt[2], optval, optlen)
        end)
        local val = memory.read_dword(optval):tonumber()
        log(string.format("  %-16s %s val=%d",
            opt[3],
            g_ok and "rv=" .. g_ret:tonumber() or "ERR",
            val))
    end

    -- Set SO_SNDBUF to extreme value
    memory.write_dword(optval, 0x7FFFFFFF)
    local sb_ok, sb_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_setsockopt(tcp_fd, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, optval, 4)
    end)
    log("  set SNDBUF=MAX: " .. (sb_ok and "rv=" .. sb_ret:tonumber() or "ERR"))

    -- Read back
    memory.write_qword(optlen, 4)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_getsockopt(tcp_fd, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, optval, optlen) end)
    log("  SNDBUF now: " .. memory.read_dword(optval):tonumber())

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tcp_fd) end)
end

log("")
log("=== FCNTL+SCM DEEP DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase4_ipc_network/30c_fcntl_bypass.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 30c: fcntl sandbox bypass investigation
-- F_SETFL returns -1 but applies the change. Does F_SETOWN do the same?
-- If so, we can set up SIGIO delivery for async socket notification.

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: FCNTL BYPASS ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
    sc_sigaction = 416,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_listen = 106,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_shutdown = 134,
    sc_select = 93,
    sc_poll = 209,
    sc_nanosleep = 240,
})

local pid = syscall.sc_getpid():tonumber()
local sp = memory.alloc(8)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Verify F_SETFL bypass pattern in detail
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: F_SETFL bypass detail ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local fa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local fb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Get baseline flags
local ok1, fl1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fa, 3, 0) end)
log("  baseline F_GETFL: rv=" .. (ok1 and fl1:tonumber() or -999))

-- Try F_SETFL with O_NONBLOCK (4), check return AND verify
local ok2, rv2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fa, 4, 4) end)
log("  F_SETFL(NONBLK): rv=" .. (ok2 and rv2:tonumber() or -999))

local ok3, fl3 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fa, 3, 0) end)
log("  verify F_GETFL: rv=" .. (ok3 and fl3:tonumber() or -999))

-- Try F_SETFL with O_APPEND (8)
local ok4, rv4 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fa, 4, 8) end)
log("  F_SETFL(APPEND): rv=" .. (ok4 and rv4:tonumber() or -999))

local ok5, fl5 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fa, 3, 0) end)
log("  verify F_GETFL: rv=" .. (ok5 and fl5:tonumber() or -999))

-- Try F_SETFL with O_ASYNC (0x40) - THIS enables SIGIO
local ok6, rv6 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fa, 4, 0x40) end)
log("  F_SETFL(ASYNC): rv=" .. (ok6 and rv6:tonumber() or -999))

local ok7, fl7 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(fa, 3, 0) end)
log("  verify F_GETFL: rv=" .. (ok7 and fl7:tonumber() or -999))
log(string.format("  flags breakdown: O_ASYNC=%s O_NONBLK=%s O_APPEND=%s",
    ok7 and (fl7:tonumber() % 128 >= 64 and "SET" or "no") or "?",
    ok7 and (fl7:tonumber() % 8 >= 4 and "SET" or "no") or "?",
    ok7 and (fl7:tonumber() % 16 >= 8 and "SET" or "no") or "?"))

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: F_SETOWN bypass test
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: F_SETOWN bypass ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Try F_SETOWN to self
local ok_s1, rv_s1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 6, pid) end)
log("  F_SETOWN(self): rv=" .. (ok_s1 and rv_s1:tonumber() or -999))

-- Try F_GETOWN to verify
local ok_s2, rv_s2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 5, 0) end)
log("  F_GETOWN verify: rv=" .. (ok_s2 and rv_s2:tonumber() or -999))
log("  (expected: " .. pid .. " if bypass worked, 0/-1 if blocked)")

-- Try F_SETOWN with negative pid (process group)
local ok_s3, rv_s3 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 6, -pid) end)
log("  F_SETOWN(-pid): rv=" .. (ok_s3 and rv_s3:tonumber() or -999))

local ok_s4, rv_s4 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 5, 0) end)
log("  F_GETOWN verify: rv=" .. (ok_s4 and rv_s4:tonumber() or -999))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: F_SETFD bypass test
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: F_SETFD bypass ---")

-- F_GETFD returned -1 in 30b. But does F_SETFD silently work?
local ok_d1, rv_d1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 2, 1) end) -- SETFD CLOEXEC
log("  F_SETFD(CLOEXEC): rv=" .. (ok_d1 and rv_d1:tonumber() or -999))

local ok_d2, rv_d2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 1, 0) end) -- GETFD
log("  F_GETFD verify: rv=" .. (ok_d2 and rv_d2:tonumber() or -999))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: SIGIO delivery via O_ASYNC + F_SETOWN
-- Set up signal handler, enable O_ASYNC, set owner, write to peer
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: SIGIO delivery test ---")

-- Set up a SIGIO counter using a known memory location
local sigio_flag = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_dword(sigio_flag, 0)

-- Set O_ASYNC on sa (should bypass-succeed based on Part 1)
local ok_a1, rv_a1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 4, 0x40) end)
log("  F_SETFL(ASYNC) on sa: rv=" .. (ok_a1 and rv_a1:tonumber() or -999))

-- Verify O_ASYNC is set
local ok_a2, rv_a2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 3, 0) end)
log("  F_GETFL verify: " .. (ok_a2 and rv_a2:tonumber() or -999))
local async_set = ok_a2 and (rv_a2:tonumber() % 128 >= 64)
log("  O_ASYNC active: " .. tostring(async_set))

-- Set F_SETOWN to our pid
local ok_a3, rv_a3 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 6, pid) end)
log("  F_SETOWN(self): rv=" .. (ok_a3 and rv_a3:tonumber() or -999))

-- Install SIGIO handler (signal 23 on FreeBSD)
-- Use SIG_IGN first to see if signal arrives without crashing
-- sigaction(23, {SIG_IGN, ...}, NULL)
local sa_struct = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(sa_struct + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(sa_struct, 1) -- SIG_IGN = 1

local ok_sig, rv_sig = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_sigaction(23, sa_struct, 0) -- SIGIO=23
end)
log("  sigaction(SIGIO, SIG_IGN): rv=" .. (ok_sig and rv_sig:tonumber() or -999))

-- Also try SIGURG (signal 16) - used by OOB data
memory.write_qword(sa_struct, 1) -- SIG_IGN
local ok_urg, rv_urg = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_sigaction(16, sa_struct, 0) -- SIGURG=16
end)
log("  sigaction(SIGURG, SIG_IGN): rv=" .. (ok_urg and rv_urg:tonumber() or -999))

-- Write data to sb (peer) — should trigger SIGIO on sa if O_ASYNC+SETOWN worked
local test_buf = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_qword(test_buf, 0xDEADBEEFCAFE0001)
local ok_w, rv_w = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sb, test_buf, 8) end)
log("  write to peer: rv=" .. (ok_w and rv_w:tonumber() or -999))

-- Small delay to let signal deliver
local ts = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(ts, 0)         -- tv_sec = 0
memory.write_qword(ts + 8, 50000000) -- tv_nsec = 50ms
pcall(function() syscall.sc_nanosleep(ts, 0) end)

-- If we're still alive, SIG_IGN worked (signal was delivered and ignored)
-- or signal was never sent
log("  survived after write (SIG_IGN caught or no signal)")

-- Now test: set O_ASYNC + NONBLOCK together
local ok_a4, rv_a4 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 4, 0x44) end) -- ASYNC|NONBLOCK
log("  F_SETFL(ASYNC|NONBLK): rv=" .. (ok_a4 and rv_a4:tonumber() or -999))
local ok_a5, rv_a5 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 3, 0) end)
log("  verify: " .. (ok_a5 and rv_a5:tonumber() or -999))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 5: poll/select on sockets
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 5: poll/select ---")

-- poll: check if sa has data ready (we wrote 8 bytes to sb earlier)
-- struct pollfd { int fd; short events; short revents; }
local pollfd = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_dword(pollfd, sa)           -- fd
memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)    -- POLLIN
memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)         -- revents

local ok_p, rv_p = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 100) -- 100ms timeout
end)
local revents = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
log(string.format("  poll(sa, POLLIN, 100ms): rv=%d revents=0x%04x",
    ok_p and rv_p:tonumber() or -999, revents))

-- Read the pending data
local rd_buf = memory.alloc(16)
local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(sa, rd_buf, 16) end)
log("  read from sa: rv=" .. (ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -999))

-- Poll again — should be empty now
memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
local ok_p2, rv_p2 = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 50)
end)
local rev2 = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
log(string.format("  poll(sa, empty): rv=%d revents=0x%04x",
    ok_p2 and rv_p2:tonumber() or -999, rev2))

-- ============================================================
-- PART 6: kqueue
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 6: kqueue ---")

local ok_kq, rv_kq = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_kqueue() end)
local kq_fd = ok_kq and rv_kq:tonumber() or -1
log("  kqueue(): fd=" .. kq_fd)

if kq_fd >= 0 then
    -- struct kevent {
    --   uintptr_t ident;    // 8 bytes
    --   short     filter;   // 2 bytes
    --   u_short   flags;    // 2 bytes
    --   u_int     fflags;   // 4 bytes
    --   intptr_t  data;     // 8 bytes
    --   void     *udata;    // 8 bytes
    -- } = 32 bytes
    local kev = memory.alloc(64)
    -- Watch sa for read events
    -- EVFILT_READ = -1, EV_ADD = 0x0001, EV_ENABLE = 0x0004
    memory.write_qword(kev, sa)              -- ident = sa fd
    memory.write_word(kev + 8, 0xFFFF)       -- filter = EVFILT_READ (-1 as uint16)
    memory.write_word(kev + 10, 0x0001)      -- flags = EV_ADD
    memory.write_dword(kev + 12, 0)          -- fflags
    memory.write_qword(kev + 16, 0)          -- data
    memory.write_qword(kev + 24, 0)          -- udata

    -- Write something to sb first so there's data ready
    memory.write_qword(test_buf, 0xAAAABBBB)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_write(sb, test_buf, 8) end)

    -- kevent(kq, changelist, nchanges, eventlist, nevents, timeout)
    -- timeout struct: {tv_sec, tv_nsec} 16 bytes
    local timeout = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(timeout, 0)
    memory.write_qword(timeout + 8, 100000000) -- 100ms

    local out_kev = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(out_kev + i, 0) end

    local ok_ke, rv_ke = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_kevent(kq_fd, kev, 1, out_kev, 1, timeout)
    end)
    log("  kevent(add+poll): rv=" .. (ok_ke and rv_ke:tonumber() or -999))

    if ok_ke and rv_ke:tonumber() > 0 then
        local ev_ident = memory.read_qword(out_kev):tonumber()
        local ev_filter = memory.read_word(out_kev + 8):tonumber()
        local ev_flags = memory.read_word(out_kev + 10):tonumber()
        local ev_data = memory.read_qword(out_kev + 16):tonumber()
        log(string.format("  event: ident=%d filter=0x%x flags=0x%x data=%d",
            ev_ident, ev_filter, ev_flags, ev_data))
    end

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(kq_fd) end)
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

log("")
log("=== FCNTL BYPASS DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase4_ipc_network/31_sockopt_fuzz.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 31: setsockopt fuzzing
-- Systematically test socket options with crafted values and edge-case lengths
-- Looking for: integer overflows, buffer overreads, type confusion

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: SOCKOPT FUZZ ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_listen = 106,
})

-- Helper: try setsockopt, return rv
local function try_set(fd, level, opt, val_buf, val_len)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, level, opt, val_buf, val_len)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

-- Helper: try getsockopt, return rv + first dword
local function try_get(fd, level, opt, buf_len)
    local buf = memory.alloc(256)
    local lenp = memory.alloc(8)
    for i = 0, 255, 8 do memory.write_qword(buf + i, 0xDEADDEADDEADDEAD) end
    memory.write_qword(lenp, buf_len)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, level, opt, buf, lenp)
    end)
    local actual_len = memory.read_qword(lenp):tonumber()
    local d0 = memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
    local d1 = memory.read_dword(buf + 4):tonumber()
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999, actual_len, d0, d1
end

local val = memory.alloc(4096)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: TCP socket options (IPPROTO_TCP = 6)
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: TCP opts (level=6) ---")

local tcp_ok, tcp_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6) -- AF_INET STREAM TCP
end)
local tcp = tcp_ok and tcp_ret:tonumber() or -1
log("  TCP fd=" .. tcp)

if tcp >= 0 then
    -- TCP options to probe
    local tcp_opts = {
        {1, "TCP_NODELAY"},
        {2, "TCP_MAXSEG"},
        {4, "TCP_NOPUSH"},
        {8, "TCP_NOOPT"},
        {16, "TCP_MD5SIG"},
        {32, "TCP_INFO"},
        {64, "TCP_CONGESTION"},
        {128, "TCP_KEEPINIT"},
        {256, "TCP_KEEPIDLE"},
        {512, "TCP_KEEPINTVL"},
        {1024, "TCP_KEEPCNT"},
        {2048, "TCP_FASTOPEN"},
        {4096, "TCP_FUNCTION_BLK"},
    }

    for _, opt in ipairs(tcp_opts) do
        local rv, len, d0, d1 = try_get(tcp, 6, opt[1], 128)
        if rv == 0 then
            log(string.format("  get %-20s rv=0 len=%d val=0x%08x,%08x",
                opt[2], len, d0, d1))
        else
            log(string.format("  get %-20s rv=%d", opt[2], rv))
        end
    end

    -- Set TCP_NODELAY
    memory.write_dword(val, 1)
    log("  set TCP_NODELAY=1: rv=" .. try_set(tcp, 6, 1, val, 4))

    -- Set TCP_MAXSEG to extreme values
    memory.write_dword(val, 0)
    log("  set TCP_MAXSEG=0: rv=" .. try_set(tcp, 6, 2, val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 1)
    log("  set TCP_MAXSEG=1: rv=" .. try_set(tcp, 6, 2, val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 65535)
    log("  set TCP_MAXSEG=65535: rv=" .. try_set(tcp, 6, 2, val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 0x7FFFFFFF)
    log("  set TCP_MAXSEG=MAX: rv=" .. try_set(tcp, 6, 2, val, 4))

    -- Verify what MAXSEG became
    local rv, len, d0 = try_get(tcp, 6, 2, 4)
    log(string.format("  get TCP_MAXSEG: val=%d", d0))

    -- TCP_KEEPINIT/IDLE/INTVL/CNT with extremes
    for _, kopt in ipairs({{128, "KEEPINIT"}, {256, "KEEPIDLE"}, {512, "KEEPINTVL"}, {1024, "KEEPCNT"}}) do
        memory.write_dword(val, 0x7FFFFFFF)
        local srv = try_set(tcp, 6, kopt[1], val, 4)
        local grv, glen, gd0 = try_get(tcp, 6, kopt[1], 4)
        log(string.format("  set %s=MAX: srv=%d get=%d", kopt[2], srv, gd0))
    end

    -- Edge: setsockopt with length 0
    log("  set NODELAY len=0: rv=" .. try_set(tcp, 6, 1, val, 0))

    -- Edge: setsockopt with length 1 (less than int)
    memory.write_byte(val, 1)
    log("  set NODELAY len=1: rv=" .. try_set(tcp, 6, 1, val, 1))

    -- Edge: setsockopt with huge length
    log("  set NODELAY len=4096: rv=" .. try_set(tcp, 6, 1, val, 4096))

    -- Edge: getsockopt with length 0
    local rv0, len0, d00 = try_get(tcp, 6, 1, 0)
    log(string.format("  get NODELAY len=0: rv=%d actual_len=%d", rv0, len0))

    -- Edge: getsockopt with length 1
    local rv1, len1, d01 = try_get(tcp, 6, 1, 1)
    log(string.format("  get NODELAY len=1: rv=%d actual_len=%d val=0x%08x", rv1, len1, d01))

    -- TCP_INFO with various sizes
    local rv_i, len_i, d0_i, d1_i = try_get(tcp, 6, 32, 256)
    log(string.format("  get TCP_INFO(256): rv=%d len=%d", rv_i, len_i))

    -- TCP_FUNCTION_BLK - string option, 32 bytes
    local rv_f, len_f, d0_f = try_get(tcp, 6, 4096, 64)
    log(string.format("  get TCP_FUNCTION_BLK: rv=%d len=%d", rv_f, len_f))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tcp) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: IP level options (IPPROTO_IP = 0)
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: IP opts (level=0) ---")

local udp_ok, udp_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) -- AF_INET DGRAM UDP
end)
local udp = udp_ok and udp_ret:tonumber() or -1
log("  UDP fd=" .. udp)

if udp >= 0 then
    local ip_opts = {
        {1, "IP_OPTIONS"},
        {2, "IP_HDRINCL"},
        {3, "IP_TOS"},
        {4, "IP_TTL"},
        {5, "IP_RECVOPTS"},
        {6, "IP_RECVRETOPTS"},
        {7, "IP_RECVDSTADDR"},
        {9, "IP_MULTICAST_IF"},
        {10, "IP_MULTICAST_TTL"},
        {11, "IP_MULTICAST_LOOP"},
        {21, "IP_RECVTTL"},
        {22, "IP_MINTTL"},
        {23, "IP_DONTFRAG"},
        {24, "IP_RECVTOS"},
        {26, "IP_FLOWID"},
        {27, "IP_FLOWTYPE"},
        {29, "IP_ORIGDSTADDR"},
    }

    for _, opt in ipairs(ip_opts) do
        local rv, len, d0 = try_get(udp, 0, opt[1], 128)
        if rv == 0 then
            log(string.format("  get %-20s rv=0 len=%d val=%d", opt[2], len, d0))
        else
            log(string.format("  get %-20s rv=%d", opt[2], rv))
        end
    end

    -- IP_TTL edge cases
    memory.write_dword(val, 0)
    log("  set IP_TTL=0: rv=" .. try_set(udp, 0, 4, val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 255)
    log("  set IP_TTL=255: rv=" .. try_set(udp, 0, 4, val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 256)
    log("  set IP_TTL=256: rv=" .. try_set(udp, 0, 4, val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, -1)
    log("  set IP_TTL=-1: rv=" .. try_set(udp, 0, 4, val, 4))

    local rv_t, _, d0_t = try_get(udp, 0, 4, 4)
    log("  get IP_TTL: val=" .. d0_t)

    -- IP_MINTTL - interesting for filtering
    memory.write_dword(val, 255)
    log("  set IP_MINTTL=255: rv=" .. try_set(udp, 0, 22, val, 4))

    -- IP_HDRINCL on raw socket
    local raw_ok, raw_ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255) -- AF_INET RAW IPPROTO_RAW
    end)
    local raw = raw_ok and raw_ret:tonumber() or -1
    log("  RAW socket: fd=" .. raw)
    if raw >= 0 then
        memory.write_dword(val, 1)
        log("  set IP_HDRINCL=1: rv=" .. try_set(raw, 0, 2, val, 4))
        local rv_h, _, d0_h = try_get(raw, 0, 2, 4)
        log("  get IP_HDRINCL: rv=" .. rv_h .. " val=" .. d0_h)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(raw) end)
    end

    -- IP_OPTIONS with crafted data (up to 40 bytes)
    for i = 0, 39 do memory.write_byte(val + i, 0x44) end -- LSRR-like
    log("  set IP_OPTIONS(40): rv=" .. try_set(udp, 0, 1, val, 40))
    log("  set IP_OPTIONS(44): rv=" .. try_set(udp, 0, 1, val, 44))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(udp) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: IPv6 options (IPPROTO_IPV6 = 41)
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: IPv6 opts (level=41) ---")

local v6_ok, v6_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(28, 2, 17) -- AF_INET6 DGRAM UDP
end)
local v6 = v6_ok and v6_ret:tonumber() or -1
log("  UDPv6 fd=" .. v6)

if v6 >= 0 then
    local v6_opts = {
        {1, "IPV6_UNICAST_HOPS"},
        {8, "IPV6_MULTICAST_HOPS"},
        {18, "IPV6_V6ONLY"},
        {21, "IPV6_RECVPKTINFO"},
        {24, "IPV6_CHECKSUM"},
        {26, "IPV6_FAITH"},
        {27, "IPV6_RECVTCLASS"},
        {29, "IPV6_AUTOFLOWLABEL"},
        {36, "IPV6_RECVRTHDR"},
        {37, "IPV6_RECVDSTOPTS"},
        {42, "IPV6_USE_MIN_MTU"},
        {50, "IPV6_TCLASS"},
        {61, "IPV6_ORIGDSTADDR"},
        {63, "IPV6_PKTINFO"},
        {72, "IPV6_FLOWID"},
        {73, "IPV6_FLOWTYPE"},
    }

    for _, opt in ipairs(v6_opts) do
        local rv, len, d0 = try_get(v6, 41, opt[1], 128)
        if rv == 0 then
            log(string.format("  get %-22s rv=0 len=%d val=%d", opt[2], len, d0))
        else
            log(string.format("  get %-22s rv=%d", opt[2], rv))
        end
    end

    -- IPV6_UNICAST_HOPS edge cases
    memory.write_dword(val, -1)
    log("  set UNICAST_HOPS=-1: rv=" .. try_set(v6, 41, 1, val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 256)
    log("  set UNICAST_HOPS=256: rv=" .. try_set(v6, 41, 1, val, 4))

    -- IPV6_PKTINFO with crafted struct (20 bytes: in6_addr + ifindex)
    for i = 0, 19 do memory.write_byte(val + i, 0) end
    memory.write_dword(val + 16, 1) -- ifindex = 1
    log("  set IPV6_PKTINFO(lo): rv=" .. try_set(v6, 41, 63, val, 20))

    -- IPV6_TCLASS extremes
    memory.write_dword(val, 255)
    log("  set IPV6_TCLASS=255: rv=" .. try_set(v6, 41, 50, val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 256)
    log("  set IPV6_TCLASS=256: rv=" .. try_set(v6, 41, 50, val, 4))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(v6) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: SOL_SOCKET level with edge cases
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: SOL_SOCKET edge cases ---")

local sp = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local ea = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local eb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- SO_RCVBUF / SO_SNDBUF extremes
for _, bopt in ipairs({{0x1001, "SNDBUF"}, {0x1002, "RCVBUF"}}) do
    memory.write_dword(val, 0)
    log("  set " .. bopt[2] .. "=0: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, bopt[1], val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 1)
    log("  set " .. bopt[2] .. "=1: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, bopt[1], val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 0x7FFFFFFF)
    log("  set " .. bopt[2] .. "=MAX: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, bopt[1], val, 4))
    memory.write_dword(val, 0x80000000)
    log("  set " .. bopt[2] .. "=NEG: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, bopt[1], val, 4))
    local rv, _, d0 = try_get(ea, 0xFFFF, bopt[1], 4)
    log("  get " .. bopt[2] .. ": val=" .. d0)
end

-- SO_LINGER with crafted struct {onoff, linger}
memory.write_dword(val, 1)      -- l_onoff = 1
memory.write_dword(val + 4, 0)  -- l_linger = 0
log("  set LINGER(on,0): rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x0080, val, 8))
memory.write_dword(val + 4, 0x7FFFFFFF)
log("  set LINGER(on,MAX): rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x0080, val, 8))
memory.write_dword(val + 4, -1)
log("  set LINGER(on,-1): rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x0080, val, 8))

-- SO_SNDLOWAT / SO_RCVLOWAT
memory.write_dword(val, 0)
log("  set SNDLOWAT=0: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x1005, val, 4))
memory.write_dword(val, 0x7FFFFFFF)
log("  set SNDLOWAT=MAX: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x1005, val, 4))
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
log("  set RCVLOWAT=1: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x1004, val, 4))
memory.write_dword(val, 0x7FFFFFFF)
log("  set RCVLOWAT=MAX: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x1004, val, 4))
local rv_l, _, d0_l = try_get(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x1004, 4)
log("  get RCVLOWAT: val=" .. d0_l)

-- SO_SNDTIMEO / SO_RCVTIMEO (struct timeval: 16 bytes on 64-bit)
memory.write_qword(val, 0)      -- tv_sec
memory.write_qword(val + 8, 0)  -- tv_usec
log("  set SNDTIMEO(0,0): rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x1005, val, 16))
memory.write_qword(val, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) -- huge sec
memory.write_qword(val + 8, 999999)
log("  set RCVTIMEO(huge): rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x1006, val, 16))

-- SO_ACCEPTFILTER (struct accept_filter_arg: 16+240=256 bytes)
for i = 0, 255 do memory.write_byte(val + i, 0x41) end
memory.write_byte(val + 15, 0)  -- null-terminate name
log("  set ACCEPTFILTER: rv=" .. try_set(ea, 0xFFFF, 0x1000, val, 256))

-- Undocumented/PS5-specific option numbers
for _, unk in ipairs({0x2000, 0x2001, 0x2002, 0x3000, 0x4000, 0x10000}) do
    local rv, len, d0 = try_get(ea, 0xFFFF, unk, 128)
    if rv == 0 then
        log(string.format("  get SOL 0x%x: rv=0 len=%d val=0x%08x", unk, len, d0))
    end
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ea) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(eb) end)

log("")
log("=== SOCKOPT FUZZ DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 31b: TCP_INFO full dump
-- Parse 236-byte struct for kernel pointer leaks
-- Also dump IP_HDRINCL anomaly and PS5 custom opts

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: TCP_INFO DUMP ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_listen = 106,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_read = 3,
})

local function try_get(fd, level, opt, buf_len)
    local buf = memory.alloc(512)
    local lenp = memory.alloc(8)
    for i = 0, 511, 8 do memory.write_qword(buf + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(lenp, buf_len)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, level, opt, buf, lenp)
    end)
    local actual_len = memory.read_qword(lenp):tonumber()
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999, actual_len, buf
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: TCP_INFO on fresh TCP socket
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: TCP_INFO fresh socket ---")

local tcp_ok, tcp_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6)
end)
local tcp = tcp_ok and tcp_ret:tonumber() or -1

if tcp >= 0 then
    local rv, len, buf = try_get(tcp, 6, 32, 512)
    log(string.format("  rv=%d actual_len=%d", rv, len))

    -- Hex dump the full structure
    log("  --- hex dump ---")
    for row = 0, len - 1, 16 do
        local hex = ""
        local ascii = ""
        for col = 0, 15 do
            local off = row + col
            if off < len then
                local b = memory.read_byte(buf + off):tonumber()
                hex = hex .. string.format("%02x ", b)
                if b >= 32 and b < 127 then
                    ascii = ascii .. string.char(b)
                else
                    ascii = ascii .. "."
                end
            end
        end
        log(string.format("  %03x: %-48s %s", row, hex, ascii))
    end

    -- Parse known FreeBSD tcp_info fields
    -- FreeBSD struct tcp_info (from tcp.h):
    -- u_int8_t  tcpi_state (0)
    -- u_int8_t  __tcpi_ca_state (1)
    -- u_int8_t  __tcpi_retransmits (2)
    -- u_int8_t  __tcpi_probes (3)
    -- u_int8_t  __tcpi_backoff (4)
    -- u_int8_t  tcpi_options (5)
    -- u_int8_t  tcpi_snd_wscale:4, tcpi_rcv_wscale:4 (6)
    -- padding (7)
    -- u_int32_t tcpi_rto (8)
    -- ... many more u_int32_t fields
    log("")
    log("  --- parsed fields ---")
    local state = memory.read_byte(buf):tonumber()
    local ca_state = memory.read_byte(buf + 1):tonumber()
    local retrans = memory.read_byte(buf + 2):tonumber()
    local probes = memory.read_byte(buf + 3):tonumber()
    local backoff = memory.read_byte(buf + 4):tonumber()
    local options = memory.read_byte(buf + 5):tonumber()
    local wscale = memory.read_byte(buf + 6):tonumber()
    log(string.format("  state=%d ca=%d retrans=%d probes=%d backoff=%d opts=0x%02x wscale=0x%02x",
        state, ca_state, retrans, probes, backoff, options, wscale))

    local rto = memory.read_dword(buf + 8):tonumber()
    log("  rto=" .. rto)

    -- Scan ALL dwords for pointer-like values (kernel: 0xFFFFxxxx, userland: 0x0000xxxx)
    log("")
    log("  --- pointer scan ---")
    for off = 0, len - 8, 4 do
        local d = memory.read_dword(buf + off):tonumber()
        -- Check for kernel-range values (high bits set)
        if d > 0x80000000 or (d > 0x10000 and d < 0x7FFFFFFF) then
            -- Also check as qword for 64-bit pointers
            local q = memory.read_qword(buf + off):tonumber()
            if q > 0xFFFF000000000000 or (q > 0x100000000 and q < 0x800000000000) then
                log(string.format("  @%03x: qword=0x%016x (POSSIBLE PTR)", off, q))
            elseif d > 0x80000000 then
                log(string.format("  @%03x: dword=0x%08x (high bits)", off, d))
            end
        end
    end

    -- Dump all non-zero qwords
    log("")
    log("  --- non-zero qwords ---")
    for off = 0, len - 8, 8 do
        local q = memory.read_qword(buf + off):tonumber()
        if q ~= 0 then
            log(string.format("  @%03x: 0x%016x", off, q))
        end
    end

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tcp) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: TCP_INFO on connected socket (via socketpair-like)
-- Create TCP, bind, listen, connect, then dump
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: TCP_INFO loopback connected ---")

local srv_ok, srv_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6)
end)
local srv = srv_ok and srv_ret:tonumber() or -1

if srv >= 0 then
    -- bind to 127.0.0.1:0
    local sa = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_byte(sa, 16)       -- sin_len
    memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)    -- AF_INET
    memory.write_word(sa + 2, 0)    -- port 0 (auto)
    memory.write_dword(sa + 4, 0x0100007F) -- 127.0.0.1 (network byte order: 7F000001)

    local bind_ok, bind_rv = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_bind(srv, sa, 16)
    end)
    log("  bind: rv=" .. (bind_ok and bind_rv:tonumber() or -999))

    -- getsockname to learn assigned port
    local name_buf = memory.alloc(16)
    local name_len = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(name_len, 16)

    -- listen
    local lis_ok, lis_rv = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_listen(srv, 5)
    end)
    log("  listen: rv=" .. (lis_ok and lis_rv:tonumber() or -999))

    if bind_ok and bind_rv:tonumber() == 0 and lis_ok and lis_rv:tonumber() == 0 then
        -- Read back assigned port via getsockname (syscall 32)
        syscall.resolve({ sc_getsockname = 32 })
        memory.write_qword(name_len, 16)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_getsockname(srv, name_buf, name_len) end)
        local port_be = memory.read_word(name_buf + 2):tonumber()
        -- Swap bytes for port
        local port = ((port_be % 256) * 256) + math.floor(port_be / 256)
        log("  bound port: " .. port)

        -- Connect client
        local cli_ok, cli_ret = pcall(function()
            return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6)
        end)
        local cli = cli_ok and cli_ret:tonumber() or -1

        if cli >= 0 then
            memory.write_word(sa + 2, port_be) -- use same byte-order port
            -- Fix 127.0.0.1 in correct network byte order
            memory.write_byte(sa + 4, 127)
            memory.write_byte(sa + 5, 0)
            memory.write_byte(sa + 6, 0)
            memory.write_byte(sa + 7, 1)

            local conn_ok, conn_rv = pcall(function()
                return syscall.sc_connect(cli, sa, 16)
            end)
            log("  connect: rv=" .. (conn_ok and conn_rv:tonumber() or -999))

            if conn_ok and conn_rv:tonumber() == 0 then
                -- Send some data
                local data = memory.alloc(64)
                for i = 0, 63, 4 do memory.write_dword(data + i, 0xBEEF0000 + i) end
                pcall(function() syscall.sc_write(cli, data, 64) end)

                -- Dump TCP_INFO on connected client socket
                local rv2, len2, buf2 = try_get(cli, 6, 32, 512)
                log(string.format("  connected TCP_INFO: rv=%d len=%d", rv2, len2))

                -- Hex dump
                log("  --- hex dump (connected) ---")
                for row = 0, len2 - 1, 16 do
                    local hex = ""
                    for col = 0, 15 do
                        local off = row + col
                        if off < len2 then
                            hex = hex .. string.format("%02x ", memory.read_byte(buf2 + off):tonumber())
                        end
                    end
                    log(string.format("  %03x: %s", row, hex))
                end

                -- Pointer scan on connected socket
                log("  --- pointer scan (connected) ---")
                for off = 0, len2 - 8, 4 do
                    local q = memory.read_qword(buf2 + off):tonumber()
                    if q > 0xFFFF000000000000 or (q > 0x100000000 and q < 0x800000000000) then
                        log(string.format("  @%03x: 0x%016x (POSSIBLE PTR)", off, q))
                    end
                end

                -- Non-zero qwords
                log("  --- non-zero qwords (connected) ---")
                for off = 0, len2 - 8, 8 do
                    local q = memory.read_qword(buf2 + off):tonumber()
                    if q ~= 0 then
                        log(string.format("  @%03x: 0x%016x", off, q))
                    end
                end
            end

            pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(cli) end)
        end
    end

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(srv) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: IP_HDRINCL anomaly
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: IP_HDRINCL detail ---")

local raw_ok, raw_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255)
end)
local raw = raw_ok and raw_ret:tonumber() or -1

if raw >= 0 then
    -- Get before set
    local rv0, len0, buf0 = try_get(raw, 0, 2, 16)
    log(string.format("  before set: rv=%d len=%d", rv0, len0))
    for off = 0, 15, 4 do
        log(string.format("    @%d: 0x%08x", off, memory.read_dword(buf0 + off):tonumber()))
    end

    -- Set to 1
    local val = memory.alloc(4)
    memory.write_dword(val, 1)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw, 0, 2, val, 4) end)

    -- Get after set
    local rv1, len1, buf1 = try_get(raw, 0, 2, 16)
    log(string.format("  after set=1: rv=%d len=%d", rv1, len1))
    for off = 0, 15, 4 do
        log(string.format("    @%d: 0x%08x", off, memory.read_dword(buf1 + off):tonumber()))
    end

    -- Set to 0 and re-read
    memory.write_dword(val, 0)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw, 0, 2, val, 4) end)
    local rv2, len2, buf2 = try_get(raw, 0, 2, 16)
    log(string.format("  after set=0: rv=%d len=%d", rv2, len2))
    for off = 0, 15, 4 do
        log(string.format("    @%d: 0x%08x", off, memory.read_dword(buf2 + off):tonumber()))
    end

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(raw) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: PS5 custom SOL_SOCKET options deeper scan
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: PS5 custom opts ---")

local sp = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local pa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()

-- Scan SOL_SOCKET option space for accessible ones
local found = {}
for opt = 0x1000, 0x10001, 1 do
    if opt <= 0x1010 or opt == 0x2000 or opt == 0x2001 or opt == 0x2002 or
       opt == 0x3000 or opt == 0x4000 or opt == 0x4001 or opt == 0x5000 or
       opt == 0x8000 or opt == 0x10000 or opt == 0x10001 then
        local rv, len, buf = try_get(pa, 0xFFFF, opt, 128)
        if rv == 0 then
            local d0 = memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
            local d1 = memory.read_dword(buf + 4):tonumber()
            log(string.format("  SOL 0x%05x: len=%d val=0x%08x %08x", opt, len, d0, d1))
            found[#found+1] = opt
        end
    end
end

-- Also scan wider range at key intervals
for opt_hi = 0x20000, 0x100000, 0x10000 do
    local rv, len, buf = try_get(pa, 0xFFFF, opt_hi, 128)
    if rv == 0 then
        local d0 = memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
        log(string.format("  SOL 0x%05x: len=%d val=0x%08x", opt_hi, len, d0))
    end
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(pa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()) end)

log("")
log("=== TCP_INFO DUMP DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase4_ipc_network/31c_ps5opts_fuzz.lua
