```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 31c: PS5 custom socket option fuzzing
-- Target: SOL_SOCKET 0x2000, 0x10000, 0x20000, 0x40000, 0x100000
-- Also: full scan of SOL_SOCKET option space for hidden options

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: PS5 OPTS FUZZ ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
})

local function try_set(fd, level, opt, val_buf, val_len)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, level, opt, val_buf, val_len)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

local function try_get(fd, level, opt, buf_len)
    local buf = memory.alloc(512)
    local lenp = memory.alloc(8)
    for i = 0, 511, 8 do memory.write_qword(buf + i, 0xDEADDEADDEADDEAD) end
    memory.write_qword(lenp, buf_len)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, level, opt, buf, lenp)
    end)
    local actual_len = memory.read_qword(lenp):tonumber()
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999, actual_len, buf
end

local val = memory.alloc(4096)
local sp = memory.alloc(8)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Scan full SOL_SOCKET option space (0x0000-0x1100)
-- Find every accessible option we missed
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: SOL_SOCKET full scan ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local fd1 = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local fd1b = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

local accessible = {}
for opt = 1, 0x1100 do
    local rv, len, buf = try_get(fd1, 0xFFFF, opt, 128)
    if rv == 0 then
        local d0 = memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
        accessible[#accessible+1] = {opt, len, d0}
    end
end
log("  found " .. #accessible .. " accessible options")
for _, a in ipairs(accessible) do
    log(string.format("  0x%04x: len=%d val=0x%08x", a[1], a[2], a[3]))
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd1) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd1b) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: Deep fuzz each PS5 custom option
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: PS5 custom opts fuzz ---")

local ps5_opts = {0x2000, 0x10000, 0x20000, 0x40000, 0x100000}

for _, opt in ipairs(ps5_opts) do
    log(string.format("  --- opt 0x%x ---", opt))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
    local fd = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
    local fdb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

    -- Get with various buffer sizes
    for _, sz in ipairs({0, 1, 4, 8, 16, 64, 256}) do
        local rv, len, buf = try_get(fd, 0xFFFF, opt, sz)
        if rv == 0 then
            local d0 = memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
            log(string.format("    get(len=%d): rv=0 actual=%d val=0x%08x", sz, len, d0))
        else
            log(string.format("    get(len=%d): rv=%d", sz, rv))
        end
    end

    -- Set with int values
    local set_vals = {0, 1, 2, 0xFF, 0xFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF}
    for _, v in ipairs(set_vals) do
        memory.write_dword(val, v)
        local srv = try_set(fd, 0xFFFF, opt, val, 4)
        if srv == 0 then
            local grv, glen, gbuf = try_get(fd, 0xFFFF, opt, 16)
            local gval = memory.read_dword(gbuf):tonumber()
            log(string.format("    set(0x%x): rv=0 readback=0x%08x", v, gval))
        elseif srv ~= -999 then
            log(string.format("    set(0x%x): rv=%d", v, srv))
        end
    end

    -- Set with length 0
    local srv0 = try_set(fd, 0xFFFF, opt, val, 0)
    if srv0 ~= -999 then
        log(string.format("    set(len=0): rv=%d", srv0))
    end

    -- Set with length 1
    memory.write_byte(val, 0x41)
    local srv1 = try_set(fd, 0xFFFF, opt, val, 1)
    if srv1 ~= -999 then
        log(string.format("    set(len=1): rv=%d", srv1))
    end

    -- Set with length 8 (qword)
    memory.write_qword(val, 0xCAFEBABE12345678)
    local srv8 = try_set(fd, 0xFFFF, opt, val, 8)
    if srv8 ~= -999 then
        log(string.format("    set(len=8,qword): rv=%d", srv8))
    end
    if srv8 == 0 then
        local grv, glen, gbuf = try_get(fd, 0xFFFF, opt, 16)
        local gq = memory.read_qword(gbuf):tonumber()
        log(string.format("    readback qword: 0x%016x (len=%d)", gq, glen))
    end

    -- Set with large length (256 bytes of pattern)
    for i = 0, 255, 4 do memory.write_dword(val + i, 0xAA000000 + i) end
    local srv256 = try_set(fd, 0xFFFF, opt, val, 256)
    if srv256 ~= -999 then
        log(string.format("    set(len=256): rv=%d", srv256))
    end

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fdb) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: Fuzz on different socket types
-- Some options may behave differently on TCP vs UDP vs RAW
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: PS5 opts on TCP ---")

local tcp_ok, tcp_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6)
end)
local tcp = tcp_ok and tcp_ret:tonumber() or -1

if tcp >= 0 then
    for _, opt in ipairs(ps5_opts) do
        local rv, len, buf = try_get(tcp, 0xFFFF, opt, 64)
        if rv == 0 then
            local d0 = memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
            log(string.format("  TCP 0x%x: len=%d val=0x%08x", opt, len, d0))

            -- Try setting
            memory.write_dword(val, 1)
            local srv = try_set(tcp, 0xFFFF, opt, val, 4)
            if srv == 0 then
                local grv, glen, gbuf = try_get(tcp, 0xFFFF, opt, 16)
                log(string.format("    set(1): rv=0 readback=0x%08x",
                    memory.read_dword(gbuf):tonumber()))
            else
                log(string.format("    set(1): rv=%d", srv))
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tcp) end)
end

log("")
log("--- PART 3b: PS5 opts on RAW ---")

local raw_ok, raw_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255)
end)
local raw = raw_ok and raw_ret:tonumber() or -1

if raw >= 0 then
    for _, opt in ipairs(ps5_opts) do
        local rv, len, buf = try_get(raw, 0xFFFF, opt, 64)
        if rv == 0 then
            local d0 = memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
            log(string.format("  RAW 0x%x: len=%d val=0x%08x", opt, len, d0))

            memory.write_dword(val, 1)
            local srv = try_set(raw, 0xFFFF, opt, val, 4)
            if srv == 0 then
                local grv, glen, gbuf = try_get(raw, 0xFFFF, opt, 16)
                log(string.format("    set(1): rv=0 readback=0x%08x",
                    memory.read_dword(gbuf):tonumber()))
            else
                log(string.format("    set(1): rv=%d", srv))
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(raw) end)
end

log("")
log("--- PART 3c: PS5 opts on IPv6 RAW ---")

local v6r_ok, v6r_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(28, 3, 255)
end)
local v6r = v6r_ok and v6r_ret:tonumber() or -1

if v6r >= 0 then
    for _, opt in ipairs(ps5_opts) do
        local rv, len, buf = try_get(v6r, 0xFFFF, opt, 64)
        if rv == 0 then
            local d0 = memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
            log(string.format("  V6RAW 0x%x: len=%d val=0x%08x", opt, len, d0))
        end
    end
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(v6r) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: Scan for PS5-specific protocol-level options
-- IPPROTO_TCP=6, IPPROTO_UDP=17, IPPROTO_IPV6=41
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: PS5 custom at other levels ---")

local tcp2_ok, tcp2_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6)
end)
local tcp2 = tcp2_ok and tcp2_ret:tonumber() or -1

if tcp2 >= 0 then
    -- Scan TCP level for high option numbers
    for _, opt in ipairs({0x100, 0x200, 0x400, 0x800, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x8000, 0x10000}) do
        local rv, len, buf = try_get(tcp2, 6, opt, 64)
        if rv == 0 then
            log(string.format("  TCP-level 0x%x: len=%d val=0x%08x", opt, len,
                memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()))
        end
    end
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tcp2) end)
end

-- IPv6 level scan
local v6_ok, v6_ret = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socket(28, 2, 17)
end)
local v6 = v6_ok and v6_ret:tonumber() or -1

if v6 >= 0 then
    for _, opt in ipairs({0x100, 0x200, 0x400, 0x800, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x4000}) do
        local rv, len, buf = try_get(v6, 41, opt, 64)
        if rv == 0 then
            log(string.format("  IPv6-level 0x%x: len=%d val=0x%08x", opt, len,
                memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()))
        end
    end
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(v6) end)
end

log("")
log("=== PS5 OPTS FUZZ DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 32: buffer stress + SETFIB/USER_COOKIE fuzz
-- SO_SNDBUF=1 with large writev, poll edge cases, nonblocking overflow

local out = {}
local function log(s) out[#out+1] = s; print(s) end

log("=== 14.10 RECON: BUF STRESS ===")
log("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
log("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_getpid = 20,
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_writev = 121,
    sc_readv = 120,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
    sc_poll = 209,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_shutdown = 134,
})

local val = memory.alloc(16)
local sp = memory.alloc(8)

local function try_set(fd, level, opt, v, len)
    memory.write_dword(val, v)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_setsockopt(fd, level, opt, val, len or 4)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

local function try_get_val(fd, level, opt)
    local buf = memory.alloc(8)
    local lenp = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(lenp, 4)
    memory.write_dword(buf, 0)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, level, opt, buf, lenp)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999, memory.read_dword(buf):tonumber()
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: SO_SNDBUF=1 + massive writev
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: SNDBUF=1 stress ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Set SNDBUF=1 on sa
log("  set SNDBUF=1: rv=" .. try_set(sa, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, 1))
local _, sndbuf = try_get_val(sa, 0xFFFF, 0x1001)
log("  actual SNDBUF: " .. sndbuf)

-- Set NONBLOCK via F_SETFL bypass
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 4, 4) end) -- O_NONBLOCK

-- Try write of various sizes
for _, sz in ipairs({1, 4, 64, 256, 1024, 4096, 8192}) do
    local wbuf = memory.alloc(sz)
    for i = 0, sz - 1, 4 do memory.write_dword(wbuf + i, 0xAA000000 + i) end
    local ok, ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wbuf, sz) end)
    local rv = ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
    log(string.format("  write(%d): rv=%d", sz, rv))
end

-- Drain some from sb
local drain = memory.alloc(65536)
local ok_d, rv_d = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(sb, drain, 65536) end)
log("  drain: " .. (ok_d and rv_d:tonumber() or -999))

-- Now writev with 1024 iovecs of 1 byte each, SNDBUF still =1
local tiny = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_byte(tiny, 0x42)
local iovecs = memory.alloc(1024 * 16)
for i = 0, 1023 do
    memory.write_qword(iovecs + i * 16, tiny)
    memory.write_qword(iovecs + i * 16 + 8, 1)
end
local ok_wv, rv_wv = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_writev(sa, iovecs, 1024) end)
log("  writev(1024x1, SNDBUF=1): rv=" .. (ok_wv and rv_wv:tonumber() or -999))

-- Drain again
ok_d, rv_d = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(sb, drain, 65536) end)
log("  drain2: " .. (ok_d and rv_d:tonumber() or -999))

-- Set RCVBUF=1 on sb
log("  set RCVBUF=1 on sb: rv=" .. try_set(sb, 0xFFFF, 0x1002, 1))

-- Write to sa when receiver has RCVBUF=1
for _, sz in ipairs({1, 64, 1024, 4096}) do
    local wbuf = memory.alloc(sz)
    memory.write_dword(wbuf, 0xBB000000 + sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wbuf, sz) end)
    log(string.format("  write(%d, RCVBUF=1): rv=%d", sz, ok and ret:tonumber() or -999))
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: Poll edge cases
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: poll edge cases ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Poll on closed peer
pcall(function() syscall.sc_shutdown(sb, 2) end) -- SHUT_RDWR
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

local pollfd = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_dword(pollfd, sa)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0045) -- POLLIN|POLLPRI|POLLHUP
memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
local ok_p, rv_p = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 50) end)
local rev = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
log(string.format("  poll(closed peer): rv=%d revents=0x%04x",
    ok_p and rv_p:tonumber() or -999, rev))

-- Read from socket with closed peer
local rbuf = memory.alloc(16)
local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(sa, rbuf, 16) end)
log("  read(closed peer): rv=" .. (ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -999))

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)

-- Poll with nfds=0
local ok_p0, rv_p0 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 0, 10) end)
log("  poll(nfds=0): rv=" .. (ok_p0 and rv_p0:tonumber() or -999))

-- Poll on invalid fd
memory.write_dword(pollfd, 9999)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
local ok_pi, rv_pi = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 10) end)
local rev_i = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
log(string.format("  poll(fd=9999): rv=%d revents=0x%04x",
    ok_pi and rv_pi:tonumber() or -999, rev_i))

-- Poll with negative fd (FreeBSD ignores negative fds)
memory.write_dword(pollfd, 0xFFFFFFFF) -- -1
memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
local ok_pn, rv_pn = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 10) end)
local rev_n = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
log(string.format("  poll(fd=-1): rv=%d revents=0x%04x",
    ok_pn and rv_pn:tonumber() or -999, rev_n))

-- Multiple pollfds: mix of valid and invalid
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Write data so sa has something to poll
local wbuf = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_qword(wbuf, 0xDEADBEEF)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_write(sb, wbuf, 8) end)

local pollfds = memory.alloc(24) -- 3 pollfds
memory.write_dword(pollfds, sa)         -- valid, has data
memory.write_word(pollfds + 4, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 6, 0)
memory.write_dword(pollfds + 8, 9999)   -- invalid
memory.write_word(pollfds + 12, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 14, 0)
memory.write_dword(pollfds + 16, sb)    -- valid, no data
memory.write_word(pollfds + 20, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 22, 0)

local ok_pm, rv_pm = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfds, 3, 50) end)
log(string.format("  poll(3 mixed): rv=%d rev=[0x%04x,0x%04x,0x%04x]",
    ok_pm and rv_pm:tonumber() or -999,
    memory.read_word(pollfds + 6):tonumber(),
    memory.read_word(pollfds + 14):tonumber(),
    memory.read_word(pollfds + 22):tonumber()))

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: SO_SETFIB (0x1011) fuzzing
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: SO_SETFIB ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local fa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local fab = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Read default

log(string.format("  default: rv=%d val=%d", rv_f, val_f))

-- Set various FIB values
for _, fib in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 15, 16, 31, 32, 255, 256, 0xFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFF, -1}) do
    local srv = try_set(fa, 0xFFFF, 0x1011, fib)
    local grv, gval = try_get_val(fa, 0xFFFF, 0x1011)
    log(string.format("  set(%d): srv=%d get=%d", fib, srv, gval))
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fab) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: SO_USER_COOKIE (0x1012) fuzzing
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: SO_USER_COOKIE ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local ca = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local cab = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

local rv_c, val_c = try_get_val(ca, 0xFFFF, 0x1012)
log(string.format("  default: rv=%d val=%d", rv_c, val_c))

for _, cookie in ipairs({0, 1, 0xDEADBEEF, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF}) do

    local grv, gval = try_get_val(ca, 0xFFFF, 0x1012)

end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ca) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(cab) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 5: SO_TS_CLOCK (0x1013) + timestamp probing
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 5: SO_TS_CLOCK ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local ta = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local tab = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

local rv_t, val_t = try_get_val(ta, 0xFFFF, 0x1013)
log(string.format("  default: rv=%d val=%d", rv_t, val_t))

-- SO_TIMESTAMP = 0x0400, SO_BINTIME = 0x2000 (wait, 0x2000 is PS5 flag)
-- Enable SO_TIMESTAMP
log("  set SO_TIMESTAMP(0x0400)=1: rv=" .. try_set(ta, 0xFFFF, 0x0400, 1))
local _, ts_val = try_get_val(ta, 0xFFFF, 0x0400)
log("  get SO_TIMESTAMP: " .. ts_val)

end

local cmsg_buf = memory.alloc(128)
local recv_buf = memory.alloc(64)

for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)

    local ts_sec = memory.read_qword(cmsg_buf + 16):tonumber()
    local ts_usec = memory.read_qword(cmsg_buf + 24):tonumber()
    log(string.format("  timestamp: sec=%d usec=%d", ts_sec, ts_usec))
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ta) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tab) end)
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 32b: buffer stress (fixed - nonblock FIRST)

})

        return syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, level, opt, buf, lenp)
    end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: SNDBUF=1 nonblocking writes
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 1: SNDBUF=1 nonblk ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- NONBLOCK first!
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 4, 4) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sb, 4, 4) end)

local _, sndbuf = try_get_val(sa, 0xFFFF, 0x1001)

-- Nonblocking writes of various sizes
for _, sz in ipairs({1, 4, 64, 256, 1024, 4096, 8192, 16384}) do

    local ok, ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wbuf, sz) end)
    log(string.format("  write(%d): rv=%d", sz, ok and ret:tonumber() or -999))
end

-- Drain

pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sb, 4, 4) end) -- nonblock
local ok_d, rv_d = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(sb, drain, 65536) end)
log("  drain: " .. (ok_d and rv_d:tonumber() or -999))

-- writev with 1024 iovecs, SNDBUF=1
local tiny = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_byte(tiny, 0x42)
local iovecs = memory.alloc(1024 * 16)
for i = 0, 1023 do
    memory.write_qword(iovecs + i * 16, tiny)
    memory.write_qword(iovecs + i * 16 + 8, 1)
end
local ok_wv, rv_wv = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_writev(sa, iovecs, 1024) end)
log("  writev(1024x1): rv=" .. (ok_wv and rv_wv:tonumber() or -999))

-- Drain again

log("  drain2: " .. (ok_d and rv_d:tonumber() or -999))

-- Now set RCVBUF=1 on sb and fill

local _, rcvbuf = try_get_val(sb, 0xFFFF, 0x1002)
log("  actual RCVBUF: " .. rcvbuf)

-- Write to sa (SNDBUF=1) when sb has RCVBUF=1
for _, sz in ipairs({1, 4, 64, 256, 1024}) do
    local wbuf = memory.alloc(sz)
    memory.write_dword(wbuf, 0xBB000000 + sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wbuf, sz) end)
    log(string.format("  write(%d, both=1): rv=%d", sz, ok and ret:tonumber() or -999))
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: Poll edge cases
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 2: poll edges ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Close peer, then poll
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

local pollfd = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_dword(pollfd, sa)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0045)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
local ok_p, rv_p = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 50) end)
local rev = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
log(string.format("  poll(closed peer): rv=%d rev=0x%04x", ok_p and rv_p:tonumber() or -999, rev))

local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(sa, drain, 16) end)
log("  read(closed peer): rv=" .. (ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -999))
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)

-- poll nfds=0
local ok_p0, rv_p0 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 0, 10) end)
log("  poll(nfds=0): rv=" .. (ok_p0 and rv_p0:tonumber() or -999))

-- poll invalid fd
memory.write_dword(pollfd, 9999)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
local ok_pi, rv_pi = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 10) end)
log(string.format("  poll(fd=9999): rv=%d rev=0x%04x",
    ok_pi and rv_pi:tonumber() or -999, memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()))

-- poll fd=-1
memory.write_dword(pollfd, 0xFFFFFFFF)
memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
local ok_pn, rv_pn = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 10) end)
log(string.format("  poll(fd=-1): rv=%d rev=0x%04x",
    ok_pn and rv_pn:tonumber() or -999, memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()))

-- Mixed poll: valid(data) + invalid + valid(empty)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()
local wbuf = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_qword(wbuf, 0xDEADBEEF)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_write(sb, wbuf, 8) end)

local pollfds = memory.alloc(24)
memory.write_dword(pollfds, sa)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 4, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 6, 0)
memory.write_dword(pollfds + 8, 9999)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 12, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 14, 0)
memory.write_dword(pollfds + 16, sb)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 20, 0x0001)
memory.write_word(pollfds + 22, 0)

local ok_pm, rv_pm = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfds, 3, 50) end)
log(string.format("  poll(3 mixed): rv=%d rev=[0x%04x,0x%04x,0x%04x]",
    ok_pm and rv_pm:tonumber() or -999,
    memory.read_word(pollfds + 6):tonumber(),
    memory.read_word(pollfds + 14):tonumber(),
    memory.read_word(pollfds + 22):tonumber()))

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: SO_SETFIB
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 3: SO_SETFIB ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local fa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local fab = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

local rv_f, val_f = try_get_val(fa, 0xFFFF, 0x1011)
log(string.format("  default: rv=%d val=%d", rv_f, val_f))

for _, fib in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 15, 16, 31, 32, 255, 256, 0xFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFF}) do
    local srv = try_set(fa, 0xFFFF, 0x1011, fib)
    local grv, gval = try_get_val(fa, 0xFFFF, 0x1011)
    log(string.format("  set(%d): srv=%d get=%d", fib, srv, gval))
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fab) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: SO_USER_COOKIE
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 4: SO_USER_COOKIE ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local ca = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local cab = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

local rv_c, val_c = try_get_val(ca, 0xFFFF, 0x1012)
log(string.format("  default: rv=%d val=%d", rv_c, val_c))

for _, cookie in ipairs({0, 1, 42, 0xDEADBEEF, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF}) do
    local srv = try_set(ca, 0xFFFF, 0x1012, cookie)
    local grv, gval = try_get_val(ca, 0xFFFF, 0x1012)
    log(string.format("  set(0x%x): srv=%d get=0x%08x", cookie, srv, gval))
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ca) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(cab) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 5: SO_TIMESTAMP + recvmsg cmsg
-- ============================================================
log("")
log("--- PART 5: SO_TIMESTAMP ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local ta = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local tab = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Enable SO_TIMESTAMP (0x0400)
log("  set SO_TIMESTAMP=1: rv=" .. try_set(ta, 0xFFFF, 0x0400, 1))

-- TS_CLOCK values
for _, clk in ipairs({0, 1, 2, 3}) do
    local srv = try_set(ta, 0xFFFF, 0x1013, clk)
    local grv, gval = try_get_val(ta, 0xFFFF, 0x1013)
    log(string.format("  TS_CLOCK=%d: srv=%d get=%d", clk, srv, gval))
end

-- Write data, recv with cmsg
pcall(function() syscall.sc_write(tab, wbuf, 8) end)

local cmsg_buf = memory.alloc(128)
local recv_buf = memory.alloc(64)
local iov = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(iov, recv_buf)
memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 64)
for i = 0, 127, 8 do memory.write_qword(cmsg_buf + i, 0) end

local mh = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
memory.write_qword(mh + 32, cmsg_buf)
memory.write_qword(mh + 40, 128)

local ok_rm, rv_rm = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_recvmsg(ta, mh, 0) end)
log("  recvmsg: rv=" .. (ok_rm and rv_rm:tonumber() or -999))

-- Parse cmsg
local cmsg_len = memory.read_dword(cmsg_buf):tonumber()
local cmsg_level = memory.read_dword(cmsg_buf + 4):tonumber()
local cmsg_type = memory.read_dword(cmsg_buf + 8):tonumber()
log(string.format("  cmsg: len=%d level=0x%x type=%d", cmsg_len, cmsg_level, cmsg_type))

-- Dump cmsg data
if cmsg_len > 0 then
    local hex = ""
    for i = 0, math.min(cmsg_len, 48) - 1 do
        hex = hex .. string.format("%02x ", memory.read_byte(cmsg_buf + i):tonumber())
    end
    log("  cmsg hex: " .. hex)
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ta) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tab) end)

log("")
log("=== BUF STRESS v2 DONE ===")
log("pid final: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
return table.concat(out, "\n")
```

## probes/phase5_buffer_io/33a_sndbuf_step1.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 33a: SNDBUF=1 isolation step 1
-- Just set SNDBUF=1 + NONBLOCK, do ONE write of 1 byte, report, exit
-- If this survives, step 2 adds more writes

print("=== 33a: SNDBUF=1 STEP1 ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
})

local sp = memory.alloc(8)
local val = memory.alloc(8)
local lenp = memory.alloc(8)

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()
print("pair: " .. sa .. "," .. sb)

-- Set NONBLOCK on both FIRST
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 4, 4) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sb, 4, 4) end)
print("nonblock set")

-- Verify flags
local ok_f, rv_f = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 3, 0) end)
print("sa flags: " .. (ok_f and rv_f:tonumber() or -999))

-- Set SNDBUF=1
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_setsockopt(sa, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, val, 4)
end)
print("set SNDBUF=1: rv=" .. (ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -999))

-- Verify
memory.write_qword(lenp, 4)
memory.write_dword(val, 0)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_getsockopt(sa, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, val, lenp) end)
print("actual SNDBUF: " .. memory.read_dword(val):tonumber())

-- Single 1-byte write
local wb = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_byte(wb, 0x41)
local ok_w, rv_w = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wb, 1) end)
print("write(1): rv=" .. (ok_w and rv_w:tonumber() or -999))

print("=== STEP1 SURVIVED ===")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)
print("=== DONE ===")
```

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 33b: SNDBUF=1 step 2
-- Write 1 byte (fills buffer), then try second write (should get EAGAIN)
-- Then try progressively larger writes

print("=== 33b: SNDBUF=1 STEP2 ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
})

local sp = memory.alloc(8)
local val = memory.alloc(8)

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- NONBLOCK first
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 4, 4) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sb, 4, 4) end)

-- SNDBUF=1
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(sa, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, val, 4) end)
print("SNDBUF=1 set")

-- Write 1: should succeed
local wb = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_byte(wb, 0x41)
local ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wb, 1) end)
print("write1(1): rv=" .. (ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -999))

-- Write 2: buffer full, should EAGAIN (-35) in nonblock
print("about to write2...")
local ok2, rv2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wb, 1) end)
print("write2(1): rv=" .. (ok2 and rv2:tonumber() or -999))

-- Write 3: 4 bytes
print("about to write3...")
local wb4 = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(wb4, 0xDEAD)
local ok3, rv3 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wb4, 4) end)
print("write3(4): rv=" .. (ok3 and rv3:tonumber() or -999))

-- Drain from sb
print("about to drain...")
local drain = memory.alloc(256)
local ok_d, rv_d = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(sb, drain, 256) end)
print("drain: rv=" .. (ok_d and rv_d:tonumber() or -999))

-- Write after drain: 4 bytes
print("about to write4 after drain...")
local ok4, rv4 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wb4, 4) end)
print("write4(4): rv=" .. (ok4 and rv4:tonumber() or -999))

-- Write 64 bytes
print("about to write5...")
local wb64 = memory.alloc(64)
memory.write_dword(wb64, 0xBEEF)
local ok5, rv5 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wb64, 64) end)
print("write5(64): rv=" .. (ok5 and rv5:tonumber() or -999))

-- Write 1024 bytes
print("about to write6...")
local wb1k = memory.alloc(1024)
memory.write_dword(wb1k, 0xCAFE)
local ok6, rv6 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, wb1k, 1024) end)
print("write6(1024): rv=" .. (ok6 and rv6:tonumber() or -999))

print("=== STEP2 SURVIVED ===")
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)
print("=== DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase5_buffer_io/33c_nonblock_test.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 33c: Does O_NONBLOCK actually work?
-- Test if the F_SETFL bypass really gives nonblocking I/O

print("=== 33c: NONBLOCK TEST ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
    sc_socket = 97,
})

local sp = memory.alloc(8)
local val = memory.alloc(8)

-- Test 1: NONBLOCK read on empty socket
pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- Set nonblock
pcall(function() syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 4, 4) end)
local ok_f, rv_f = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(sa, 3, 0) end)
print("flags after SETFL: " .. (ok_f and rv_f:tonumber() or -999))

-- Read from empty socket — if NONBLOCK works, should return -35 (EAGAIN) immediately
print("about to read empty socket with NONBLOCK...")
local rb = memory.alloc(16)
local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(sa, rb, 16) end)
print("read(empty, NONBLK): rv=" .. (ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -999))
-- If we get here, NONBLOCK works for reads

-- Test 2: Fill the send buffer with default SNDBUF, then try one more
-- Default SNDBUF=8192, fill it
print("filling default buffer...")
local big = memory.alloc(8192)
memory.write_dword(big, 0xAAAA)
local ok_w1, rv_w1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, big, 8192) end)
print("write(8192): rv=" .. (ok_w1 and rv_w1:tonumber() or -999))

-- Try another write — buffer should be full
print("about to write to full buffer...")
local ok_w2, rv_w2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(sa, big, 1) end)
print("write(1, full): rv=" .. (ok_w2 and rv_w2:tonumber() or -999))

-- Try with SOCK_NONBLOCK flag at creation (0x20000000)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

-- socketpair with SOCK_NONBLOCK (type | 0x20000000)
print("")
print("--- SOCK_NONBLOCK at creation ---")
local sp2 = memory.alloc(8)
local ok_sp, rv_sp = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1 + 0x20000000, 0, sp2)
end)
print("socketpair(NONBLOCK): rv=" .. (ok_sp and rv_sp:tonumber() or -999))

if ok_sp and rv_sp:tonumber() == 0 then
    local na = memory.read_dword(sp2):tonumber()
    local nb = memory.read_dword(sp2 + 4):tonumber()
    print("pair: " .. na .. "," .. nb)

    local ok_nf, rv_nf = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(na, 3, 0) end)
    print("flags: " .. (ok_nf and rv_nf:tonumber() or -999))

    -- Read empty — should EAGAIN
    print("about to read empty SOCK_NONBLOCK...")
    local ok_nr, rv_nr = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(na, rb, 16) end)
    print("read(empty): rv=" .. (ok_nr and rv_nr:tonumber() or -999))

    -- Set SNDBUF=1 and test
    memory.write_dword(val, 1)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(na, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, val, 4) end)

    -- Write 1 byte
    memory.write_byte(big, 0x42)
    local ok_nw1, rv_nw1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(na, big, 1) end)
    print("write(1, SNDBUF=1): rv=" .. (ok_nw1 and rv_nw1:tonumber() or -999))

    -- Write second byte — should EAGAIN if nonblock works
    print("about to write2 SNDBUF=1...")
    local ok_nw2, rv_nw2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(na, big, 1) end)
    print("write2(1, SNDBUF=1): rv=" .. (ok_nw2 and rv_nw2:tonumber() or -999))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(na) end)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(nb) end)
else
    print("SOCK_NONBLOCK not supported, trying O_NONBLOCK via ioctl")
end

print("=== NONBLOCK TEST DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase5_buffer_io/33d_sock_nonblock.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 33d: SOCK_NONBLOCK at creation
-- F_SETFL doesn't actually enable nonblock. Try socket flags instead.

print("=== 33d: SOCK_NONBLOCK ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
})

local rb = memory.alloc(16)

-- Try SOCK_NONBLOCK (0x20000000) in type field
local sp = memory.alloc(8)
local ok1, rv1 = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1 + 0x20000000, 0, sp) -- STREAM|NONBLOCK
end)
print("socketpair(STREAM|NONBLOCK): rv=" .. (ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -999))

if ok1 and rv1:tonumber() == 0 then
    local na = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
    local nb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()
    print("fds: " .. na .. "," .. nb)

    local ok_f, rv_f = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_fcntl(na, 3, 0) end)
    print("F_GETFL: " .. (ok_f and rv_f:tonumber() or -999))

    -- Test: read empty should return immediately with EAGAIN
    print("about to read empty...")
    local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(na, rb, 16) end)
    print("read(empty): rv=" .. (ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -999))

    -- SNDBUF=1 test
    local val = memory.alloc(4)
    memory.write_dword(val, 1)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(na, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, val, 4) end)

    local wb = memory.alloc(4)
    memory.write_byte(wb, 0x42)
    local ok_w1, rv_w1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(na, wb, 1) end)
    print("write1(1, SNDBUF=1): rv=" .. (ok_w1 and rv_w1:tonumber() or -999))

    print("about to write2...")
    local ok_w2, rv_w2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_write(na, wb, 1) end)
    print("write2(1, SNDBUF=1): rv=" .. (ok_w2 and rv_w2:tonumber() or -999))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(na) end)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(nb) end)
else
    print("SOCK_NONBLOCK failed, trying SOCK_DGRAM|NONBLOCK")
    local ok2, rv2 = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 2 + 0x20000000, 0, sp) -- DGRAM|NONBLOCK
    end)
    print("socketpair(DGRAM|NONBLOCK): rv=" .. (ok2 and rv2:tonumber() or -999))

    if ok2 and rv2:tonumber() == 0 then
        local da = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
        local db = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()
        print("dgram fds: " .. da .. "," .. db)

        print("about to read empty dgram...")
        local ok_dr, rv_dr = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_read(da, rb, 16) end)
        print("dgram read(empty): rv=" .. (ok_dr and rv_dr:tonumber() or -999))

        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(da) end)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(db) end)
    end

    -- Also try MSG_DONTWAIT on sendmsg (0x80)
    print("")
    print("--- MSG_DONTWAIT ---")
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
    local ma = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
    local mb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

    -- Set SNDBUF=1
    local val2 = memory.alloc(4)
    memory.write_dword(val2, 1)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(ma, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, val2, 4) end)

    -- Write 1 byte
    local wb = memory.alloc(4)
    memory.write_byte(wb, 0x43)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_write(ma, wb, 1) end)
    print("write1(1): done")

    -- sendmsg with MSG_DONTWAIT on full buffer
    syscall.resolve({ sc_sendmsg = 28 })
    local pl = memory.alloc(4)
    memory.write_byte(pl, 0x44)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, pl)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 1)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)

    print("about to sendmsg DONTWAIT...")
    local ok_sm, rv_sm = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(ma, mh, 0x80) -- MSG_DONTWAIT
    end)
    print("sendmsg(DONTWAIT): rv=" .. (ok_sm and rv_sm:tonumber() or -999))

    -- Also try recv with MSG_DONTWAIT on empty
    syscall.resolve({ sc_recvmsg = 27 })
    local rbuf = memory.alloc(16)
    local riov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(riov, rbuf)
    memory.write_qword(riov + 8, 16)
    local rmh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(rmh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(rmh + 16, riov)
    memory.write_qword(rmh + 24, 1)

    print("about to recvmsg DONTWAIT on empty mb...")
    local ok_rm, rv_rm = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_recvmsg(mb, rmh, 0x80) -- MSG_DONTWAIT
    end)
    print("recvmsg(DONTWAIT, empty): rv=" .. (ok_rm and rv_rm:tonumber() or -999))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(ma) end)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(mb) end)
end

print("=== SOCK_NONBLOCK DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase5_buffer_io/33e_dontwait.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 33e: MSG_DONTWAIT nonblocking I/O
-- F_SETFL NONBLOCK is cosmetic only. Test per-call MSG_DONTWAIT (0x80).
-- NO blocking reads or writes in this probe.

print("=== 33e: MSG_DONTWAIT ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_read = 3,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_sendto = 133,
    sc_recvfrom = 29,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_fcntl = 92,
})

local sp = memory.alloc(8)

-- Helper: sendmsg with MSG_DONTWAIT
local function send_dw(fd, data_buf, data_len)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, data_buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, data_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(fd, mh, 0x80)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

-- Helper: recvmsg with MSG_DONTWAIT
local function recv_dw(fd, buf, buf_len)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, buf_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_recvmsg(fd, mh, 0x80)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Basic MSG_DONTWAIT test
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 1: MSG_DONTWAIT basic ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
local sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()
print("pair: " .. sa .. "," .. sb)

-- Recv on empty socket — should EAGAIN immediately
local rb = memory.alloc(64)
local rv_re = recv_dw(sa, rb, 64)
print("recv(empty, DONTWAIT): rv=" .. rv_re)

-- Send 8 bytes
local wb = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_qword(wb, 0xDEADBEEFCAFE0001)
local rv_s1 = send_dw(sa, wb, 8)
print("send(8, DONTWAIT): rv=" .. rv_s1)

-- Recv should get data
local rv_r1 = recv_dw(sb, rb, 64)
print("recv(DONTWAIT): rv=" .. rv_r1)
print("  data: 0x" .. string.format("%016x", memory.read_qword(rb):tonumber()))

-- Recv again — empty, should EAGAIN
local rv_r2 = recv_dw(sb, rb, 64)
print("recv(empty again): rv=" .. rv_r2)

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: SNDBUF=1 with MSG_DONTWAIT
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 2: SNDBUF=1 + DONTWAIT ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

local val = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(sa, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, val, 4) end)
print("SNDBUF=1 set")

-- Send 1 byte — should succeed
memory.write_byte(wb, 0x41)
local rv_s2 = send_dw(sa, wb, 1)
print("send1(1): rv=" .. rv_s2)

-- Send again — buffer full, should EAGAIN
local rv_s3 = send_dw(sa, wb, 1)
print("send2(1, full): rv=" .. rv_s3)

-- Send 4 bytes — too big for SNDBUF=1
memory.write_dword(wb, 0xDEAD)
local rv_s4 = send_dw(sa, wb, 4)
print("send3(4, full): rv=" .. rv_s4)

-- Drain
local rv_dr = recv_dw(sb, rb, 64)
print("drain: rv=" .. rv_dr)

-- Send 4 after drain
local rv_s5 = send_dw(sa, wb, 4)
print("send4(4, drained): rv=" .. rv_s5)

-- Send 1024
local big = memory.alloc(1024)
memory.write_dword(big, 0xBEEF)
local rv_s6 = send_dw(sa, big, 1024)
print("send5(1024): rv=" .. rv_s6)

-- Drain all
local rv_dr2 = recv_dw(sb, rb, 64)
print("drain2: rv=" .. rv_dr2)

-- Rapid fire: send/recv cycle 100 times
local ok_count = 0
for i = 1, 100 do
    memory.write_byte(wb, i)
    local srv = send_dw(sa, wb, 1)
    if srv == 1 then
        local rrv = recv_dw(sb, rb, 1)
        if rrv == 1 then ok_count = ok_count + 1 end
    end
end
print("rapid fire 100x: " .. ok_count .. " ok")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: RCVBUF=1 + SNDBUF=1 stress
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 3: both buf=1 ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

memory.write_dword(val, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(sa, 0xFFFF, 0x1001, val, 4) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(sb, 0xFFFF, 0x1002, val, 4) end)
print("SNDBUF=1 + RCVBUF=1")

-- Send 1 byte
local rv_b1 = send_dw(sa, wb, 1)
print("send(1): rv=" .. rv_b1)

-- Send another — should EAGAIN
local rv_b2 = send_dw(sa, wb, 1)
print("send(1, full): rv=" .. rv_b2)

-- Large send
local rv_b3 = send_dw(sa, big, 1024)
print("send(1024): rv=" .. rv_b3)

-- Drain
local rv_b4 = recv_dw(sb, rb, 64)
print("drain: rv=" .. rv_b4)

-- Repeat send+drain 50 times
local ok3 = 0
for i = 1, 50 do
    memory.write_byte(wb, i)
    local s = send_dw(sa, wb, 1)
    if s == 1 then
        local r = recv_dw(sb, rb, 1)
        if r == 1 then ok3 = ok3 + 1 end
    end
end
print("50x send/recv: " .. ok3 .. " ok")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: sendto/recvfrom with MSG_DONTWAIT
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 4: sendto/recvfrom ---")

pcall(function() syscall.sc_socketpair(1, 1, 0, sp) end)
sa = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
sb = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()

-- sendto with MSG_DONTWAIT (flags in arg4)
memory.write_dword(wb, 0xAAAA)
local ok_st, rv_st = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_sendto(sa, wb, 4, 0x80, 0, 0) -- MSG_DONTWAIT, no addr
end)
print("sendto(DONTWAIT): rv=" .. (ok_st and rv_st:tonumber() or -999))

-- recvfrom with MSG_DONTWAIT
local from = memory.alloc(32)
local fromlen = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_qword(fromlen, 32)
local ok_rf, rv_rf = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_recvfrom(sb, rb, 64, 0x80, from, fromlen)
end)
print("recvfrom(DONTWAIT): rv=" .. (ok_rf and rv_rf:tonumber() or -999))

-- recvfrom on empty
local ok_rf2, rv_rf2 = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_recvfrom(sb, rb, 64, 0x80, from, fromlen)
end)
print("recvfrom(empty): rv=" .. (ok_rf2 and rv_rf2:tonumber() or -999))

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sa) end)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sb) end)

print("")
print("=== MSG_DONTWAIT DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase6_raw_packets/34_raw_hdrincl.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 34: RAW socket + IP_HDRINCL to localhost
-- Test if we can inject crafted IP packets into kernel's ip_input() path
-- This bypasses the syscall sandbox — kernel parses our packet data directly

print("=== 34: RAW HDRINCL LOCALHOST ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_socketpair = 135,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_listen = 106,
    sc_poll = 209,
})

local function send_dw(fd, data_buf, data_len, name_buf, name_len)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, data_buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, data_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    if name_buf and name_len then
        memory.write_qword(mh + 0, name_buf)   -- msg_name
        memory.write_qword(mh + 8, name_len)   -- msg_namelen
    end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)   -- msg_iov
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)     -- msg_iovlen
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(fd, mh, 0x80) -- MSG_DONTWAIT
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

local function recv_dw(fd, buf, buf_len)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, buf_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_recvmsg(fd, mh, 0x80)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

-- Helper: build sockaddr_in (16 bytes)
local function make_sockaddr_in(ip_a, ip_b, ip_c, ip_d, port)
    local sa = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)       -- sin_len
    memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)        -- sin_family = AF_INET
    -- port in network byte order (big endian)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(port / 256))
    memory.write_byte(sa + 3, port % 256)
    -- IP address
    memory.write_byte(sa + 4, ip_a)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 5, ip_b)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 6, ip_c)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 7, ip_d)
    return sa
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 1: Create RAW socket + IP_HDRINCL
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 1: RAW socket creation ---")

-- socket(AF_INET, SOCK_RAW, IPPROTO_RAW=255)
local ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255) end)
local raw_fd = ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -1
print("socket(INET,RAW,255): fd=" .. raw_fd)

if raw_fd < 0 then
    -- Try IPPROTO_TCP(6) raw
    ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 6) end)
    raw_fd = ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -1
    print("socket(INET,RAW,TCP): fd=" .. raw_fd)
end

if raw_fd < 0 then
    -- Try IPPROTO_UDP(17) raw
    ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 17) end)
    raw_fd = ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -1
    print("socket(INET,RAW,UDP): fd=" .. raw_fd)
end

if raw_fd < 0 then
    -- Try IPPROTO_ICMP(1) raw
    ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 1) end)
    raw_fd = ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -1
    print("socket(INET,RAW,ICMP): fd=" .. raw_fd)
end

if raw_fd < 0 then
    -- Try protocol 0
    ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 0) end)
    raw_fd = ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -1
    print("socket(INET,RAW,0): fd=" .. raw_fd)
end

if raw_fd < 0 then
    print("ALL RAW SOCKETS FAILED - trying scan")
    -- Scan protocols 0-20
    for proto = 0, 20 do
        local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, proto) end)
        local fd_s = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
        if fd_s >= 0 then
            print("  proto " .. proto .. " -> fd=" .. fd_s)
            if raw_fd < 0 then raw_fd = fd_s
            else pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd_s) end) end
        end
    end
end

if raw_fd < 0 then
    print("NO RAW SOCKET AVAILABLE")
    print("=== 34 DONE (no raw) ===")
    return
end

print("using raw_fd=" .. raw_fd)

-- Set IP_HDRINCL
local val = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
local ok_hi, rv_hi = pcall(function()
    return syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw_fd, 0, 2, val, 4) -- IPPROTO_IP=0, IP_HDRINCL=2
end)
print("IP_HDRINCL set: rv=" .. (ok_hi and rv_hi:tonumber() or -999))

-- Verify
local gval = memory.alloc(4)
local glen = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(glen, 4)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_getsockopt(raw_fd, 0, 2, gval, glen) end)
print("IP_HDRINCL get: " .. memory.read_dword(gval):tonumber())

-- ============================================================
-- PART 2: Set up TCP listener on localhost:31337
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 2: TCP listener ---")

local ok_tcp, rv_tcp = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6) end)
local tcp_fd = ok_tcp and rv_tcp:tonumber() or -1
print("TCP socket: fd=" .. tcp_fd)

if tcp_fd >= 0 then
    local sa_listen = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 31337)
    local ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(tcp_fd, sa_listen, 16) end)
    print("bind(127.0.0.1:31337): rv=" .. (ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() or -999))

    local ok_l, rv_l = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_listen(tcp_fd, 5) end)
    print("listen: rv=" .. (ok_l and rv_l:tonumber() or -999))
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 3: Craft and send raw IP packet (TCP SYN to 127.0.0.1:31337)
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 3: send raw IP packet ---")

-- Build a minimal IP header + TCP SYN
-- IP header: 20 bytes (no options)
-- TCP header: 20 bytes (no options)
-- Total: 40 bytes

local pkt = memory.alloc(64)

-- IP header (20 bytes)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 0, 0x45)    -- version=4, IHL=5 (20 bytes)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 1, 0x00)    -- DSCP/ECN
memory.write_byte(pkt + 2, 0x00)    -- total length high (40)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 3, 40)      -- total length low
memory.write_byte(pkt + 4, 0x00)    -- identification high
memory.write_byte(pkt + 5, 0x01)    -- identification low
memory.write_byte(pkt + 6, 0x40)    -- flags=DF, frag offset=0
memory.write_byte(pkt + 7, 0x00)    -- frag offset low
memory.write_byte(pkt + 8, 64)      -- TTL
memory.write_byte(pkt + 9, 6)       -- protocol=TCP
memory.write_byte(pkt + 10, 0x00)   -- checksum (kernel fills)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 11, 0x00)
-- src IP: 127.0.0.1
memory.write_byte(pkt + 12, 127)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 13, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 14, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 15, 1)
-- dst IP: 127.0.0.1
memory.write_byte(pkt + 16, 127)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 17, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 18, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 19, 1)

-- TCP header (20 bytes) at offset 20
-- src port: 12345
memory.write_byte(pkt + 20, 0x30)   -- 12345 >> 8 = 48
memory.write_byte(pkt + 21, 0x39)   -- 12345 & 0xFF = 57
-- dst port: 31337
memory.write_byte(pkt + 22, 0x7A)   -- 31337 >> 8 = 122
memory.write_byte(pkt + 23, 0x69)   -- 31337 & 0xFF = 105
-- seq number: 0x00000001
memory.write_byte(pkt + 24, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 25, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 26, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 27, 1)
-- ack number: 0
memory.write_byte(pkt + 28, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 29, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 30, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 31, 0)
-- data offset (5<<4=0x50) + flags (SYN=0x02)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 32, 0x50)   -- data offset = 5 (20 bytes), no flags high
memory.write_byte(pkt + 33, 0x02)   -- SYN
-- window size: 65535
memory.write_byte(pkt + 34, 0xFF)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 35, 0xFF)
-- checksum: 0 (we'll see if kernel fills or if it matters)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 36, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 37, 0)
-- urgent pointer: 0
memory.write_byte(pkt + 38, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 39, 0)

-- Destination sockaddr for sendmsg
local sa_dst = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 0)

-- Send the crafted packet
local rv_send = send_dw(raw_fd, pkt, 40, sa_dst, 16)
print("sendmsg(raw SYN): rv=" .. rv_send)

-- Try without HDRINCL destination port
local sa_dst2 = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 31337)
local rv_send2 = send_dw(raw_fd, pkt, 40, sa_dst2, 16)
print("sendmsg(raw SYN, port): rv=" .. rv_send2)

-- ============================================================
-- PART 4: Check if SYN arrived at listener
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 4: check listener ---")

if tcp_fd >= 0 then
    -- Poll the listening socket
    local pollfd = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_dword(pollfd, tcp_fd)       -- fd
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)    -- POLLIN
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)         -- revents

    local ok_p, rv_p = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 100) end)
    local revents = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
    print("poll(listener, 100ms): rv=" .. (ok_p and rv_p:tonumber() or -999) .. " revents=0x" .. string.format("%04x", revents))

    if revents > 0 then
        print("*** PACKET REACHED LISTENER ***")
    else
        print("no connection (packet may not have arrived)")
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 5: Try sending raw UDP to see if any raw path works
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 5: raw UDP test ---")

-- Create UDP listener on 127.0.0.1:31338
local ok_udp, rv_udp = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
local udp_fd = ok_udp and rv_udp:tonumber() or -1
print("UDP socket: fd=" .. udp_fd)

if udp_fd >= 0 then
    local sa_udp = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 31338)
    local ok_ub, rv_ub = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(udp_fd, sa_udp, 16) end)
    print("bind(UDP 31338): rv=" .. (ok_ub and rv_ub:tonumber() or -999))

    -- Craft raw IP+UDP packet
    local upkt = memory.alloc(48)
    -- IP header
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 0, 0x45)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 1, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 2, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 3, 32)     -- total len = 20(IP) + 8(UDP) + 4(data) = 32
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 4, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 5, 0x02)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 6, 0x40)   -- DF
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 7, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 8, 64)     -- TTL
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 9, 17)     -- protocol=UDP
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 10, 0)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 11, 0)
    -- src 127.0.0.1
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 12, 127)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 13, 0)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 14, 0)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 15, 1)
    -- dst 127.0.0.1
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 16, 127)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 17, 0)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 18, 0)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 19, 1)

    -- UDP header at offset 20
    -- src port: 12345
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 20, 0x30)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 21, 0x39)
    -- dst port: 31338
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 22, 0x7A)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 23, 0x6A)  -- 31338
    -- length: 12 (8 header + 4 data)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 24, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 25, 0x0C)
    -- checksum: 0
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 26, 0)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 27, 0)
    -- data: BEEF
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 28, 0xBE)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 29, 0xEF)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 30, 0xCA)
    memory.write_byte(upkt + 31, 0xFE)

    local sa_udst = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 0)
    local rv_us = send_dw(raw_fd, upkt, 32, sa_udst, 16)
    print("sendmsg(raw UDP): rv=" .. rv_us)

    -- Poll UDP listener
    local pollfd2 = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_dword(pollfd2, udp_fd)
    memory.write_word(pollfd2 + 4, 0x0001)
    memory.write_word(pollfd2 + 6, 0)

    local ok_p2, rv_p2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd2, 1, 100) end)
    local rev2 = memory.read_word(pollfd2 + 6):tonumber()
    print("poll(UDP, 100ms): rv=" .. (ok_p2 and rv_p2:tonumber() or -999) .. " revents=0x" .. string.format("%04x", rev2))

    if rev2 > 0 then
        print("*** UDP PACKET REACHED LISTENER ***")
        local rbuf = memory.alloc(64)
        local rrv = recv_dw(udp_fd, rbuf, 64)
        print("recv: rv=" .. rrv)
        if rrv > 0 then
            local hex = ""
            for i = 0, math.min(rrv - 1, 15) do
                hex = hex .. string.format("%02x ", memory.read_byte(rbuf + i):tonumber())
            end
            print("data: " .. hex)
        end
    end

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(udp_fd) end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- PART 6: Try raw socket bound to loopback
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- PART 6: bound raw socket ---")

local ok_r2, rv_r2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255) end)
local raw2 = ok_r2 and rv_r2:tonumber() or -1
if raw2 >= 0 then
    memory.write_dword(val, 1)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw2, 0, 2, val, 4) end)

    local sa_lo = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 0)
    local ok_rb, rv_rb = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(raw2, sa_lo, 16) end)
    print("bind(raw,lo): rv=" .. (ok_rb and rv_rb:tonumber() or -999))

    -- Connect raw to loopback
    local ok_rc, rv_rc = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_connect(raw2, sa_lo, 16) end)
    print("connect(raw,lo): rv=" .. (ok_rc and rv_rc:tonumber() or -999))

    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(raw2) end)
else
    print("second raw socket failed")
end

-- Cleanup
pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(raw_fd) end)
if tcp_fd >= 0 then pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(tcp_fd) end) end

print("")
print("=== 34 DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase6_raw_packets/35_frag_fuzz.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 35: IP fragment reassembly fuzzing
-- RAW+HDRINCL confirmed working (probe 34). UDP with checksum 0 accepted.
-- Target: kernel ip_reass() — overlapping frags, tiny frags, frag bombs
-- Each test sends fragments to a UDP listener and checks what arrives.

print("=== 35: FRAG REASSEMBLY FUZZ ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_poll = 209,
})

local function send_raw(fd, pkt_buf, pkt_len, dst_sa)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, pkt_buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, pkt_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 0, dst_sa)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 8, 16)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(fd, mh, 0x80)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

local function recv_dw(fd, buf, buf_len)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, buf_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_recvmsg(fd, mh, 0x80)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

local function poll_fd(fd, timeout_ms)
    local pfd = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_dword(pfd, fd)
    memory.write_word(pfd + 4, 0x0001)
    memory.write_word(pfd + 6, 0)
    local ok, rv = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pfd, 1, timeout_ms) end)
    return ok and rv:tonumber() or -1, memory.read_word(pfd + 6):tonumber()
end

local function make_sockaddr_in(a, b, c, d, port)
    local sa = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(port / 256))
    memory.write_byte(sa + 3, port % 256)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 4, a)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 5, b)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 6, c)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 7, d)
    return sa
end

-- Build IP header into buf at offset 0
-- frag_off is in 8-byte units, MF = more fragments flag
-- total_len includes IP header
local function write_ip_hdr(buf, total_len, ident, MF, frag_off, proto)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 0, 0x45)       -- ver=4, ihl=5
    memory.write_byte(buf + 1, 0x00)       -- tos
    memory.write_byte(buf + 2, math.floor(total_len / 256))
    memory.write_byte(buf + 3, total_len % 256)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 4, math.floor(ident / 256))
    memory.write_byte(buf + 5, ident % 256)
    -- flags + frag offset (13 bits, in 8-byte units)
    local flags_frag = frag_off
    if MF then flags_frag = flags_frag + 0x2000 end  -- MF bit
    memory.write_byte(buf + 6, math.floor(flags_frag / 256))
    memory.write_byte(buf + 7, flags_frag % 256)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 8, 64)         -- TTL
    memory.write_byte(buf + 9, proto)      -- protocol
    memory.write_byte(buf + 10, 0)         -- checksum (kernel fills for loopback)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 11, 0)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 12, 127)       -- src
    memory.write_byte(buf + 13, 0)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 14, 0)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 15, 1)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 16, 127)       -- dst
    memory.write_byte(buf + 17, 0)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 18, 0)
    memory.write_byte(buf + 19, 1)
end

-- Fill payload bytes at buf+offset with pattern
local function fill_pattern(buf, offset, len, pat_byte)
    for i = 0, len - 1 do
        memory.write_byte(buf + offset + i, pat_byte)
    end
end

-- Setup: RAW socket + UDP listener
local ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255) end)
local raw_fd = ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -1
print("raw_fd=" .. raw_fd)

local val = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw_fd, 0, 2, val, 4) end)

local dst_sa = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 0)

local ok_u, rv_u = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
local udp_fd = ok_u and rv_u:tonumber() or -1
local sa_udp = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 44444)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_bind(udp_fd, sa_udp, 16) end)
print("udp_fd=" .. udp_fd)

local rbuf = memory.alloc(2048)
local pkt = memory.alloc(1600)

local test_id = 100  -- IP identification counter

-- ============================================================
-- TEST 1: Normal 2-fragment reassembly (baseline)
-- Fragment 1: IP(20) + UDP(8) + 8 bytes data, MF=1, offset=0
-- Fragment 2: IP(20) + 8 bytes data, MF=0, offset=2 (=16 bytes)
-- Total payload: UDP(8) + 16 bytes = reassembled
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- TEST 1: normal 2-frag ---")
test_id = test_id + 1

-- Frag 1: offset=0, MF=1, carries UDP header + 8 bytes
-- UDP hdr: src=11111, dst=44444, len=24 (8+16), cksum=0
write_ip_hdr(pkt, 20 + 16, test_id, true, 0, 17)
-- UDP header in payload
memory.write_byte(pkt + 20, 0x2B)   -- src port 11111 = 0x2B67
memory.write_byte(pkt + 21, 0x67)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 22, 0xAD)   -- dst port 44444 = 0xAD9C
memory.write_byte(pkt + 23, 0x9C)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 24, 0x00)   -- UDP length 24
memory.write_byte(pkt + 25, 0x18)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 26, 0x00)   -- checksum 0
memory.write_byte(pkt + 27, 0x00)
fill_pattern(pkt, 28, 8, 0xAA)      -- 8 bytes data

local rv_f1 = send_raw(raw_fd, pkt, 36, dst_sa)
print("frag1(MF,off=0): rv=" .. rv_f1)

-- Frag 2: offset=2 (=16 bytes), MF=0, 8 bytes payload
write_ip_hdr(pkt, 20 + 8, test_id, false, 2, 17)
fill_pattern(pkt, 20, 8, 0xBB)

local rv_f2 = send_raw(raw_fd, pkt, 28, dst_sa)
print("frag2(off=2): rv=" .. rv_f2)

local prv, prev = poll_fd(udp_fd, 200)
print("poll: rv=" .. prv .. " rev=0x" .. string.format("%04x", prev))
if prev > 0 then
    local rrv = recv_dw(udp_fd, rbuf, 2048)
    print("recv: rv=" .. rrv)
    if rrv > 0 then
        local hex = ""
        for i = 0, math.min(rrv - 1, 31) do
            hex = hex .. string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(rbuf + i):tonumber())
            if i % 8 == 7 then hex = hex .. " " end
        end
        print("data: " .. hex)
    end
else
    print("NO DATA (reassembly failed or dropped)")
end

-- ============================================================
-- TEST 2: Reverse order fragments (frag2 first, then frag1)
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- TEST 2: reverse order ---")
test_id = test_id + 1

-- Send last fragment first
write_ip_hdr(pkt, 20 + 8, test_id, false, 2, 17)
fill_pattern(pkt, 20, 8, 0xDD)
send_raw(raw_fd, pkt, 28, dst_sa)
print("frag2 sent first")

-- Now send first fragment
write_ip_hdr(pkt, 20 + 16, test_id, true, 0, 17)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 20, 0x2B)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 21, 0x67)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 22, 0xAD)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 23, 0x9C)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 24, 0x00)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 25, 0x18)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 26, 0x00)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 27, 0x00)
fill_pattern(pkt, 28, 8, 0xCC)
send_raw(raw_fd, pkt, 36, dst_sa)
print("frag1 sent second")
```

## probes/phase6_raw_packets/35b_frag_isolate.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Recon Probe 35b: Isolate why fragments don't arrive
-- Probe 34: unfragmented UDP via raw+HDRINCL → arrived at listener
-- Probe 35: ALL fragments (and even test 7 unfragmented) → nothing arrived
-- Hypothesis: port mismatch, listener setup, or raw socket state issue
-- This probe tests step by step with minimal code.

print("=== 35b: FRAG ISOLATE ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_poll = 209,
})

local function send_raw(fd, pkt_buf, pkt_len, dst_sa)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, pkt_buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, pkt_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 0, dst_sa)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 8, 16)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(fd, mh, 0x80)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

local function recv_dw(fd, buf, buf_len)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, buf_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_recvmsg(fd, mh, 0x80)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

local function poll_fd(fd, ms)
    local pfd = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_dword(pfd, fd)
    memory.write_word(pfd + 4, 0x0001)
    memory.write_word(pfd + 6, 0)
    local ok, rv = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pfd, 1, ms) end)
    return ok and rv:tonumber() or -1, memory.read_word(pfd + 6):tonumber()
end

local function make_sa(a, b, c, d, port)
    local sa = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(port / 256))
    memory.write_byte(sa + 3, port % 256)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 4, a)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 5, b)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 6, c)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 7, d)
    return sa
end

local pkt = memory.alloc(256)
local rbuf = memory.alloc(256)

-- ============================================================
-- STEP A: Exact clone of probe 34 working test
-- RAW(255) + HDRINCL + unfragmented UDP to listener
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- STEP A: clone probe 34 ---")

local ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255) end)
local raw_fd = ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -1
print("raw_fd=" .. raw_fd)

local val = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw_fd, 0, 2, val, 4) end)

-- UDP listener on port 55555
local ok_u, rv_u = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
local udp_fd = ok_u and rv_u:tonumber() or -1
local sa_bind = make_sa(127, 0, 0, 1, 55555)
local ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(udp_fd, sa_bind, 16) end)
print("udp_fd=" .. udp_fd .. " bind=" .. (ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() or -999))

-- Build unfragmented IP+UDP packet (exact same as probe 34 part 5)
-- IP: 20 bytes, UDP: 8 bytes, data: 4 bytes = 32 total
memory.write_byte(pkt + 0, 0x45)    -- ver=4 ihl=5
memory.write_byte(pkt + 1, 0x00)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 2, 0x00)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 3, 32)      -- total=32
memory.write_byte(pkt + 4, 0x00)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 5, 0x50)    -- ident
memory.write_byte(pkt + 6, 0x40)    -- DF flag, no frag
memory.write_byte(pkt + 7, 0x00)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 8, 64)      -- TTL
memory.write_byte(pkt + 9, 17)      -- UDP
memory.write_byte(pkt + 10, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 11, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 12, 127)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 13, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 14, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 15, 1)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 16, 127)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 17, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 18, 0)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 19, 1)
-- UDP: src=12345 dst=55555
memory.write_byte(pkt + 20, 0x30)   -- 12345
memory.write_byte(pkt + 21, 0x39)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 22, 0xD9)   -- 55555 = 0xD903
memory.write_byte(pkt + 23, 0x03)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 24, 0x00)   -- udp len=12
memory.write_byte(pkt + 25, 0x0C)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 26, 0x00)   -- checksum=0
memory.write_byte(pkt + 27, 0x00)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 28, 0xBE)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 29, 0xEF)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 30, 0xCA)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 31, 0xFE)

local dst = make_sa(127, 0, 0, 1, 0)
local srv = send_raw(raw_fd, pkt, 32, dst)
print("send(unfrag): rv=" .. srv)

local prv, prev = poll_fd(udp_fd, 200)
print("poll: rv=" .. prv .. " rev=0x" .. string.format("%04x", prev))
if prev > 0 then
    local rrv = recv_dw(udp_fd, rbuf, 256)
    print("recv: rv=" .. rrv)
    if rrv > 0 then
        local h = ""
        for i = 0, math.min(rrv-1, 7) do h = h .. string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(rbuf+i):tonumber()) end
        print("data: " .. h)
    end
    print("STEP A: PASS")
else
    print("STEP A: FAIL (unfragmented not arriving)")
end

-- ============================================================
-- STEP B: Same packet but WITHOUT DF flag (flags=0)
-- ============================================================
print("")
print("--- STEP B: no DF flag ---")

memory.write_byte(pkt + 5, 0x51)    -- new ident
memory.write_byte(pkt + 6, 0x00)    -- flags=0, offset=0 (no DF, no MF)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 7, 0x00)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 28, 0xDE)
memory.write_byte(pkt + 29, 0xAD)

srv = send_raw(raw_fd, pkt, 32, dst)
print("send(no-DF): rv=" .. srv)

prv, prev = poll_fd(udp_fd, 200)
print("poll: rv=" .. prv .. " rev=0x" .. string.format("%04x", prev))
if prev > 0 then
    local rrv = recv_dw(udp_fd, rbuf, 256)
    print("recv: rv=" .. rrv)
    if rrv > 0 then
        local h = ""
        for i = 0, math.min(rrv-1, 7) do h = h .. string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(rbuf+i):tonumber()) end
        print("data: " .. h)
    end
    print("STEP B: PASS")
else
    print("STEP B: FAIL")
end

-- ============================================================
-- STEP C: Minimal 2-fragment test
-- Frag1: IP(20) + UDP(8) + 8 data = 36 bytes, offset=0, MF=1
-- Frag2: IP(20) + 8 data = 28 bytes, offset=2, MF=0
-- Same ident, same raw socket, same listener
-- ============================================================
print("")
```
