## probes/phase6_raw_packets/36_bind_port_sweep.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 36: bind() port sweep
-- Goal: unblock fragment reassembly testing (Finding 8) by mapping which
-- ports actually bind on loopback for UDP and TCP listeners.
-- Safe: no crash primitives, pure bind/close cycles.

print("=== 36: BIND PORT SWEEP ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_listen = 106,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
})

local function make_sockaddr_in(ip_a, ip_b, ip_c, ip_d, port)
    local sa = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)        -- AF_INET
    memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(port / 256))
    memory.write_byte(sa + 3, port % 256)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 4, ip_a)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 5, ip_b)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 6, ip_c)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 7, ip_d)
    return sa
end

-- Candidate ports: known-good from probe 34 (31337/31338), loader-adjacent,
-- low/system ports, ephemeral range, and edge cases.
local ports = {
    0,      -- ephemeral: let kernel pick
    1, 53, 80, 443, 1023, 1024,
    5000, 8080, 9026, 9027,
    31337, 31338, 31339, 31340,
    40000, 49152, 50000, 60000, 65534, 65535,
}

print("")
print("--- UDP bind sweep (127.0.0.1) ---")
local udp_ok = {}
for _, p in ipairs(ports) do
    local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
    local fd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
    if fd >= 0 then
        local sa = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, p)
        local ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(fd, sa, 16) end)
        local rv = ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() or -999
        print(string.format("UDP bind port %5d: rv=%d", p, rv))
        if rv == 0 then table.insert(udp_ok, p) end
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
    else
        print(string.format("UDP bind port %5d: SOCKET FAILED", p))
    end
end

print("")
print("--- TCP bind+listen sweep (127.0.0.1) ---")
local tcp_ok = {}
for _, p in ipairs(ports) do
    local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6) end)
    local fd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
    if fd >= 0 then
        local sa = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, p)
        local ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(fd, sa, 16) end)
        local rv = ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() or -999
        local lrv = -1
        if rv == 0 then
            local ok_l, rv_l = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_listen(fd, 4) end)
            lrv = ok_l and rv_l:tonumber() or -999
            table.insert(tcp_ok, p)
        end
        print(string.format("TCP bind port %5d: rv=%d listen=%d", p, rv, lrv))
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
    else
        print(string.format("TCP bind port %5d: SOCKET FAILED", p))
    end
end

-- Also test bind on INADDR_ANY (0.0.0.0) for a known-good port, in case
-- the restriction is address-specific rather than port-specific.
print("")
print("--- INADDR_ANY comparison ---")
for _, p in ipairs({31338, 9027}) do
    local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
    local fd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
    if fd >= 0 then
        local sa = make_sockaddr_in(0, 0, 0, 0, p)
        local ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(fd, sa, 16) end)
        print(string.format("UDP bind 0.0.0.0:%d: rv=%d", p, ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() or -999))
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
    end
end

-- Double-bind test: does SO_REUSEADDR change anything? (rebind same port twice)
print("")
print("--- SO_REUSEADDR double-bind ---")
local f1 = -1
local ok1, rv1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
f1 = ok1 and rv1:tonumber() or -1
if f1 >= 0 then
    local sa = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 31338)
    local okb1, rvb1 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(f1, sa, 16) end)
    print("first bind: rv=" .. (okb1 and rvb1:tonumber() or -999))
    local ok2, rv2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
    local f2 = ok2 and rv2:tonumber() or -1
    if f2 >= 0 then
        local v = memory.alloc(4)
        memory.write_dword(v, 1)
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(f2, 0xFFFF, 0x0004, v, 4) end) -- SO_REUSEADDR
        local okb2, rvb2 = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(f2, sa, 16) end)
        print("second bind (REUSEADDR): rv=" .. (okb2 and rvb2:tonumber() or -999))
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(f2) end)
    end
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(f1) end)
end

print("")
print("--- SUMMARY ---")
local s = "UDP bindable: "
for _, p in ipairs(udp_ok) do s = s .. p .. " " end
print(s)
s = "TCP bindable: "
for _, p in ipairs(tcp_ok) do s = s .. p .. " " end
print(s)
print("=== 36 DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase6_raw_packets/37_ip_options.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 37: IP options injection via RAW + IP_HDRINCL
-- Target: ip_dooptions() — complex option parsing (RR, TS, LSRR, SSRR) runs
-- in kernel context on packet input, OUTSIDE the syscall sandbox.
-- No fragment reassembly needed. Malformed option lengths included.

print("=== 37: IP OPTIONS INJECTION ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_poll = 209,
})

local MSG_DONTWAIT = 0x80

local function make_sockaddr_in(ip_a, ip_b, ip_c, ip_d, port)
    local sa = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(port / 256))
    memory.write_byte(sa + 3, port % 256)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 4, ip_a)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 5, ip_b)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 6, ip_c)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 7, ip_d)
    return sa
end

local function send_dw(fd, data_buf, data_len, name_buf, name_len)
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, data_buf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, data_len)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    if name_buf and name_len then
        memory.write_qword(mh + 0, name_buf)
        memory.write_qword(mh + 8, name_len)
    end
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_sendmsg(fd, mh, MSG_DONTWAIT)
    end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- Setup: RAW socket with HDRINCL
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255) end)
local raw_fd = ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -1
print("raw socket: fd=" .. raw_fd)
if raw_fd < 0 then
    print("=== 37 DONE (no raw) ===")
    return
end
local val = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw_fd, 0, 2, val, 4) end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- Setup: UDP listener — try candidate ports until one binds
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
local udp_fd = -1
local listen_port = 0
for _, p in ipairs({31338, 31337, 9027, 40000, 50000, 1234}) do
    local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
    local fd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
    if fd >= 0 then
        local sa = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, p)
        local ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(fd, sa, 16) end)
        if ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() == 0 then
            udp_fd = fd
            listen_port = p
            print("UDP listener bound on 127.0.0.1:" .. p .. " fd=" .. fd)
            break
        end
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
    end
end
if udp_fd < 0 then
    print("NO BINDABLE UDP PORT — run probe 36 first")
    print("=== 37 DONE (no listener) ===")
    return
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- Packet builder: IP header with options + UDP payload to listener
-- opts: array of bytes (must pad total IP header to 4-byte boundary)
-- Returns packet length sent.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
local function ip_checksum(buf, len)
    -- one's complement sum over 16-bit words
    local sum = 0
    local i = 0
    while i + 1 < len do
        sum = sum + memory.read_byte(buf + i):tonumber() * 256
              + memory.read_byte(buf + i + 1):tonumber()
        i = i + 2
    end
    while sum > 0xFFFF do
        sum = math.floor(sum / 65536) + (sum % 65536)
    end
    return 0xFFFF - sum
end

local function send_opt_packet(opts, tag)
    local ihl = 5 + math.floor((#opts + 3) / 4)
    local ip_hlen = ihl * 4
    local udp_len = 8 + 4
    local total = ip_hlen + udp_len
    local pkt = memory.alloc(total + 4)
    for i = 0, total + 3 do memory.write_byte(pkt + i, 0) end

    -- IP header
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 0, 0x40 + ihl)      -- version 4, IHL
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 1, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 2, math.floor(total / 256))
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 3, total % 256)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 4, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 5, 0x37)            -- id
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 6, 0x40)            -- DF
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 7, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 8, 64)              -- TTL
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 9, 17)              -- UDP
    -- checksum at +10 filled below
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 12, 127)            -- src 127.0.0.1
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 15, 1)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 16, 127)            -- dst 127.0.0.1
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 19, 1)

    -- options (pad with EOL=0)
    for i, b in ipairs(opts) do
        memory.write_byte(pkt + 20 + i - 1, b)
    end

    -- real IP checksum (do not rely on kernel filling it for opt packets)
    local cks = ip_checksum(pkt, ip_hlen)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 10, math.floor(cks / 256))
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 11, cks % 256)

    -- UDP header
    local u = pkt + ip_hlen
    memory.write_byte(u + 0, 0x30)              -- src port 12345
    memory.write_byte(u + 1, 0x39)
    memory.write_byte(u + 2, math.floor(listen_port / 256))
    memory.write_byte(u + 3, listen_port % 256)
    memory.write_byte(u + 4, 0x00)              -- length 12
    memory.write_byte(u + 5, 0x0C)
    memory.write_byte(u + 6, 0x00)              -- checksum 0 (legal for IPv4)
    memory.write_byte(u + 7, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(u + 8, 0xC0)              -- payload marker
    memory.write_byte(u + 9, 0xFF)
    memory.write_byte(u + 10, 0xEE)
    memory.write_byte(u + 11, 0x11)

    local sa_dst = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 0)
    local rv = send_dw(raw_fd, pkt, total, sa_dst, 16)

    -- drain listener, report whether datagram arrived
    local pollfd = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_dword(pollfd, udp_fd)
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 150) end)
    local rev = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
    local delivered = "no"
    if rev > 0 then
        local rbuf = memory.alloc(64)
        local iov = memory.alloc(16)
        memory.write_qword(iov, rbuf)
        memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 64)
        local mh = memory.alloc(64)
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
        memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
        memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
        local ok_rr, rv_rr = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_recvmsg(udp_fd, mh, MSG_DONTWAIT) end)
        local n = ok_rr and rv_rr:tonumber() or -999
        delivered = "YES (recv=" .. n .. ")"
    end
    print(string.format("%-28s send rv=%3d  delivered=%s", tag, rv, delivered))
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- Option test cases
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- baseline + well-formed options ---")

send_opt_packet({}, "baseline no options")

-- NOP x4
send_opt_packet({1, 1, 1, 1}, "NOP x4")

-- Record Route (7), len 7, ptr 4, one slot
send_opt_packet({7, 7, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1}, "RR len7 empty")

-- RR fully populated: len 39, ptr 40 (past end)
send_opt_packet({7, 39, 40,
    127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1,
    127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1,
    127,0,0,1, 1,1,1}, "RR len39 full ptr40")

-- Timestamp (68): len 8, ptr 5, flags 0
send_opt_packet({68, 8, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, "TS len8 flags0")

-- TS with overflow flag set (flg=15)
send_opt_packet({68, 8, 5, 0xF0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, "TS overflow-flag")

-- LSRR (131) with 127.0.0.1 hop, ptr 4
send_opt_packet({131, 7, 4, 127, 0, 0, 1, 1}, "LSRR loopback")

-- SSRR (137) with 127.0.0.1 hop
send_opt_packet({137, 7, 4, 127, 0, 0, 1, 1}, "SSRR loopback")

print("")
print("--- malformed options (the interesting ones) ---")

-- Option length 0 (classic parser killer)
send_opt_packet({7, 0, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1}, "RR len=0")

-- Option length exceeds remaining header
send_opt_packet({7, 39, 4, 127, 0, 0, 1, 1}, "RR len39 in 8B space")

-- Truncated option: claims 12 bytes, only 8 present
send_opt_packet({68, 12, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, "TS len12 truncated")

-- Pointer beyond option data
send_opt_packet({7, 7, 250, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1}, "RR ptr=250")

-- Max-size option field: 40 bytes of RR
send_opt_packet({7, 39, 4,
    127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1,
    127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1, 127,0,0,1,
    127,0,0,1, 1,1,1}, "RR max header")

-- CIPSO-style unknown option (134) — exercises default handling
send_opt_packet({134, 8, 0xAA, 0xBB, 0xCC, 0xDD, 0xEE, 0xFF}, "unknown opt 134")

-- EOL (0) immediately followed by garbage (parser should stop at EOL)
send_opt_packet({0, 7, 39, 250, 0x41, 0x41, 0x41, 0x41}, "EOL then garbage")

print("")
print("NOTE: if the loader/console dies on any case above, the LAST printed")
print("tag before silence is the packet class that killed it — retest it")
print("in isolation. A hang/reboot here = kernel path reached.")
print("=== 37 DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase6_raw_packets/38_untested_syscalls.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 38: untested syscall availability sweep (Tier 3 targets)
-- Resolves and exercises syscalls the repo has never tested.
-- Each resolve is isolated in its own pcall because some numbers
-- (e.g. sendto=133) crash the whole batch resolve.
-- Call arguments chosen to ERROR OUT cleanly (EBADF etc.) rather than
-- block or corrupt state, except where a real object is needed.

print("=== 38: UNTESTED SYSCALL SWEEP ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

local function try_resolve(name, num)
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        syscall.resolve({ [name] = num })
    end)
    if not ok then
        print(name .. " (" .. num .. "): RESOLVE CRASH/ERR")
        return false
    end
    -- touch it: some resolve lazily; a pcall'd bad call confirms usability
    return true
end

print("")
print("--- phase 1: resolve check ---")
local targets = {
    { "sc_ktimer_create", 235 },
    { "sc_ktimer_settime", 236 },
    { "sc_ktimer_gettime", 238 },
    { "sc_ktimer_delete", 237 },
    { "sc_accept4", 541 },
    { "sc_preadv", 289 },
    { "sc_pwritev", 290 },
    { "sc_copy_file_range", 580 },
    { "sc_msync", 226 },
    { "sc_minherit", 250 },
    { "sc_cap_rights_limit", 533 },
    { "sc_cap_rights_get", 515 },
    { "sc_ppoll", 545 },
    { "sc_getrandom", 563 },
    { "sc_memfd_create", 585 },
    { "sc_posix_fallocate", 530 },
    { "sc_fsync", 95 },
    { "sc_ftruncate", 480 },
    { "sc_getsockname", 32 },
    { "sc_getpeername", 31 },
    { "sc_sctp_peeloff", 471 },
}
for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
    local ok = try_resolve(t[1], t[2])
    print(string.format("%-24s %3d  resolve=%s", t[1], t[2], ok and "ok" or "FAIL"))
end

print("")
print("--- phase 2: safe calls (expect EBADF/EINVAL, NOT block) ---")

local function report(tag, fn)
    local ok, rv = pcall(fn)
    if not ok then
        print(tag .. ": PCALL ERR")
    elseif rv == nil then
        print(tag .. ": nil return")
    else
        local okn, n = pcall(function() return rv:tonumber() end)
        print(tag .. ": rv=" .. (okn and tostring(n) or tostring(rv)))
    end
end

-- getrandom: benign if present — great PRNG + availability signal
local grbuf = memory.alloc(32)
report("getrandom(32B)", function() return syscall.sc_getrandom(grbuf, 32, 0) end)
do
    local hex = ""
    for i = 0, 7 do hex = hex .. string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(grbuf + i):tonumber()) end
    print("  bytes: " .. hex)
end

-- ktimer_create(CLOCK_REALTIME=0, sigevent*, timerid*)
local sevp = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(sevp + i, 0) end
-- sigev_notify = SIGEV_SIGNAL(1)? start with SIGEV_NONE-ish 0 to avoid signals
local tid = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_qword(tid, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)
report("ktimer_create", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_create(0, sevp, tid) end)
print("  timerid out: " .. string.format("0x%x", memory.read_dword(tid):tonumber()))

-- ktimer_gettime on (probably invalid) id
local its = memory.alloc(16)
report("ktimer_gettime(id=out)", function()
    return syscall.sc_ktimer_gettime(memory.read_dword(tid):tonumber(), its)
end)

-- accept4 on invalid fd (must NOT block: bad fd errors immediately)
report("accept4(-1)", function() return syscall.sc_accept4(-1, 0, 0, 0) end)

-- preadv/pwritev on invalid fd
local iov = memory.alloc(16)
local buf = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(iov, buf)
memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 16)
report("preadv(-1)", function() return syscall.sc_preadv(-1, iov, 1, 0) end)
report("pwritev(-1)", function() return syscall.sc_pwritev(-1, iov, 1, 0) end)

-- copy_file_range with invalid fds
report("copy_file_range(-1,-1)", function()
    return syscall.sc_copy_file_range(-1, 0, -1, 0, 16, 0)
end)

-- cap_rights on a real socket fd
local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
local sfd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
if sfd >= 0 then
    local rights = memory.alloc(80)   -- cap_rights_t: version + rights array
    for i = 0, 79, 8 do memory.write_qword(rights + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(rights, 0)     -- cr_version 0
    report("cap_rights_get(sock)", function() return syscall.sc_cap_rights_get(sfd, rights) end)
    report("cap_rights_limit(sock)", function() return syscall.sc_cap_rights_limit(sfd, rights) end)
end

-- getsockname / getpeername on the socket
local sa = memory.alloc(32)
local salen = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(salen, 32)
report("getsockname(sock)", function() return syscall.sc_getsockname(sfd, sa, salen) end)
if sfd >= 0 then
    print("  family=" .. memory.read_byte(sa + 1):tonumber()
        .. " port=" .. (memory.read_byte(sa + 2):tonumber() * 256 + memory.read_byte(sa + 3):tonumber()))
end

-- memfd_create (name ptr, flags) — kernel anonymous file object
local nm = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_byte(nm, 0x6B)  -- "k"
memory.write_byte(nm + 1, 0)
report("memfd_create", function() return syscall.sc_memfd_create(nm, 0) end)

-- ppoll with nfds=0 timeout=0: immediate return
local ts = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(ts, 0)
memory.write_qword(ts + 8, 0)
report("ppoll(nfds=0)", function() return syscall.sc_ppoll(memory.alloc(8), 0, ts, 0) end)

print("")
print("--- phase 3: minherit (isolated — crashed in probe 30) ---")
local region = memory.alloc(0x4000)
-- INHERIT_SHARE=0, INHERIT_COPY=1, INHERIT_NONE=2
report("minherit(COPY)", function() return syscall.sc_minherit(region, 0x4000, 1) end)
report("minherit(NONE)", function() return syscall.sc_minherit(region, 0x4000, 2) end)
report("minherit(SHARE)", function() return syscall.sc_minherit(region, 0x4000, 0) end)
-- garbage inherit value: parser validation test
report("minherit(0x1337)", function() return syscall.sc_minherit(region, 0x4000, 0x1337) end)

print("")
print("--- phase 4: msync (LAST — crashed probe 29/30, isolate here) ---")
print("if loader dies now, msync was the probe-30 killer")
report("msync(MS_SYNC=0)", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region, 0x4000, 0) end)
report("msync(MS_INVALIDATE=2)", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region, 0x4000, 2) end)
report("msync unaligned", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region + 1, 0x4000, 0) end)

if sfd >= 0 then pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(sfd) end) end
print("=== 38 DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase6_raw_packets/39_frag_reass.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 39: IP fragment reassembly (retry of 35/35b with fixed bind)
-- Target: ip_reass() — historically one of the buggiest paths in BSD.
-- Cases: baseline, out-of-order, overlap, tiny-first, dup-final-overwrite.
-- Detection: UDP listener receives reassembled datagram (or console dies).

print("=== 39: FRAGMENT REASSEMBLY ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_bind = 104,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_setsockopt = 105,
    sc_poll = 209,
})

local MSG_DONTWAIT = 0x80

local function make_sockaddr_in(a, b, c, d, port)
    local sa = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(port / 256))
    memory.write_byte(sa + 3, port % 256)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 4, a)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 5, b)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 6, c)
    memory.write_byte(sa + 7, d)
    return sa
end

local function ip_checksum(buf, len)
    local sum = 0
    local i = 0
    while i + 1 < len do
        sum = sum + memory.read_byte(buf + i):tonumber() * 256
              + memory.read_byte(buf + i + 1):tonumber()
        i = i + 2
    end
    while sum > 0xFFFF do
        sum = math.floor(sum / 65536) + (sum % 65536)
    end
    return 0xFFFF - sum
end

-- RAW socket
local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 3, 255) end)
local raw_fd = ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -1
if raw_fd < 0 then
    print("no raw socket"); print("=== 39 DONE (no raw) ===")
    return
end
local val = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_dword(val, 1)
pcall(function() syscall.sc_setsockopt(raw_fd, 0, 2, val, 4) end)

-- UDP listener: candidate ports until bind works
local udp_fd, listen_port = -1, 0
for _, p in ipairs({31338, 31337, 9027, 40000, 50000, 1234}) do
    local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 2, 17) end)
    local fd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
    if fd >= 0 then
        local sa = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, p)
        local ok_b, rv_b = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_bind(fd, sa, 16) end)
        if ok_b and rv_b:tonumber() == 0 then
            udp_fd, listen_port = fd, p
            break
        end
        pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
    end
end
if udp_fd < 0 then
    print("no bindable UDP port — run probe 36")
    print("=== 39 DONE (no listener) ===")
    return
end
print("listener: 127.0.0.1:" .. listen_port .. " fd=" .. udp_fd)

-- send one IP fragment. data = byte array, frag_off in BYTES, mf = bool
local ident = 0x1000
local function send_frag(data, frag_off, mf, proto)
    local total = 20 + #data
    local pkt = memory.alloc(total)
    for i = 0, total - 1 do memory.write_byte(pkt + i, 0) end
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 0, 0x45)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 1, 0x00)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 2, math.floor(total / 256))
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 3, total % 256)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 4, math.floor(ident / 256))
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 5, ident % 256)
    local fo = math.floor(frag_off / 8) + (mf and 0x2000 or 0)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 6, math.floor(fo / 256))
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 7, fo % 256)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 8, 64)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 9, proto or 17)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 12, 127)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 15, 1)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 16, 127)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 19, 1)
    for i, b in ipairs(data) do
        memory.write_byte(pkt + 19 + i, b)
    end
    local cks = ip_checksum(pkt, 20)
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 10, math.floor(cks / 256))
    memory.write_byte(pkt + 11, cks % 256)

    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, pkt)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, total)
    local mh = memory.alloc(64)
    for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
    local sa = make_sockaddr_in(127, 0, 0, 1, 0)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 0, sa)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 8, 16)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
    memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(raw_fd, mh, MSG_DONTWAIT) end)
    return ok and ret:tonumber() or -999
end

-- Build a full UDP datagram as byte array (hdr + payload), then slice it.
local function make_udp(payload)
    local udp_len = 8 + #payload
    local d = {}
    table.insert(d, 0x30); table.insert(d, 0x39)               -- src 12345
    table.insert(d, math.floor(listen_port / 256))
    table.insert(d, listen_port % 256)                          -- dst
    table.insert(d, math.floor(udp_len / 256))
    table.insert(d, udp_len % 256)                              -- len
    table.insert(d, 0); table.insert(d, 0)                      -- csum 0
    for _, b in ipairs(payload) do table.insert(d, b) end
    return d
end

local function slice(t, i, j)
    local o = {}
    for k = i, j do table.insert(o, t[k]) end
    return o
end

local function drain(tag)
    local pollfd = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_dword(pollfd, udp_fd)
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 200) end)
    local rev = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()
    if rev > 0 then
        local rbuf = memory.alloc(128)
        local iov = memory.alloc(16)
        memory.write_qword(iov, rbuf)
        memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 128)
        local mh = memory.alloc(64)
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
        memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
        memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
        local ok_rr, rv_rr = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_recvmsg(udp_fd, mh, MSG_DONTWAIT) end)
        local n = ok_rr and rv_rr:tonumber() or -999
        local hex = ""
        if n > 0 then
            for i = 0, math.min(n - 1, 23) do
                hex = hex .. string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(rbuf + i):tonumber())
            end
        end
        print(string.format("%-26s REASSEMBLED recv=%d data=%s", tag, n, hex))
    else
        print(string.format("%-26s no delivery", tag))
    end
end

local P16 = {0x41,0x42,0x43,0x44,0x45,0x46,0x47,0x48,
             0x49,0x4A,0x4B,0x4C,0x4D,0x4E,0x4F,0x50}

print("")
print("--- reassembly cases ---")

-- Case 1: baseline, in-order, 2 fragments (16 + 8 bytes)
ident = 0x2001
local dg = make_udp(P16)
send_frag(slice(dg, 1, 16), 0, true)
send_frag(slice(dg, 17, 24), 16, false)
drain("baseline 2-frag")

-- Case 2: out-of-order (second fragment first)
ident = 0x2002
send_frag(slice(dg, 17, 24), 16, false)
send_frag(slice(dg, 1, 16), 0, true)
drain("out-of-order")

-- Case 3: overlapping fragments — frag2 starts 8 bytes early,
-- conflicting data in the overlap region
ident = 0x2003
send_frag(slice(dg, 1, 16), 0, true)
send_frag(slice(dg, 9, 24), 8, false)   -- overlaps bytes 8..15
drain("overlap -8B")

-- Case 4: tiny first fragment (8 bytes), then rest
ident = 0x2004
send_frag(slice(dg, 1, 8), 0, true)
send_frag(slice(dg, 9, 24), 8, false)
drain("tiny-first 8B")

-- Case 5: duplicate final fragment with DIFFERENT data (overwrite test)
ident = 0x2005
send_frag(slice(dg, 1, 16), 0, true)
send_frag(slice(dg, 17, 24), 16, false)
local evil = {0xFF,0xFF,0xFF,0xFF,0xFF,0xFF,0xFF,0xFF}
send_frag(evil, 16, false)
drain("dup-final-overwrite")

-- Case 6: many 8-byte fragments (stress reassembly queue)
ident = 0x2006
local big = {}
for i = 1, 64 do table.insert(big, i % 256) end
local dg64 = make_udp(big)   -- 72 bytes = 9 fragments of 8
for f = 0, 7 do
    send_frag(slice(dg64, f * 8 + 1, f * 8 + 8), f * 8, true)
end
send_frag(slice(dg64, 65, 72), 64, false)
drain("9x 8-byte frags")

-- Case 7: fragment with bogus protocol (47=GRE) — exercises non-UDP reass path
ident = 0x2007
send_frag(slice(dg, 1, 16), 0, true, 47)
send_frag(slice(dg, 17, 24), 16, false, 47)
drain("proto=47 frags (expect none)")

print("")
print("NOTE: a queue-size or overlap handling bug here typically shows as a")
print("hang/reboot mid-case. Last tag printed before silence = suspect case.")
print("=== 39 DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/40_gpu_dmem_boundary.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE
-- PROBE: 40 — GPU/CPU shared direct-memory boundary scanner
-- PURPOSE: Allocate physical memory with CPU+GPU visibility at multiple
--          sizes, write marker patterns, probe adjacent virtual pages
--          for leaked data, report VA layout around each allocation.

print("=== PROBE 40: GPU/CPU DMEM BOUNDARY SCANNER ===")
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local function safe_read_byte(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return true, to_num(val) end
    return false, 0
end

local function safe_read_qword(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return true, val end
    return false, nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- syscalls
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local sc_mmap         = make_syscall(477)
local sc_alloc_dmem   = make_syscall(547)
local sc_map_dmem     = make_syscall(548)
local sc_dmem_total   = make_syscall(549)
local sc_release_dmem = make_syscall(550)
local sc_dmem_avail   = make_syscall(552)
local sc_munmap       = make_syscall(588)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- constants
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local PROT_READ      = 1
local PROT_WRITE     = 2
local PROT_GPU_READ  = 0x10
local PROT_GPU_WRITE = 0x20
local PROT_CPU_RW    = PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE
local PROT_ALL       = PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE + PROT_GPU_READ + PROT_GPU_WRITE

local MAP_SHARED  = 0x0001
local MAP_PRIVATE = 0x0002
local MAP_ANON    = 0x1000

local DMEM_TYPE_MAIN = 0
local PAGE = 0x4000  -- 16 KB PS5 page

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 1: Direct memory pool stats
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 1: DIRECT MEMORY POOL STATS ---")

local pool_total = 0
do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function() return sc_dmem_total() end)
    if ok then
        pool_total = to_num(ret)
        print("  total dmem pool  : " .. hex(ret) .. " (" .. string.format("%.1f MB", pool_total / 1048576) .. ")")
    else
        print("  total dmem pool  : FAILED (" .. tostring(ret) .. ")")
    end

    local search_end = pool_total > 0 and pool_total or 0x300000000
    local size_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(size_buf, uint64(0))

    local ok2, err2 = pcall(function()
        return sc_dmem_avail(
            uint64(0),
            uint64(search_end),
            uint64(PAGE),
            size_buf
        )
    end)
    if ok2 then
        local avail = memory.read_qword(size_buf)
        print("  available dmem   : " .. hex(avail) .. " (" .. string.format("%.1f MB", to_num(avail) / 1048576) .. ")")
    else
        -- try 5-arg form (searchStart, searchEnd, alignment, startOut, sizeOut)
        local start_buf = memory.alloc(8)
        memory.write_qword(start_buf, uint64(0))
        memory.write_qword(size_buf, uint64(0))
        local ok3, err3 = pcall(function()
            return sc_dmem_avail(
                uint64(0),
                uint64(search_end),
                uint64(PAGE),
                start_buf,
                size_buf
            )
        end)
        if ok3 then
            local avail = memory.read_qword(size_buf)
            print("  available dmem   : " .. hex(avail) .. " (" .. string.format("%.1f MB", to_num(avail) / 1048576) .. ")")
        else
            print("  available dmem   : FAILED (" .. tostring(err3) .. ")")
        end
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 2: Multi-size allocation + boundary probing
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local test_sizes = {
    { name = "4KB  (1 page)",   size = 0x1000   },
    { name = "64KB (16 pages)", size = 0x10000  },
    { name = "2MB  (large)",    size = 0x200000 },
}

-- page-boundary offsets to probe around the mapping
local probe_before = { -0x4000, -0x3000, -0x2000, -0x1000 }
local probe_after  = {  0x0000,  0x1000,  0x2000,  0x3000 }

for ti, tinfo in ipairs(test_sizes) do
  repeat
    print("--- SECTION 2." .. ti .. ": " .. tinfo.name .. " ---")
    local alloc_size = tinfo.size
    local alignment  = alloc_size < PAGE and PAGE or alloc_size

    -- 2a: allocate physical dmem
    local phys_out = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(phys_out, uint64(0))

    local ok_a, ret_a = pcall(function()
        return sc_alloc_dmem(
            uint64(0),
            uint64("0x0000000300000000"),
            uint64(alloc_size),
            uint64(alignment),
            uint64(DMEM_TYPE_MAIN),
            phys_out
        )
    end)

    if not ok_a then
        print("  alloc_dmem FAILED: " .. tostring(ret_a))
        print("")
        break
    end

    local alloc_rv = to_num(ret_a)
    local phys_addr = memory.read_qword(phys_out)
    print("  alloc return     : " .. alloc_rv)
    print("  phys addr        : " .. hex(phys_addr))

    if alloc_rv ~= 0 then
        print("  alloc returned non-zero, skipping")
        print("")
        break
    end

    -- 2b: map with CPU+GPU visibility
    local va_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(va_buf, uint64(0))

    local ok_m, ret_m = pcall(function()
        return sc_map_dmem(
            va_buf,
            uint64(alloc_size),
            uint64(PROT_ALL),
            uint64(0),
            phys_addr,
            uint64(alignment)
        )
    end)

    if not ok_m then
        print("  map_dmem FAILED  : " .. tostring(ret_m))
        pcall(function() sc_release_dmem(phys_addr, uint64(alloc_size)) end)
        print("")
        break
    end

    local map_rv  = to_num(ret_m)
    local va_base = to_num(memory.read_qword(va_buf))
    local va_end  = va_base + alloc_size
    print("  map return       : " .. map_rv)
    print("  virt base        : " .. hex(va_base))
    print("  virt end         : " .. hex(va_end))
    print("  size             : " .. hex(alloc_size))
    print("  prot             : CPU_RW + GPU_RW (0x" .. string.format("%X", PROT_ALL) .. ")")

    if map_rv ~= 0 or va_base == 0 then
        print("  map failed or returned NULL, skipping")
        pcall(function() sc_release_dmem(phys_addr, uint64(alloc_size)) end)
        print("")
        break
    end

    -- 2c: write marker pattern into every page
    local marker_dw0 = 0xDEAD4000 + ti
    local marker_dw1 = 0xBEEF0040 + ti
    local pages_written = 0
    for off = 0, alloc_size - 1, PAGE do
        local ok_w = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(va_base + off, marker_dw0) end)
        if ok_w then
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(va_base + off + 4, marker_dw1) end)
            pages_written = pages_written + 1
        end
    end
    if alloc_size < PAGE then
        for off = 0, alloc_size - 4, 0x1000 do
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(va_base + off, marker_dw0) end)
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(va_base + off + 4, marker_dw1) end)
        end
    end
    print("  pages marked     : " .. pages_written)

    -- 2d: verify first qword
    local ok_v, v_val = safe_read_qword(uint64(va_base))
    if ok_v then
        print("  verify [base]    : " .. dump_qword(v_val))
    else
        print("  verify [base]    : READ FAILED")
    end

    -- 2e: probe pages BEFORE the mapping
    print("  -- probing BEFORE mapping --")
    for _, off in ipairs(probe_before) do
        local addr = va_base + off
        if addr > 0 then
            local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
            if ok_r then
                local bytes = {}
                for i = 0, 7 do
                    local ok_b, bv = safe_read_byte(uint64(addr + i))
                    bytes[#bytes + 1] = ok_b and string.format("%02X", bv) or "??"
                end
                print(string.format("    [base%+06X] %s = %s [%s]  READABLE",
                    off, hex(addr), dump_qword(qval), table.concat(bytes, " ")))
            else
                print(string.format("    [base%+06X] %s = FAULT", off, hex(addr)))
            end
        end
    end

    -- 2f: probe pages AT AND AFTER the mapping end
    print("  -- probing AT/AFTER mapping end --")
    for _, off in ipairs(probe_after) do
        local addr = va_end + off
        local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
        if ok_r then
            local bytes = {}
            for i = 0, 7 do
                local ok_b, bv = safe_read_byte(uint64(addr + i))
                bytes[#bytes + 1] = ok_b and string.format("%02X", bv) or "??"
            end
            local tag = ""
            if off == 0 then tag = " <-- first page past end" end
            print(string.format("    [end+%05X]  %s = %s [%s]  READABLE%s",
                off, hex(addr), dump_qword(qval), table.concat(bytes, " "), tag))
        else
            local tag = ""
            if off == 0 then tag = " <-- guard page OK" end
            print(string.format("    [end+%05X]  %s = FAULT%s", off, hex(addr), tag))
        end
    end

    -- 2g: marker leak check
    print("  -- marker leak check --")
    local leaked = false
    local leak_check_offsets = { -PAGE, -0x1000, alloc_size, alloc_size + 0x1000, alloc_size + PAGE }
    for _, off in ipairs(leak_check_offsets) do
        local addr = va_base + off
        if addr < va_base or addr >= va_end then
            if addr > 0 then
                local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
                if ok_r then
                    local hi = 0
                    local lo = 0
                    if type(qval) == "table" and qval.h then
                        hi = qval.h
                        lo = qval.l
                    else
                        lo = to_num(qval)
                    end
                    if lo == marker_dw0 and hi == marker_dw1 then
                        print("    WARNING: marker found at " .. hex(addr) .. " (offset " .. hex(off) .. ") -- ALIASING!")
                        leaked = true
                    elseif lo == marker_dw0 or hi == marker_dw1 then
                        print("    PARTIAL marker match at " .. hex(addr) .. " lo=" .. hex(lo) .. " hi=" .. hex(hi))
                        leaked = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not leaked then
        print("    no marker leakage detected in adjacent pages")
    end

    -- 2h: wider non-zero data survey (32 pages each direction)
    print("  -- wider survey: non-zero pages within 32 pages --")
    local data_found = 0
    for i = 1, 32 do
        for _, sign in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
            local addr = (sign < 0) and (va_base - i * PAGE) or (va_end + (i - 1) * PAGE)
            if addr > 0 and addr < 0x7FFFFFFFFFFF then
                local ok_r, dval = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
                if ok_r and to_num(dval) ~= 0 then
                    if addr < va_base or addr >= va_end then
                        data_found = data_found + 1
                        local ok_q, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
                        local q_str = ok_q and dump_qword(qval) or "??"
                        local dir = sign < 0 and "before" or "after"
                        print(string.format("    DATA at %s (%s, %d pages): %s",
                            hex(addr), dir, i, q_str))
                        if data_found >= 8 then break end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if data_found >= 8 then break end
    end
    print("    non-zero pages found: " .. data_found)

    -- 2i: mmap adjacency
    print("  -- mmap adjacency test --")
    do
        local ok_mm, mm_ret = pcall(function()
            return sc_mmap(
                uint64(0),
                uint64(PAGE),
                uint64(PROT_CPU_RW),
                uint64(MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON),
                uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"),
                uint64(0)
            )
        end)
        if ok_mm then
            local mmap_addr = to_num(mm_ret)
            if mmap_addr > 0 and mmap_addr ~= 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF then
                local distance
                if mmap_addr >= va_end then
                    distance = mmap_addr - va_end
                else
                    distance = va_base - mmap_addr
                end
                print("    anon mmap at   : " .. hex(mmap_addr))
                print("    distance       : " .. hex(distance) .. " (" .. string.format("%.1f MB", distance / 1048576) .. ")")
                pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(mmap_addr), uint64(PAGE)) end)
            else
                print("    mmap returned  : " .. hex(mm_ret) .. " (failed)")
            end
        else
            print("    mmap FAILED    : " .. tostring(mm_ret))
        end
    end

    -- 2j: cleanup this allocation
    print("  -- cleanup --")
    local ok_um = pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(va_base), uint64(alloc_size)) end)
    print("    munmap         : " .. (ok_um and "OK" or "FAILED"))
    local ok_rl = pcall(function() sc_release_dmem(phys_addr, uint64(alloc_size)) end)
    print("    release        : " .. (ok_rl and "OK" or "FAILED"))

    print("")
  until true
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 3: GPU-only mapping test (no CPU prot)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 3: GPU-ONLY MAPPING TEST ---")
do
    local phys_out = memory.alloc(8)
    memory.write_qword(phys_out, uint64(0))

    local ok_a, ret_a = pcall(function()
        return sc_alloc_dmem(
            uint64(0),
            uint64("0x0000000300000000"),
            uint64(PAGE),
            uint64(PAGE),
            uint64(DMEM_TYPE_MAIN),
            phys_out
        )
    end)

    if ok_a and to_num(ret_a) == 0 then
        local phys = memory.read_qword(phys_out)
        print("  gpu-only phys    : " .. hex(phys))

        local va_buf = memory.alloc(8)
        memory.write_qword(va_buf, uint64(0))

        local ok_m, ret_m = pcall(function()
            return sc_map_dmem(
                va_buf,
                uint64(PAGE),
                uint64(PROT_GPU_READ + PROT_GPU_WRITE),  -- GPU only
                uint64(0),
                phys,
                uint64(PAGE)
            )
        end)

        local map_rv = ok_m and to_num(ret_m) or -1
        local va = to_num(memory.read_qword(va_buf))
        print("  gpu-only map ret : " .. map_rv)
        print("  gpu-only VA      : " .. hex(va))

        if map_rv == 0 and va ~= 0 then
            -- try CPU read — should fault if truly GPU-only
            local ok_cpu, cpu_val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(va) end)
            if ok_cpu then
                print("  CPU read of GPU-only page SUCCEEDED: " .. hex(cpu_val))
                print("  => GPU-only pages may be CPU-accessible (FINDING)")
            else
                print("  CPU read of GPU-only page faulted (expected)")
            end
            pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(va), uint64(PAGE)) end)
        end

        pcall(function() sc_release_dmem(phys, uint64(PAGE)) end)
    else
        print("  gpu-only alloc failed: " .. tostring(ret_a))
    end
end
print("")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE
-- PROBE 41: mmap with GPU prot flags + boundary scanning
-- Instead of dmem syscalls (which return -1), try regular mmap
-- with GPU protection bits to get CPU+GPU shared pages.

print("=== PROBE 41: MMAP GPU BOUNDARY SCANNER ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local function safe_read_byte(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return true, to_num(val) end
    return false, 0
end

local function safe_read_qword(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return true, val end
    return false, nil
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)

local PAGE = 0x4000

local PROT_READ      = 1
local PROT_WRITE     = 2
local PROT_GPU_READ  = 0x10
local PROT_GPU_WRITE = 0x20

local MAP_PRIVATE = 0x0002
local MAP_SHARED  = 0x0001
local MAP_ANON    = 0x1000

local probe_before = { -0x4000, -0x3000, -0x2000, -0x1000 }
local probe_after  = {  0x0000,  0x1000,  0x2000,  0x3000,  0x4000 }

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 1: Test which prot flag combos succeed with mmap
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 1: PROT FLAG COMBOS ---")

local combos = {
    { name = "CPU_RW",              prot = PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE },
    { name = "CPU_RW+GPU_R",       prot = PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE + PROT_GPU_READ },
    { name = "CPU_RW+GPU_RW",     prot = PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE + PROT_GPU_READ + PROT_GPU_WRITE },
    { name = "GPU_RW_only",        prot = PROT_GPU_READ + PROT_GPU_WRITE },
    { name = "CPU_R+GPU_RW",      prot = PROT_READ + PROT_GPU_READ + PROT_GPU_WRITE },
    { name = "ALL_0x33",           prot = 0x33 },
    { name = "PROT_0x37",         prot = 0x37 },
    { name = "PROT_0x3F",         prot = 0x3F },
}

local working = {}

for _, c in ipairs(combos) do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0),
            uint64(PAGE),
            uint64(c.prot),
            uint64(MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"),
            uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    local addr = ok and to_num(ret) or 0
    local fail = (not ok) or (addr == 0) or (addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000)
    if not fail then
        local can_read = false
        local can_write = false
        local ok_r, rv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
        if ok_r then can_read = true end
        local ok_w = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, 0x41414141) end)
        if ok_w then can_write = true end
        print(string.format("  %-18s prot=0x%02X -> %s  R=%s W=%s",
            c.name, c.prot, hex(addr),
            can_read and "Y" or "N", can_write and "Y" or "N"))
        working[#working + 1] = { name = c.name, prot = c.prot, addr = addr, r = can_read, w = can_write }
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(addr), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    else
        local err_str = ok and hex(ret) or tostring(ret)
        print(string.format("  %-18s prot=0x%02X -> FAILED (%s)", c.name, c.prot, err_str))
    end
end

print(string.format("  working combos: %d / %d", #working, #combos))
print("")

-- SECTION 2: MAP_SHARED vs MAP_PRIVATE with GPU flags
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 2: SHARED vs PRIVATE ---")

for _, map_flag in ipairs({ {name="PRIVATE", val=MAP_PRIVATE}, {name="SHARED", val=MAP_SHARED} }) do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0),
            uint64(PAGE),
            uint64(PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE + PROT_GPU_READ + PROT_GPU_WRITE),
            uint64(map_flag.val + MAP_ANON),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"),
            uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    local addr = ok and to_num(ret) or 0
    local fail = (not ok) or (addr == 0) or (addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000)
    if not fail then
        print(string.format("  %s+ANON+GPU_RW -> %s  OK", map_flag.name, hex(addr)))
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(addr), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    else
        local err_str = ok and hex(ret) or tostring(ret)
        print(string.format("  %s+ANON+GPU_RW -> FAILED (%s)", map_flag.name, err_str))
    end
end

-- SECTION 3: Multi-size boundary probe with best working combo
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 3: BOUNDARY PROBING ---")

local best_prot = PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE + PROT_GPU_READ + PROT_GPU_WRITE
local test_sizes = {
    { name = "16KB (1 page)",    size = PAGE },
    { name = "64KB (4 pages)",   size = PAGE * 4 },
    { name = "1MB (64 pages)",   size = PAGE * 64 },
}

for ti, tinfo in ipairs(test_sizes) do
  repeat
    print("  -- " .. tinfo.name .. " --")
    local sz = tinfo.size

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0),
            uint64(sz),
            uint64(best_prot),
            uint64(MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"),
            uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    local va_base = ok and to_num(ret) or 0
    if va_base == 0 or va_base >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then
        print("    mmap FAILED: " .. (ok and hex(ret) or tostring(ret)))
        break
    end
    local va_end = va_base + sz
    print("    base: " .. hex(va_base) .. "  end: " .. hex(va_end))

    -- write markers
    local marker = 0xCAFE0040 + ti
    local pages_ok = 0
    for off = 0, sz - 1, PAGE do
        local ok_w = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(va_base + off, marker) end)
        if ok_w then pages_ok = pages_ok + 1 end
    end
    print("    pages written: " .. pages_ok .. "/" .. (sz / PAGE))

    -- probe BEFORE
    print("    -- before mapping --")
    for _, off in ipairs(probe_before) do
        local addr = va_base + off
        if addr > 0 then
            local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
            if ok_r then
                local bytes = {}
                for i = 0, 7 do
                    local ok_b, bv = safe_read_byte(uint64(addr + i))
                    bytes[#bytes + 1] = ok_b and string.format("%02X", bv) or "??"
                end
                print(string.format("      [base%+06X] %s [%s] READABLE",
                    off, dump_qword(qval), table.concat(bytes, " ")))
            else
                print(string.format("      [base%+06X] FAULT", off))
            end
        end
    end

    -- probe AFTER
    print("    -- after mapping --")
    for _, off in ipairs(probe_after) do
        local addr = va_end + off
        local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
        if ok_r then
            local bytes = {}
            for i = 0, 7 do
                local ok_b, bv = safe_read_byte(uint64(addr + i))
                bytes[#bytes + 1] = ok_b and string.format("%02X", bv) or "??"
            end
            local tag = (off == 0) and " <-- first past end" or ""
            print(string.format("      [end+%05X] %s [%s] READABLE%s",
                off, dump_qword(qval), table.concat(bytes, " "), tag))
        else
            local tag = (off == 0) and " <-- guard OK" or ""
            print(string.format("      [end+%05X] FAULT%s", off, tag))
        end
    end

    -- marker leak check
    local leaked = false
    for _, off in ipairs({ -PAGE, sz, sz + PAGE }) do
        local addr = va_base + off
        if addr > 0 and (addr < va_base or addr >= va_end) then
            local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
            if ok_r then
                local lo = 0
                if type(qval) == "table" and qval.l then lo = qval.l
                else lo = to_num(qval) end
                if lo == marker then
                    print("      MARKER LEAK at offset " .. hex(off) .. "!")
                    leaked = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not leaked then
        print("      no marker leakage")
    end

    -- second mmap adjacency
    local ok2, ret2 = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0), uint64(PAGE), uint64(best_prot),
            uint64(MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    if ok2 then
        local addr2 = to_num(ret2)
        if addr2 > 0 and addr2 < 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then
            local gap
            if addr2 >= va_end then gap = addr2 - va_end
            else gap = va_base - addr2 end
            print("    next mmap at " .. hex(addr2) .. " gap=" .. hex(gap))
            pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(addr2), uint64(PAGE)) end)
        end
    end

    -- cleanup
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(va_base), uint64(sz)) end)
    print("")
  until true
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 4: GPU-only mmap (no CPU prot)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 4: GPU-ONLY MMAP (no CPU prot) ---")
do
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0),
            uint64(PAGE),
            uint64(PROT_GPU_READ + PROT_GPU_WRITE),
            uint64(MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"),
            uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    local addr = ok and to_num(ret) or 0
    if addr > 0 and addr < 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then
        print("  gpu-only VA: " .. hex(addr))
        local ok_r, rv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
        if ok_r then
            print("  CPU read of GPU-only page SUCCEEDED: " .. hex(rv) .. " (FINDING)")
        else
            print("  CPU read of GPU-only page faulted (expected)")
        end
        local ok_w = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, 0xBBBBBBBB) end)
        if ok_w then
            print("  CPU write of GPU-only page SUCCEEDED (FINDING)")
        else
            print("  CPU write of GPU-only page faulted (expected)")
        end
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(addr), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    else
        print("  gpu-only mmap failed: " .. (ok and hex(ret) or tostring(ret)))
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 5: Double-map test — same phys via two VAs?
-- Use MAP_SHARED to see if two mmaps can alias
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 5: DOUBLE MAP ALIAS TEST ---")
do
    local ok1, ret1 = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0), uint64(PAGE),
            uint64(PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE),
            uint64(MAP_SHARED + MAP_ANON),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    local a1 = ok1 and to_num(ret1) or 0
    if a1 > 0 and a1 < 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then
        pcall(function() memory.write_dword(a1, 0x12345678) end)
        local ok2, ret2 = pcall(function()
            return sc_mmap(
                uint64(0), uint64(PAGE),
                uint64(PROT_READ + PROT_WRITE),
                uint64(MAP_SHARED + MAP_ANON),
                uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0)
            )
        end)
        local a2 = ok2 and to_num(ret2) or 0
        if a2 > 0 and a2 < 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then
            local ok_r, v2 = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(a2) end)
            local val2 = ok_r and to_num(v2) or -1
            print("  map1=" .. hex(a1) .. " map2=" .. hex(a2))
            print("  wrote 0x12345678 to map1, read from map2: " .. hex(val2))
            if val2 == 0x12345678 then
                print("  ALIAS DETECTED — same physical page! (FINDING)")
            else
                print("  no alias (different physical pages)")
            end
            pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a2), uint64(PAGE)) end)
        end
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a1), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    else
        print("  shared mmap failed: " .. (ok1 and hex(ret1) or tostring(ret1)))
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 41 COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41b_mmap_gpu_boundary.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE
-- PROBE 41b: boundary scan using mmap+GPU (0x33 confirmed working)
-- Skips GPU-only and risky combos that crashed the loader in 41.

print("=== PROBE 41b: MMAP GPU BOUNDARY SCAN ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local function safe_read_qword(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return true, val end
    return false, nil
end

local function safe_read_byte(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return true, to_num(val) end
    return false, 0
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)

local PAGE = 0x4000
local PROT_ALL = 0x33
local MAP_PRIVATE = 0x0002
local MAP_ANON    = 0x1000

local probe_before = { -0x4000, -0x3000, -0x2000, -0x1000 }
local probe_after  = {  0x0000,  0x1000,  0x2000,  0x3000,  0x4000 }

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(PROT_ALL),
            uint64(MAP_PRIVATE + MAP_ANON),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 1: Multi-size boundary probe (0x33 = CPU+GPU RW)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local test_sizes = {
    { name = "16KB (1 page)",     size = PAGE },
    { name = "64KB (4 pages)",    size = PAGE * 4 },
    { name = "256KB (16 pages)",  size = PAGE * 16 },
    { name = "1MB (64 pages)",    size = PAGE * 64 },
}

for ti, tinfo in ipairs(test_sizes) do
  repeat
    print("--- SIZE " .. ti .. ": " .. tinfo.name .. " ---")
    local sz = tinfo.size

    local va_base = do_mmap(sz)
    if not va_base then
        print("  mmap FAILED")
        break
    end
    local va_end = va_base + sz
    print("  base=" .. hex(va_base) .. " end=" .. hex(va_end))

    -- write markers every page
    local marker = 0xCAFE0040 + ti
    local pages_ok = 0
    for off = 0, sz - 1, PAGE do
        local ok_w = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(va_base + off, marker) end)
        if ok_w then
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(va_base + off + 4, 0xDEAD0000 + ti) end)
            pages_ok = pages_ok + 1
        end
    end
    print("  pages marked: " .. pages_ok .. "/" .. (sz / PAGE))

    -- verify
    local ok_v, v_val = safe_read_qword(uint64(va_base))
    if ok_v then print("  verify: " .. dump_qword(v_val)) end

    -- probe BEFORE
    print("  -- before --")
    for _, off in ipairs(probe_before) do
        local addr = va_base + off
        if addr > 0 then
            local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
            if ok_r then
                print(string.format("    [%+06X] %s READABLE", off, dump_qword(qval)))
            else
                print(string.format("    [%+06X] FAULT", off))
            end
        end
    end

    -- probe AFTER
    print("  -- after --")
    for _, off in ipairs(probe_after) do
        local addr = va_end + off
        local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
        if ok_r then
            local tag = (off == 0) and " <-- past end" or ""
            print(string.format("    [+%05X] %s READABLE%s", off, dump_qword(qval), tag))
        else
            local tag = (off == 0) and " <-- guard OK" or ""
            print(string.format("    [+%05X] FAULT%s", off, tag))
        end
    end

    -- marker leak
    local leaked = false
    for _, off in ipairs({ -PAGE, sz, sz + PAGE }) do
        local addr = va_base + off
        if addr > 0 and (addr < va_base or addr >= va_end) then
            local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(addr))
            if ok_r then
                local lo = (type(qval) == "table" and qval.l) and qval.l or to_num(qval)
                if lo == marker then
                    print("    MARKER LEAK at " .. hex(off) .. "!")
                    leaked = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not leaked then print("    no marker leak") end

    -- adjacency: where does next mmap land?
    local a2 = do_mmap(PAGE)
    if a2 then
        local gap = (a2 >= va_end) and (a2 - va_end) or (va_base - a2)
        print("  next mmap=" .. hex(a2) .. " gap=" .. hex(gap))
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a2), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    end

    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(va_base), uint64(sz)) end)
    print("")
  until true
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 2: Contiguous allocation test
-- Allocate 4 pages back-to-back, check if VAs are contiguous
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 2: CONTIGUOUS ALLOCATION ---")
do
    local addrs = {}
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local a = do_mmap(PAGE)
        if a then
            addrs[#addrs + 1] = a
            print("  alloc " .. i .. ": " .. hex(a))
        end
    end

    if #addrs >= 2 then
        for i = 2, #addrs do
            local gap = addrs[i] - addrs[i-1]
            print("  gap " .. (i-1) .. "->" .. i .. ": " .. hex(gap) ..
                  (gap == PAGE and " (CONTIGUOUS)" or ""))
        end

        -- can we read across the boundary between alloc 1 and 2?
        if addrs[2] - addrs[1] == PAGE then
            print("  boundary test: allocs 1-2 are adjacent")
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addrs[1], 0xAAAAAAAA) end)
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addrs[2], 0xBBBBBBBB) end)
            -- read from alloc1 end into alloc2
            local bridge_addr = addrs[1] + PAGE - 4
            local ok_r, bv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(bridge_addr) end)
            if ok_r then
                print("  read at alloc1+PAGE-4: " .. hex(bv))
            end
            local ok_r2, bv2 = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addrs[1] + PAGE) end)
            if ok_r2 then
                print("  read at alloc1+PAGE (=alloc2 base): " .. hex(bv2))
                if to_num(bv2) == 0xBBBBBBBB then
                    print("  CROSS-BOUNDARY READ WORKS (alloc1 can read alloc2)")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, a in ipairs(addrs) do
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 3: Large gap scan — what's between GPU mmaps and
-- existing process memory?
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 3: VA SPACE LAYOUT ---")
do
    local gpu_page = do_mmap(PAGE)
    if gpu_page then
        print("  gpu mmap at: " .. hex(gpu_page))

        -- probe well-known VA ranges for data
        local probes = {
            { name = "stack_area",   addr = 0x7FFFFFFFD000 },
            { name = "heap_low",     addr = 0x200000000 },
            { name = "heap_mid",     addr = 0x800000000 },
            { name = "text_base",    addr = 0x400000 },
            { name = "lib_area",     addr = 0x80000000 },
        }
        for _, p in ipairs(probes) do
            local ok_r, qval = safe_read_qword(uint64(p.addr))
            if ok_r then
                print(string.format("  %-15s %s = %s READABLE", p.name, hex(p.addr), dump_qword(qval)))
            else
                print(string.format("  %-15s %s = FAULT", p.name, hex(p.addr)))
            end
        end

        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(gpu_page), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 41b COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41c_safe_adjacent.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE
-- PROBE 41c: scan readable pages BEFORE gpu mmap only (after-scan crashes loader)
-- Finding from 41b: 4 pages before the mapping are READABLE (zeroes)
-- Question: how far back can we read? Is there useful data?

print("=== PROBE 41c: SAFE ADJACENT PAGE SCAN ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 1: Allocate, then scan backwards to find how far we can read
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 1: BACKWARD SCAN FROM GPU MMAP ---")
do
    local base = do_mmap(PAGE)
    if not base then
        print("  mmap FAILED")
    else
        print("  mmap base: " .. hex(base))
        pcall(function() memory.write_dword(base, 0xDEADCAFE) end)
        local ok_v, vv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(base) end)
        if ok_v then print("  verify write: " .. hex(vv)) end

        -- scan backwards in 0x1000 steps (not PAGE to catch 4K sub-pages)
        local readable_count = 0
        local first_fault = nil
        local nonzero_pages = {}

        for i = 1, 256 do
            local addr = base - i * 0x1000
            if addr <= 0 then break end
            local ok_r, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
            if ok_r then
                readable_count = readable_count + 1
                local v = to_num(val)
                if v ~= 0 then
                    nonzero_pages[#nonzero_pages + 1] = {offset = -i * 0x1000, addr = addr, val = v}
                end
            else
                first_fault = i * 0x1000
                break
            end
        end

        print("  readable pages before base: " .. readable_count .. " (at 0x1000 stride)")
        if first_fault then
            print("  first fault at: base-0x" .. string.format("%X", first_fault))
            print("  readable range: " .. hex(base - first_fault + 0x1000) .. " to " .. hex(base))
        else
            print("  readable range: 256+ pages (no fault found)")
        end

        if #nonzero_pages > 0 then
            print("  NON-ZERO pages found: " .. #nonzero_pages)
            for j, p in ipairs(nonzero_pages) do
                if j > 16 then
                    print("    ... and " .. (#nonzero_pages - 16) .. " more")
                    break
                end
                local ok_q, qval = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(p.addr) end)
                local qs = ok_q and dump_qword(qval) or "??"
                print(string.format("    [%+07X] %s = %s", p.offset, hex(p.addr), qs))
            end
        else
            print("  all readable pages are ZERO")
        end

        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 2: Two allocations, scan the gap between them
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 2: GAP BETWEEN TWO MMAPS ---")
do
    local a1 = do_mmap(PAGE)
    local a2 = do_mmap(PAGE)
    if a1 and a2 then
        local lo = math.min(a1, a2)
        local hi = math.max(a1, a2)
        local gap = hi - lo - PAGE
        print("  alloc1: " .. hex(a1))
        print("  alloc2: " .. hex(a2))
        print("  gap: " .. hex(gap) .. " (" .. (gap / 0x1000) .. " x 4KB)")

        if gap > 0 and gap <= PAGE * 64 then
            -- scan pages in the gap
            local gap_readable = 0
            local gap_nonzero = 0
            for off = PAGE, gap, 0x1000 do
                local addr = lo + off
                if addr < hi then
                    local ok_r, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
                    if ok_r then
                        gap_readable = gap_readable + 1
                        if to_num(val) ~= 0 then gap_nonzero = gap_nonzero + 1 end
                    end
                end
            end
            print("  gap pages readable: " .. gap_readable)
            print("  gap pages nonzero: " .. gap_nonzero)
        elseif gap == 0 then
            print("  CONTIGUOUS — no gap!")
            -- write to a1, read from a2-PAGE boundary
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(a1, 0x11111111) end)
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(a2, 0x22222222) end)
            local ok_r, bv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(lo + PAGE) end)
            if ok_r then
                print("  cross-boundary read: " .. hex(bv))
            end
        end

        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a1), uint64(PAGE)) end)
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a2), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    else
        print("  mmap failed")
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 3: Large alloc (1MB) backward scan — more surface
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 3: 1MB ALLOC BACKWARD SCAN ---")
do
    local sz = PAGE * 64
    local base = do_mmap(sz)
    if base then
        print("  base: " .. hex(base) .. " size: " .. hex(sz))
        -- write pattern
        pcall(function() memory.write_dword(base, 0xFACEFEED) end)
        pcall(function() memory.write_dword(base + sz - 4, 0xCAFEBABE) end)

        -- scan 128 pages backward
        local readable = 0
        local first_nonzero = nil
        for i = 1, 128 do
            local addr = base - i * PAGE
            if addr <= 0 then break end
            local ok_r, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
            if ok_r then
                readable = readable + 1
                if to_num(val) ~= 0 and not first_nonzero then
                    first_nonzero = {i = i, addr = addr, val = to_num(val)}
                end
            else
                break
            end
        end
        print("  readable pages before: " .. readable)
        if first_nonzero then
            print(string.format("  first nonzero at -%d pages: %s = %s",
                first_nonzero.i, hex(first_nonzero.addr), hex(first_nonzero.val)))
        else
            print("  all zero")
        end

        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(sz)) end)
    else
        print("  mmap failed")
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 4: Read existing process memory around known module addresses
-- (from probe 39b: modules live at 0x80d0xxxxx range)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 4: KNOWN VA RANGE SCAN ---")
do
    local known_ranges = {
        { name = "modules_0x800", addr = 0x800000000 },
        { name = "modules_0x80d", addr = 0x80D000000 },
        { name = "heap_0x200",    addr = 0x200000000 },
        { name = "heap_0x300",    addr = 0x300000000 },
        { name = "stack_hi",      addr = 0x7FFFFF0000 },
        { name = "low_text",      addr = 0x400000 },
        { name = "gpu_mmap_area", addr = 0x310000000 },
    }
    for _, r in ipairs(known_ranges) do
        local ok_r, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(r.addr) end)
        if ok_r then
            local ok_q, qval = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(r.addr) end)
            local qs = ok_q and dump_qword(qval) or hex(val)
            print(string.format("  %-18s %s = %s READABLE", r.name, hex(r.addr), qs))
        else
            print(string.format("  %-18s %s = FAULT", r.name, hex(r.addr)))
        end
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 41c COMPLETE ===")
```
